chapters.title: Chapter 251 251: Shi A's Bitter Smile! Sparring with Tong Yuan
paragraphs: Tong Yuan and Wang Yue could not possibly take lethal action against a group of ordinary people.
Moreover, these players were well-versed in the art of dark scheming. When they saw Tong Yuan and Wang Yue, they immediately knelt and called them Master!
How could Tong Yuan and Wang Yue have the heart to act against such devout and polite individuals?
Hence.
They set up layer upon layer of obstacles for assessment on Penglai Mountain.
Only after passing these assessments could one proceed to the next stage.
Whoever reached the final stage was definitely a rare genius among thousands.
Wang Yue and Tong Yuan would not be stingy and would immediately teach the Breathing Technique to those who passed!
It was precisely because of the fairness and openness here that more and more players were drawn to learn martial arts here.
At this moment.
Seeing Ding Ling arrive.
The players were abuzz, pointing at Ding Ling and discussing excitedly:

"I heard that Ding Ling reached his current martial arts prowess thanks to the guidance of Tong Yuan and Wang Yue. Hahaha, I've also succeeded in becoming a disciple. Does this mean I too can become a legendary figure like Ding Ling?! Flying around, taking on ten thousand at once, invincible in the world!"
"Wake up, it's still broad daylight. Stop dreaming!"
"...Can't I even fantasize, huh?! Besides, we have the same masters, there's no reason for the gap to be that big!"
"In school, we also have the same teachers, yet some are geniuses while others are failures?! How can you compare yourself to Ding Ling? Why aren't you ascending to the heavens?!"
Ding Ling's fame and popularity among the players could be described as explosive!
His fanbase spanned the globe!
Any player who watched him display his divine might in the Three Kingdoms World could hardly not be awed by Ding Ling, developing a fervent sense of admiration and reverence!
These were his die-hard fans!

Especially male players, seeing Ding Ling single-handedly slaughter his way through the Xianbei Royal Court, felt their blood boil, thinking Ding Ling was truly dazzlingly handsome! He was considered a model man!
What reason is there not to worship someone like that?
Within Penglai Mountain.
There were many such hardcore fans.
Seeing Ding Ling arrive, they cheered exuberantly, either shouting Ding Ling's name or directly calling him the War God! Or they called him Senior Brother to forge a closer bond.
In their view.
They all shared the same masters.
What's wrong with calling him Senior Brother?!
"They're really enthusiastic."
Ding Ling smiled awkwardly.
"Hahaha..."
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue exchanged a glance and laughed:
"You'll get used to it. We were also awkward around their over-enthusiasm at first. But now we've become accustomed to it. Besides..."
They paused, looking Ding Ling up and down:
"You are already the World's Number One War God, the National Preceptor, Guardian God, and Grand General of the Great Wei Empire! It's more understandable that they are this fervent about you.
Ding Ling just smiled.
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue's expressions turned slightly complex:
"After parting ways back then, we didn't expect you would become this strong upon our next meeting. You're not here just to visit, are you?"
"Indeed. I wish to spar with the two esteemed elders."
"That can be easily arranged."
Wang Yue and Tong Yuan didn't question the reason, nodding and saying:
"Let's have a meal first, then we can chat properly."
"I'll follow the seniors' lead."
The group conversed as they walked.
Zhao Yun and the others followed behind.
The players occasionally screamed at Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and the others.
Every player now knew.
Ding Ling was accompanied by Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Chen Dao.
Among these, particularly Diao Chan and Da and Xiao Qiao, their popularity among male players was extremely high, having countless fanatic fans.
Seeing their idols arrive, how could they not welcome them warmly?
Diao Chan and the others had long been used to it.
During their time with Ding Ling, similar incidents had occurred more than once.
Initially, there was some resistance, but later they became numb to it.
"I'm so envious of Ding Ling. Having so many beauties attending to him daily. I heard Ding Ling's daily life is taken care of by Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng in turns."
"He's no different from an emperor. I've been in the Three Kingdoms World for so long, yet I'm still single! Comparing oneself to others can be deadly!"
"Haha. It's as if you're not single in the real world either!"
Upon reaching the top of Penglai Mountain.
Ding Ling met Shi A.
"Ding Ling."
Shi A's eyes lit up as he greeted proactively.
"Shi A. Long time no see."
Ding Ling smiled.
"Indeed."
Shi A's eyes carried a hint of nostalgia, as if he momentarily returned to the instant they met over a year ago in Luoyang:
"In the blink of an eye, so much time has passed. You have become the renowned Great Wei Kingdom Preceptor and Guardian God!"
He laughed:
"I forgot to congratulate you earlier. Congratulations on becoming an Earth Immortal and achieving the true Celestial Human Realm!"
"You will have your day too.
Ding Ling replied.
"Alas."
Shi A smiled bitterly:
"I can't compare to you."
In comparison to Ding Ling, he felt like a nobody.
Especially after chatting for a while and confirming Zhao Yun's realm level, he felt even more dejected.
He was somewhat regretful and chagrined.
Had he followed Ding Ling and the others in Luoyang City back then.
Could he now be stepping into the unparalleled Super-Elite Peak Realm like Zhao Yun?
Unfortunately, time cannot be turned back, and now he could only envy Zhao Yun and the others' fortunes.
After the meal.
Tong Yuan stood up tall, his eyes gleaming as he looked at Ding Ling:
"There's no time like the present. Let me test your mettle."
He was quite eager:
"The Celestial Human Realm! I've always wanted to break through and enter this legendary realm, but I've been unable to fulfill that wish. I hope this battle will give me some insight."
"Alright."
Ding Ling didn't hesitate, leaping up suddenly, landing across from Tong Yuan with a cupped fist salute:
"Senior, please!"
"Hahaha..."

Tong Yuan, with a youthful spirit, couldn't help but unleash his enthusiasm, feeling his blood boil. Without wasting any words, he activated the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, using the Wall-Climbing Technique, moving like lightning and wind. In a blink, he was in front of Ding Ling, using his arm as a spear and his fist as the spearhead, performing the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Spear shadows transformed from countless arms filled the sky, densely overlaying, descending upon Ding Ling's head.
Ding Ling advanced instead of retreating.
Also using his arm as a spear, he executed the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Kung!
Kongkong!
Patterns of the Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix rapidly materialized, charging at the spear shadows!
Boom Boom Boom!
The two fought with incredible speed, instantly entering a heated state!
Their battle stirred up waves in the void, and gusts of Xun Wind arose involuntarily!
As they passed along their path, the earth trembled, thorns shattered, and the grass and trees swayed and creaked as if they were on the verge of collapsing.
This battle.
Was earth-shattering!
Akin to two Immortals clashing.
Every move of theirs was like that of Celestial Beings; at times, they leaped onto bamboo trunks, confronting and kicking in mid-air, each punch and kick sending shockwaves rippling through the air!

chapters.title: Chapter 252 252: Ding Ling VS Sword God (14/17)
paragraphs: The airwaves collided in mid-air, producing a crackling sound like muffled thunder.
Bang, bang, bang!
The four legs were like four iron whips, continuously entwining and striking, the banging sound echoing endlessly, as if hitting a donkey's hide.
Boom, boom, boom!
Each kick seemed capable of snapping a large tree.
At the extreme point.
Tong Yuan and Ding Ling once again jumped onto the earth, swiftly clashing in mid-air; sometimes punching, sometimes with an open palm—a punch, a palm—all showcasing the grandeur of a Grandmaster!
By the time they landed on the ground, the two had exchanged no less than hundreds of punches!
Each bombardment of punches resounded with a thunderous roar, stirring the surroundings!
Kong!
When both sides stood ready, delivering a heavy punch towards each other's fists, Kong! Ding Ling didn't move a bit, while Tong Yuan stumbled back a dozen steps before he barely steadied himself.
He smiled wryly and waved his hand:
"No more, no more. Physical strength can't keep up. Let's continue tomorrow. That's it for today!"
Wang Yue was moved and said:
"Ding Ling's strength now can be said to have undergone a tremendous transformation. Looking at your recent exchange, Tong Yuan, it seems you are not Ding Ling's match at all!"
"Indeed."
Tong Yuan candidly said:
"As soon as we exchanged blows, I felt the surging, overwhelming power on Ding Ling! I was shocked, having a chilling sense that I could be beaten to death by Ding Ling at any moment."
He paused, looking at Ding Ling with a face full of relief:

"Good thing Ding Ling was very measured, always accommodating me, allowing me to experience the strength of a Celestial Human Realm powerhouse. Unfortunately, even so, I still couldn't handle it. My stamina is nothing compared to Ding Ling's. His physique and endurance are just too strong. Truly worthy of a Celestial Human Realm powerhouse, it's terrifying.
Compared to some Celestial Human Realm powerhouses recorded in ancient texts, it seems even more powerful!"
"Mutual learning."
Ding Ling said:
"Mutual progress."
"Ding Ling, you remain as humble, steady, and sincere as always!"
Tong Yuan praised:
"But being too humble is not good. I'm telling you from my heart, not just praising you. Just telling the truth."
Ding Ling was speechless.
Tong Yuan patted Ding Ling's shoulder:
"In front of us two old fellows, no need to be too restrained. Just consider us your elders."
Before Ding Ling could reply.
He looked at Wang Yue:

"You try. Ding Ling's Celestial Human Realm is truly unparalleled. Almost no weaknesses. If he were born in the time of the Ancient Yellow Emperor or Chiyou, he might even fight against Chiyou, the Commander!
"Really?"
Wang Yue couldn't sit still, stood up, and walked to Ding Ling's side, saying:
"Ding Ling, let's try."
"Yes, senior."
At that moment, the two set up their stances.
Beginning to use their hands as swords, fighting speedily, and clashing swiftly.
Both had extremely high attainment in the Sword Dao.
They could be called the two unparalleled Sword Gods of the present age.

At this fight, one could see sword light shining brightly, with occasional glimpses of Sword Map flickering in the void, the sharp Sword Qi flashing in all directions, occasionally slicing and breaking some branches and bamboo leaves.
Vaguely, Shi A and others could even hear the clanging of the sword edge.
"Just using their hands for comparison, reaching such a level."
Everyone was shocked.
"This has reached a realm of not being hindered by objects. Any random object can be transformed into a sword!"
Some players from afar also saw these scenes, feeling very envious:
"Ding Ling is too terrifying. No wonder he's the number one player!"

"Indeed. Ding Ling stands alone at the top of the leaderboard, overwhelming all other players. Although the second place is just one rank apart, the gap in strength cannot be measured! Really don't know how he trains."
Klang, klang, klang!

Ding Ling and Wang Yue, in their final confrontation, using their fingers as swords, sketched stroke by stroke, the Sword Qi overflowing, various sword moves emerging endlessly, as if a surging Sword River was falling to the earth, continuously evolving into Supreme Sword Techniques;
It was more like two Sword Dragons confronting each other, the Sword Qi and sparks they collided with were so intense even from a distance that it could blind one's eyes! Terrifying!
After a period of time.
Their fingers clashed.
Boom!
A loud noise.
Ding Ling stood as firm as Mount Tai.
Wang Yue was hit as if struck by lightning, flying back dozens of meters, spinning several times in mid-air before dispelling the Vigorous Qi and landing gracefully.
He looked at Ding Ling with a face of amazement, sighing:

"The waves behind on the Yangtze River push the waves ahead! Truly worthy of being the new-generation Sword God of the Great Wei Kingdom! You are worthy of the Sword God's title! I am far inferior to you."
"Senior is over-praising."
Ding Ling said solemnly:

"Without senior's guidance, there would be no me today. My Sword God title began with you! At most, I am just a second-generation Sword God! It can be considered that I inherited your first-generation Sword God's title."
"Hahaha..."
Wang Yue was stunned, then laughed heartily:

"Right, right. I was trapped in appearances. Talents emerge in every generation, each leading for hundreds of years. Every generation has its glory. I am the older generation, you are the younger generation. Why should I compare with you?"
That's what he said.
Wang Yue still seemed unable to let go:

"But your progress is too exaggerated. Not to mention my generation. Even going up several generations, decades, or a hundred generations, it's still hard to find someone comparable to you. You are too dazzling, too powerful!"
Tong Yuan nodded in deep agreement:
"Ding Ling, no need to be humble anymore. We know you are steady and sincere."
He stroked his beard and said:

"Knowing Ding Ling, is more valuable than forming a bond with you, teaching you Breathing Technique and Cultivation Technique. It's the most boast-worthy thing in my life. Because I, Tong Yuan, have actually guided a peerless hero! Even ancestors in the Underworld would be greatly comforted to know this."
"Indeed."
Wang Yue laughed and said:
"The Sword Sect having a successor like Ding Ling. If there really is an Underworld and Reincarnation in this world, I believe the seniors of the Sword Sect would be proud of you!"
"Come, come, come."
Tong Yuan invited Ding Ling:

"Accompany this old man for a cup of wine. After resting well for a while, we can spar some more. I have too many doubts about the Celestial Human Realm. It's now your turn, young one, to guide this old man. Please don't despise me."
"I wouldn't dare."
Ding Ling said solemnly:
"Senior will always be the senior I respect most!"
"Hahaha..."
Tong Yuan felt greatly comforted:
"I didn't misjudge you. Very good, very good!"
He seemed very happy and delighted:
"Today should drink three hundred cups!"
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and others were watching from the side, some smiling, some feeling honored, some enthusiastic.
But without exception.
All were proud to follow a person like Ding Ling.
Time flowed like water.
Ding Ling stayed on Penglai Mountain for three days.
During the three days.
He sparred with Wang Yue and Tong Yuan countless times.
Each time.
He would hold back his strength, fighting them, even so, he could still easily defeat Wang Yue and Tong Yuan.
However.
Ding Ling did not see a notification about Task 2 being completed.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 253: Encountering Zhen Jiang Again (15/17)
paragraphs: Instead, Task 1: The progress of defeating more than 20 plane powerhouses has jumped forward two more squares, becoming: 71/20.
Previously it was 47.
Over the past days, Ding Ling has been fighting in all directions, and indeed has faced a considerable number of first-class and above formidable generals.
There were even two super-elite ones.
But most were second-class.
Compared to the talent-packed Jiuzhou Land.
The number of experts in areas like Xianbei and the Western Realm was much less.
Although there were quite a few first-class experts, they were scattered everywhere, sparse and not as concentrated as in Jiuzhou.
Even so, Ding Ling's progress bar kept rising.
So much that after defeating Tong Yuan and Wang Yue.
The progress bar reached 71.
Far exceeding the target progress of 20 more.
But Ding Ling needed to defeat the strongest on the plane to complete the target.
He originally thought the mightiest person in this world would surely be one of Wang Yue or Tong Yuan.
Unexpectedly.
It wasn't them.
Who could possibly be stronger than them?
Ding Ling asked this question.
Wang Yue was quite astonished too, pondering for a while before saying:
"We boast ourselves invincible on earth. Of course..."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"Now that you've appeared, it made us realize that our so-called invincibility against Celestial Human Realm powerhouses is just a joke."
He was feeling a sense of urgency:
"I hope to break the shackles and enter the threshold of the Celestial Being in my lifetime."
Ding Ling offered his blessings.
Wang Yue chuckled, continuing:
"If neither of us is the strongest in the world, then only one person might be stronger than us."
"Who?"
"Zuo Ci Zuo Yuanfang!"
Wang Yue and Tong Yuan exchanged a glance and almost spoke the name in unison.
"Zuo Ci?"
Ding Ling mused:
"This person is like a Divine Dragon, seen its head but not its tail. I have looked for him too. But it seems he leaves no trace in the mortal world!"
"Only leave it to fate."
Wang Yue sighed:
"Why are you in such a hurry to find him?"
Ding Ling didn't mention it was for a task, just said he wanted to witness his Tao and techniques.
"You've reached the Celestial Human Realm and are still unsatisfied."
Tong Yuan complimented:
"Deservedly so, a natural War God!
He added:
"In these days, discussing with you the various difficulties and doubts of the Celestial Human Realm, and you also taught me the Inner Refining Breathing Technique."
He glanced gratefully at Ding Ling, affirming:
"I now have a strong premonition that when I master the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, it may be the time I break into the Celestial Being's threshold."
"I have the same feeling."
Wang Yue nodded:
"So I'm planning to retreat for a period of cultivation."
"In that case, I won't disturb the two seniors."
Ding Ling cupped his hands in farewell:
"I also have something to tend to in Chang'an, so I will not intrude further."
Ding Ling left Penglai Mountain.
He left under Shi A's expression of wanting to speak yet keeping silent, and reluctance to part.
Ding Ling did not invite Shi A to leave with him.
Though he could see Shi A wanted to follow.
But as the heir of the Sword Sect and the irreplaceable choice to oversee Penglai Mountain,
If he left, who would protect Tong Yuan and Wang Yue in retreat?
Who would guide the disciples all over the mountain?
Ding Ling naturally couldn't be so selfish.
Furthermore, he already had enough followers.
Because of this, even after rescuing Cai Wenji from the Xiongnu, he didn't add her to his group of followers.
Compared to heroines like Diao Chan and the others.
Cai Wenji was much more frail.
And her martial talent wasn't impressive either.
Most likely, she wouldn't be able to keep up with Ding Ling's pace in the future, and Ding Ling naturally didn't want someone who would be a drag.
This was secondary.
The main reason was still the lack of deep feelings between him and Cai Wenji.
He had been with Da and Xiao Qiao, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and the others for over a year, and had deep feelings, naturally willing to bring them along.
They were also willing to give everything for him.
Clip-clop! Clip-clop!
A group of people rode their horses on a journey.
Passing through Quyang City, Ding Ling and his group stopped at an inn to rest, and he saw a familiar figure.
"Ding, Ding, Young Master Ding!"
The figure's owner had delicate features like a fairy, yet her face was constantly marked by worry.
Until the moment she met Ding Ling, her worried face instantly relaxed, overtaken by a thick mix of surprise and confusion.
"Zhen Jiang."
Ding Ling was surprised, not expecting to meet her here.
This was a woman who initially stirred some feelings in him.
Back then, he even had thoughts of marrying her!
But looking back now.
He realized he had a loser mindset back then!
Being single for too long, upon encountering someone as gentle, understanding, kind, and beautiful as Zhen Jiang, it was understandably hard not to lose composure and be moved!
It's like a starving person suddenly eating a hearty meal, finding it the most delicious food in the world!
Back then, Ding Ling was simply single for too long; though he wasn't enamored with just anyone he saw, seeing someone like Zhen Jiang - sweet, kind, endearing - he surely liked her.
After all, he was a normal man who had been single for a long time.
Yet, after over a year, nearly two years.
Looking at Zhen Jiang now.
He no longer had the same mindset he once did.
The difference in power and status had subtly changed his perspective unknowingly.
"You!"
Zhen Jiang seemed to sense the difficult-to-bridge gap between herself and Ding Ling, her expression slightly freezing, looking shyly at Ding Ling:
"You, how have you been?"
"Come over and sit."
Ding Ling noticed Zhen Jiang's timidity, sighed inwardly, and beckoned her with his hand:
"It's been almost two years. How are you and your father?"
Zhen Jiang, seeing Ding Ling actually gesture for her to come over, her eyes seemed alive again from their previous dead-glow.

Her face slightly flushed, head slightly bowed, obediently walked to Ding Ling, not daring to sit until Ding Ling prompted her twice, cautiously sitting diagonally across from Ding Ling, neither too close nor too far.
A perfect distance.
Ding Ling asked her questions about her life,
And she answered stiffly like a robot.
But Diao Chan was sharp; seeing the raised veins on Zhen Jiang's hands clenching her clothes, she knew she was extremely nervous, shy, bewildered, and anxious.
'She must be in love with my master.'
Diao Chan thought, 'Should I help her get with my master?'
In this society.
The emperor having three palaces and seventy-two consorts was the norm.
As a First-Rank Prince.
Ding Ling naturally could marry as many as he wished.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng frequently attended to Ding Ling, in the eyes of outsiders, they were already considered Ding Ling's women.
They thought so themselves!
Thus, they naturally and willingly did things for Ding Ling like making his bed, washing his feet, tasks typically done by a wife.
Ding Ling refused yet enjoyed it.
Refusal because it feels outrageous!
Is he, a dignified man, incapable of washing his own feet?! Did he really need Diao Chan and the others to specially wash them for him?!

chapters.title: Chapter 254 254: The Zhen Family Throws a Banquet! Luoshen Wants to Meet Her Brother-in-Law
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt a bit embarrassed.
Although he had arrived in this Three Kingdoms World, deep down, he was still someone shaped by modern society!
He would naturally handle many things himself rather than letting women do it for him.
Most importantly, Diao Chan and the others took care of everything, serving Ding Ling so well that he felt embarrassed and ashamed given his inherent values.
It was enjoyable because:
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, and Du Qingcheng took care of him meticulously. While it wasn't to the extreme of being waited on hand and foot, it wasn't far off.
Who wouldn't enjoy such a lazy life?
If Ding Ling weren't clearly aware that endless worlds within this game world awaited his conquest and that he was still very weak, he might have really succumbed.
Without strong capital and power, one must not relax! One must always strive and push forward!
This was Ding Ling's "whip" that brought him back to reality each time!
This whip constantly urged him to work hard!
Diao Chan, with things on her mind, saw that Zhen Jiang was still hesitant. She stood up and took Zhen Jiang aside to comfort her.
Du Qingcheng, who was more understanding, also went over to help.
Zhen Jiang looked at Ding Ling in confusion and helplessness.
After Ding Ling confirmed that Diao Chan and the others were on his side, she listened to their questions like an obedient student, replying to whatever Diao Chan asked.
Of course.
Compared to conversations with Ding Ling, which felt robotic.
Her conversations with Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were more lively and spirited.
Facing Ding Ling.
Zhen Jiang felt like she was facing a crush she had admired for years, nervous, self-conscious, her delicate hands unsure of where to rest, making it hard for her to speak properly.
After learning the general situation.
And considering Ding Ling's subtle attitude towards Zhen Jiang, Diao Chan and the others took the initiative to accept Zhen Jiang.
Zhen Jiang felt a mix of surprise, shock, joy, panic, shyness, and disbelief... a whirlwind of emotions hard to describe in words!
Ding Ling was unaware of what Diao Chan and the others had done or said.
It wasn't until a day later.
When Zhen Jiang appeared in their group.
That he suddenly realized.
By that time, it was impossible to send Zhen Jiang away, so he could only accept her as a team member.
Zhen Jiang breathed a sigh of relief, feeling ecstatic as the worries on her brow disappeared, replaced by hope, excitement, and yearning for happiness!
With the establishment of the Great Wei Kingdom, the unification of Jiuzhou, and Cao Mengde's great ambition, diligent governance, and open-mindedness, he welcomed talents from all around!
By adopting players' suggestions, implementing the imperial examination system, and encouraging science... the Great Wei Kingdom developed at an almost lightning speed!
Jizhou, as a prosperous region!
And as a large region conquered by Ding Ling early on!
It developed rapidly as expected.
And the Zhen Family, as the top merchant family in Jizhou, seized the opportunity, soared, and sent their members to do business in various directions.
Zhen Jiang appeared in Quyang City today because she was dispatched to do business in the Si Li Region! She was merely in Quyang City to pick up goods!
Meeting Ding Ling here was purely by chance.
She couldn't help but marvel at the strange workings of fate.
Over the past year or so.
She constantly thought of Ding Ling, her lifesaver, and considered going to see him during his conquest of Jizhou. Unfortunately, she ended up being a step too late.
By the time she reached Ye City, Ding Ling had already left.
During the past year or so, she had been to the Si Li Region for business several times and even went out of her way to visit Ding Ling's residence in Chang'an City, hoping to encounter Ding Ling.
Regrettably.
Every attempt ended in disappointment.
Unexpectedly.
Just as she thought there was no way forward.
A new path appeared.
She finally reached her lucky moment!
She sent a pigeon post to her family that day to explain the situation.
Her family was overjoyed and supportive.
To become in-laws with the First-Rank Prince!
It was the highest honor!
It was as if even their ancestors' graves were blessed!
Zhen Yi was ecstatic, stroking his beard as he said:

"When I first met Ding Ling, I felt he was extraordinary, destined to become a hero in chaotic times, a regional powerhouse! As it turns out, I was right. No, no, Ding Ling is even more outstanding than I imagined! Exceptional! He's become the Grand General, National Preceptor, and Guardian God of the Great Wei Kingdom!
Becoming a First-Rank Prince shoulder to shoulder with Cao Mengde, the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom!
His words are as good as a Holy Decree!
He's the man at the very pinnacle of power in this world!
To become in-laws with such a figure is something I never even dared to dream of before. I never expected it to become a reality today?! Hahaha..."
Zhen Yi was overwhelmed with joy and immediately decided to host a feast with 300 tables to express his excitement and enthusiasm!
Zhen Mi, while eating at the feast, listened as her father proudly boasted to family and relatives about his acquaintance with Ding Ling.
She felt curious and a bit envious.
She quietly asked her sister Zhen Tuo:
"Sister, is Ding Ling my brother-in-law?"
Though young, she was as beautifully crafted as a celestial child!
Her voice was melodious like pearls dropping on a jade plate, very pleasant to hear.
Zhen Tuo nodded and whispered to her:
"You little clever fox. You know as much as I do, so stop pretending."
"Hehe."
Zhen Mi stuck out her tongue playfully, then changed the subject with enthusiasm:

"Will I have the chance to meet brother-in-law? I heard he rivals Earth Immortals and is the Guardian God, Grand General, National Preceptor, and First-Rank Prince of our Great Wei Kingdom! He's also the world's number one Sword God and Spear God, a single sword sweeping the frontier, deterring barbarians from venturing southward with their horses!"
Her bright eyes sparkled, full of admiration and desire as she said:
"I really want to see what this peerless hero of a brother-in-law is like and if he's easy to talk to."
"I do too."
Zhen Tuo, unmatched in charm and equally as refined and graceful as Zhen Jiang, also looked longing:
"Originally, I thought such a legendary figure would have no connection with our Zhen Family at all. Little did I know that the hero my sister longed for was this very hero!"
"If only we had known earlier. We could have pestered our sister to take us to Chang'an City to see brother-in-law."
Zhen Mi clutched Zhen Tuo's arm, shaking it as she pleaded:
"Sister, next time you go to Chang'an City for business, can you take me with you?"
"This..."
"Please!"
When Ding Ling returned to Chang'an City.
A few more days had passed.
During these days.

Diao Chan and the group ate and slept with Zhen Jiang. Because Zhen Jiang was very obedient, kind, and multi-talented, she gained Diao Chan and the group's approval, becoming their close friends who talked about everything.
From time to time, they would point at Ding Ling and let out sounds of delightful laughter, speaking of things only they knew.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 255: The Crow Speaks (17/17)
paragraphs: Ding Ling wouldn't intentionally ask.
After all, a girl's heart is hard to understand.
He only knows that being upright and having a clear conscience makes one impervious to any heart demons! Even the abyss can't hold him!
Towards Diao Chan and the others,
He is without guilt.
So he walks righteously and sits upright, very at ease.
Even if something happens between them in the future, it will be a natural course of events.
Ding Ling stayed in Chang'an City for a month.
With him overseeing Chang'an,
All kinds of demonic creatures vanished like smoke, not daring to show up.
Because whenever they did, Ding Ling would trace them to their source and decapitate the culprit with one sword!
There were many such examples.
No one dared to challenge Ding Ling's authority!
Plus, as Great Wei has established for so long.
With the help and support of natives like Guo Jia, Xi Zhicai, Manchong, and many players, this burgeoning empire has begun a leapfrog development, progressing step by step!
As for the players who wanted to compete for hegemony?
They had long given up.
Facing a cheat-like strong man like Ding Ling,
No matter how much they plotted, it was in vain!
Because no matter what they did, it was useless, Ding Ling simply wouldn't care, he only focused on sweeping forward! Suppressing!
In terms of sweeping forward!
Who in this world could compare to Ding Ling?
After despairing, the players had no choice but to participate in the imperial exams and enter the court as officials.
After all, being an official would greatly increase their chances of encountering Breathing Techniques and Great Medicine.
Ding Ling observed this.
But didn't intervene.
His purpose had been achieved.
Collecting the world's martial arts and secret manuals, enhancing himself, making his foundation deep as mountains, surging like the ocean! Vast to the extreme!
Gathering Great Medicine to benefit Diao Chan and others, also succeeded. Zhao Yun reached Super-Elite Peak, Diao Chan became Super-Elite.
Du Qingcheng and others were a bit behind.
But with Ding Ling's full guidance and continuous support of various Great Medicines, their rise was inevitable!
Even if Zhen Jiang joined, it didn't matter.
The resources from Jiuzhou plus the Western Regions' Kingdoms and the lands beyond the borders were more than enough to support them!
"All achievements have been accomplished."
Ding Ling stood up tall, walked to the window, and looked up at the sky:
"Now only task two remains. Where on earth has Zuo Ci died?!"
A few days ago.
In his mansion in Chang'an City,
Ding Ling received Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing, who came specially to see him.
The reason they came was to thank Ding Ling.
Because Ding Ling indeed kept his promise!
This brought them immense relief! They praised Ding Ling profusely!
To support Ding Ling, to support the nascent Great Wei Kingdom.
They stayed in Chang'an Ancient City.
And became court physicians, giving lectures on medicine, instructing those with talent in Medical Dao.
For a while,
People seeking knowledge and seeking the Dao flocked in endlessly, nearly breaking down the threshold of the Medical Academy.
Many of them were players who studied medicine in the real world!
They were overjoyed to have the opportunity to study medicine under Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing!
Natives were plenty as well.
After all, graduating from the Medical Academy meant guaranteed food, lodging, and job placement!
As for the location of the Medical Academy?
It's said that the former residence of Li Jue was vacated for Hua Tuo and them to use.
It's not far from Ding Ling's residence.
Since then, Hua Tuo and Zhang Zhongjing frequently visited Ding Ling.
On this day,
Ding Ling asked them about Zuo Ci's whereabouts.
Both sighed and also expressed their unawareness, only suggesting Ding Ling could spread the word and widely post notices across Jiuzhou.
Maybe if Zuo Ci sees it, he will come to find him personally.
Ding Ling thought this was a good idea.
So he went to Cao Mengde and told him about it.
Cao Mengde didn't delay, immediately making a decision, gathering spies from all places, instructing them to quickly post notices in each province and city, not even sparing rural areas.
Wherever he could help Ding Ling, Cao Mengde supported without reservation!
Indeed.
This method worked.
One day,
While Ding Ling was enjoying the service of the beauties Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, and Zhen Jiang.
A strange cry suddenly sounded ahead.
"Caw caw."
As if a crow was wailing.
Ding Ling furrowed his brow and looked.
In the courtyard ahead, on a Phoenix Tree, perched a crow, completely black as ink.
Its eyes were bright as it looked at Ding Ling, then suddenly spoke:
"I hear you're looking for me?
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was so startled that a date in his mouth was swallowed down his throat, almost choking him!
He coughed a couple of times, suddenly operating his Breathing Technique, exhaled a breath, and poof! The date flew out, shooting over ten meters away, and with a ding, embedded into the wall!
Only after spitting the date did Ding Ling feel somewhat relieved.
He looked at the crow again, incredulous, and said:
"You, you can talk?!"
Diao Chan and Da and Xiao Qiao were equally astonished, their hands holding fruit plates frozen.
Zhen Jiang, who was feeding Ding Ling fruit, was also stunned, her eyes wide open. If not for Ding Ling, the Earth Immortal, Zhen Jiang might have been scared out of her wits.
"Hehe."
The crow's voice sounded old and hoarse, like iron scraping on the ground, extremely jarring:
"What else?"
It stared at Ding Ling with eyes shining with a black light, sizing him up:
"Have you entered the Celestial Human Realm?"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling finally recovered, stood tall, activated the three major Breathing Techniques, his noble and sharp aura sweeping towards the crow:
"You are Zuo Ci, Zuo Yuanfang the elder?!"
"Heh heh."
The crow chuckled strangely:

"Yes. I am indeed Zuo Ci. I heard that the First-Rank Prince, the renowned World's Number One Sword God, was explicitly searching for me. Out of curiosity, I came to see Chang'an City. Now that I've seen you, you're indeed a graceful and handsome young man! Your skills are already extraordinary!
To have such proficiency at your age.
Remarkable, truly remarkable!"
"Elder, you're too kind."
Ding Ling said respectfully, saluted Zuo Ci, then went straight to the point:
"I sought you out to have a sparring match."
"Caw caw."
Zuo Ci was taken aback, then chuckled bizarrely:
"Young man. Don't think that just because you've entered the Celestial Human Realm, you are invincible. You still have a long way to go."
Ding Ling remained neither humble nor arrogant, yet a faint sense of pride burst from his heart, mingling with the noble and sharp aura, appearing increasingly grand and tenacious:
"Elder, it's just sparring. Besides, how can you know if you can win unless you fight? Wouldn't you agree?"
"Quite right, quite right."
Zuo Ci laughed:
"Youngsters not confined by conventions, broad-minded, with remarkable determination, commendable. Good, good."
He flapped his wings, soaring into the sky:
"If you want to have a magical battle with me, we'll meet again in three days, at the pavilion ten miles outside Chang'an City!"
"Elder, it's a deal!"
"Hahaha, I, Zuo Ci, never utter falsehoods. Just wait."
As his voice drifted, it sounded like a waft of breeze, swirling in the void, faintly audible yet ethereal, unlike human speech.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 256: Full Level Detailed Explanation of the Eight Array Map (1/10)
paragraphs: Ding Ling looked up, only to see that the crow had already spread its wings and soared into the clouds, disappearing without a trace.
Its speed was extremely fast, like a flash of lightning; more like flying escape, instant teleportation, full of mystery, unpredictable!
"What a powerful body technique."
Ding Ling was moved:
"What a mysterious transformation skill!"
He couldn't see through Zuo Ci's Daoist skill at all.
If he had to face such magical and unpredictable Daoist magic in three days, how was he going to fight? How was he going to contend?
"Is this person Zuo Ci?"
Diao Chan was shocked:
"How can he be this strange?!"
"Like a monster."
Da and Xiao Qiao added.
Ding Ling was stunned, then smiled and said:
"The talk of monsters is elusive. This Zuo Ci may only be proficient in the art of transformation. We are simply lacking in insight and can't see through it."
"Ding Ling, do you have the confidence to beat him?"
Du Qingcheng looked worried:
"Why not just not go. If anything happens, that would be too terrible."
For Du Qingcheng, Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao,
Ding Ling was their heaven, their world!
They had no family in this world, and Ding Ling was truly their central focus!
If that center collapsed, they couldn't imagine!
Although Zhen Jiang had family alive, she also found it hard to accept any ill fate befalling Ding Ling!
Her beautiful eyes filled with tears looking at Ding Ling, as if she had thousands of words to say.
"My cultivation is as vast as the cosmos."
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting, his spirit soaring, full of confidence:
"Just Zuo Ci, I don't believe I can't take him down."
Though he had no real plan in his heart.
But Ding Ling didn't want Diao Chan and the others to worry excessively.
After chatting with the ladies,
Diao Chan and the others went to practice martial arts.
Ding Ling then entered the Imperial Palace and met with Cao Mengde.
When Cao Mengde saw Ding Ling, he immediately said:
"I found the person you wanted to see."
He clapped his hands.
Not long after,
a middle-aged man with a handsome appearance, upright build, and full of scholarly grace entered through a side door.
Behind him followed four children.
Two girls and two boys.

The older boy was distinguished and fair, with lips like they were cut by a knife and eyes like polished ink, although young in age, appeared very serious and meticulous, seeming to naturally hold a sense of righteousness, like a small adult well-read in literature, the scholarly aura on him was no less than that of the middle-aged man.
"Your humble servant Zhuge Xuan, greets Your Majesty and Prince!
The middle-aged man, along with the children, performed a grand salute to Ding Ling and Cao Mengde.
"As we discussed, you can now offer the Zhuge Clan's secret manuals to the Grand General."
Cao Mengde stroked his beard and said.
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Zhuge Xuan retrieved several secret manuals from his bosom, holding them with both hands, and carefully and respectfully presented them to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling received them.
He flipped through them.
"Detailed Explanation of the Eight Array Map"
"Sleeping Dragon Breathing Technique"
"Wolong Body Cultivation Technique"
"Initial Tier Array Dao Explanation"
"Middle-tier Array Dao Explanation"
"Stargazing Skill"
A total of six volumes.
The more Ding Ling looked, the brighter his eyes became.
Cao Mengde sighed in relief, smiling:
"It seems the Grand General is very satisfied."
"Satisfied."
Ding Ling was very forthright, putting away the secret manuals, and said:
"Are these the originals or copies?"
"The originals."
Zhuge Xuan blushed slightly:

"The mysteries of the Eight Array Map are unfathomable, extremely difficult to copy. A slight discrepancy could result in drastic differences. I dare not deceive nor slight Your Majesty and Prince. I can only offer the originals."
He paused, then added:
"The originals are an ancestral inheritance, and must not be lost."
"Understood."
Ding Ling nodded:
"Please wait a moment while I finish reading and return them to you."
"Whew."
Zhuge Xuan breathed a sigh of relief.
He truly feared Ding Ling wouldn't return them.
After all, if Ding Ling didn't return them, he had no recourse!
Rustle!
Ding Ling flipped through the books like they were pages of a book.
Soon,
the library shelves contained several additional secret manuals; the breathing technique remained illusory, unable to reach full level.
But the other books were all instantly at full level.
[Stargazing Skill Full Level]
[Charm +0.1]

Ding Ling found himself with a profound understanding of the ways of the stars, seemingly able to discern from celestial phenomena and the paths of stars whether it would rain, whether a general star would fall, and the trajectory of dynasties.
It was quite an excellent book of secrets.
Unbeknownst to him,
at the moment his stargazing skill reached full level,

everyone present sensed a subtle change in Ding Ling's aura, especially in his eyes, which seemed to contain an endless starry sky, becoming extremely deep and mysterious, his charm seemed to have increased significantly in an instant.
He appeared more attractive.
Zhuge Xuan's family, whether Zhuge Xuan himself or the other children, looked at Ding Ling in surprise and awe, their eyes full of disbelief.
[Initial Tier Array Dao Explanation Full Level]
Ding Ling's understanding of the Array Dao immediately reached a master level!
[Middle-tier Array Dao Explanation Full Level.]
Ding Ling's mastery of basic array dao was already perfected!
[Detailed Explanation of the Eight Array Map Full Level]
[Charm +0.3]
Ding Ling reached a peak in array formations in an instant!
At his level, he could almost effortlessly set up an Eight Array Map!
And the more he understood the Eight Array Map, the more he realized its terrifying and extraordinary qualities.
Just some randomly arranged stones could set up an Eight Array Map to block a thousand troops!
The more Ding Ling comprehended it, the more he admired the power of the Eight Array Map.
And almost simultaneously,
a rotating phantom pattern of the Eight Array Map surged out from Ding Ling's body, though it flashed away in an instant, everyone saw it clearly!

In the moment the pattern appeared, it felt as if mist surged and killing intent rushed to the constellations, as if countless armor and weapons were hidden within, the power of the eight directions gathered inside!
A torrential, devouring aura rushed forth, causing everyone present to pause, nearly suffocating!
They looked at Ding Ling in trepidation.
Especially Zhuge Xuan's family, who were shocked and incredulous to the extreme.
"This aura, this feeling, could it be, could it be the Eight Array Map has entered the Transformation Realm?!"
"But how is this possible?! The Prince only had the secret manual for a short time. How could he have learned the Eight Array Map?!"
Zhuge Xuan's jaw almost dropped to the ground!
The children behind him all had a look of existential disbelief.
The foremost among them was none other than the future Sleeping Dragon, Zhuge Liang, Zhuge Kongming.
He was already eleven years old.
Although his features were handsome and youthful, appearing younger than his age.
At his age, due to his extraordinary intelligence and talent, in his cultivation of the Sleeping Dragon Breathing Technique and other arts, he was far ahead of the rest of the family.
Especially in his understanding and study of array dao and stargazing skills, he seemed like he was possessed by an immortal, making extremely rapid progress!
Yet even as a rare genius in the Zhuge Clan for a thousand years!
At this moment, he also looked utterly stunned and incredulous!
To know that he had spent countless years, to the point of neglecting sleep and meals, studying the Eight Array Map, but had only gained a little.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 257: Dragon Taming Skill Full Level (2/10)
paragraphs: But what about Ding Ling?
How long has he been studying?!
Zhuge Liang prided himself on his exceptional talent, believing that his future achievements would be limitless, and he had immense confidence in himself!
He even thought of himself as the smartest person in the world! In this world, in this era, it's absolutely hard to find anyone who could compare to him!
However...
Without comparison, there's no harm!
Compare with Ding Ling.
Zhuge Liang immediately felt a suffocating sense of being crushed by a prodigy!
At this moment.
He suddenly understood his younger brother's mindset and empathized with the pain of those who struggled academically!
Clearly, he was more diligent, more hardworking!
But he just couldn't surpass the other party!
This was infuriating! So demoralizing!
Zhuge Liang drooped his head like an eggplant hit by frost, feeling somewhat dejected.
Who could accept that after years of hard work, someone else could learn something after just a brief look!
The gap was too large!
Zhuge Liang found it hard to accept!
It was as if he had suffered a hundred thousand critical hits! Each blow a direct hit to the vital organs! Heart-wrenching!
Zhuge Xuan also couldn't accept it, but still, with a glimmer of hope, he asked:
"Prince, did you just learn the Eight Array Map?!"
"That's right."
Ding Ling nodded confidently.
Zhuge Xuan took a deep breath.
Zhuge Liang's eye twitched uncontrollably, staring at Ding Ling with a bewildered gaze!
He seemed to want to see through Ding Ling! To see exactly what made Ding Ling so powerful and frightening!
"Have you ever been exposed to the Eight Array Map before?"
Zhuge Xuan reluctantly asked again.
"No."
Zhuge Xuan was stunned, then prostrated himself with admiration:

"There were rumors saying that no matter what you learn, Prince, you grasp it quickly, master it fast, and once mastered, it becomes second nature. I didn't believe it and thought it was nonsense. Today, I see that my perspective and vision were too small!
Prince, you truly are a rare prodigy throughout the ages! If the Eight Array Map of the Zhuge Clan can prosper in your hands, it would indeed be a blessing for us!"
Zhuge Liang felt a tinge of embarrassment but looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes, hoping to see Ding Ling demonstrate the Eight Array Map.
But Ding Ling only exchanged a few words with Zhuge Xuan.
And then continued flipping through the Secret Manual.
[Wolong Body Cultivation Technique Full Level]
This is a high-tier Cultivation Technique that enhances physical constitution.
If practiced in conjunction with the Sleeping Dragon Breathing Technique,
it can be cultivated to the extreme, enough to break into the threshold of the Celestial Human Realm; it is a genuinely top-tier technique, quite rare!
After Ding Ling reached full level.
He felt his longevity, stamina, and endurance seemed to have increased again.
Yet, in this world, his lifespan is infinite, so the sensation was not evident!
Moreover, there was no prompt for adding points to four-dimensional attributes.
Clearly.
He had already reached the pinnacle level of this world's standards, with nowhere further to advance.
"Thank you."
Ding Ling returned the Secret Manual to Zhuge Xuan, expressing gratitude.
Zhuge Xuan, overwhelmed with surprise, repeatedly expressed his unworthiness.
"Besides, I have prepared numerous other Secret Manuals."
Cao Mengde looked at Ding Ling with shock and admiration, pointing to the side:
"They're housed in the secret chamber of the Royal Library. I'll take you there now."
Cao Mengde knew that Ding Ling learned martial arts and medical skills extremely quickly.
But he didn't expect Ding Ling to learn Array Dao just as swiftly!
Is there anything Ding Ling can't learn?!
Cao Mengde couldn't imagine, he sighed at his own inadequacy!
Comparing himself to Ding Ling, he felt like a useless man!
If Ding Ling weren't indifferent to the throne, whole-heartedly pursuing the Martial Dao.
He probably wouldn't be able to keep his throne stable.
Of course, without Ding Ling defending the country, his position as emperor would also be insecure!
Regarding Ding Ling, Cao Mengde's feelings were extraordinarily complex, having awe, fear, respect, admiration, recognition...complicated to the extreme!
Just like the complexity of human nature.
It's difficult to sum up in a few words!
"No need."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:

"You are the emperor of the Great Wei Kingdom, tending to numerous state affairs daily, and it's already commendable for you to spare so much time to help me; there's no need to take me personally. Just have a palace maid or guard lead the way."
Cao Mengde no longer insisted and had a palace maid lead Ding Ling.
Before leaving.
Zhuge Liang mustered up his courage and said to Ding Ling:
"Prince, may I come to discuss the Eight Array Map with you when I am free?"
"Of course."
Ding Ling turned to look at Zhuge Liang:
"Your name is Zhuge Kongming?"
"You know me, Prince?"
Zhuge Liang's eyes lit up, his handsome face glowing, as if being recognized by Ding Ling was something worth bragging about. He unconsciously straightened his chest.
"Of course."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"You can come to me at any time."
He paused for a moment and added:
"It's best if you come these few days. In a few days, you might not be able to see me."
"What do you mean by that?!
Cao Mengde was puzzled.
"When the time comes, Your Majesty, you will naturally understand."
Ding Ling didn't explain further.
He turned and left.
Zhuge Liang, however, was flushed with excitement, already pondering what gifts to buy for visiting Ding Ling later.
He had always been interested in the Eight Array Map.
Unfortunately, no one in the family had significant knowledge, leaving him without guidance, forcing him to figure it out on his own, with very slow progress.
Now, Ding Ling's mastery of the Eight Array Map was like second nature.
In an instant, it was as if he saw the path ahead and found a guiding light!
Ding Ling entered the secret chamber of the Royal Library.
Here, there were a considerable number of new volumes arranged.
Because they were extremely precious, moving might lead to damage, so Ding Ling had Cao Mengde leave them here untouched, and he would come by when free.
Now was the right time, so he could read.
He picked up an ancient bamboo scroll and began to read.
It documented the "Observing People Skill"!
After flipping through it.
[Observing People Skill Full Level]
In an instant, Ding Ling already had a rough understanding of how to read people.
Just by observing facial features, expressions, and eyes, he could discern subtle changes in a person's mindset and also roughly judge if they are good or evil.
Truly remarkable.
The second ancient bamboo scroll.
It was about "Dragon Taming Skill."
It was a fragment.
And it was severely incomplete, with certain characters smeared, making them unreadable.
Nonetheless.
[Dragon Taming Skill (Fragment) Full Level]
After reaching full level, Ding Ling had an extremely high comprehension of this Dragon Taming Skill.
It turns out it truly is a technique that can control a real dragon!
"Incredible."
Ding Ling was astounded:
"It seems that in the Ancient Era, there indeed were dragons! And there were Human Emperors who commanded real dragons!"
This Dragon Taming Skill requires the Human Emperor Breathing Technique to be paired with it to display its complete effect.
Ding Ling naturally deduced that this Dragon Taming Skill must have been from the hand of an ancient Human Emperor!
"What a pity, what a pity, it's just a fragment. It might be hard to exert any significant effect."
Regarding the Ancient Era, Ding Ling was quite longed for.
Needless to say.
This piece of heaven and earth, might well be a legacy from the ancient times.
There is too much historical data and Martial Arts Secret Manuals proving this point!

chapters.title: Chapter 258 258: Zhuge Liang Seeks Instruction from Ding Ling
paragraphs: In the Ancient Era, it must have been an extremely illustrious and splendid time. Just look at Zuo Ci's Daoist Techniques, as well as the various Martial Arts Secret Manuals mastered by Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, and others, and you can infer a thing or two.
Unfortunately, the inheritance has been severed too much.
Even the supreme Sword Sect almost faced a gap!
Imagine the situation of other sects and clans.
If this continues.

It's possible that after a thousand years, all martial arts will be lost, and the Central Plains Jiuzhou will enter an era of ordinary people! There will no longer be truly extraordinary and unmatched warriors!
Ding Ling shook his head, no longer overthinking, but instead continued to browse other secret manuals.
One ancient secret manual after another was read by him in its entirety.
Then swiftly reached full level.
In the entire secret chamber, he spent several hours finishing reading over a thousand secret manuals.
Aside from some Breathing Techniques.
All reached full level!
[Wisdom +0.2]
[Charisma +0.7]
This is the result brought by these secret manuals.
"It's a pity most of them are incomplete. Otherwise, it would definitely increase wisdom and charisma more than this."
Ding Ling was deeply shocked by these incomplete texts!
So many mysterious Cultivation Techniques! Secret Manuals!
They dazzled his eyes.
If each one had the complete text, Ding Ling could assert that they could definitely reach the Celestial Human Realm.
It means...
In ancient times, most techniques just needed to be combined with Breathing Techniques to break through shackles and enter the Celestial Human Realm?
Ding Ling marvels.
It seems that the information Wang Yue and Tong Yuan knew was also incomplete.
After all, even the Sword Sect's inheritance was cut off.
Can you expect historical facts to be consistent?
It's possible that the so-called historical facts about Martial Dao that Wang Yue and others know have been deliberately altered and edited by someone else?
What the truth is.
Remains unknown.
But Ding Ling knows that people of this era are definitely far inferior to those in the distant ancient and ancient times!
He glanced at the Character Panel:
Strength:
[Root Bone 1 (1 point for ordinary people), Wisdom 2.3+0.2+0.1+0.2+0.2 (3), Strength 31, Agility 31, Constitution 31, Defense 31, Charisma 7+0.8+0.4+0.9+0.1+0.3+0.7 (10.2).]
Wisdom increased to 3 points.
The Sea of Consciousness became more transparent, the mind more agile, and many forgotten things were remembered.
It is evident that wisdom indeed relates closely to memory.
As for the increase in charisma?
After coming out of the secret chamber.
From the subtle glances of the palace maids, you could discern a thing or two.
He's definitely become more handsome now!
This is a good thing; no one can refuse becoming more handsome.
Returning from the palace to the residence.
Diao Chan and others apparently had paused their martial practice. Seeing him, they quickly ran over, and said to him:
"A boy named Zhuge Liang said he admires you, he brought a basket of fruit to visit you a few hours ago. Now he's waiting in the living room."
"Let him wait for me at the Martial Arts Arena."
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then said:
"I know what he wants to learn. I will guide him a little."
The Eight Array Map still comes from the Zhuge Clan.
Although Ding Ling doesn't know what transaction the Zhuge Clan made with Cao Mengde to willingly offer the secret manual.
But ultimately, Ding Ling still got the Zhuge Clan's inheritance.
Guiding a member of the Zhuge Clan.
Ding Ling doesn't think much of it.
Moreover.
Zhuge Liang, huh.
The legendary prodigy!
Ding Ling is also curious about how much of a genius he really is, that he appears as wise and talented, almost like a genius in Romance of the Three Kingdoms!
This is also because Ding Ling has seen many renowned figures and generals, and defeated countless great generals.
He has become immune to these famous people.
If he had met Zhuge Liang when he first entered this game world, he would definitely have been apprehensive, excited, and extremely exhilarated.
It can only be said.
The change in strength and status.
The increase in experience and knowledge!
Has also changed how Ding Ling interacts with people, and his demeanor has become more composed and mature, with a serene and calm disposition, as if unfazed even if the heavens were to collapse.
Some time later.
Ding Ling saw Zhuge Liang at the Martial Arts Arena.
His attire differed from what it was in the Imperial Palace, as he wore a completely white Confucian-style outfit, highlighting his extraordinary temperament.
Ding Ling nodded inwardly, the current Zhuge Liang, though still young, already had a hint of future Sleeping Dragon aura.
He got straight to the point without delay and asked Zhuge Liang what he wanted to do.
Zhuge Liang respectfully replied:
"I want to learn the Eight Array Map!"
"I can teach you."
Zhuge Liang's eyes lit up.
"But after you learn it, remember to use the Eight Array Map to protect the Great Wei Kingdom. Can you do that?"
"This..."
Zhuge Liang hesitated but for a moment before nodding solemnly.
Now Cao Mengde is wise and martial, granting amnesty to the world, offering benefits and prosperity to the people!
Zhuge Liang's view of him is completely different from the future, and having such an attitude is normal.
"Good."
Ding Ling laughed heartily, waved his hand, Vigorous Qi danced, condensed into palm form, and with a sound, smashed a giant stone on one side of the Martial Arts Arena.
The stone shattered and burst apart.
The fragments flew like sharp arrows in all directions.

Ding Ling flicked his hands continuously, using the Human Emperor Palm Technique, Human Emperor Fist, Eight Trigrams Palm, Lion Palm, Python Palm, Wind Gate Fist, Kongmen Fist, and other fist and palm techniques in succession.

And in the void, sometimes a portal formed by Qingfeng gathered and fleetingly appeared, capturing flying fragments one after another; at other times, a gigantic python swallowed unknown amounts of stones, falling to the east;
Ding Ling's Vigorous Qi danced gracefully and naturally, with each fist and palm resembling the universe showcasing divine might.
In just a short moment.
Several Eight Array Maps had already been arranged on the Martial Arts Arena.
Zhuge Liang was dumbfounded, regarding him as a Divine Being!

For the first time, he truly realized why Ding Ling, single-handedly, could suppress the universe and quell all rascals, preventing any reckless movements! Why, with only a sword, he could strike fear in the Xianbei Race beyond the border, forcing them to seek peace from the south!
Ding Ling's divine bravery!
Truly incomparable to ordinary mortals.
"Come."
Ding Ling grabbed Zhuge Liang by the shoulder, leaped several dozen meters, and amidst Zhuge Liang's trepidation, jumped into one of the Eight Array Maps.
As soon as they entered this Array Map.
Zhuge Liang looked around.

To the east, sand and stones flew, a fierce wind bewildering the eyes, making it difficult to move forward. He tried to take a few steps, but was beaten painfully on his handsome face by flying sand and stones, making him gasp and hurriedly retreat to Ding Ling's side.
Looking to the west.
Odd rocks jutted, forming nine twists and eighteen turns, and vaguely sword-like evil qi seemed to form, with the sound of weapons clashing incessantly!
To the north.
The river water surges, the sound of the waves resembling swords and drums roaring;
To the south.
Sand piles up, forming a tower, layered like a mountain.
Thunderclouds rolled above, obscuring the color of the blue sky.
Dangers abound underground, like eggs on the brink of collapse, risk of toppling!
Zhuge Liang's eyes were wide open in surprise, admiration, envy, and longing as he said:
"Prince, is this the true nature of the Eight Array Map? I want to learn it!"
"Let me see how insightful you are!"

chapters.title: Chapter 259 259: Outside the Pavilion! Surrounded by Onlookers
paragraphs: Zhuge Liang's comprehension exceeded Ding Ling's expectations.
As long as Ding Ling explained in detail, Zhuge Liang could easily understand and quickly apply what he learned!
It can be said.
As long as the teacher teaches well, explains thoroughly.
Zhuge Liang could quickly grasp and score full marks on exams!
He truly is a person of divine learning capability!
It took Ding Ling more than two days to teach Zhuge Liang.
He then mastered the Eight Array Map.
Upon witnessing Zhuge Liang struggling to set up an Eight Array Map firsthand, Ding Ling, skilled as he was, couldn't help but take a breath, feeling a bit awestruck.
Truly Zhuge Liang was a prodigy throughout the ages!
Truly he was a supreme figure shining brightly in Romance of the Three Kingdoms!
Such wisdom and comprehension.
Really beyond the imagination of ordinary people.
Ding Ling already anticipated Zhuge Liang's rise!

Especially after Zhuge Liang joined the Great Wei Kingdom, if given adequate herbal baths without having to labor exhaustively, becoming a celestial-level strongman was probably just a matter of time!
"You're very good!"
Ding Ling applauded, sparing no praise:
"You are the most talented person I've ever met."
Zhuge Liang, feeling somewhat embarrassed, replied:
"Compared to the Prince, I dare not call myself a genius!"
He said sternly:

"I should learn and gain insights from the Prince! If one day I can reach the level where I can instantly grasp, rapidly master, and internalize mastery like you, perhaps then I could truly relax and claim that I, Zhuge Liang, am not inferior to anyone!"
Saying this.
He humbly said:
"But right now, I dare not say that. Compared to the Prince, I am still far behind."
Ding Ling looked speechlessly at the sky.
Zhuge Liang, this guy, actually wanted to compete with him, someone already extraordinary!
Truly, Zhuge Liang gleamed in the vast river of five thousand years of history!
"Keep working hard."
Ding Ling could only encourage:

"The future of the Great Wei Kingdom needs people like you to protect it. I will recommend you to the Emperor of Great Wei. Let you study and advance at the Royal Academy. I believe after you succeed in your studies, you will bring different changes to the Great Wei Kingdom."
"Yes, Prince!
After an exchange between the two.
Ding Ling looked outside Chang'an City:
"Now I am going to meet Zuo Ci."
"Is it the Demon Dao Zuo Ci that the Queen and others mentioned?"
Zhuge Liang asked curiously.
"The term 'Demon Dao' from your lips, into my ear, shouldn't be spoken in the future."
Ding Ling raised his leg to leave:
"He is just a practitioner with success, not an actual demon."
"Can I follow to watch the duel?"
Despite asking, Zhuge Liang closely followed Ding Ling, clearly indicating that even if Ding Ling didn't allow him, he would stealthily follow regardless.
"If you want to go, then go."
Ding Ling saw this, understood, and didn't stop him:
"Just be careful not to get injured by accident."
"I will."
The two reached the entrance.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Yun, and Chen Dao had already prepared the horses and were waiting nearby.
Seeing Ding Ling, they all greeted him.

Ding Ling nodded and leapt onto the horse's back, shouting 'giddy-up', neighing! Ferghana Horses stood on their hind legs, their front hooves stamping heavily on the ground, carrying Ding Ling swiftly like the wind, directly heading outside Chang'an City.
Da and Xiao Qiao closely followed.
Zhuge Liang didn't know how to ride a horse, stubbornly sitting behind Zhao Yun, holding Zhao Yun's waist, constantly inquiring about Ding Ling from Zhao Yun on the way.
Zhao Yun didn't hide much, choosing some key points to share.
Even so, after listening, Zhuge Liang was astonished: "The Prince is truly incredible."
Zhao Yun smiled slightly:
"He is indeed the strongest and most powerful person in the world."
The pride in his voice was evident to anyone.
Zhuge Liang naturally caught on too, he asked:
"Do you think the Prince can win in this duel against Zuo Ci?"
"This... hard to say."
Zhao Yun's expression turned a bit serious:

"Zuo Ci is unpredictable, comes and goes without a trace, difficult to locate, with unforeseen divine power! Coupled with mastery in Transformation Skill, how can mortal eyes see through his true form? If careless and attacked by his transformed self, wouldn't it be dangerous?"
His concern grew as he spoke:

"Although the Prince is as powerful as an Earth Immortal, Zuo Ci has boundless prowess and celestial aura, truly hard to assess! When I saw the crow Zuo Ci transformed into, I couldn't see through or approach him! So uncanny!"
He paused and added:

"At that time, the crow was like the Death God possessed by Ghost God! If us mortals approached haphazardly, we might get our soul harvested and die. Facing him directly, there was an eerie feeling that made one's hair stand on end everywhere. I don't know how the Prince managed to stand evenly with him back then?"
"The Prince is the number one in the world, the Martial God of the day! War God! If he cannot even contend with that Zuo Ci, then who in the world can tackle Zuo Ci?"
Zhuge Liang and Zhao Yun occasionally chatted softly.
Regarding whether Ding Ling could defeat Zuo Ci, they dared not hold too optimistic a view.
After all, Zuo Ci seemed half demon, half divine.
Indeed somewhat beyond mortal imagination, needing cautious handling.
Ding Ling's duel with Zuo Ci.
Aside from their own people, outsiders did not know.
But when Ding Ling arrived at the agreed location with Zuo Ci.

Nearby merchants who came to Chang'an City either for leisure or traveled from afar, hearing others say that the horseback person was Ding Ling and Zhao Yun among others, immediately couldn't move their legs.
Most people stayed far away, using telescopes to observe.
This is understandable.
Like modern people seeing top celebrities, big idols, they certainly want to take a closer look or enjoy the spectacle, a natural human instinct!
And Ding Ling?
First-Rank Prince of the Three Kingdoms, truly a top figure of power! Even Cao Mengde couldn't command him; instead, would listen to Ding Ling's orders, albeit Ding Ling never ordered him.

In the real world, Ding Ling is a top stream prominent figure! In terms of popularity, Ding Ling now dominates all celebrities! Truly achieved worldwide fame! Making countless people flock to analyze and study him!
Such a famous figure.
Whenever appearing in public, will inevitably be swarmed by crowds.

Only because Ding Ling's power in the Three Kingdoms was too high, ordinary people dared not gather too close, fearing punishment or responsibility! Only dared to watch from afar for a moment's thrill!
At this moment.
These people were all speculating on the cautious arrival of Ding Ling and his party, wondering what he was here for?
Time flowed like water.
Ding Ling stood in the pavilion, carrying the Giant Que Sword, holding the Heaven-Swaying Sword, slightly raised his head, looking at the sky.
It's already past the promised time.
Zuo Ci still didn't come.
Ding Ling had no choice but to continue waiting.
This waiting lasted another day.
Diao Chan ran back and forth several times to Chang'an City just to serve Ding Ling's meals.
To avoid affecting the upcoming duel.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 260: Demon Dao Dismembered Yet Unkilled
paragraphs: Ding Ling ate quickly, devouring his food ravenously.
However, no matter how eagerly he waited.
Zuo Ci seemed to have forgotten their agreement.
Ding Ling stood outside the pavilion for three full days.
There was still no sign of Zuo Ci.

Zhao Yun was furious. Ding Ling, after all, was now the Guardian God, Grand General, and First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom! How dignified was his status? Yet Zuo Ci dared to toy with the Prince! What's tolerable and what's intolerable!
Zhao Yun couldn't help but say:

"Your Highness, I think there's no need to wait any longer. Such a demon dao, who breaks his promises and treats his words as humor, is certainly a shameless person. We don't need to have a magical battle with him. Let's leave."
Zhuge Liang fully agreed.
He too despised people with no sense of timing!
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, and the others were naturally filled with righteous indignation, feeling that this demon dao Zuo Ci was being too excessive.
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"No need to be angry, let's wait a bit longer. If we really can't wait, then we'll leave."
Ding Ling was not a pedantic person; he wouldn't wait blindly for long.
If it weren't for the task at hand, and considering Zuo Ci's mysterious actions and his elusive, ever-changing nature, Ding Ling wouldn't wait here but would choose to go directly to fight!
He respected Zuo Ci as a senior.
Zuo Ci stood him up like this.
Ding Ling was also harboring a hidden flame in his heart and thought:
"Clearly these high achievers aren't all as virtuous as Tong Yuan and Hua Tuo, who keep promises with golden words!"
Since Zuo Ci ignored the agreement and promises.
Naturally, Ding Ling no longer needed to respect Zuo Ci!
If they meet again.
Ding Ling would certainly use thunderous techniques.
He secretly gripped his sword.
And waited for half a day.
Then decisively leaped onto his horse, prepared to depart.
Suddenly, strange laughter echoed through, and from among the crowd not far away, an old man with an ancient appearance walked out.
He looked at Ding Ling, laughing heartily:
"Getting impatient after waiting for three days?"
"Are you Daoist Zuo Ci?"
Zhuge Liang questioned.
"The gentleman hasn't spoken, why is a kid interrupting?"
The old man glanced at Zhuge Liang, quite surprised:
"What qualifies you to speak on behalf of the First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom? You should know..."
"He is qualified."
Ding Ling interrupted the old man coldly, saying:
"Zuo Ci, I haven't just waited three days for you, but six and a half days! You've broken the promise.
With those words.
Ding Ling suddenly activated the three major Breathing Techniques, performing the Flying Swallow Technique, spinning, and flying up from the horse's back, treading on air, drawing his sword!
Clang!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Sunset Swordsmanship!

The Sword God Skill revealed its powerful effects, under Ding Ling's intense anger, the Heaven-Swaying Sword radiated a dazzling brilliance, and blossoming sword flowers scattered from its tip, sometimes transforming into the Flowers in Bloom pattern, falling into a pile of stones, exploding the stones into fragments;
At other times, it transformed into the Setting Sun Diagram, as the sword diagrams embodied a noble, sharp sword qi, falling upon Zuo Ci's head like a raging Sword River.
"Hahaha..."
Zuo Ci laughed loud, without even dodging:
"Young man, with a raging fire, you'll harm your heart, mind, and body!"
Before his voice fell, the sword diagram descended, whizzing through!
The fierce sword diagram fell like the scythe of a Death God upon the old man's body, with a slicing sound cutting through the Celestial Extreme.
The old man's head, arms, body, were instantly severed into pieces, scattering across the ground.
A wisp of light smoke dispersed.
The elder's remains vanished into thin air.
Looking again.
The elder was already a hundred meters away, laughing:

"Wang Yue's Sword God Skill. It's just a small trick! Trying to hurt me, is too difficult. Young man, I've already said, your Dao Practice is too shallow. If you want to battle me, you're still lacking some firepower!"
"Really?"
Ding Ling took a deep breath, a sword danced into the sky.
Qing Frost Swordsmanship activated!
Vigorous Qi burst from the sword tip, forming clusters of flying snow and frost beads!
With Ding Ling's clear shout.
The snowflakes and frost beads scattered all around, piercing and shattering stone after stone.
Amidst the clanging of stones, each one burst open!
In an instant, a rain of shattered stones fell from the sky!
Ding Ling's left hand swiftly gathered the Human Emperor Palm and Lion Palm, repeatedly striking the directions, and the shattered stones fell with precision in every direction.
Within just a few breaths.
Ding Ling had arranged as many as eight Eight Array Maps with the shattered stones!
Ding Ling coldly looked at Zuo Ci:
"Dare you enter my array map testing?"
"Hehe."
Zuo Ci chuckled:
"Don't use the Provocation Technique. I won't fall for it. However..."
His eyes turned slightly, curiously examining the Broken Stone Array for a few moments, stroking his beard and speaking:
"This array map looks familiar. Like I've seen it somewhere before. But I don't remember too well, so this array map probably isn't strong.
Saying so.
He boldly and leisurely walked in, swaggering into the Eight Array Map, looking at Ding Ling:
"Well? How do you plan to handle me?"
"This demon dao is too arrogant!"
Zhao Yun's anger burst forth.

Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhuge Liang, and others also felt incensed. Such a demon dao, frivolous, treating promises as jokes, treating others as nothing, clearly resembles a deity playing in the mortal world, not considering himself as human, purely playing with people's hearts in a mocking manner.

Ding Ling was no longer the same, his wisdom had grown much, and naturally, he saw through Zuo Ci's thoughts and intentions at this moment, causing his favorability towards Zuo Ci to fall to an all-time low.
He no longer had any thought of holding back, deciding that even if he couldn't kill Zuo Ci today, he was definitely going to make him hurt deeply!
Having decided.
Ding Ling hesitated not one bit.
Instantly activated the eight great Eight Array Maps!
In a flash.
Heaven and Earth seemed overturned.

Within the Eight Array Map, sometimes sand and stones flew, sometimes waves surged, sometimes sword qi like frost, sometimes sand piled into mountains... There was nothing but the Forbidden Realm in ten directions of the universe.
Zuo Ci was moved:

"I remember now. This is the ancient Eight Array Map passed down. It's the ancestral Secret Manual of the Zhuge Family, no one has been able to master it for thousands of years. How did you master it!"
He looked at Ding Ling in astonishment, as if seeing Ding Ling for the first time, beginning to take him seriously.
Ding Ling gave no response to him.
Instead, he invigorated himself.
Wielding the Heaven-Swaying Sword!
Howling Moon Sword Technique!
Calm Wind Swordsmanship!
Qing Frost Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
All the sword skills were mastered to their deepest levels, Ding Ling wielded them with ease, and with a casual thrust or swing, he could unleash the boundless power of this superior swordsmanship!
As Ding Ling demonstrated his prowess!
In an instant!
The clear wind breezed through the Ninefold Heaven;
Flying snow and frost beads filled the sky;
Flower patterns adorned all directions;
The Human Emperor stepped forth from the ancient time stream.
Under Ding Ling's clear command, all sword skills revealed their might, attacking Zuo Ci from one side of the Eight Array Map.
Zuo Ci, trapped in the Eight Array Maps, charged forward and backward, up to the heavens and down into the earth, unable to escape in the moment.
In his bewilderment and anxiety, Ding Ling's various sword moves and flower patterns had already arrived.
