chapters.title: Chapter 261 261: Commanding Ghost Gods! The Power of the Human Emperor’s Supreme Skill Unleashed
paragraphs: Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The sword blade resounded, the crisp wind enveloping the Flying Snow Frost Pearl Flower Sword Map, like thunder alongside the flying sand and stone in the Eight Array Map, descending upon Zuo Ci.
Boom crack!
Thud thud!
It took only an instant.
Zuo Ci was dismembered!
But as a wisp of smoke blew past the spot.

He once again manifested his original form, though his face was somewhat grim, scanning all around, trying to find Ding Ling, but Ding Ling hid within the Eight Array Map, appearing faintly, sometimes suddenly in the flying sand, sometimes swiftly above the vast sea, sometimes vanishing among the boundless strange rocks!
Ding Ling swung a sword in the air.
Various sword moves and skills descended like divine interventions.
In the clanging of the sword map, it occasionally stabbed towards Zuo Ci.
Zuo Ci struggled left and right, unable to fend off the attacks, limbs flying skyward, yet again, his head was severed.
For the third time, a wisp of smoke blew past the spot.
Zuo Ci once more manifested his form.
This time his body seemed somewhat illusory, no longer as solid as at the start.
He seemed enraged, with a roar, gusts of sinister wind swept across the Ten Directions Realm, within moments, a portal over two hundred feet high opened in the void within the Eight Array Map.
A giant man, standing three meters tall, stepped out from the portal.
He was clad in black armor.
Held a giant sword in hand.
Wore an iron helmet, face concealed behind a mask, his features indistinct.
But Ding Ling clearly saw his eyes.
They were eyes blazing with green fire.
This was not human!
Ding Ling's scalp tingled, in the world of the Three Kingdoms, there were ghosts?!
Was this indeed not Xuanhuan Three Kingdoms?!
He dared not hesitate longer, with a clear shout, fully activated the Eight Array Map, the eight great maps collectively covered Zuo Ci and the Ghost General.
Then Ding Ling, moving like lightning, with a motion of his right hand, drew the Giant Que Sword.

One hand wielded the Heaven-Swaying Sword, the other the Giant Que Sword, operating the Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill, he interspersed throughout the Eight Array Map, his speed as swift as a whirlwind sweeping over the land!
With his two swords.
One sword used the Sword God Skill!
The other wielded the Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Sword God Skill to slay Zuo Ci!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship struck at the Ghost General.
Clang!
Zuo Ci, using his finger as a sword, for the first time engaged in a skill duel with Ding Ling.
The two fought quickly, astonishingly exchanging no less than ten moves in an instant!
Simultaneously.

Ding Ling split his focus to confront the Ghost General, the Human Emperor Swordsmanship operating with grand and open moves, as if the Human Emperor descended to the earth, each motion carrying celestial might upon him.
Boom!
The Human Emperor Swordsmanship clashed with the Ghost General's giant sword, emitting a deafening sound.
Much to Ding Ling's surprise and delight, the Human Emperor Swordsmanship seemed to restrain the Ghost General.
Moreover.
The Eight Array Map also seemed to be the Ghost General's nemesis!
With both restraining means deployed, Ding Ling was able to press the Ghost General hard!
Ding Ling, who initially thought he was in trouble, was overjoyed, daring not to hold back again?
Each move was a fatal strike!

The Human Emperor Palm Technique, Human Emperor Fist, and Human Emperor Spear Technique were also employed, transforming into a ceaseless stream of vigorous qi through the blade of the Giant Que Sword, like raging waves surging into the Ghost General's shell.
Visible to the naked eye.

The Ghost General screamed continuously as the scalding, searing Human Emperor Pattern grilled it; after merely a few breaths of exchange, Ding Ling finally executed a Human Emperor Swordsmanship move, clang!
He sliced off the Ghost General's head with one stroke.

The Ghost General's towering body crumpled like a Gold Mountain, collapsing like jade pillars before Zuo Ci, and amid Zuo Ci's surprise and anger, the Ghost General promptly dissipated into black smoke.
Ding Ling saw this, his spirit lifted, and he laughed heartily:
"Zuo Ci, no matter how extraordinary your abilities, this time you will not escape! Watch the sword!"
Clang clang clang!
The Giant Que Sword spun, transforming into a storm as it stabbed towards Zuo Ci!
Two swords against Zuo Ci!

Zuo Ci, who originally could only match Ding Ling evenly, instantly fell into disadvantage, as Ding Ling's speed increased, intermittently vanishing within the Eight Array Map to attack Zuo Ci with sharp swords, like a ghost god lurking in the dark ambushing humans.
Every surging assault managed to sever a part of Zuo Ci's body!
As Ding Ling exerted his full strength!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Ghost Prison Spear Technique!
Overlord Halberd Technique!
Various supreme skills!
Executed with the two swords, the emerging moves were unpredictable and untouchable, like the antelope's horns, having no trace to follow.
How could Zuo Ci compete against such a fearsome opponent?
He was steadily beaten back, ultimately blocked by the Eight Array Map, unable to escape; once again, Ding Ling caught up, the dual swords dancing!
One sword executed the Howling Moon Spear Technique! Like a lone wolf confronting the cold moon, its overbearing and iron-blooded aura spread throughout the ten directions!
The other sword executed the Breaking Army Spear Skill! Its path unstoppable, as if breaking through the legion of thousands, an unrivaled War God's aggressiveness charged at the stars!
The two swords produced a perfect effect akin to dual spears!
Zuo Ci was baffled by these peculiar moves, momentarily unsure how to defend!

Ding Ling seized the opportunity, the Giant Que Sword stabbed downward, howling! In the faint momentary flash, a pattern of a wolf howling at the moon seemed to linger in the void! In the next instant!
The sword tip pierced through Zuo Ci's skull!
He stared at Ding Ling in astonishment, rage, and disbelief.
Crackle pop!
The elderly body once more shattered, falling on the spot, and shortly after, transformed into a wisp of smoke soaring into the sky, as if attempting to escape from the upper position once more.
Ding Ling would not have it his way.
The three great Breathing Techniques fortified him! His aura changed again and again, akin to a magnificent, sanctified yet sharply imposing Sword Saint!

With a stomp on the ground, like a cannonball exiting the barrel, he soared a hundred meters into the air in an instant, catching up to the smoke in a flash, then crossed his swords, slashing down furiously!
Sword Qi surged like rivers sweeping the eight directions, the sword map clanging like thousands of divine swords in resonance!
As the sword maps flashed from time to time in the void!
The smoke was forcibly erased by the sword map in the void!
In the next moment.
On the earth below.
The blue smoke billowed, Zuo Ci's form emerged once more, but this time his shape turned extremely dim, he looked at Ding Ling, somewhat shocked and angry:
"Young man, your mastery of the Eight Array Map surpasses my imagination! But isn't it time to stop?"
"Hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor, and I will spare you!"
Ding Ling descended from mid-air, falling into the Eight Array Map, appearing and disappearing, left to right, front to back.
His voice was ethereal and elusive, defying pinpointing.
"How do you know I have learned the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor?"
Zuo Ci was stunned, but quickly he realized:
"It is rumored Daoist Yhiuu Ji taught you Taiqing Breathing Technique and Taiqing Talisman. Now it seems absolutely accurate! Did he tell you I possess the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor?"
"It was my guess."
Ding Ling said coldly: "What? You don't believe it? If not, forget it!"
Daoist Yhiuu Ji said Zuo Ci knew the Escape Armor Transformation Art!

Ding Ling thought of the records in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms and some unofficial histories and casually mentioned the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor, unexpectedly hitting the mark. Zuo Ci indeed learned this technique!
It seems Zuo Ci indeed might have, as the unofficial histories suggest, reached the Transformation Realm in cultivating the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor!

chapters.title: Chapter 262 262: Zuo Ci Is Immortal! Quest Complete
paragraphs: Zuo Ci was already like an Immortal among men!
No longer comparable to mere mortals.

No wonder his demeanor was so lofty, like a Deity overlooking the Mortal World, boldly confident in his Great Abilities and Divine Techniques, considering himself a god, disregarding the kings and generals of the Mortal World as mere toys to be played with.
However, toying with the Human Martial God, Ding Ling, was like kicking an iron plate!
Ding Ling would not easily let go of such a character, too dangerous!
And since they already had enmity, there was absolutely no reason not to kill or eliminate him.
Thinking of this.

Ding Ling's attacks became even more fierce and swift, striking like thunderbolts, hitting like a meteor crashing down to the Mortal World, amid rumbling sounds, the two Divine Swords intertwined, unleashing the destructive effect like the Infinite Sword Mountain crashing into a Human Kingdom, clang!
Just one strike!

The Human Emperor Sword Map, the Setting Sun Diagram, descended in succession, in an instant, slicing Zuo Ci's body into pieces, splitting head and torso, shattering into dozens of fragments, scattering in all directions.
Kong!
His body suddenly exploded, once again transforming into a green smoke.
This time Zuo Ci's figure was even dimmer.
Teetering on the brink of collapse.
As if a breeze could blow him away.
Ding Ling didn't care.
Deadly moves continued to emerge.
Killing Zuo Ci eight times.
Upon preparing to kill him the ninth time, Zuo Ci shouted loudly:
"Wait!"
"What's this? Are you planning to hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor?!"
Ding Ling paused, his figure hidden within the Eight Array Map, his voice wafting like the clouds in the sky!
"You have quite an ambition, actually desiring my Heavenly Book of Escape Armor."
Zuo Ci's face was very unpleasant, gloomy enough to drip water:

"You are so young, yet your Sword Technique, Spear Technique, and Halberd Technique have entered the Transformation Realm, not to mention your control over the powers of the Celestial Human Realm, you even surpass me, incredible!
I, Zuo Ci, have cultivated for a hundred years, becoming Immortal, transcending the extraordinary, no longer a person of the Mortal World, at any time may ascend to Immortal Kingdom!
Years of cultivation far surpass yours! Countless fortuitous encounters gathered all upon myself!
How could you possibly surpass me in the mastery of the Celestial Human Realm's powers!"
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed out loud:

"Zuo Ci, it's you who overestimated yourself, underestimating the heroes of the world! You don't have invincible power, yet your ambition reaches the sky, disregarding mortal kings. Such a person as you, will inevitably fail!"
"That may not necessarily be the case."
Zuo Ci's face suddenly darkened, scanning all around, yet unable to find Ding Ling:
"If it weren't for my miscalculation, you would never have defeated me this time!"
"To the victor go the spoils! Will you hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor or not?"
"Hehe.
Zuo Ci sneered coldly:
"How could I ever hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor intertwined with my life and body."
As the words fell.
Clang clang clang!
The Sword Qi roared, the Evil Qi, Killing Qi surged like a river, sweeping toward Zuo Ci like a vast wave, seemingly about to drown and crush him to fragments.
Zuo Ci once again shouted loudly:
"Hold on, as long as you answer a few questions. I might hand it over."
Kong!
The overwhelming Evil Qi, Killing Qi instantly dissipated into nothingness.

Zuo Ci was secretly astonished, Ding Ling's control over the Celestial Human Realm's powers seemed to have reached the Transformation Realm! Terrifying to the extreme! He distinctly recalled that a person entering the Celestial Human Realm, without fortuitous encounters in the early stages, their celestial power would be scattered and uncoordinated, even if there were ten, Zuo Ci would not fear!
Yet Ding Ling's Celestial Human Realm power, extremely restrained, freely retractable, and effortlessly controlled, clearly reached an exceptionally profound and advanced realm.
This realm, even Zuo Ci had not reached!
How could he not be shocked, envious, jealous!
Then hatred arose!
Toward a mere junior reaching a realm unattained by a god of the Mortal World like himself, why?!
"Ask away!"
Ding Ling's voice rang out.
Zuo Ci took a deep breath and said:
"According to the information I've gathered, you have only cultivated for about two years! How could your improvement speed be so unbelievably fast?!"
His voice was sharp and powerful, like a blade able to pierce through metal and stone.
Evidently.
At this moment, his emotions were extremely complex and turbulent!
"I have a unique natural talent!"

Ding Ling's skin had grown quite thick by now, or perhaps it was because for nearly two years he was praised as a peerless genius daily, his tolerance had reached a highly elevated state, now displaying only a bit of his full-level acting skills, fully encapsulating the role of an arrogant, confident peerless genius:
"Naturally, I can accomplish things ordinary people cannot, what's so remarkable about that?!"
"So, you attribute your control of celestial power also to having extraordinary bones and talent?"
Zuo Ci was both astonished and uncertain.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling laughed loudly:
"Zuo Ci, there are countless extraordinary talents in the world, you're not the only genius! When someone greater and more talented appears, your downfall is inevitable."
"Hmph!"
Zuo Ci snorted coldly:
"Though I may lose, I will definitely not die."
His body slightly shook, a resolute and overwhelming aura swept the ten directions:
"Ding Ling, if you kill me today, believe me, you will certainly not fare well!"
He shouted loudly:
"Because if you kill one of me, there are millions more of me!"
"Stop boasting!"
Ding Ling's brows stood like a blade, without further hesitation, he attacked Zuo Ci again, as the Divine Sword Shield descended, clang!
Like a knife cutting through tofu.
Crackling!
Clang!
Zuo Ci's body once again shattered to pieces, falling to the ground.
This time, he did not disintegrate into green smoke.
Instead, he gradually turned into a pool of thick liquid!
The thick liquid was nauseating and stench-filled.
"Ding Ling!"
Zuo Ci's somewhat shrill voice echoed incessantly in the air:
"I am undying! Remember, I will definitely come back for you!"
[Mission 2: You must defeat the strongest in the Plane to prove you are a true War God. Task progress 100%.]
[Congratulations player Ding Ling, you have completed all tasks on the Path of the Glory War God!]
[Mission overachieved! Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal and proceed to the Martial Hero Plane World now?]
Accompanied by the in-game prompt.
Zuo Ci's voice thundered into his ears.
The two sounds intertwined, causing Ding Ling some dizziness.
Ding Ling shook his head, steadied himself, took a deep breath, and glanced at the Character Panel.
Indeed.
All tasks were completed.
So it seems.
Just now, it was true that he'd defeated Zuo Ci?
Then what did Zuo Ci mean when he said he wasn't dead?
Ding Ling's face was somewhat dark.
He hadn't expected to encounter such a cunning individual who played with hearts and regarded kings as mere jesters at the end of the Three Kingdoms World!
If it weren't for his decisive action.
He might have been toyed with by Zuo Ci like a fool!
At that time, let alone completing Mission 2.
Surviving might even have been a problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 263: One of the Incarnations! Where Is the Corpse?
paragraphs: Ding Ling is proficient in Observing People Skill, Stargazing Skill, psychology, and more.
Although he couldn't understand Zuo Ci's thoughts at a glance, through their constant interactions, Zuo Ci's eyes and expressions have undergone complex changes.
Ding Ling could already conclude.
Zuo Ci not only wanted to toy with him! He might also kill him.
Because he isn't Cao Mengde, not one of the corresponding celestial Star Generals, killing him wouldn't cost Zuo Ci much Dao Practice, might even enhance it?
Of course, this is just Ding Ling's guess.
But he has read many ancient texts and Secret Manuals.
He already knows a fact.

That among cultivators, they cannot recklessly kill human Emperors, Princes, great Generals, etc., or else the entanglement of Cause and Effect will descend, and the killing karma will befall, making possible transcendence from this world difficult, and perhaps causing a drop in their Daoist Technique and cultivation.
Compared to Martial Dao, there's not so much concern.
Of course, perhaps Daoist Techniques in other worlds also aren't as scrupled.
But it's obvious that the Dao of the Three Kingdoms World has such constraints and limits!
And it's precisely because of these constraints that Zuo Ci didn't dare to arbitrarily erase Human Emperors and others.
However, Ding Ling isn't one of the corresponding celestial Generals and Emperor Stars, he is an Alien, killing him wouldn't have much impact on this world.
Zuo Ci enjoys toying with people, akin to a deity high above, seeing mortals as ants.
Would a god care about the life of an ant?
Casually stepping on and crushing them is just like blowing out air, they don't care much at all.
And the reason for making Ding Ling wait for a few days.
Maybe it's just to watch a drama.
After all, the world is too boring.
Zuo Ci himself creates a few dramas for amusement, it's only normal.
Especially the drama of a Human Martial God, how interesting could that be?
In Zuo Ci's view, this might be exactly it.
The above...

Is the 'viewpoint' that Ding Ling, through using Observing People Skill and others, continuously observed Zuo Ci's appearance, eyes, and combined them with various ancient Secret Manuals and texts, inferred!
As for how far this is from the truth?
Ding Ling felt it shouldn't be too far off.
It's also by knowing Zuo Ci's strange personality, his unreliability, and once his murderous intent arises, he might just crush him like an 'ant'.
Ding Ling decided to make frequent fatal moves decisively!
The offense was already fatal.
There was no need to show mercy.
Only what surprised Ding Ling greatly was.
"Zuo Ci doesn't seem to be dead?"
Looking at the pools of thick liquid on the ground, Ding Ling's expression was rather grave:
"Dead people shouldn't look like this!"
What remains from the dead should be the corpse!
But what Zuo Ci left was just a foul-smelling thick liquid.
Thinking again about Zuo Ci's previous Crow incarnation, and now the old man incarnation.
Ding Ling furrowed his brow:
"Could it really be as Zuo Ci said? He has thousands of himself? Unlikely." Ding Ling denied:
"If there were really that many of him. Why would he let me kill one incarnation?"
Ding Ling speculated the old man Zuo Ci transformed into should be one incarnation.
"Just one incarnation needs to be killed nine times. This should be one of his most powerful incarnations available?"
Ding Ling was thoughtful.
Furthermore, the task was completed.
It shows indeed it's one of his most powerful incarnations!
This kind of incarnation, Zuo Ci must not have many, otherwise, he might have already come to kill Ding Ling."
"Not worthy of being the elusive Immortal of the Divine Dragon Zuo Ci!"
Ding Ling thought about Zuo Ci's ability to transform into countless species and command Ghost Gods, and felt quite heavy-hearted.
This Three Kingdoms World has become incomprehensible!
"Seems like even standing at the peak of this world. I haven't touched the water beneath the world's Abyss!"
"This world's water might be unimaginably deep!"
"But no matter how deep it is. I won't stay in this world for long. I might leave soon."
Ding Ling did not choose to immediately redeem a Glory Medal to leave the Three Kingdoms World.
He still has some matters that must be resolved.
He also has attachments in this world.

When Ding Ling dispersed the mighty power of the Eight Array Map, and walked out of the stones where Evil Qi soared, killing intent was unpredictable, Diao Chan and others immediately rushed over, scrutinizing him:
"Prince, are, are you alright?"
Diao Chan and others seemed visibly anxious, apprehensive, fearful.
Apparently, the combat scene just now had completely stunned them!
Indeed that's the case.
Seeing a Ghost Gate open in the void and a Ghost General stepping out, they were so terrified their bodies nearly froze.
But soon after came deep concern and worry for Ding Ling.
Diao Chan tried several times to rush to rescue Ding Ling, only to be decisively stopped by Zhuge Liang, who said: "Rushing over now would only hinder. We should believe in the Prince!"
"I'm fine. Very well."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"Phew."
Zhuge Liang breathed a sigh of relief, and laughed loudly:
"I knew the Prince's Divine Skill was invincible, that demon Daoist couldn't possibly defeat the Prince. Looking back, my discernment was keen, I guessed the outcome in one go!"
"But your previous expression wasn't exactly what you're saying now."
Diao Chan felt relieved, joyful, but hearing Zhuge Liang's words, she couldn't help but chuckle lightly:
"You're just saying it after the fact!"
"Injustice."
Zhuge Liang pouted:
"I was just worried about the Prince, naturally uncontrolled emotions showed on my face. But truly from the heart, I believe the Prince is the World's Number One! No one is a match for the Prince!
That demon Daoist, arrogant and foolishly underestimated the Prince, being killed was normal."
Saying this.
He glanced at the direction where the Eight Array Map was located, and said with some confusion:
"Where's the demon Daoist's body?"
"Indeed."
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Yun, Chen Dao also looked over, very puzzled, shocked:
"Did he escape again?"
"He turned into thick liquid."
Ding Ling pointed to the location of the thick liquid and explained a few words.
The group understood, yet all felt uneasy:

"This demon Daoist is truly extraordinary and terrifying. Killing him multiple times still didn't work. Thankfully Prince's Martial Dao strength is Tongtian, otherwise, anyone else facing this demon Daoist would mostly surely be dead!"
Diao Chan and Zhao Yun's strength had reached Super-Elite, so they clearly saw the situation.
Da and Xiao Qiao and others were taught and guided by Ding Ling daily, their vision and mindset were incomparable, naturally possessing extraordinary judgment.
Zhuge Liang goes without saying.
Watching the battle, their emotions were extremely turbulent.
When Ding Ling had the upper hand, they were ecstatic.
When Zuo Ci couldn't be killed, their hearts sank down again, a bit uneasy!
In these repeated joys, unease, excitement, and fear... emotional swings.
Their moods were like a rollercoaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 264: I’ll Pay a Billion! It’s Confirmed
paragraphs: Sometimes up, sometimes down.
Sometimes soaring, sometimes sinking.
As turbulent as the rise and fall of mountains and seas, as unsettling as facing a giant beast!
Fortunately, Ding Ling ultimately won.
They all completely relaxed.
Their admiration and amazement for Ding Ling reached a peak at that moment.

Especially Zhuge Liang, who already admired Ding Ling, became even more impressed after this battle, for the first time thinking, ’If you’re going to learn, learn martial arts; if you’re going to compete, compete with the Prince!’
The reason for this thought.
It was because he realized a fact!
When strength reaches the level of Zuo Ci and Ding Ling, every move, every word and action, can easily influence the structure of this world!
If someone as strong as Ding Ling wants to change the world!
No one can stop him!
Even an army of a million, tens of millions, would be in vain!
In the face of absolute power, all careful preparations, all schemes and intrigues, are just jokes!
Zhuge Liang was boiling with enthusiasm, and at this moment, he, being in the middle school age, developed a strong desire to abandon literature for martial arts, aiming to become a Martial Dao God!
After all.
Becoming a Martial Dao God means standing easily at the pinnacle of the world, overlooking all beings! What can’t be solved? Who can hurt him?
And studying literature?
Although it can also make one invincible in the world.
Compared to martial arts, it is much more laborious and mentally taxing!
Zhuge Liang calculated in his mind and thought that learning martial arts was more cost-effective. Of course, he couldn’t really give up literature.
He just felt it was necessary to shift his focus more towards martial arts in the future!
After all, he considered his martial arts talent to be outstanding, with a high likelihood of becoming a Martial God.
The more he thought about it.
The brighter Zhuge Liang’s eyes became.
He looked at Ding Ling and thought to himself:
"The position where the Prince stands is my current goal. One day, I too will shine brightly and dominate all directions, leaving my name in history!"
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, and the rest didn’t have as many thoughts as Zhuge Liang.
All they needed was for Ding Ling to be safe and sound!
After carefully checking Ding Ling’s body.
Once they confirmed that Ding Ling was truly unharmed,
they all sighed in relief, understanding each other’s thoughts in the exchange of glances, and couldn’t help but laugh.
Zhao Yun and Chen Dao completely regarded Ding Ling as a milestone and idol on the martial path!
After chatting for a while, the group
all mounted their horses, ready to return to Chang’an City.
And as some bystanders saw this, they couldn’t help but shout:
"Ding Ling, will you take apprentices? I’ll pay a hundred thousand, no, a million! Just to teach me Divine Skill!"
"A million, who are you looking down on?! Ding Ling, I’ll pay a billion! You don’t need to teach me anything else, just teach me the Eight Array Map!"
"Ding Ling, look over here, look here..."
You can tell they are players!
Only players have such a distinct style from the natives!
Even though many players have started families and careers in this world, their inherent worldview is difficult to change quickly.

Especially some rich second-generations from the real world, who are accustomed to using money to solve problems, find that this trick works equally well in the Game World! Making them very popular in the Three Kingdoms World.
After inadvertently hearing about Ding Ling waiting outside the pavilion,
their curiosity drove them to come and see, but since Ding Ling had been waiting for too long, many left out of boredom, while many new people joined in curiosity.
Many people came and went in groups.
Now the players here are different from the newcomers a few days ago; of course, there are also some die-hard fans of Ding Ling, persistently waiting here.
But among them, real moneyed people are a minority.
"Ding Ling. I’ll pay a billion! As long as you can teach me to become like you, no, even half, a quarter? A tenth of your strength will do! Please, Ding Ling!"
Some extravagant top rich second-generations shouted loudly, almost going over to hug Ding Ling’s leg.
But because Ding Ling was a prince of the Great Wei Kingdom,
when Cao Mengde heard he was waiting here, he sent a squad of soldiers to maintain order.
So these rich second-generations had no way to really get close to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t acknowledge them, riding his horse towards Chang’an City.
"Confirmed!"
A player sighed upon seeing this:

"Ding Ling must be a descendant of a Hidden Clan! Otherwise, how could he ignore a billion! If it were me hearing a billion, my heart would almost jump out! If I had a billion, why would I still be playing games? What can’t I do in the real world?!"
"Exactly. Hearing a billion and still not changing his expression, just like a normal person hearing ten bucks! Worthy of being the rumored, behind-the-scenes game boss’s son!
For a moment,
there were many opinions.
But undeniably, Ding Ling’s popularity soared!
This group who witnessed Ding Ling’s battle with Zuo Ci returned to the real world and sensationalized the fight.
As a result, Ding Ling’s popularity once again skyrocketed!
Of course, there were more skeptics, thinking this too unbelievable:
"How can the Three Kingdoms World be so Xuanhuan? This is clearly the world of Ghosts and Gods!"
"Heh. Just read some unofficial history. Zuo Ci once conjured peonies and catfish out of thin air in the wild history, mocking Cao Mengde and his ministers, leaving them helpless to only watch!
In Romance of the Three Kingdoms, there are words praising Zuo Ci: ’Soaring in the clouds across Jiuzhou, wandering freely with only magic!’ This shows it clearly!

"Agree with the statement above. Moreover, the game’s Three Kingdoms World setting is obviously different from Romance of the Three Kingdoms. The Combat Power is higher and more terrifying! Can’t be generalized!"
And after coming to their senses, the skeptics suddenly realized the terrifying nature of Ding Ling!
Even Zuo Ci, who could command ghosts and gods and was killed several times but never died, was extinguished by Ding Ling!
At what terrifying level is this Ding Ling?!
"Unimaginable!"
"Terrifying!"
"A divine being of the present age!"
Some who were itching to act against Ding Ling, upon seeing Ding Ling become more terrifying, were frustrated and immediately abandoned their plans.
After all...
If the Eight Array Map could be used in the real world, and its power was as strong as in the Three Kingdoms World,
even one Eight Array Map would be enough to ruin many families!
Without a foolproof plan.
No one would undertake a task that is known to be suicidal.
"Ding Ling! I want to have monkeys with you!"
"Prince. Look over here!"
On the return journey, people occasionally shouted at Ding Ling.

Some of the female die-hard fans said things that made Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao blush; they exchanged looks and then all looked at Ding Ling, each thinking about when they could also have a child with Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Glory Medal Settlement (10/10)
paragraphs: Ding Ling was completely unaware of this.
But it was certain that without absolute strength, he wouldn’t consider having children.
Clatter clatter clatter!
Ding Ling and his group galloped swiftly along the road.
Occasionally, someone would shout at Ding Ling, clearly players, as only players would be so lacking in manners.
Zhao Yun and his group were not surprised, yet they felt quite honored.
After all, Ding Ling was their leader!
Especially Zhao Yun.
He felt that choosing to follow Ding Ling was the most correct decision he made in his life!
The defeat of Zuo Ci.
In some high-level circles within the Three Kingdoms, it stirred up quite a wave.
But it quickly settled down again.
Because the one who defeated Zuo Ci was Ding Ling!
And Ding Ling, as the Guardian God of the Great Wei Kingdom, had long been enshrined with a Golden Body, mythologized by many!
In their eyes.
Ding Ling was inherently invincible.
It was only natural for him to defeat Zuo Ci.
If he had lost, that would have been abnormal! The very foundation of the Great Wei Kingdom would have trembled, wavered!
Cao Mengde and others were well aware of this.
Upon learning of Ding Ling’s experience, they breathed a sigh of relief, secretly rejoicing:
"It seems Ding Ling truly is the world’s number one. Even the elusive and legendary old immortal Zuo Ci has been defeated. Who else can stop Ding Ling?"
Cao Mengde became even more open and decisive.
Once various national and public beneficial policies were released.
Everyone was required to complete them immediately.
No one dared to disobey!
Because, the Great Wei Kingdom had a living deity: Ding Ling!
Ding Ling stayed in his mansion in Chang’an City for several months.
He was waiting for Zuo Ci.
Meanwhile, he secretly ordered spies to investigate Jiuzhou and Ten Lands to see if they could find traces of Zuo Ci.
If they could find him.
Ding Ling would eliminate this threat at the first opportunity.
If the roots are not eradicated.
The spring wind will bring them back to life!
This principle is understood by many. Ding Ling was no exception.
Without completely killing Zuo Ci, Ding Ling was not entirely at ease.
But unfortunately...
Zuo Ci completely vanished. There was no sign, no trace of him.
It was very clear.

He was frightened by Ding Ling. Certainly, he felt that he was currently no match for Ding Ling, so he hid away, waiting for his Divine Skill to reach Great Success before coming out again to engage Ding Ling in a magical battle.
"If that’s the case? I have no reason to continue waiting."
Ding Ling pondered for a long moment, then stood up:

"Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Feng, Pan Feng have all been brought to Chang’an City by my command, Pan Feng and Zhao Feng have become generals, Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan now also live in my mansion, starting to receive daily guidance from me and Zhao Yun in martial arts and herbal baths!"
"I don’t have many regrets left in this world."
Ding Ling walked to the window, looking out at the courtyard.
In the courtyard.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan got along very harmoniously, chatting and listening together.
They were mostly discussing martial arts and Ding Ling.
It was very obvious.
Their hearts now, besides Ding Ling, were solely focused on martial arts!

The reason why all the women, including Da and Xiao Qiao, were so engrossed in martial arts was that Ding Ling hoped they could become heroines, not inferior to top masters like Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, or even Pan Feng, Zhao Yun!
Ding Ling had high expectations for them!
They, flattered and surprised, could only train hard.
Over the past few months.
Du Qingcheng, who had a high talent in the Breathing Technique, also stepped into the Super-Elite standard.
Although her martial arts were average, her physical quality was extremely high, not much inferior to Diao Chan.
To put it plainly.
Du Qingcheng was akin to a monk with extremely high Inner Strength but only average Martial Arts!
In addition.

Along with their extraordinary talent and bone structure.
They had surprisingly reached the Half-step Super First-class realm.
Zhen Jiang, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, and several women followed closely, making rapid progress in the Martial Dao.
Not to mention Diao Chan.

She had already stepped into the Super-Elite Peak standard. Although she wasn’t an All-Powerful King with all four-dimensional attributes like Ding Ling, she did have one attribute excluding Charm Value at the Super-Elite Peak, which was very rare indeed.
"It’s time to leave."
Ding Ling also wasn’t truly idle these past months.
He had already dealt with everything possible.
Even the Achievement Medals for the entire Zhuge Xuan and Pang Tong families were cleaned out.
He also obtained the ’Phoenix Chick Breathing Technique’ and other Secret Manuals from the Pang Tong family.
He had done everything that could be completed.
As of now:
[Achievement Medals: Regular 103, E-level 22]
This is what’s left after redeeming all his strength back to reality!
The Glory Medals were still zero.
Ding Ling hadn’t started settling it yet.
But today.
He was ready to begin.
Ding Ling scrolled up on his Character Panel.
Reaching the earlier message prompt:
[Mission completed in excess! Would you like to redeem Glory Medals now? Head to Martial Hero Plane World?]
"Yes!"
He clicked ’yes’!
[Conversion successful!]
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Strongmen: 75/20.]
Later, he defeated people like Zuo Ci, Pan Feng, so the mission progress leapt forward several more steps.
[Mission 1. Earn Glory Medal 1. Glory Increase 375%. Final Glory Medals approximately 4 pieces.]
[2, You must defeat the strongest in the Plane. Prove you are the true War God. Progress 100%]
[Mission 2. Earn Glory Medal 1]
[3: You must let your name as War God resound throughout the entire Plane World. 100%/100%.]
[Mission 3: Earn Glory Medal 1]
Although the rules had more than a dozen clauses.
The main path to obtaining the Glory Medals was still the first three clauses.
Therefore, the final number of Glory Medals he received was: 6 pieces.
[Glory Medals settlement complete.]
[Would you like to open the Path of Glory now?]
Ding Ling looked askance, surprised.
There’s more?
He reached out and clicked on the panel in the air.
This Character Panel was generally invisible to others besides the individual.
[The Path of Glory is opening. Please select a place to set the Path of Glory.]

[Friendly Reminder: The Path of Glory is the Celestial Ladder. It allows you to directly reach a stronger plane from the current plane! As long as the strength meets the requirements of the current plane. Anyone can climb the Celestial Ladder, and once the location is set, it cannot be changed, moved, or converted.]
Ding Ling was moved.
It could be played this way?!

"Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao..."
He recited everyone’s names:
"Ride with me to the outskirts of Chang’an City."
If truly on this day he was forced against his will to ascend the Celestial Ladder of the Path of Glory!
Unable to return.
Ding Ling’s meeting with Diao Chan and others might be the last. Or perhaps they might meet again in some plane in the future?

chapters.title: Chapter 266: The Celestial Ladder Descends Upon the Mortal Realm (1/13)
paragraphs: Ding Ling thought of a friendly reminder.
It’s very clear.
Once the Path of Glory is constructed.
Anyone whose strength meets the requirements can ascend it, whether they are players or local natives?
As for the facts.
It remains unknown.
But Ding Ling had already thought of this possibility.
If such a possibility does exist.
With the aptitude and strength of Zhao Yun and Diao Chan, it’s uncertain if they might really meet in some future Plane World.
Clop, clop, clop!
Ding Ling and his group rode out of Chang’an City.
As they departed.
The whole of Chang’an City seemed to be disturbed.
It’s known that the people of the Prince’s Mansion going out of the city in such a grand manner collectively is the second time in months.
The first time was during the standoff with the demon daoist Zuo Ci!
Needless to say, something significant must have happened.
Many were excited.
And followed along.
Spies were also quick to report this to Cao Mengde.

Cao Mengde was working at his desk. Over the years, he had dedicated himself to the country and its people, striving tirelessly to govern the Great Wei Kingdom, bringing about prosperity and progress!
Prosperity and flourishing are just around the corner!
Far better than the Great Han Kingdom during the Yellow Turban Rebellion.
Thus now that the common people lead good lives, few remember the Great Han Kingdom.
The common people’s thoughts are so simple.
Whoever can bring them peace, harmony, stability, and happiness, they support.
Although there are still many aristocrats and old powers opposing the Great Wei Kingdom, they cannot stir great waves anymore!
Now under Cao Mengde’s iron-handed rule, with the aid of talents like Guo Jia, the Great Wei Kingdom has entered the right path and has sped far ahead.
Plus, with Ding Ling as the Guardian God of the nation.
Any demonic creatures that dare cause trouble or rebellion are suppressed and cleansed by blood!
As batch after batch of rebellious forces were cleared out.
The remaining remnants are no longer a threat, as they are like eggs striking stones, mantises trying to stop carriages, and ants shaking trees compared to the Great Wei Kingdom!
It is because he sees it clearly.
Ding Ling leaves without regret.
Now whether the Great Wei Kingdom has him or not makes no difference.
He has thoroughly fulfilled his promises to Zhang Zhongjing and others, and can leave Diao Chan and the rest with peace of mind.
With a stable environment.
They can live well.
Of course.
The reason for leaving at this time is also related to Tong Yuan and Wang Yue breaking their shackles and entering the Celestial Human Realm.
Ding Ling entrusted them both to look after Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao a bit. They agreed.
Though they didn’t quite understand why initially.
But since Ding Ling spared no effort in guiding them on breaking the Celestial Human Shackles and even taught them the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, they had no reason to refuse.
Clop, clop, clop!
Arriving ten miles outside Chang’an City.
The same old pavilion stood.
Ding Ling leaped off the horse’s back.
Standing in the pavilion.
Ignoring the pointing and discussing players and natives.
Under the earnest eyes of Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhao Yun, and others.
Ding Ling opened the Character Panel and clicked.
[Confirm the selection of the ancient pavilion outside Chang’an City?]
Confirm!
[Selection completed. Cannot be altered!]
Boom!
In the next instant.
Heaven and Earth changed color.
Heaven and Earth reversed!
Rumble!
The bright day suddenly darkened, dark clouds shrouded the sky, and streaks of lightning, like dragons and serpents, swayed through the high sky, giving off dragon roars that shook the heavens.
Everyone was terrified by it.
At a loss for what to do.
"What on earth is happening?"
In the Imperial Palace, Cao Mengde was also so startled that he almost overturned the table, and with help from others, he walked out of the Imperial Study.
Looking up at the sky.
Seeing dark clouds pressing down on the city, the city looked about to collapse; a storm was coming, the wind filled the building!
As if it were a winter’s night.
The night is cold and frosty! Piercing through soul and bone, the cold made everyone shiver uncontrollably!
Wisps of cold wind descended from the Ninth Heaven like a tornado, leaving a desolate icy frost in its wake!
As if in the blink of an eye.
They had entered the Ice Age.
In the thunderous rumble, visibly.
After the cold wind came, there was flying snow everywhere.
Such a spectacle.
Still happening during the scorching summer!
Everyone was utterly horrified and bewilderedly astounded to the extreme.

Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Gongsun Zan, Taishi Ci, Sun Ce, Ma Chao, Huang Zhong, Xiahou Yuan, and other formidable warriors all stepped out of their mansions, looking up at the Celestial Palace with a sense of trepidation and fear.
Like mortals facing Mount Tai;
Even like birds facing the vast sea!
The feeling of insignificance and trepidation is indescribable with words.
Huuong!
As everyone was shocked, an ethereal sound pierced through the world, like a sun breaking the darkness, a beam of sunlight suddenly penetrating through the darkness and thunder dragons!
Descending from the sky, falling towards outside Chang’an City.
"That position."
Guan Yu and the others quickly glanced over:
"Isn’t that where the prince’s followers reported he went?"
They pondered:
"Could all this strange phenomenon be related to the prince?"
The more they thought, the less they dared to believe.
But recalling the earth-shattering scene when Ding Ling took action, they couldn’t help but fall silent.
Afterward.
All tacitly put on armor, grabbed weapons, and rushed on horseback towards outside Chang’an City.
Instinctively.
They felt that something unspeakably significant happened this time!
Absolutely cannot miss it!
Rumble!
That beam of light shattered the tornado formed by the cold wind, smashed the numerous thunder dragons, and cleared all the ice and snow.
Its appearance.
Like a majestic deity descending to earth.
Every move, unimaginable.
The sun reappeared, the warm light falling on people, the cold that chilled to the bone disappearing without a trace.
The common people all involuntarily looked toward where the light fell.
That was outside Chang’an City.
What on earth happened there?!
Ding Ling looked up at the Celestial Palace, watching the beam of light descending to earth.
He saw that the light resembled the Celestial Ladder.
Extending all the way from the heavenly direction to his feet, landing in front of him.
Everyone stared at Ding Ling, dumbfounded.
As if looking at a deity.
"Your Highness."
Zhao Yun was moved:
"This, this, is?!"
Diao Chan and the Da and Xiao Qiao were on the verge of tears, seeming to have a premonition that Ding Ling was about to leave them.
They clearly saw that the Celestial Ladder formed by the light was meant for Ding Ling. Otherwise, why would it fall so precisely in front of Ding Ling!
Looking up.
The Celestial Ladder reached straight into the clouds, its end obscured by clouds, invisible.
But Diao Chan and the others knew that this journey of Ding Ling’s might mean no return.
"This is the Path of Glory. The Celestial Ladder!"
Ding Ling gazed deeply at Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Yun, Chen Dao, and others:
"I want to pursue a stronger path of martial arts. So I must see more vast, stronger worlds."
"Your Highness."
Diao Chan’s eyes were slightly red.

chapters.title: Chapter 267: The First Clearer’s Reward! Gate of Glory (2/13)
paragraphs: Diao Chan is iron-blooded, resolute, brave, tenacious, fearless of death.
She is a true heroine!
Heroes may bleed but do not shed tears until the moment of heartbreak arrives!
At this moment, Diao Chan’s eyes are red, her graceful body trembling slightly, evidently showing she is overwhelmed with fear and sadness.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng are no different.
Zhen Jiang is even shedding tears, quietly wiping her eyes, not daring to say much.
Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Yun, and others show varied expressions.
But without exception, all are filled with reluctance and longing for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling knows if he delays further, he may not be able to leave.
Because he too is reluctant to leave just like that.
Yet the path of Martial Dao is long and arduous.
If he were to become enamored with this place, should others break into the Martial Hero Plane or other higher-tiered planes, can he guarantee that all he possesses now will not be snatched away?
Moreover.
The technology in the Three Kingdoms World is also developing crazily.
If in the future, they develop nuclear bombs, can he withstand them?
What can he use to protect himself and shield Diao Chan and the others?
Too many uncertainties surround him.
The most uncertain remains the real world.
Currently, no player has broken into the Celestial Human Realm, so they don’t know the details within, but what if one day they break through?
Once they comprehend it, will they hunt Ding Ling relentlessly to seize his opportunities?
Just to rob Ding Ling of his fortuitous encounters?
Humans may not harbor malice against tigers, but tigers can harm humans!
Be wary of others is indispensable.
Ding Ling never shies away from speculating on players with the worst intentions!
Because he understands.
Good people exist in this world, but there are also definitely many bad ones.
Some are even rotten to the core, beyond absurd, beyond imagination!
Yet reality is such a mess!
Unbelievable, yet undeniable!
To avoid being surpassed by other players in the future, and for a brighter future.
Ding Ling must keep running forward!
Until reaching the summit!
Thus.
After saying comforting words to Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, he decisively stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Boom!
The moment he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, the Dharma Conch blew, the heavens roared, as if blessing Ding Ling with a symphony!
Golden light surged on the Celestial Ladder like a rushing stream.
Instantly sweeping Ding Ling up into the Ninefold Heaven.
He gazed down at the world.
Seeing the figures of Diao Chan and the others grow smaller, until they completely disappeared.
Then Chang’an City too shrank so small it was no longer visible.
All he saw was the vast white mist and the shimmering golden Celestial Ladder, expanding and contracting without end.
Whoosh!
The Celestial Ladder pierced through world dimensions.
Carrying Ding Ling through the clouds, into the strange dimension unknown to mortals.
Then Ding Ling saw a gate woven with golden light.
The gate was closed.
And inscribed upon it was a line of words.
[Gate of Glory!]
Ding Ling stepped forward to push the door, it was heavy, unable to budge even slightly at first.
He glanced behind, the Celestial Ladder woven with golden light was still there, but attempting to return met an unseen barrier blocking the way, making retreat impossible.
He did not attempt further, instead gathering all his strength to push the door.
Yet to no avail.
He looked at the Character Panel.
Indeed.
An information prompt appeared.
[Congratulations player Ding Ling for first opening the portal to the Historical Plane!]
[As the first person to open the portal to the Historical Plane, you will receive the following rewards:]
[1: A Historical Plane World where you alone may tread!]
[2: One opportunity to return to the Three Kingdoms World.]
[3: Reward of free choice among Martial Hero Planes! Note: Only the first person to open the Plane World receives this reward. Others do not.]
[4: Rewards include Ascension Items: Two weapons, two sets of clothing, two mounts, and two hundred taels of gold. Note: Other Ascenders may only carry one weapon and one set of clothing.]
Upon reading, Ding Ling’s brows raised slightly.
There are additional reward points!
It seems his decision was correct.
If other players with extraordinary talent and fortuitous encounters break into the Celestial Human Realm, complete the Path of Glory, and open the portal to the Historical Plane before him.
Wouldn’t he suffer a great loss?
Even with just this ’one chance to return to the Three Kingdoms World’, Ding Ling feels it’s immensely valuable!
As long as he grows extremely powerful in the future, returning to the Three Kingdoms World, he can naturally aid those he wishes to support!
Just this, allows him to move forward courageously without reservations or concerns!
After all, there will be a day to meet again!
[Please choose the Ascension Items to carry.]

Ding Ling opted for the Heaven-Swaying Sword and Giant Que Sword for convenience, as for the eighty-pound Heaven-piercing Halberd, Ding Ling discarded it. Compared to the two Divine Weapons, Giant Que Sword and Heaven-Swaying Sword, the Heaven-piercing Halberd is quite inferior.
Apart from weapons.
Ding Ling also chose a set of luxurious clothing, a white outfit, the mounts were naturally his own: two Ferghana Horses.
Just after completing the selection.
Neigh!

Hearing the sound of a horse’s neigh, the next moment, Ding Ling unexpectedly sees a stream of golden light carrying two horses from below Earth Realm, rushing up along the Celestial Ladder to his front.
Neigh!
The two Ferghana Horses spotting Ding Ling, their eyes brightened, affectionately nudging their heads against Ding Ling’s face.
Ding Ling gently smiled, pushing them aside.
This game is truly magical.
Indeed capable of achieving the impossible.
He continued observing.
[Martial Hero Plane: The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. Please choose one of three.]
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
After pondering briefly, Ding Ling chose The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Compared to The Deer and the Cauldron and Green Blood Sword, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’s Combat Power and Martial Arts Secret Manual are evidently stronger!
Of course, this is Ding Ling’s personal judgment.
The Deer and the Cauldron is set during the Qing Dynasty.
Green Blood Sword in the late Ming Dynasty.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer should be in the mid-Ming Dynasty.
According to the notion that the further back in time, the stronger the martial arts must be, Ding Ling naturally chose The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, which is relatively earlier.
[Selection complete. Choice cannot be changed.]
[Do you wish to expend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
[Note 1: Once the Gate of Glory is opened, it cannot be reversed.]
Yes!
Having reached this point.
Does Ding Ling still have any room to choose?
Blast!
Eleven dazzling streams of light erupted from Ding Ling’s body.
Eleven medals condensed out of thin air.
One blazing golden, ten shimmering silver.
The ten silver medals encircled the golden light medal forming a peculiar three-dimensional array pattern, then pushed forward, transforming into a brand mark, imprinting on the Gate of Glory.
Click!
A crisp sound.
The Gate of Glory, surprisingly opened just like that.
Ding Ling stared in astonishment.
Nonetheless, he chose to push it open, revealing before him three boundless, limitless Heaven-Reaching Daos.
Above the Daos hung golden characters in mid-air.
From left to right, the golden words clearly spell out: The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer
Ding Ling helplessly swept by the golden light, landed before The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Dao.
Along with him were two Ferghana Horses, and two hundred taels of gold, among other items.

sentences.text: Diao Chan is iron-blooded, resolute, brave, tenacious, fearless of death.
She is a true heroine!
Heroes may bleed but do not shed tears until the moment of heartbreak arrives!
At this moment, Diao Chan’s eyes are red, her graceful body trembling slightly, evidently showing she is overwhelmed with fear and sadness.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng are no different.
Zhen Jiang is even shedding tears, quietly wiping her eyes, not daring to say much.
Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Yun, and others show varied expressions.
But without exception, all are filled with reluctance and longing for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling knows if he delays further, he may not be able to leave.
Because he too is reluctant to leave just like that.
Yet the path of Martial Dao is long and arduous.
If he were to become enamored with this place, should others break into the Martial Hero Plane or other higher-tiered planes, can he guarantee that all he possesses now will not be snatched away?
Moreover.
The technology in the Three Kingdoms World is also developing crazily.
If in the future, they develop nuclear bombs, can he withstand them?
What can he use to protect himself and shield Diao Chan and the others?
Too many uncertainties surround him.
The most uncertain remains the real world.
Currently, no player has broken into the Celestial Human Realm, so they don’t know the details within, but what if one day they break through?
Once they comprehend it, will they hunt Ding Ling relentlessly to seize his opportunities?
Just to rob Ding Ling of his fortuitous encounters?
Humans may not harbor malice against tigers, but tigers can harm humans!
Be wary of others is indispensable.
Ding Ling never shies away from speculating on players with the worst intentions!
Because he understands.
Good people exist in this world, but there are also definitely many bad ones.
Some are even rotten to the core, beyond absurd, beyond imagination!
Yet reality is such a mess!
Unbelievable, yet undeniable!
To avoid being surpassed by other players in the future, and for a brighter future.
Ding Ling must keep running forward!
Until reaching the summit!
Thus.

Whoosh!

Indeed.

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Common Storage Pouch and True Pill
paragraphs: [Player is about to enter The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.]
[Would you like to exchange for Storage Space or Bone Treasure before entering?]
Yes!
Ding Ling immediately said.
He had long wanted to make the exchange.
But he couldn’t find a way in the Player Plaza. It seemed to be right here!
Hummm!
A ethereal sound swept past his ears.
When Ding Ling looked again, beside the Heaven-Reaching Dao, there suddenly appeared rows and rows of counters that seemed endless.
The counters were made of unknown materials, showing a chaotic rainbow-colored glass.
Extremely dazzling!
Through the glass, various treasures inside the counters could be seen clearly.
Most of the treasures were concealed from view, seemingly covered by restrictions, with only layers of thick fog visible.
Ding Ling quickly scanned through most of the counters.
Finally, he focused on the first counter closest to him.
Because the items in this counter were open and unrestricted!
As Ding Ling moved slightly and found he could walk, he stepped forward for a closer look at the counter.
’True First-Order Pill: 5 Glory Medals’
’True Second-Order Pill: 10 Glory Medals’
Ding Ling read quickly.
He didn’t linger on things he couldn’t afford.
Since they were unaffordable, why let them disturb his state of mind?
He eventually focused on a few drab-looking bags.
’Mortal First-Order Storage Pouch: 10 Ordinary Achievement Medals and 2 E-level Achievement Medals.’
’Mortal Second-Order Storage Pouch: 20 Ordinary Achievement Medals and 4 E-level Achievement Medals’
Ding Ling’s eyebrow twitched.
He had thought it was something like creating Storage Space out of thin air, but it seemed he was overthinking it.
"Clearly priced. All items need to be purchased with Achievement Medals and Glory Medals!"
"And only the items at the first counter can be bought."
He couldn’t see what was on other counters at all.
He pushed the counter but found it couldn’t be moved at all, as if it was embedded and firmly set beside the Heaven-Reaching Dao.
Looking again at the interior decoration of the counter, it seemed very ancient and simple!
Ding Ling speculated.
Perhaps the counter had always been placed here.
The reason he couldn’t see it.
Was ninety percent likely due to his low cultivation level, hidden by the blinding technique here.
As for why he could see it later?
"It must be because my ’savings’ were enough, qualifying me to purchase items here!
"And only the first counter is open. That must be because my savings can only buy the goods from the first counter."
Ding Ling felt a bit frustrated.
He initially thought he was a big ’tycoon.’
After all, he had swept through the entire Three Kingdoms World for Achievement Medals.
The number of medals he had acquired was absolutely overwhelming compared to other players!
But now it seems.
He still was a nobody, a poor chap!
He glanced at the Character Panel:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 93, E-level 22]
[Glory Medals: 5]
A bit poor indeed.
Ding Ling sighed. There were many things he wanted to buy, but unfortunately, he couldn’t afford them.
He pondered for a moment and decided to purchase a Mortal Tier Four Storage Pouch.
[Confirm to spend 80 Ordinary Achievement Medals and 16 E-level Achievement Medals to purchase Mortal Tier Four Storage Pouch?]
Ding Ling felt a pinch.
He hadn’t usually inquired in the Player Plaza about how to buy other materials.
Just to save more medals, thinking he could exchange them later for strength to use in reality!
After all, there is only one life in reality.
He constantly reminded himself that once he gained strength, he should exchange it back to reality to prevent any accidents due to lack of strength.
So, Ding Ling would never exchange all his Achievement Medals; he had to keep some for enhancing his strength when he reached a certain level back in reality.
Even if he went to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer to gain more Achievement Medals from other famous figures and masters.
Ding Ling would keep some as a safeguard.
That was his cautious nature at play.
He was inherently a cautious and reserved person.
Without absolute strength, he was unwilling to take too much risk.
But at the same time, the blood of bravery and boldness ran within him. In the face of real risk, he wouldn’t be too timid and dared to stand firm!
"Confirm!"
In the end, Ding Ling still bought the Mortal Tier Four Storage Pouch.
When he clicked confirm.
A total of 96 silver star points flew out from his body and landed in a box beside the counter.
Click!
The counter opened.
An invisible wave of air swept past.
The drab Mortal Tier Four Storage Pouch was blown out from the counter, hovering before Ding Ling.
Ding Ling reached out to grab it.
Like picking a flower, he took the Storage Pouch in his hand, examining it from side to side. No matter how he looked, it seemed like a miniature trash bag!
Truly living up to its Mortal name!
But how to use it?
Ding Ling was somewhat perplexed.
He found that after obtaining the Storage Pouch, he didn’t know how to use it?
His several attempts to open it were ineffective.
Could it be he bought a decorative piece?
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched. He had a sense of having instantly turned into a big fool.
"I’ll keep it for now. Maybe one day it will come in handy."
Ding Ling placed the Storage Pouch in his bosom.
He had often read in novels that Storage Pouches required some sort of Divine Sense to unlock?
Could it be that he lacked the related Divine Sense?
Ding Ling mused. It seemed even a Mortal Storage Pouch wasn’t something he could easily use at the moment.
He looked at other items.
None were to his liking.
The first counter’s Achievement Medals could exchange for only some Storage Pouches, weapons, armors, and other Mortal materials.
The weapons were no better than the Giant Que Sword, yet still expensive as hell.
Ding Ling bought the Storage Pouch purely out of curiosity and felt it was necessary, as it would surely be useful in the future.
But as for weapons and armors, there was no necessary reason to purchase them. He could acquire them in other planes just the same.
"Should I use the Glory Medals to exchange for materials?"
Ding Ling looked at the other side of the counter.
There were quite a few Pills and some treasures here.
Most were very expensive.
Ding Ling didn’t look in detail.
The more he looked, the more it tantalized him, but he couldn’t afford them! Not worth disturbing his mind.
"Let’s buy a True Pill and try it."
Ding Ling complained silently.
The service quality of this counter was too bad. Not even a manual!
He had to figure it out himself!
[Confirm to spend 5 Glory Medals to purchase a True First-Order Pill?]
Confirm.
Hummm!
Five shining golden rays flew out from him, landing into a box just like the star points before.
Then, click!
The counter opened, and a pill emerged, appearing in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling reached out to catch it, observing it closely.
It was like a longan.
Carrying a sense of transcendence within it.
As if it embodied the essence of heaven and earth, a creation treasure.
"Do I eat it directly?"
Ding Ling felt his teeth aching.
If there were a rating system, he would definitely rate the counter’s service zero stars!
Would providing a manual kill them?

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Xiang Yu’s Ambition (4/13)
paragraphs: However, Ding Ling quickly realized that it seemed he could currently only use the Glory Medal to purchase, exchange for things that increased his natural talent, and a few other items like the Dao Rhyme World.
What on earth was the Dao Rhyme World?
Ding Ling had no idea.
But the concept of increasing natural talent was easy to understand.
"These pills should be able to increase my natural talent?"
Ding Ling was a bit hesitant but finally decided to consume it.
He had already bought it; not consuming it would be a waste.
Moreover.
The items here were clearly priced, and it seemed like their quantities were limited.
Ding Ling noticed that after buying that True First-Order Pill, there was no activity at the counter, nor was another First-Order Pill replenished.
"If there really is no replenishment, then the treasures here might be one-time use only. Once exchanged, they won’t be available anymore."
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
He pondered:
"In that case, the lack of service is understandable. After all, the owner here might be long gone. What’s left to serve might just be a piece of emotionless software?"
As for the specifics.
It’s unknown.
But if this is truly the case, Ding Ling felt that any time he makes a gain in the future, any extra Achievement Medals and Glory Medals could be used to purchase and exchange for resources.
Otherwise, why hold onto them?
Achievement Medals can be exchanged for strength in reality, and can also be used with Glory Medals to pierce through dimensions and open the Gate of Glory.
But other than these, it seemed like there was no other use?
Ding Ling wasn’t clear on this either.
After all, he was still too weak now.
Forget it.
Once he finished conquering The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane and returned to a similar place, he’ll see and understand more.
Ding Ling didn’t worry further and closed his eyes, directly putting the Dragon Eye Great Pill into his mouth.
To his surprise.
The pill melted as soon as it entered his mouth.
Slightly sweet!
As if a warm current rushed straight into his lungs, transforming into streams of exuberant and sharp energy, penetrating into his bones everywhere.
Crack!
Rumble!
The bones trembled, the meridians shivered!
It was like muffled thunder roaring inside his body, and more like a vast clock sound booming in his skull.
Ding Ling felt as if he was being baptized, transformed, sublimated!
Though there was a slight pain.
But it felt more like soaking in a hot spring, a sense of comfort and joy, as if his whole being underwent refinement.
Feeling joy from inside out.
For a good while.
The sound gradually weakened until it was silent.
Ding Ling was drenched in sweat, carefully feeling.
Sure enough.
His natural talent and meridians became even more transparent and bright.
He glanced at his Character Panel.
[Natural Talent 2!]
Previously, his natural talent was an unchanged 1 point for ages!
Now it had finally reached 2 points!
"A natural talent of two points. Although still extremely poor, compared to ordinary people, it’s already above average."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He couldn’t compare with geniuses.
But compared to ordinary people, he was still quite outstanding.
Moreover, his biggest cheat was Divine Skill Automatic Full Level.
He didn’t heavily rely on natural talent.
But if his natural talent were extremely high, then even without cheats, he might become a character akin to Zhao Zilong. He looked forward to this day immensely.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling took a deep breath and stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
[Player is about to enter The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane. Please prepare yourself.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!
Golden light swept across thousands of miles, sweeping Ding Ling straight to the end of the Dao, and then with a booming sound, it seemed to pierce through a dimensional barrier.
In the stillness.
Ding Ling had a feeling.
He was about to step into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane!
At the same time.
Boom! Boom! Boom!

In the late Sui Dynasty! Late Qin Dynasty! In these two planes, suddenly thunder rolled, black clouds pressed down on the city, and frost and snow fell from the sky, replicating the scenes from the Three Kingdoms World plane.
Boom!

A streak of golden light shattered tornadoes, swept away thunder, cleared frost, and descended thunderously straight ten miles outside of Chang’an City! Forming a Celestial Ladder leading directly to the End of the World Path!
"What happened?!"
Xiang Yu had just captured the Xianyang Ancient Capital, passed through this place, and was moved and astonished at the sight of this phenomenon.
He immediately ordered his men to investigate.
His brave general, Yhu Ziqi, volunteered to take on this task, galloping to the Celestial Ladder, inspecting it for a while, and then returned to report to Xiang Yu.
Xiang Yu, tall and mighty, with a heroic presence, frowned and looked up at the sky after hearing Yhu Ziqi’s report, saying:
"Does anyone in the army know the exact situation of the alien?"
A player immediately said:
"It seems that someone shattered the void, breaking the shackles of the universe, which is why it’s affecting our world."
This player had logged in and out in a short span while pretending to ’use the bathroom’ earlier, and thus learned about Ding Ling shattering the void and departing.
He also knew the details of the whole event and was greatly shocked, being in awe of Ding Ling to the utmost degree!
For players like him.
Most were still in the barracks as mere soldiers, learning horse stance and practicing Pile Skill!
Meanwhile, Ding Ling had already shattered the void and headed to a higher-level world!
How could they not be envious, jealous, or in awe?!
Of course, there were some who were immensely resentful, eager for Ding Ling to perish soon.
But undeniably, Ding Ling’s charisma was growing stronger, with more and more supporters.
This player was among them.
Seeing Xiang Yu’s confusion, he said:

"In the boundless void and vast cosmos lie countless Great Thousand Worlds and Small Thousand Worlds. Our world is just an insignificant speck of dust among them. It’s not surprising that their shattering of the void would affect us here."
He was exaggerating.
He had no real knowledge of the mythology game’s specifics.
But he had read novels!
And who hasn’t read novels and picked up a few cryptic words to impress?!
Whether he believed it or not, misleading native NPCs was a huge victory for them!
And sure enough.
Xiang Yu, such a character, also couldn’t help but tremble, pondering and mumbling while looking up at the sky:
"Sounds like I might have a chance to climb this Celestial Ladder too."
"Indeed."
The player’s face was full of longing:

"The one who shattered the void is named Ding Ling! The strongest warrior of the Three Kingdoms World! The Guardian God, Grand General, and First-Rank Prince of the Great Wei Kingdom! He has now gone to a stronger world, pursuing a stronger Martial Dao. Perhaps he might even become a Martial Arts Immortal in the future."
"Martial Arts Immortal."
These four words were like four sharp swords piercing straight into Xiang Yu’s chest!
His blood and overbearing aura burned intensely.
"It’s been so long since I last made any progress."
"I never thought. Today I would see the hope of becoming a Martial Arts Immortal!"
Compared to the mundane world’s emperors.
Xiang Yu desired to be a Martial Arts Immortal more. A true master who could effortlessly command millions of troops with a mere flick of a finger!
He didn’t doubt the player’s words.

sentences.text: However, Ding Ling quickly realized that it seemed he could currently only use the Glory Medal to purchase, exchange for things that increased his natural talent, and a few other items like the Dao Rhyme World.
What on earth was the Dao Rhyme World?
Ding Ling had no idea.
But the concept of increasing natural talent was easy to understand.
"These pills should be able to increase my natural talent?"
Ding Ling was a bit hesitant but finally decided to consume it.
He had already bought it; not consuming it would be a waste.
Moreover.
The items here were clearly priced, and it seemed like their quantities were limited.
Ding Ling noticed that after buying that True First-Order Pill, there was no activity at the counter, nor was another First-Order Pill replenished.
"If there really is no replenishment, then the treasures here might be one-time use only.
Once exchanged, they won’t be available anymore."
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
He pondered:
"In that case, the lack of service is understandable.
After all, the owner here might be long gone.
What’s left to serve might just be a piece of emotionless software?"
As for the specifics.
It’s unknown.
But if this is truly the case, Ding Ling felt that any time he makes a gain in the future, any extra Achievement Medals and Glory Medals could be used to purchase and exchange for resources.
Otherwise, why hold onto them?
Achievement Medals can be exchanged for strength in reality, and can also be used with Glory Medals to pierce through dimensions and open the Gate of Glory.
But other than these, it seemed like there was no other use?
Ding Ling wasn’t clear on this either.
After all, he was still too weak now.
Forget it.
Once he finished conquering The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane and returned to a similar place, he’ll see and understand more.
Ding Ling didn’t worry further and closed his eyes, directly putting the Dragon Eye Great Pill into his mouth.
To his surprise.
The pill melted as soon as it entered his mouth.
Slightly sweet!
As if a warm current rushed straight into his lungs, transforming into streams of exuberant and sharp energy, penetrating into his bones everywhere.
Crack!
Rumble!
The bones trembled, the meridians shivered!
It was like muffled thunder roaring inside his body, and more like a vast clock sound booming in his skull.
Ding Ling felt as if he was being baptized, transformed, sublimated!
Though there was a slight pain.
But it felt more like soaking in a hot spring, a sense of comfort and joy, as if his whole being underwent refinement.
Feeling joy from inside out.
For a good while.
The sound gradually weakened until it was silent.
Ding Ling was drenched in sweat, carefully feeling.
Sure enough.
His natural talent and meridians became even more transparent and bright.
He glanced at his Character Panel.
[Natural Talent 2!]
Previously, his natural talent was an unchanged 1 point for ages!
Now it had finally reached 2 points!
"A natural talent of two points.
Although still extremely poor, compared to ordinary people, it’s already above average."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He couldn’t compare with geniuses.
But compared to ordinary people, he was still quite outstanding.
Moreover, his biggest cheat was Divine Skill Automatic Full Level.
He didn’t heavily rely on natural talent.
But if his natural talent were extremely high, then even without cheats, he might become a character akin to Zhao Zilong.
He looked forward to this day immensely.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling took a deep breath and stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
[Player is about to enter The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane.
Please prepare yourself.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!
Golden light swept across thousands of miles, sweeping Ding Ling straight to the end of the Dao, and then with a booming sound, it seemed to pierce through a dimensional barrier.
In the stillness.
Ding Ling had a feeling.
He was about to step into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane!
At the same time.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
