chapters.title: Chapter 270: Diao Chan’s Thoughts (5/13)
paragraphs: Because Xiang Yu knew that the player had no reason to deceive him.
Especially this player reporting the situation to him, he knew well about his character and considered him a close confidant.
As for close confidants.
Xiang Yu was candid and extremely valued them.
After understanding the importance of this Celestial Ladder.
He immediately led a heavy guard to watch over it.
And began his first tentative steps on the Celestial Ladder.
Tap, tap!

Step by step upward, it wasn’t very strenuous. Xiang Yu walked faster and faster, eventually running, and when he sprinted up several kilometers, overlooking the Lower Realm, the shadow of the Great Army had long vanished, only endless white mist was seen; when he turned his head forward, the Celestial Ladder gleamed golden, reaching into unknown realms.
It seemed to have no end.
"It’s so far!"
Xiang Yu contemplated for a moment, choosing to return to the ground.
He still had lingering concerns in the mortal realm.
To leave.
He needed to resolve these worldly affairs and then ride the Black Steed, taking along his Consort Yhu to ascend the Celestial Ladder together!
"Worthy of Xiang Yu."
The player sighed with envy and admiration.
He also tried to ascend the Celestial Ladder, but an invisible wall blocked him outside.
He simply couldn’t step in.
He understood it was likely due to his strength not meeting the requirement, unable to break this barrier himself.
Like Xiang Yu.
With immense power, he might shatter this invisible barrier with a single step forward.
But for Xiang Yu, what wasn’t a big obstacle was like a Celestial Abyss for him, unreachable!
To put it plainly.
Xiang Yu could easily lift a two-thousand-pound giant cauldron.
Could he?
That’s the gap!
Tap, tap!
Xiang Yu rushed down with the force of a meteor crashing, stopping with a ’sudden brake’ to stabilize his body just in time.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Even Xiang Yu couldn’t help but pant a few breaths, with a subtle expression saying:

"Surely, it’s easy to go up the mountain but hard to come down! This Celestial Ladder, even if one can climb up, it’s definitely hard to come down! A slight mistake and they’ll be shattered into Bone Shards just like nothing!"
Yhu Ziqi and other valiant warriors, upon hearing this, lost their previous eager expression instantly, becoming solemn and serious.
"Long Qie."
Xiang Yu looked over at a burly man on his left:
"Immediately lead an elite troop south to fetch Consort Yhu."
Long Qie clasped his hands in obedience.
Xiang Yu pondered and called him back:
"Forget it, I will personally go back. This time I will handle some affairs in the south, and then see if I can bring you all up the Celestial Ladder."
Long Qie, Yhu Ziqi, and others show expressions of joy, worry, or contemplation...
Xiang Yu said no more, directly leaping onto Black Steed’s back, and with its neighing, he gave a clear command, leading a troop of elites south.
Similar events occurred in the Late Sui Dynasty.
Li Shimin also had people guard the Celestial Ladder there.
But at the same time.
Some people aspiring to reach higher peaks in the Martial Dao had their hearts set ablaze.
All wanted to attempt ascending the Celestial Ladder to venture into other worlds.
Cheng Yaojin, Yuchi Gong, Qin Qiong, even Li Yuanba!
All began to stir!
Li Shimin noticed it.
Nervous at heart, he immediately accelerated reforms and campaigns across regions!
Three Kingdoms Plane World.
The time rewinds to the moment Ding Ling was swept away by the golden light.
Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Bingxuan, Zhao Xiaoyiu were all staring dazedly at the Celestial Palace.
Some showed grief;
Some were at a loss;
Some appeared confused, eyes filled with sorrow;
Different people, different expressions.
But without exception, they were all downcast at this moment.
They were used to staying by Ding Ling’s side, following him, being his ’Queens’!
Even though Ding Ling never acknowledged them as his Queens.
When many addressed them as Queens, he didn’t deny it, and they had spent quite some time together.
Especially Diao Chan and several other women who followed Ding Ling for a long time, living and eating with him, had long been infatuated, refusing to marry anyone else.
Now Ding Ling was gone.
Their hearts seemed to have flown away too, feeling hollow, as if something was missing, a bit sad, a bit inexplicably sorrowful.
Diao Chan was the first to leap towards the Celestial Ladder and stepped onto it.
No golden light whisked her into the heavens.
But she didn’t seem to be blocked either.
Her heart started pounding wildly, she had an uncertain guess.
She tried walking upward, took ten plus meters.
Suddenly, Xiao Qiao’s voice came from below, ’Sister Diao Chan!’
Diao Chan’s delicate body trembled slightly.
She looked down, seeing the reluctant and wistful eyes of Da, Xiao Qiao, and others.
She understood, sighed, looked towards the Celestial Palace, bit her lip, and turned back down.
It’s not the time yet!
"Once Da and Xiao Qiao become stronger and aren’t blocked by this golden light, we’ll go find Ding Ling together!"
She thought.
In front of outsiders or under public gaze.
They called him Prince.
But in private, Ding Ling didn’t allow such titles.
They didn’t insist either.
In their hearts, addressing him by his name felt more intimate.
"We sisters are one. Can’t leave anyone behind. Otherwise, how could I explain to Ding Ling then?"
Diao Chan thought.
Her spirit became even more determined.
To get stronger together.
Eventually ascend the Celestial Ladder to find Ding Ling!
In the following time.
Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, Taishi Ci, Pan Feng, and others successively arrived.
They attempted to climb the Celestial Ladder too.
They could indeed walk the Celestial Ladder.
But they had worldly attachments, unable to leave immediately, deciding to finish mundane affairs first.
"Path to the pinnacle of Martial Dao."
Guan Yu’s eyes burned as if concealing flames:
"I must ascend and see!"
"Second brother, I will accompany you!"
Zhang Fei shouted, voice like thunder.
Guan Yu nodded, looking at Liu Bei.
Liu Bei looked frustrated.
He was blocked and rejected by the golden light!
Unable to set foot on the Celestial Ladder!
"From the present circumstances. To ascend the Celestial Ladder, one likely must reach Super-Elite strength or so."
Guan Yu contemplated:
"Elder brother’s strength isn’t up to par, naturally failing to qualify for the Celestial Ladder."
"You must train diligently next, elder brother."
Zhang Fei hoped earnestly at Liu Bei:

"This is the Celestial Ladder. Can’t tell if the world above is the Martial Arts Immortal Kingdom. If one day we achieve immortality through Martial Dao and live forever, wouldn’t that be more promising than being a general?"
Liu Bei agreed deeply, shaking off his spirits as he spoke:

chapters.title: Chapter 271: The Sigh of the Emperor of Great Wei
paragraphs: "I would trouble my two wise brothers for some help. It’s hard for me to make rapid progress alone."
"Elder brother, don’t worry. My third brother and I will absolutely give it our all to assist you!"
After Guan Yu, Liu Bei, and Zhang Fei left.
Immediately, others came forward to test the Celestial Ladder.
Some left with interest and excitement;
Some departed dejectedly;
Some were secretly invigorated;
The varied states of the human world are endless.
But what can be confirmed is.
The existence of the Celestial Ladder.
Is enough to reignite the determination of many in the Martial Dao to train once more!
Especially those who were already passionate about martial arts, having a goal now needs no further explanation.
After Cao Mengde learned of this.
He sighed repeatedly.
The illustrious Great Wei Kingdom has since lost a Guardian God!
He lamented for it.
But at the same time.
The colossal mountain pressing on him finally ’flew away’ on its own.
He couldn’t help but let out a heavy sigh of relief.
Although he is the Emperor of Great Wei, holding significant power, and everyone would adhere to his orders.
It seemed that everyone at court and across Jiuzhou knew that his current status was all because of Ding Ling!
Without Ding Ling.
He, Cao Mengde, could never have come this far.
For this, he had felt grateful, joyful, and laughed heartily.
But...
When a person reaches a certain stage, their thoughts undergo subtle changes.
"With you, Ding Ling, here. My glory as Cao Mengde is overshadowed! Because you, Ding Ling, have absorbed all the radiance. Leaving me in deep, profound darkness!"
"But now you are gone. I am saddened but more relieved. Because I no longer have to fear or worry that one day, you might unseat me and replace me!"
"These days of constant apprehension. Honestly, I really don’t want them anymore."
Cao Mengde thought to himself:

"Though these words I will never be able to speak to others because they sound too heartless. But reality is that cruel. How could an Emperor wish for another looming sky overhead that suppresses him unto breathlessness?"
Cao Mengde felt slightly apologetic.
Because he knew.
Without Ding Ling guarding the Great Wei Kingdom, he would not have walked so smoothly over this ’long’ period!
But the crisis had mostly been resolved.
Nevertheless, Ding Ling remained.
Yet Cao Mengde had no means to deal with Ding Ling!
He could only offer various benefits, hoping to stabilize Ding Ling.
Like a servant, humbly trying to please his master.
The feeling of trembling discomfort filled him entirely at all times. Especially in recent months, this feeling became increasingly pronounced.
"Ding Ling, you have finally left."
Cao Mengde exhaled deeply.
The heavy feeling in his heart dispersed, replaced by a sense of rejuvenated joy.
"I finally don’t have to think every day about how to please you, how to support your close ones, how to spare no effort to assist you!"
Because of his earlier promises to Ding Ling.
And also fearing Ding Ling’s unparalleled martial prowess!
Cao Mengde had truly exhausted his service for Ding Ling! Sincerely dealing with him!
The resources of Jiuzhou supported only Ding Ling’s family!
After satisfying Ding Ling’s family.
Only then it would be his, Cao Mengde’s, family’s turn!
Clearly, he was the Emperor.
But Ding Ling lived like the Supreme Emperor! Every move concerned his heart, leaving him with no choice but to revolve around Ding Ling.
A word from Ding Ling.
An order!
He had to exhaust every means to fulfill it.
Many of the tasks were unbelievably difficult!
But he still managed to accomplish most of them.
Just thinking about it was exhausting!
"Ah, Ding Ling, this guy, really lived as I imagined."

Sometimes, when Cao Mengde worked overtime, exhausted in the dead of night, slumping onto the Emperor’s Seat, thinking of Ding Ling, carefree and enjoying each day with several beauties, he couldn’t help but feel some envy, some jealousy.
"Drunk, resting upon a beauty’s knee, waking to rule the land. Carefree and happy. It was just too enjoyable. But alas, this wasn’t me; it was Ding Ling!"
Cao Mengde thought of Ding Ling’s women.
He couldn’t help but admire in his heart.
Ding Ling’s eye for women was piercing.
The women he chose were all top-notch.
Diao Chan was unrivaled in Jiuzhou.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang each had their qualities, be it youthful and delicate, elegant and refined, or like beautiful jade flowers, or intelligent and refined.
It truly made Cao Mengde envious.
Because in Cao Mengde’s residence, he couldn’t find a woman comparable to Du Qingcheng.
Let alone someone comparable to Diao Chan.
Cai Wenji, though elegantly no less than Da Qiao, unfortunately, Cai Wenji was also attached to Ding Ling and unwilling to marry him, Cao Mengde.
At this thought.
Cao Mengde’s heart couldn’t help but feel a twinge of bitterness and jealousy!
He, an emperor, was completely overshadowed by Ding Ling.
But thinking that even his throne was brought about by Ding Ling.
Cao Mengde sighed.
"People really can’t be compared to one another!"
"Ding Ling is someone rare across ages! That I, Cao Mengde, could meet him, all in all, is very fortunate!"
"Because of Ding Ling, at least I became an emperor. Accomplished something many could only dream of!"

"In the end, I should respect him, be grateful to him, admire him! And not envy! Because no matter how much I envy, I could never have his kind of martial talent. He is Heaven’s chosen one, so what’s the use of being jealous of him? Better to just diligently perform my role as emperor!"
He seemed to be convincing himself.
After a moment.
He resigned himself, accepting:
"Let it be so."
He loudly called out:
"Someone, dispatch heavy troops immediately to guard the Celestial Ladder and keep idle individuals at a distance!"
Ding Ling did not know that the Cao Mengde now was very different from the one who used to think solely for him, for the country and the people, eager to please him and hold onto his power.
He had become more overbearing, restrained, stable, dignified, decisive!
However, though Ding Ling wasn’t aware of Cao Mengde’s deep changes.
He did know one thing.
People change!
No matter who he chooses as emperor.
Once they reach that emperor’s position, many people’s ambitions, and desires start to swell!
They become more tyrannical and more intolerant of people disobeying their orders!
Especially those emperors with absolute military power, who wield significant influence!
How could they allow someone with a higher status than them to constantly overshadow them?
Once when Ding Ling visited the Imperial Palace to see Cao Mengde, he sensed Cao Mengde’s tension, discomfort, and from then on, he rarely took the initiative to see Cao Mengde.
Everything was focused on strengthening Diao Chan and others.
Until he ascended the Celestial Ladder and left.
He never actively visited the Imperial Palace.
Instead, he had Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, and others help take care of Diao Chan, to avoid conflicts of interest.
Proven by fact.
Ding Ling’s actions were right.
After he left.
Cao Mengde began, intentionally or not, to weaken the control Ding Ling’s generals had over military power.
Upon noticing this, Pan Feng brought his entire family to join Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and others.

sentences.text: "I would trouble my two wise brothers for some help.
It’s hard for me to make rapid progress alone."
"Elder brother, don’t worry.
My third brother and I will absolutely give it our all to assist you!"
After Guan Yu, Liu Bei, and Zhang Fei left.
Immediately, others came forward to test the Celestial Ladder.
Some left with interest and excitement;
Some departed dejectedly;
Some were secretly invigorated;
The varied states of the human world are endless.
But what can be confirmed is.
The existence of the Celestial Ladder.
Is enough to reignite the determination of many in the Martial Dao to train once more!
Especially those who were already passionate about martial arts, having a goal now needs no further explanation.
After Cao Mengde learned of this.
He sighed repeatedly.
The illustrious Great Wei Kingdom has since lost a Guardian God!
He lamented for it.
But at the same time.
The colossal mountain pressing on him finally ’flew away’ on its own.
He couldn’t help but let out a heavy sigh of relief.
Although he is the Emperor of Great Wei, holding significant power, and everyone would adhere to his orders.
It seemed that everyone at court and across Jiuzhou knew that his current status was all because of Ding Ling!
Without Ding Ling.
He, Cao Mengde, could never have come this far.
For this, he had felt grateful, joyful, and laughed heartily.
But...
When a person reaches a certain stage, their thoughts undergo subtle changes.
"With you, Ding Ling, here.
My glory as Cao Mengde is overshadowed!
Because you, Ding Ling, have absorbed all the radiance.
Leaving me in deep, profound darkness!"
"But now you are gone.
I am saddened but more relieved.
Because I no longer have to fear or worry that one day, you might unseat me and replace me!"
"These days of constant apprehension.
Honestly, I really don’t want them anymore."
Cao Mengde thought to himself:
"Though these words I will never be able to speak to others because they sound too heartless.
But reality is that cruel.
How could an Emperor wish for another looming sky overhead that suppresses him unto breathlessness?"
Cao Mengde felt slightly apologetic.
Because he knew.
Without Ding Ling guarding the Great Wei Kingdom, he would not have walked so smoothly over this ’long’ period!
But the crisis had mostly been resolved.
Nevertheless, Ding Ling remained.
Yet Cao Mengde had no means to deal with Ding Ling!
He could only offer various benefits, hoping to stabilize Ding Ling.
Like a servant, humbly trying to please his master.
The feeling of trembling discomfort filled him entirely at all times.
Especially in recent months, this feeling became increasingly pronounced.
"Ding Ling, you have finally left."
Cao Mengde exhaled deeply.
The heavy feeling in his heart dispersed, replaced by a sense of rejuvenated joy.
"I finally don’t have to think every day about how to please you, how to support your close ones, how to spare no effort to assist you!"
Because of his earlier promises to Ding Ling.
And also fearing Ding Ling’s unparalleled martial prowess!
Cao Mengde had truly exhausted his service for Ding Ling!
Sincerely dealing with him!
The resources of Jiuzhou supported only Ding Ling’s family!
After satisfying Ding Ling’s family.
Only then it would be his, Cao Mengde’s, family’s turn!
Clearly, he was the Emperor.
But Ding Ling lived like the Supreme Emperor!
Every move concerned his heart, leaving him with no choice but to revolve around Ding Ling.
A word from Ding Ling.
An order!
He had to exhaust every means to fulfill it.
Many of the tasks were unbelievably difficult!
But he still managed to accomplish most of them.
Just thinking about it was exhausting!
"Ah, Ding Ling, this guy, really lived as I imagined."

Sometimes, when Cao Mengde worked overtime, exhausted in the dead of night, slumping onto the Emperor’s Seat, thinking of Ding Ling, carefree and enjoying each day with several beauties, he couldn’t help but feel some envy, some jealousy.
"Drunk, resting upon a beauty’s knee, waking to rule the land.
Carefree and happy.
It was just too enjoyable.
But alas, this wasn’t me; it was Ding Ling!"
Cao Mengde thought of Ding Ling’s women.
He couldn’t help but admire in his heart.
Ding Ling’s eye for women was piercing.
The women he chose were all top-notch.
Diao Chan was unrivaled in Jiuzhou.
Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Zhen Jiang each had their qualities, be it youthful and delicate, elegant and refined, or like beautiful jade flowers, or intelligent and refined.
It truly made Cao Mengde envious.
Because in Cao Mengde’s residence, he couldn’t find a woman comparable to Du Qingcheng.
Let alone someone comparable to Diao Chan.
Cai Wenji, though elegantly no less than Da Qiao, unfortunately, Cai Wenji was also attached to Ding Ling and unwilling to marry him, Cao Mengde.
At this thought.
Cao Mengde’s heart couldn’t help but feel a twinge of bitterness and jealousy!
He, an emperor, was completely overshadowed by Ding Ling.
But thinking that even his throne was brought about by Ding Ling.
Cao Mengde sighed.
"People really can’t be compared to one another!"

That I, Cao Mengde, could meet him, all in all, is very fortunate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Zhou Yu and Gan Ning Encounter Xiao Qiao
paragraphs: Regarding Pan Feng’s arrival.
Zhao Yun and the others were naturally very happy and asked why he resigned from the General position.
Pan Feng laughed heartily:
"The Great Wei Kingdom is currently thriving and prosperous, and the court is full of strategists and great generals. Whether I am present or not, it does not matter."
He looked towards the direction of the Celestial Ladder, his heart burning with passion:
"What I want most now is to follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps and cultivate stronger in the Martial Dao!"
Zhao Yun stared at Pan Feng for a couple of moments, then suddenly asked:
"Have you reached the entry level in your Inner Refining Breathing Technique?"
"Indeed."
Pan Feng felt both gratified and ashamed:
"I owe it all to Ding Ling’s guidance. If not, given my talent, I fear I would never have been able to reach the entry level in this lifetime!"
"General Pan, you are too modest."
Chen Dao raised an eyebrow and said:
"Who in Jizhou doesn’t know you’re the Unrivaled Divine General? Your talent is exceptional. If you have ordinary talent, then no one else would have higher talent."
"Compared to Ding Ling, I really feel like a piece of trash."
Pan Feng learned the word ’trash’ from the players.
Spending every day with the players made it difficult not to be influenced by them.
Pan Feng was naturally no exception:

"Just think about how long it’s been since I met Ding Ling until now? Yet he has already shattered the void and been taken by the Heaven-Ascending Ladder. Without Ding Ling’s help, I might still be standing in place! The gap is too wide!"
"Who else on Jiuzhou Land can compare to Ding Ling?"
Zhao Yun was both gratified and proud, but mostly honored, as Ding Ling was someone from ’his family’:
"It’s natural that General Pan falls short, there’s no need to belittle yourself."
"What you say is true."
Pan Feng had a subtle expression:

"Yet whenever I recall the scenes of teaching Ding Ling, I still feel a sense of life’s unpredictability. The world changes too quickly and too greatly. Ding Ling’s progress is unbelievably rapid. I feel as if I could be eliminated at any moment. So..."
He solemnly said:
"I’ve heard you’re all ready to ascend the Celestial Ladder anytime. Take me with you then."
He glanced at his family:
"I’ve made better arrangements for them. You don’t need to worry too much."
"Alright."
Zhao Yun exchanged a glance with Diao Chan.
Seeing Diao Chan didn’t object.
Zhao Yun agreed:
"We’ll go together when the time comes!"
Tong Yuan and Wang Yue also arrived at the Prince’s Mansion.
Watching from a distance, they did not join the conversation.
They simply stood with hands behind their backs, looking at the Celestial Ladder.
But no matter how they looked, they still couldn’t see through it.
"Where exactly has Ding Ling gone?"
They thought:
"Perhaps when his women have all reached the Super-Elite level, we will know the answer.
They decided to put all their effort into guiding and training Ding Ling’s women.
To help his women together reach the Super-Elite level, and then ascend the Celestial Ladder together!
On this day.
Zhou Yu and Gan Ning arrived together outside Chang’an City.
Looking at the Celestial Ladder.
Gan Ning’s emotions were complex.

Now he had no more bells on his waist, no more bird feathers on his head, and his entire demeanor had become much more simple and steady, standing there as steadfast as a mountain, his presence deep as an abyss!
He seemed like a completely different person from before!
"If it’s possible, I truly wish to compete with Ding Ling once more in the rivers and seas."
Gan Ning murmured:
"Even if I can’t win, I still want to fight to make up for the regret in my heart."
The last magical battle.
Was too rushed.
Plus, his own skills had not reached the level of Great Perfection, naturally or effortlessly.
But things are different now.
His abilities have become celestial; just standing there is like a mountain in the sea, attracting attention!
Observing his form and aura.
Anyone with sharp eyes would know he is certainly a super master.
"Hmph."
Zhou Yu snorted coldly, appearing jealous, dissatisfied, terrified, and angry, looking deeply once more at the position of the Celestial Ladder, then turned and left in a whirl.
Ding Ling.
A person he would remember all his life! A person who once caused a shadow in his heart!
Now, that person has ascended!
Would Zhou Yu never have the chance to retaliate?
Then why is he putting so much effort into cultivating?
Why is he desperately learning?
"I must exact revenge!"
Recalling words said to Ding Ling.
Zhou Yu felt a tingling in his teeth.
If he couldn’t avenge.
Encountering Ding Ling and detouring three feet was an unbearable stain and humiliation for him!
"Zhou Yu. Wait a moment."
Gan Ning chased after him:
"Didn’t you come to Chang’an City this time to participate in the imperial examination? Why are you leaving now?"
"I suddenly felt that participating in the imperial examination was meaningless."
Zhou Yu took a deep breath, with a gaze as sharp as a blade as he looked at Gan Ning, they became friends halfway through journeying, out of mutual admiration:
"I want to focus on learning martial arts, to ascend the Celestial Ladder! Next time, I’ll compete against Ding Ling once more. Next time, I will definitely defeat him!"
"Hmm.
Gan Ning praised:
"Your talent is exceptional, remarkably wise. I believe you can definitely do it."
He said this, paused, as if he saw something, giving Zhou Yu a sidelong hint with his eyes.
Zhou Yu looked over.
At this sight.
He was thunderstruck.
He saw Xiao Qiao.
The woman dressed as a married woman, following closely behind Diao Chan! The very Xiao Qiao with whom he had once had a great relationship, and felt they were destined to marry!!
"Zhou Yu!"
Xiao Qiao also saw Zhou Yu, her expression halted for a moment, then she maintained a calm demeanor.
She and he were only friends.
She appreciated him.
But she was more grateful to Ding Ling, because Ding Ling supported her more, and stood firmly by her side when she and her sister were vulnerable.
Moreover, through daily interactions over time.
Xiao Qiao’s heart was already etched with Ding Ling’s imprint, impossible to erase.
She admired Zhou Yu.
But she worshiped Ding Ling more.
Because in comparison, Zhou Yu was incomparable to Ding Ling.
Therefore.
Xiao Qiao still considered Zhou Yu a friend, but at most, would only offer polite greetings, because she was now the Prince’s woman, and had to maintain a distance from outsiders!
"You!"

Zhou Yu seemed to want to say something, but seeing the indifferent eyes of Diao Chan, Zhao Yun, Du Qingcheng and others, as if he understood something, his handsome face flushed red, ultimately said nothing, just turned and left even more quickly.
His figure appeared somewhat embarrassed.
As if one who had failed to the utmost was distancing himself from past beauty.
But at the same time.
His eyes were flickering with flames.
The belief in defeating Ding Ling! It was growing even deeper!
Not having defeated Ding Ling!
He, Zhou Yu, will definitely not, cannot give up his efforts.
He must strive with all his might, work hard so that one day he can openly stand before Ding Ling, challenge him face-to-face, and defeat him!
He wants to show Xiao Qiao.
He, Zhou Yu, will not be defeated a second time!
"Sigh."
Da Qiao watched Zhou Yu’s retreating back, sighing softly.
Seemed to want to say a few words.
But suddenly, her gaze was drawn to a figure, and upon seeing that person’s appearance clearly, she was startled.

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Zuo Ci Ascends the Celestial Ladder
paragraphs: "Zuo Ci!"
Da Qiao’s pupils contracted sharply, and she exclaimed involuntarily.
Diao Chan and the others also turned to look.
Next to the Celestial Ladder stood an elderly man, who looked exactly like Zuo Ci, causing them to be astonished.
At the same time.
Clang!
Clang! Clang! Clang!

Pan Feng, Zhao Yun, Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, Diao Chan and others, holding spears or drawing swords, stood solemnly, instantly transforming the atmosphere from warm sun to frost and snow, chilling to the extreme.
A surge of cold aura swept across all directions.
Passersby, noticing this scene, quickly moved away, watching from the sidelines.
"Hahaha..."
Zuo Ci also saw Diao Chan and the others and laughed:
"Don’t worry. I won’t kill you. I’m a person of cultivation and cannot kill indiscriminately."
These words were indeed honest.
Diao Chan, Pan Feng, Zhao Yun, and others were all extraordinarily destined stars of the Three Kingdoms world, and Zuo Ci dared not kill.
If he were to kill, his Dao heart would be tarnished, entangled in cause and effect and burdened by the karma of killing, which would be troublesome.
Of course, this was secondary.
The most important point was that his strongest avatar had been slain by Ding Ling.
The incarnation he came with this time was strong too.
Yet, it couldn’t match the joint forces of Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, Pan Feng, and Diao Chan. If a real conflict occurred, this incarnation might also meet its end here!
Therefore.
After laughing, he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, waved to Diao Chan and the others without looking back, and loudly said:
"Ladies and gentlemen, hopefully, we’ll never meet again."

Stepping onto the ladder, like a breeze or light smoke, in a whizzing sound, he headed straight up to the Ninefold Heaven, disappearing within moments, as if vanishing? Evading through space? Or had he truly soared into the clouds?!
Diao Chan and others reacted:
"This Demon Dao isn’t yet dead. If he has gone to the Upper Realm and causes trouble, wouldn’t Ding Ling be in danger?"
Da and Xiao Qiao felt somewhat anxious.
Du Qingcheng was uneasy.
Diao Chan also felt anxious, but she didn’t show it, only saying:

"This Demon Dao was defeated by Ding Ling before. If he encounters Ding Ling in the Upper Realm, it’s surely his fate to be killed. Don’t forget Ding Ling’s talent. He learns everything quickly. If he goes to the Upper Realm and by chance obtains the Heaven-Defying Fate Technique, killing Zuo Ci would be as easy as killing a chicken."
Da and Xiao Qiao and others listened and echoed.
It was unclear if they were comforting themselves or their sisters.
Each had full confidence in Ding Ling!
Even so.
Deep down, a shadow lingered; each pondered the need to enhance their own cultivation! Otherwise, even going to the Upper Realm, if unable to assist Ding Ling, what worth would they have?
"Don’t worry."
Wang Yue seemed to see through Zuo Ci’s reality:

"This Demon Dao is merely a facade. Though it appears powerful, its aura is unstable and not very strong. It seems he was indeed gravely injured by Ding Ling! Now his strength might only remain one or two parts. Such a Zuo Ci, with Tong Yuan and I here, he won’t succeed."
"Indeed."
Tong Yuan stroked his beard:

"How talented and remarkable Ding Ling is! How could a mere Zuo Ci, severely wounded, harm him? You need not overly worry. The urgent matter is still to enhance yourselves. Our purpose in coming out this time is to verify whether Da and Xiao Qiao have reached the Super-Elite level. Let’s go and test it."
"Yes, master!"
Though the side of the Celestial Ladder was heavily guarded.
Clearly useless against a Demon Dao like Zuo Ci.
Upon reaching the Celestial Human Realm.
No amount of soldiers or horses could matter!
As long as powerhouses of the Celestial Human Realm are cautious, the secular world can barely kill them.
Eventually, Da and Xiao Qiao managed to step onto the Celestial Ladder.
They were overjoyed, feeling as if they’d gotten one step closer to Ding Ling.
But they still needed to help Zhen Jiang and the others.
To leave.
They must leave together.
Wang Yue and Tong Yuan had longed to leave.
Because over time, a War God from the Xianbei Tribe broke through the defensive walls and directly stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Now another Zuo Ci arrives.
Perhaps as the forces guarding the Celestial Ladder dwindle.
More generals and Divine Generals will step onto the ladder.

But they promised Ding Ling they’d care for Diao Chan and the others, so despite wanting to leave, they could only endure, seriously and patiently guiding and instructing Zhen Jiang and others onto a stronger path.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had already laid an extremely solid foundation for Zhen Jiang and the others; their cultivation progress was not slow.
Someday.
They will certainly ascend the Celestial Ladder together.
Zuo Ci transformed into light smoke, arriving at the end of the Celestial Ladder.
Whoosh-whoosh.
He stood before the Gate of Glory, somewhat shocked, bewildered, and dazed as he looked and pondered for a long time, yielding nothing, only mumbling:
"That fellow Ding Ling, is truly incredible."

"Not only did he ascend, but he also selflessly left behind such a ladder! Left an unparalleled treasure for posterity! From now on, descendants can see the pathway for Martial Dao advancement! Rather than reaching a realm and having to remain in the original world, awaiting death and old age!"
Zuo Ci stroked his beard, his eyes flashing with uncertain light:
"Or is this portal a trap?"
Zuo Ci’s intent to kill Ding Ling hadn’t diminished.
But Ding Ling was simply too strong, his control over Celestial Human Realm powers far exceeding Zuo Ci, protected by the Eight Array Map among others.
After his strongest incarnation was cut down.
Zuo Ci seemingly has no means against Ding Ling, only able to flee far, study diligently, and await the future.
But upon noticing the appearance of the Celestial Ladder.
Zuo Ci’s mindset subtly changed.
Upon seeing others ascend the ladder and not return.
He developed a different aspiration.
Thus stepping onto the ladder today, testing the waters!
"Anyway, my primary Primordial Spirit remains in this world, only an incarnation is departing, even if damaged, I won’t die."
Zuo Ci bit his lips, eventually stepping into the portal.
Whiz!
A golden light suddenly burst out like a scroll, instantly enveloping his form, pulling him toward ’The Deer and the Cauldron’ at the front of the Heaven-Reaching Dao.
Then amidst Zuo Ci’s astonished, shouting voice, whiz!
The golden light directly coated him, propelling him toward the end of the Heaven-Reaching Dao, swiftly his cries disappeared on the End of the World Path!
Plop!
A sound of landing brushed past his ears.
Ding Ling opened his eyes sharply, surveying his surroundings.
In front, green mountains resemble dragons and serpents, and lush grasses spread on both sides, extending into the distance, with a verdant forest behind.
He had landed in an unknown realm.
"Where is this?"

sentences.text: "Zuo Ci!"
Da Qiao’s pupils contracted sharply, and she exclaimed involuntarily.
Diao Chan and the others also turned to look.
Next to the Celestial Ladder stood an elderly man, who looked exactly like Zuo Ci, causing them to be astonished.
At the same time.
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!

Pan Feng, Zhao Yun, Tong Yuan, Wang Yue, Diao Chan and others, holding spears or drawing swords, stood solemnly, instantly transforming the atmosphere from warm sun to frost and snow, chilling to the extreme.
A surge of cold aura swept across all directions.
Passersby, noticing this scene, quickly moved away, watching from the sidelines.
"Hahaha..."
Zuo Ci also saw Diao Chan and the others and laughed:
"Don’t worry.
I won’t kill you.
I’m a person of cultivation and cannot kill indiscriminately."
These words were indeed honest.
Diao Chan, Pan Feng, Zhao Yun, and others were all extraordinarily destined stars of the Three Kingdoms world, and Zuo Ci dared not kill.
If he were to kill, his Dao heart would be tarnished, entangled in cause and effect and burdened by the karma of killing, which would be troublesome.
Of course, this was secondary.
The most important point was that his strongest avatar had been slain by Ding Ling.
The incarnation he came with this time was strong too.
Yet, it couldn’t match the joint forces of Wang Yue, Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, Pan Feng, and Diao Chan.
If a real conflict occurred, this incarnation might also meet its end here!
Therefore.
After laughing, he stepped onto the Celestial Ladder, waved to Diao Chan and the others without looking back, and loudly said:
"Ladies and gentlemen, hopefully, we’ll never meet again."
Stepping onto the ladder, like a breeze or light smoke, in a whizzing sound, he headed straight up to the Ninefold Heaven, disappearing within moments, as if vanishing?
Evading through space?
Or had he truly soared into the clouds?!
Diao Chan and others reacted:
"This Demon Dao isn’t yet dead.
If he has gone to the Upper Realm and causes trouble, wouldn’t Ding Ling be in danger?"
Da and Xiao Qiao felt somewhat anxious.
Du Qingcheng was uneasy.
Diao Chan also felt anxious, but she didn’t show it, only saying:
"This Demon Dao was defeated by Ding Ling before.
If he encounters Ding Ling in the Upper Realm, it’s surely his fate to be killed.
Don’t forget Ding Ling’s talent.
He learns everything quickly.
If he goes to the Upper Realm and by chance obtains the Heaven-Defying Fate Technique, killing Zuo Ci would be as easy as killing a chicken."
Da and Xiao Qiao and others listened and echoed.
It was unclear if they were comforting themselves or their sisters.
Each had full confidence in Ding Ling!
Even so.
Deep down, a shadow lingered; each pondered the need to enhance their own cultivation!
Otherwise, even going to the Upper Realm, if unable to assist Ding Ling, what worth would they have?
"Don’t worry."
Wang Yue seemed to see through Zuo Ci’s reality:
"This Demon Dao is merely a facade.
Though it appears powerful, its aura is unstable and not very strong.
It seems he was indeed gravely injured by Ding Ling!
Now his strength might only remain one or two parts.
Such a Zuo Ci, with Tong Yuan and I here, he won’t succeed."
"Indeed."
Tong Yuan stroked his beard:
"How talented and remarkable Ding Ling is!
How could a mere Zuo Ci, severely wounded, harm him?
You need not overly worry.
The urgent matter is still to enhance yourselves.
Our purpose in coming out this time is to verify whether Da and Xiao Qiao have reached the Super-Elite level.
Let’s go and test it."
"Yes, master!"
Though the side of the Celestial Ladder was heavily guarded.
Clearly useless against a Demon Dao like Zuo Ci.
Upon reaching the Celestial Human Realm.
No amount of soldiers or horses could matter!
As long as powerhouses of the Celestial Human Realm are cautious, the secular world can barely kill them.
Eventually, Da and Xiao Qiao managed to step onto the Celestial Ladder.
They were overjoyed, feeling as if they’d gotten one step closer to Ding Ling.
But they still needed to help Zhen Jiang and the others.
To leave.
They must leave together.
Wang Yue and Tong Yuan had longed to leave.
Because over time, a War God from the Xianbei Tribe broke through the defensive walls and directly stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Now another Zuo Ci arrives.
Perhaps as the forces guarding the Celestial Ladder dwindle.
More generals and Divine Generals will step onto the ladder.

But they promised Ding Ling they’d care for Diao Chan and the others, so despite wanting to leave, they could only endure, seriously and patiently guiding and instructing Zhen Jiang and others onto a stronger path.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had already laid an extremely solid foundation for Zhen Jiang and the others; their cultivation progress was not slow.
Someday.
They will certainly ascend the Celestial Ladder together.
Zuo Ci transformed into light smoke, arriving at the end of the Celestial Ladder.
Whoosh-whoosh.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Congratulations, Player Leveled Up
paragraphs: "Where exactly am I in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World?"
Ding Ling carefully compared the environment of the Three Kingdoms World with this place.
There was nothing to be gained.
No matter how strong his memory was, it was impossible for him to remember every place on the Jiuzhou Land clearly.
Moreover.
His memory was far inferior to that of people like Diao Chan, hardly considered strong!
If it weren’t for the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats, Ding Ling might still be practicing the horse stance and Pile Skill like everyone else in the Three Kingdoms World!
Upon thinking of this.
Ding Ling did not force himself.
He just stretched his limbs.
He was somewhat shocked to discover.
That his strength seemed to be weakened?
No, no, no!
"Actually, it hasn’t been weakened."
Ding Ling comprehended carefully.
Clang!
Drawing the sword.
Calm Wind Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!

It was as if a gentle breeze swept through the void, and then a Setting Sun Diagram flashed across the sky and vanished, the harsh sound of metal reverberated as the green grass in front of him was cut and ravaged beyond recognition, as if a tornado had swept through.
"The strength is exactly the same as in the real world!"
Ding Ling mused:
"My strength in the Three Kingdoms World has actually all been transferred to the real world. But in the real world, I am just someone slightly stronger than a Super-Elite Peak Fierce General."
A Super-Elite Peak Fierce General refers to a formidable figure who has reached the limits of the External Refining Breathing Technique!
Ding Ling had surpassed the limits of the External Refining Breathing Technique.
Subsequently, the Unity of Inner and Outer Breathing Method occurred.
Once again, breaking the limits!
Reaching the Celestial Human Realm in the Three Kingdoms World!
Unable to advance any further!
Every move he made seemed to be blessed by Celestial Might, favored by fate, with his defense, power, agility, and physique magnified to the utmost limit that the Three Kingdoms World could offer!
Meaning: he became a ceiling-level Divine Being in that world!
Seemingly a ’Saint’ chosen by the Heavenly Dao!
Now he had ascended to another world.
The sky of the Three Kingdoms World naturally could no longer bestow Celestial Might upon him!
"Perhaps, that’s exactly it."
There’s no instruction manual.
Ding Ling was groping in the dark.
Just like when he was earning Achievement Medals, there was no manual, he figured out on his own which famous figures had already been used by other players, so he couldn’t earn from them again.
Now it’s the same principle.
Only he could figure it out on his own.
But he assumed it was most likely exactly as he thought.
Because, apart from this, he couldn’t think of any other reason.
"Without Celestial Might’s blessing, it’s slightly disappointing, but this should be normal!"
Ding Ling felt relieved, he felt no discomfort.
After all, this was his strength in the real world.
Instead, the strength boosted by Celestial Might in the Three Kingdoms World was too overwhelming, often giving him the illusion of being a ’God’!
Now without the Celestial Might’s blessing.
He was back to his original form.
Ding Ling felt more grounded instead.
"External power is external power after all."
Ding Ling didn’t overthink.
He just began practicing his sword techniques continuously.
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
Qing Frost Swordsmanship! Warm Jade Swordsmanship! Moon Shadow Swordsmanship! Howling Moon Sword Technique...
Each sword skill demonstrated extraordinary power under his Heaven-Swaying Sword, transforming either into a gentle breeze, a profusion of blossoms, or tracing out the pattern of a crescent moon...
After a while.
Clang!
Ding Ling sheathed his sword.
He pondered:
"The power is indeed identical to reality. But this world seems sturdier, not as easily fragmented as the Three Kingdoms World!"
At the level of a Super-Elite Peak Fierce General.
Every move.
Seemed capable of making the void tremble! The universe quiver!
But not in this world!
The sturdiness and perfection of this world far exceed that of the Three Kingdoms World.
"No wonder it became the Upper Realm of the Historical Plane!"
Ding Ling mused:
"Perhaps when I reach the extreme state of this world, I might be able to shake the void as well? If I can’t now, it’s purely because my strength isn’t strong enough?"
Ding Ling recalled the standards of the various Sect Leaders from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Comparing them.
He gained nothing.
Without concrete figures, imagining was exhausting, and the likely result was unreliable.
"If I truly encounter them, by comparing or perhaps watching others practice, I’ll know my own standard."
Ding Ling stopped dwelling on it.
He leaped onto his horse.
Took a look around.
Listened closely with his ears.
Chose a direction where the sound of flowing water was coming from, and rode the horse straight towards it.
While galloping at high speed.
Ding Ling checked the character panel.
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 25
Race: Human
Faction: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (Great Wei Kingdom) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (None)
Occupation: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (First-Rank Prince) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (Ranger)
Level: 2 (Note: Congratulations to the player on leveling up! Only if your level is adequate can you continue unlocking paths to other worlds.)

Strength: [Root Bone 2 (Ordinary humans have 1 point), Wisdom 3, Power 31, Agility 31, Physique 31, Defense 31, Charm 10.2. Inner Power Value: 0 (Note: The Martial Hero Plane’s Martial Dao values inner power)]
Weapons: Heaven-Swaying Sword, Giant Que Sword, Tier Four Mortal Storage Pouch...
Mount: Ferghana Horse

Skills: Breaking Army Spear Skill, Howling Moon Sword Technique, Slaughter Void Saber Technique, Detailed Explanation of the Eight Array Map, Wolong Body Cultivation Technique, Initial Tier Array Dao Explanation, Middle-tier Array Dao Explanation, Dragon Taming Skill (Fragment), Clear Roar Swordsmanship...
[Achievement Medals: Normal 13, E-Level 6]
[Glory Medals: 0]
[The Path of Glory in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World has not yet been activated. Activate now?]
Aha!
Ding Ling saw the last line, didn’t think much, and directly activated it.
[Activation Successful!]
[In view of the player selecting the Path of the War God. Reopening the Path of Glory War God for the player!]
[The rules for the Path of the Glory War God in this Plane World are as follows:
1, You must defeat more than twenty strong beings of the plane. The more you defeat, the more glory bonuses you receive.
2, You must defeat the strongest being of the plane. Prove you are the true World’s Number One.
3, You must let your World’s Number One title resonate throughout the entire plane world.
There were a dozen miscellaneous rules.
But the main ones were still the first three.
Similar to the rules of the Three Kingdoms World, there wasn’t much change.
The Three Kingdoms World was about the title of War God.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World was simpler, about being the World’s Number One.
In essence, they were quite similar.
Clop, clop!
The Ferghana Horse galloped to the streamside.
Ding Ling leaped off the horse, letting the two Ferghana Horses drink and graze.
He also washed his face in the stream, then looked towards the library within his sea of consciousness.
After activating the Path of the Glory War God, he sensed something unusual in the library.
Now, examining it closely.
He indeed found the reason.
It turned out that those illusory Breathing Techniques were continually flashing with light.
Ding Ling sensed for a while.
Suddenly he understood.

"Turns out the inability to simultaneously cultivate three External Refining Breathing Techniques has something to do with the world’s constraints. Of course, more importantly, my physical state cannot break through the limits after the Unity of Inner and Outer in the Three Kingdoms.
But now it’s different. Coming to this world. I can still continue to break these limits."
Ding Ling had a very clear feeling.
He could cultivate another External Refining Breathing Technique again.

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Full Level Medicine King Breathing Technique! The Girl Outside the City
paragraphs: This feeling was extremely intense.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate any longer.
He chose the Medicine King Breathing Technique to prepare for cultivation.

The Medicine King Breathing Technique, combined with the Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, and other internal techniques, possesses miraculous effects for healing and detoxification.
Although the Charming Fox Breathing Technique is also outstanding in detoxification and greatly enhances charm, making it the top breathing technique in the Three Kingdoms World.
In comparison, Ding Ling still chose the Medicine King.
Simply because the Medicine King Breathing Technique is more comprehensive! Especially when combined with the Qingnang Scripture, its effects are extraordinary.
He arrived in the Martial World.
He must be wary of others using poison on him!
In the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling would also be cautious, but his food and drink were all handled by Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Da and Xiao Qiao.
So he didn’t worry too much.
But arriving in this unfamiliar Jianghu World, he must be cautious.
After all.
In the Martial Hero Plane, compared to the Historical Plane, more people use poisons, and they are stronger.
In the Three Kingdoms World, just one Ma Zhong managed to poison Diao Chan. If Ding Ling hadn’t found the antidote in time, Diao Chan might have died young!
In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
All sorts of bizarre poisons are hard to guard against. If he were to be poisoned by the Three Corpses Brain God Pill, Ding Ling would be helpless!
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
In an instant.
[Medicine King Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +0.8]
The esoteric truths and essence of the Medicine King Breathing Technique surged in his mind like towering waves.
In just the blink of an eye.
The Medicine King Breathing Technique quickly became an instinct, permeating every part of Ding Ling’s body.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s breathing style began to change again.
With each breath in and out.
There seemed to be a compassionate aura of a saint in it.
To put it simply.
Now Ding Ling seemed like a noble, compassionate Sword God!
"It succeeded indeed."
Ding Ling was elated.
He had initially thought that so many breathing techniques would be wasted.
Now it seemed that he was too weak, or perhaps the ’Heavenly Dao’ of the Three Kingdoms World was too weak to help him break through the original shackles.
In the Three Kingdoms World, 31 points seemed to be the limit.
But this world is different.
It seems possible to continue increasing the values of the four-dimensional attributes?
"I’ll know how it really is when I encounter suitable martial arts and start cultivating."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Staying in the Three Kingdoms World, he could certainly become an ’Earth Immortal’ and enjoy immortal blessings forever.
But Diao Chan and the others would all age and die. He couldn’t accept that!
Moreover, who could guarantee that no genius player would emerge?
If such a genius also reached the Celestial Human Realm and discovered the secrets, Ding Ling would be in big trouble too.
Therefore.
Ding Ling didn’t immerse himself in that ’illusory prosperity.’
He wanted to continue improving himself, climbing to higher peaks.
"Only by becoming truly strong yourself is true strength. The strength supported by the Heavenly Dao is merely external force. It’s not worth reminiscing about."
"And when I truly achieve immortality! I will definitely return to the Three Kingdoms World, teaching the Immortality Technique to Diao Chan and the others to help them transcend!"
Ding Ling’s determination was firm, his gaze profound. He took a deep breath, mounted the horse again, and started heading east along the flow of the water.
Where there is water, there are sure to be people.
He could find someone to ask for directions.
Unexpectedly, after galloping for just over ten miles,
Ding Ling saw people.
It was two people.
A senior was busy at a stall, while a young girl seemed rather bored, sitting on a long bench, chatting with the senior.
Ding Ling’s ’clip-clop’ of horse hooves seemed to wake them up, and they turned to look.
At that glance.
The gazes of both sides instantly locked together.
Ding Ling saw the appearance of the two clearly.
One was a hunchbacked old man over seven feet tall, with an ordinary face;
The other was a charming young girl whose face was full of freckles, and she had a black mole at the corner of her mouth.

Ding Ling, with his extraordinary Kung Fu, full-level Stargazing Skill, full-level Observing People Skill, full-level Makeup Skill, and full-level acting skill, naturally saw through the reality and appearance of the two at a glance.
Needless to say, these two must have put on makeup and stayed here for some significant purpose.
Looking at their outfits again.
Ding Ling’s heart skipped a beat, thinking: Could it be such a coincidence? Is this outside the Fuzhou City?
His horse was fast.
There was no time for much thought.
The Ferghana horse had already reached the stall.
Ding Ling dismounted and cupped his fists in salutation to the two, asking:
"I lost my way while traveling. Could you kindly tell me where this place is?"
"Hmm?!"
The girl was startled and looked at Ding Ling with some surprise.
Ding Ling was tall and high-spirited, with a handsome appearance and dignified manners. Having practiced a breathing technique, his charm increased further, making him even more handsome.
An outsider would only see him as an outstanding and talented gentleman!
They would further feel that his disposition was unique, hard to find in the mundane world.
The girl and the old man were clearly seeing such a complex character for the first time, inevitably becoming more alert and cautious. Hearing Ding Ling’s words, they didn’t dare neglect them.
The old man was the first to respond, replied courteously:
"Reporting to the Hero, this is outside Fuzhou City. If you continue a bit further, you’ll reach Fuzhou."
Is it really outside Fuzhou City?
Then has the story begun?
While Ding Ling was pondering, clip-clop!
Another sound of galloping horses, quite a few people, the sound of the hooves was chaotic and fast, and soon, a group of people came into view.
It was a group of extremely flamboyant-looking individuals.
At the forefront was a frivolous young man with a slightly intoxicated appearance.
Arriving at the stall, he dismounted directly, glanced at Ding Ling, then looked at Ding Ling’s two Ferghana horses, and his eyes showed a greedy expression.
But soon.
He shivered.
Because Ding Ling’s indifferent gaze made him feel as if doused with cold water, experiencing a wave of frightening anxiety!

He couldn’t help but take a step back, catching his breath, regaining his composure, noticing the curious looks of those around him. He felt both ashamed and angry, instantly developing a murderous intent towards Ding Ling!
But at the moment.
Not knowing Ding Ling’s level of cultivation, he didn’t dare make a move, merely sat down first, his gaze coldly fixed on the old man and the girl, slamming the table loudly:
"Didn’t you see the guest? Hurry up, serve the good wine and meat quickly!!"
"Okay, okay."
The old man nodded humbly, appearing very careful. How excellent was Ding Ling’s acting? How skilled was his Observing People Skill?
He saw through the old man’s act at a glance.
He didn’t point it out.
Instead, he paid attention to the frivolous young man just now.
Originally, the young man hadn’t harbored any ill will towards him, but once he did, what kind of person was Ding Ling?
He sensed it immediately.
So he wasn’t in a hurry to rush to Fuzhou City, he sat down as well.
He sat not far from the young man’s diagonal, on a long bench.

sentences.text: This feeling was extremely intense.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate any longer.
He chose the Medicine King Breathing Technique to prepare for cultivation.

The Medicine King Breathing Technique, combined with the Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, Treatise on Cold Pathogenic and Miscellaneous Diseases, and other internal techniques, possesses miraculous effects for healing and detoxification.
Although the Charming Fox Breathing Technique is also outstanding in detoxification and greatly enhances charm, making it the top breathing technique in the Three Kingdoms World.
In comparison, Ding Ling still chose the Medicine King.
Simply because the Medicine King Breathing Technique is more comprehensive!
Especially when combined with the Qingnang Scripture, its effects are extraordinary.
He arrived in the Martial World.
He must be wary of others using poison on him!
In the Three Kingdoms World, Ding Ling would also be cautious, but his food and drink were all handled by Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Da and Xiao Qiao.
So he didn’t worry too much.
But arriving in this unfamiliar Jianghu World, he must be cautious.
After all.
In the Martial Hero Plane, compared to the Historical Plane, more people use poisons, and they are stronger.
In the Three Kingdoms World, just one Ma Zhong managed to poison Diao Chan.
If Ding Ling hadn’t found the antidote in time, Diao Chan might have died young!
In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
All sorts of bizarre poisons are hard to guard against.
If he were to be poisoned by the Three Corpses Brain God Pill, Ding Ling would be helpless!
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
In an instant.
[Medicine King Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +0.8]
The esoteric truths and essence of the Medicine King Breathing Technique surged in his mind like towering waves.
In just the blink of an eye.
The Medicine King Breathing Technique quickly became an instinct, permeating every part of Ding Ling’s body.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s breathing style began to change again.
With each breath in and out.
There seemed to be a compassionate aura of a saint in it.
To put it simply.
Now Ding Ling seemed like a noble, compassionate Sword God!
"It succeeded indeed."
Ding Ling was elated.
He had initially thought that so many breathing techniques would be wasted.
Now it seemed that he was too weak, or perhaps the ’Heavenly Dao’ of the Three Kingdoms World was too weak to help him break through the original shackles.
In the Three Kingdoms World, 31 points seemed to be the limit.
But this world is different.
It seems possible to continue increasing the values of the four-dimensional attributes?
"I’ll know how it really is when I encounter suitable martial arts and start cultivating."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Staying in the Three Kingdoms World, he could certainly become an ’Earth Immortal’ and enjoy immortal blessings forever.
But Diao Chan and the others would all age and die.
He couldn’t accept that!
Moreover, who could guarantee that no genius player would emerge?
If such a genius also reached the Celestial Human Realm and discovered the secrets, Ding Ling would be in big trouble too.
Therefore.
Ding Ling didn’t immerse himself in that ’illusory prosperity.’
He wanted to continue improving himself, climbing to higher peaks.
"Only by becoming truly strong yourself is true strength.
The strength supported by the Heavenly Dao is merely external force.
It’s not worth reminiscing about."
"And when I truly achieve immortality!
I will definitely return to the Three Kingdoms World, teaching the Immortality Technique to Diao Chan and the others to help them transcend!"
Ding Ling’s determination was firm, his gaze profound.
He took a deep breath, mounted the horse again, and started heading east along the flow of the water.
Where there is water, there are sure to be people.
He could find someone to ask for directions.
Unexpectedly, after galloping for just over ten miles,
Ding Ling saw people.
It was two people.
A senior was busy at a stall, while a young girl seemed rather bored, sitting on a long bench, chatting with the senior.
Ding Ling’s ’clip-clop’ of horse hooves seemed to wake them up, and they turned to look.
At that glance.
The gazes of both sides instantly locked together.
Ding Ling saw the appearance of the two clearly.
One was a hunchbacked old man over seven feet tall, with an ordinary face;
The other was a charming young girl whose face was full of freckles, and she had a black mole at the corner of her mouth.

Ding Ling, with his extraordinary Kung Fu, full-level Stargazing Skill, full-level Observing People Skill, full-level Makeup Skill, and full-level acting skill, naturally saw through the reality and appearance of the two at a glance.
Needless to say, these two must have put on makeup and stayed here for some significant purpose.
Looking at their outfits again.
Ding Ling’s heart skipped a beat, thinking: Could it be such a coincidence?
Is this outside the Fuzhou City?
His horse was fast.
There was no time for much thought.
The Ferghana horse had already reached the stall.

Could you kindly tell me where this place is?"

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Lin Pingzhi (11/13)
paragraphs: "What would you like to order, sir?"
The young girl came up to Ding Ling and asked softly.
Her voice was melodious, like spring water flowing through a mountain stream, very pleasant to the ear.
Ding Ling looked at the girl silently.
If you’re going to disguise yourself, at least make it convincing.
Apart from her plain face, her figure, delicate hands, and voice all strongly suggested she was hiding her true nature!
If one were bold and reckless.
It’s only natural to have thoughts about such a woman!
Ding Ling instantly understood ’Yu Renyan’ from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
As expected.
The girl in front of him was definitely Yue Lingshan, and that old man was Laudeno.
The one who was just boisterous and frivolous must have been Yu Renyan.
Yu Renyan...
Ding Ling’s mind turned, and he came up with an idea, so he told the girl she could just bring him anything she wished.
The girl nodded and went inside the shop to prepare.
Ding Ling didn’t know how Laudeno and the girl thought their disguises could fool anyone.
Fooling someone like Lin Pingzhi, who’s new to Jianghu, would be fine, but in front of Ding Ling, the two of them were flawed from head to toe.
It’s safe to say.
Ding Ling had successfully evolved into a ’veteran’ of Jianghu!
For this reason.
Ding Ling only felt a bit complicated, but he quickly suppressed this emotion and curiously wondered how powerful these martial arts experts were.
Assuming his guesses were correct.
He should be witnessing a Jianghu battle soon.
Soon enough.
The girl served wine and dishes to Ding Ling.

Ding Ling took a taste; the flavor was mediocre. But since the two were not legitimate business operators, Ding Ling was relieved. Besides, he was hungry, so he drank wine and ate meat heartily, appearing to enjoy it thoroughly, leaving the girl standing beside him in a daze, thinking:
"Is what I made really that delicious?!"
While quietly delighted.
An angry roar came from one side:
"What kind of dog food did you serve!"
The girl’s brow twitched, and she looked in the direction of the voice, only to see the young boy from before in a fury, glaring at her:
"What are you looking at? Hurry up and pour me some wine!"
His face was flushed with anger.
It’s unclear if he was upset about being frightened by Ding Ling earlier.
Or genuinely angry about the unsatisfying food and drink.
In any case, he looked ferocious and quite intimidating.
The girl’s expression changed slightly, hesitated for a moment, and didn’t go over.
The old man quickly came out to smooth things over, smiling apologetically while personally pouring wine for the young man, who pushed him away:
"You, with your stinking old body, think you can serve me wine?"
He pointed at the girl and yelled:
"Get over here immediately, or don’t blame me for being rude!"
The girl glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling acting as if he hadn’t a care for what was happening.
The girl felt stifled, a bit frustrated and upset, but she obediently moved over to the young man’s side and picked up the wine pot to pour him wine.
Clattering!
She had just filled a cup.
The young man saw the girl’s rosy lips and bright teeth; despite her pockmarked face, her charm was still undeniable, causing his eyes to light up. Just as he was about to speak.
The clatter of horses’ hooves suddenly filled the air.
Looking towards the sound.
A group of riders came galloping, at great speed, quickly halting in front of the shop.
Clack!
Leading the group was a young man with handsome features, refined and dignified, with an aura like jade! He dismounted, standing elegantly by the side, highlighting his extraordinary grace!

The frivolous youth was momentarily stunned by such a charming young man, but soon, as if remembering who this person was, he snorted coldly, looked at the pockmarked girl, saw her also staring blankly at the jade-like young man, and became jealous and hateful, angrily saying:
"What are you looking at? Hurry and fill my cup!"
The pockmarked girl snapped back, a bit embarrassed, but instinctively flicked her hair by her ear, revealing a hint of a girl’s demeanor, pointing at the cup before the frivolous youth:
"I already filled it."
"Hmph!"

The frivolous youth picked up the cup, downed the drink in one gulp, and banged the cup back on the table, casting a sideways glance at the pockmarked girl, releasing a breath of foul-smelling wine, saying:
"Now it’s not full!"
The pockmarked girl had nothing to say, continuing to sulkily pour wine for the frivolous youth.
For the first time, she realized how hard it was to set up a stall.
It was her first true experience of the hardships at the grassroots; it was too difficult!
Splash!
Cups of wine were filled.
Gulp!
The frivolous youth drank one cup after another, quickly becoming slightly drunk. Looking at the girl in front of him, he couldn’t resist grabbing her hand with a laugh, saying:

"Looks as ugly as death, but such delicate skin, it’s the first time I’ve seen it. Today, don’t leave. Stay with me to Fuzhou City later. I have plenty of money and will make sure you eat, drink, and have fun, much better than staying with that old coot, right?"
If a woman vain of wealth and vanity had heard this, she might be tempted.
But the pockmarked girl had an air of nobility, clearly a ’rich white beauty,’ unlikely to be swayed by mere money.
It was her first time being treated so lightly by someone.
Stunned and furious, angry and anxious.
She instinctively wanted to act but thought of her father’s instructions and lost her energy, her eyes reddening:
"You, let go!"
She struggled.
But the frivolous youth gripped her hand tightly, laughing heartily.
This scene.
As if a lamb was about to fall into a wolf’s mouth.
Ding Ling’s eye twitched at the corner.
None of them have any acting skills! So full of flaws!
Only the frivolous youth acts true to form, with some ’real kung fu,’ the pockmarked girl and the hunchbacked old man were too fake!
The hunchbacked old man was preparing tea for the handsome young man, hearing the laughter, glanced sideways, turned color, wanted to intervene, but felt conflicted, couldn’t help but wail:
"You, you all..."
The handsome young man, seeing the old man’s act, and the frivolous youth’s rudeness, couldn’t help but boil with righteous indignation, slammed the table, and shouted:

"In broad daylight, under the sun, in front of everyone’s eyes! How dare you act so absurdly, unreasonably, it’s outrageous! Release her immediately, or don’t blame me, Lin Pingzhi, for being impolite!"
Upon hearing the name Lin Pingzhi.
Ding Ling secretly breathed a sigh, thinking:
"My guess was indeed correct. This is indeed the shop outside Fuzhou City. But the location and timing of my Ascension was just too convenient."
Ding Ling thought of the vast, complex, and unpredictable nature of the game.
He felt relieved.
Since events like the Three Kingdoms’ Ascension and the Celestial Ladder fixed in all directions had happened.
A coincidence like this isn’t hard to understand.
Besides.
He was heading east.
If he had gone west back then.
