chapters.title: Chapter 277: The Giant Que Sword Unleashed! Yue Lingshan Turns Pale (12/13)
paragraphs: Might be another story.
It wouldn’t be Lin Pingzhi’s group.
One can only say, with different choices, different encounters naturally follow.
Ding Ling watched quietly from the side.
As expected.

That arrogant young man was reprimanded and immediately changed color and erupted in anger. He shoved away the pockmarked girl, and with a clang, drew the sharp sword from the table, pointing straight at Lin Pingzhi:
"Lin Pingzhi from the Fuwei Escort Agency?"
"Indeed."
Lin Pingzhi was calm, seeing the arrogant young man released the girl, he let it go and was about to sit down.
The young man laughed out loud:
"I am Yu Renyan, the son of Yu Canghai, Sect Leader of Qingcheng Sect! You, a mere escort agency kid, think you can play the hero and save the beauty."
He spat towards Lin Pingzhi:
"Bah!"
After spitting.
He took a step forward, grabbed the girl’s shoulder again, and arrogantly and triumphantly wiped her face, ignoring her struggle, he looked at Lin Pingzhi and laughed:
"I’m teasing her, what can you do?!"
"Abominable!"
Lin Pingzhi was furious, his handsome face flushed red, and in rash youth zeal, he acted without thinking, stood up, drew his sword, and charged straight at Yu Renyan:
"Eat my sword!"
"Afraid of you?!"
Yu Renyan sneered, casually thrusting a sword towards Lin Pingzhi.
Clang!
One was enraged, with ordinary moves;
The other had intoxicated eyes, with exquisite sword skills.
In this fight, it seemed like a bully teasing a child, Lin Pingzhi stumbled around, unable to resist.
The people Lin Pingzhi brought clearly saw the difference between the two, and shouted ’Young Leader, we’ll help you’, drawing swords and charging forward.
Yu Renyan’s men also stepped in to assist immediately.
Suddenly.
The shop became chaotic.
In the midst of crashing sounds, tables and benches were kicked over, smashed to the ground.
Unconsciously.
Whether Yu Renyan did it intentionally or unintentionally.
He led Lin Pingzhi fighting towards Ding Ling’s direction, obviously wanting to test Ding Ling’s skills. If Ding Ling was not strong enough, Yu Renyan would surely launch a deadly attack!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Amidst the flashing blades and shadows, Yu Renyan and Lin Pingzhi’s duel got extremely close to Ding Ling.
Lin Pingzhi struggled to parry, too weary to warn Ding Ling.
But the pockmarked girl couldn’t stand it and reminded promptly:
"Watch out!"
Ding Ling ignored the girl, watching the two fight with some contemplation, although it wasn’t bad, it didn’t seem much different from third-rate or second-rate generals of the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling felt a bit disappointed.
Thinking the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer would be much stronger.
Turns out it’s just at this level?
Considering Lin Pingzhi and Yu Renyan were originally bottom-tier roles in the Jianghu.
He became at ease.
Seeing them getting closer.
Yu Renyan audaciously swung the sword towards him several times, nearly stabbing his neck, what was he up to?
It was obvious.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrow, suddenly drew his sword.
Clang!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
One sword out, and flowers bloom, with a clang, hitting straight into Yu Renyan and Lin Pingzhi’s swords, and with just one move, both swords were knocked into the air.
Humph!
Ding Ling snorted coldly, turning and spinning the sword edge, shook the sword back, patting sideways, like thunder in motion, swiftly and sharply, smack!
Right on Yu Renyan’s face.
Yu Renyan screamed tragically, stumbled and rolled four or five meters away.
He clutched his face, looking at Ding Ling with disbelief:
"You, you, you dare hit me?!"
In great pain.
His drunkenness vanished instantly.
"Why not hit you?"
Ding Ling chuckled, activated the Throwing Skill, and casually tossed the Heaven-Swaying Sword, thud!
Right into Yu Renyan’s leg, in a flash, the sword edge pierced through his calf, pinned to the ground, sinking a full foot!
This move.
Sudden and fierce.
Yu Renyan never expected Ding Ling to be so ruthless and decisive, when he did strike, it was earth-shattering, extremely sharp!
On his calf being pierced.
He finally reacted.
Uncontrollably letting out a hysterical wail.
"Young Sect Leader!"
Yu Renyan’s men saw it, got furious, and switched weapons, charging at Ding Ling, planning to attack in numbers to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling sneered.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword left the sheath.
With the sword in hand, moving like dragon and snake, thunderstorm surprise!
Whoosh whoosh!

Ding Ling’s Calm Wind Swordsmanship laid open, the Four Great Breathing Techniques activated for amplification, strolling amidst enemies, naturally free and easy, a slash an attack, all struck the enemy’s vital spots.
Whether it’s chopping, cleaving, slicing, or stabbing.
A single sword sometimes transformed into a breeze, sometimes into a ghost prison, sometimes grand and magnificent, sometimes freezing cold.
Ding Ling wielded the sword in style.
People walked through.
Like flowers through a wire.
In just a few blinks.
Yu Renyan’s group, all flipped over to the ground, each either gripping their neck, staring widely, or with fearful panic...
Their posture and looks varied.
But without exception.
They were all dead!
The pockmarked girl and hunched old man widened their eyes, staring dumbfounded at Ding Ling.
They never expected, this guy, who looked like a prince or crown prince, would be a top-notch expert not inferior to major sect leaders!
"Hiss!"
Lin Pingzhi gasped in awe and fear at Ding Ling, feeling at a loss, and involuntarily stepped back a few steps, distancing himself from Ding Ling.
Other darts masters saw it, and quickly surrounded Lin Pingzhi protectively.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, merely sheathing the sword!
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword returned to its place.
Carried on Ding Ling’s back, making his figure seem heavier and taller!
He stood there, walking slowly, like a towering mountain, a deep chasm! Immeasurable, incalculable!
Previously, they didn’t feel this way.
But as Ding Ling showed his might.
Looking at Ding Ling now, he seemed more and more like a peerless Sword God!
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Lin Pingzhi.]

[Note: Lin Pingzhi, spoiled since childhood, unaware of the world’s dangers, not knowing where the true strength of the world’s experts lies. Your presence made him realize he had lived inside a well, never seeing the real scenery on the path of Martial Dao!]
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Yue Lingshan.]
[Note: On Yue Buqun’s order, Yue Lingshan came here, never having suffered hardships. Pure and cute, lively and active, she believed the world’s goodness outweighs the evil.
But your decisive killings, ruthless strikes without mercy, with one sword taking countless lives.
Stunned and terrified her!]
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Yu Renyan.]

sentences.text: Might be another story.
It wouldn’t be Lin Pingzhi’s group.
One can only say, with different choices, different encounters naturally follow.
Ding Ling watched quietly from the side.
As expected.
That arrogant young man was reprimanded and immediately changed color and erupted in anger.
He shoved away the pockmarked girl, and with a clang, drew the sharp sword from the table, pointing straight at Lin Pingzhi:
"Lin Pingzhi from the Fuwei Escort Agency?"
"Indeed."
Lin Pingzhi was calm, seeing the arrogant young man released the girl, he let it go and was about to sit down.
The young man laughed out loud:
"I am Yu Renyan, the son of Yu Canghai, Sect Leader of Qingcheng Sect!
You, a mere escort agency kid, think you can play the hero and save the beauty."
He spat towards Lin Pingzhi:
"Bah!"
After spitting.
He took a step forward, grabbed the girl’s shoulder again, and arrogantly and triumphantly wiped her face, ignoring her struggle, he looked at Lin Pingzhi and laughed:
"I’m teasing her, what can you do?!"
"Abominable!"
Lin Pingzhi was furious, his handsome face flushed red, and in rash youth zeal, he acted without thinking, stood up, drew his sword, and charged straight at Yu Renyan:
"Eat my sword!"
"Afraid of you?!"
Yu Renyan sneered, casually thrusting a sword towards Lin Pingzhi.
Clang!
One was enraged, with ordinary moves;
The other had intoxicated eyes, with exquisite sword skills.
In this fight, it seemed like a bully teasing a child, Lin Pingzhi stumbled around, unable to resist.
The people Lin Pingzhi brought clearly saw the difference between the two, and shouted ’Young Leader, we’ll help you’, drawing swords and charging forward.
Yu Renyan’s men also stepped in to assist immediately.
Suddenly.
The shop became chaotic.
In the midst of crashing sounds, tables and benches were kicked over, smashed to the ground.
Unconsciously.
Whether Yu Renyan did it intentionally or unintentionally.
He led Lin Pingzhi fighting towards Ding Ling’s direction, obviously wanting to test Ding Ling’s skills.
If Ding Ling was not strong enough, Yu Renyan would surely launch a deadly attack!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Amidst the flashing blades and shadows, Yu Renyan and Lin Pingzhi’s duel got extremely close to Ding Ling.
Lin Pingzhi struggled to parry, too weary to warn Ding Ling.
But the pockmarked girl couldn’t stand it and reminded promptly:
"Watch out!"
Ding Ling ignored the girl, watching the two fight with some contemplation, although it wasn’t bad, it didn’t seem much different from third-rate or second-rate generals of the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling felt a bit disappointed.
Thinking the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer would be much stronger.
Turns out it’s just at this level?
Considering Lin Pingzhi and Yu Renyan were originally bottom-tier roles in the Jianghu.
He became at ease.
Seeing them getting closer.
Yu Renyan audaciously swung the sword towards him several times, nearly stabbing his neck, what was he up to?
It was obvious.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrow, suddenly drew his sword.
Clang!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
One sword out, and flowers bloom, with a clang, hitting straight into Yu Renyan and Lin Pingzhi’s swords, and with just one move, both swords were knocked into the air.
Humph!
Ding Ling snorted coldly, turning and spinning the sword edge, shook the sword back, patting sideways, like thunder in motion, swiftly and sharply, smack!
Right on Yu Renyan’s face.
Yu Renyan screamed tragically, stumbled and rolled four or five meters away.
He clutched his face, looking at Ding Ling with disbelief:
"You, you, you dare hit me?!"
In great pain.
His drunkenness vanished instantly.
"Why not hit you?"
Ding Ling chuckled, activated the Throwing Skill, and casually tossed the Heaven-Swaying Sword, thud!
Right into Yu Renyan’s leg, in a flash, the sword edge pierced through his calf, pinned to the ground, sinking a full foot!
This move.
Sudden and fierce.
Yu Renyan never expected Ding Ling to be so ruthless and decisive, when he did strike, it was earth-shattering, extremely sharp!
On his calf being pierced.
He finally reacted.
Uncontrollably letting out a hysterical wail.
"Young Sect Leader!"
Yu Renyan’s men saw it, got furious, and switched weapons, charging at Ding Ling, planning to attack in numbers to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling sneered.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword left the sheath.
With the sword in hand, moving like dragon and snake, thunderstorm surprise!
Whoosh whoosh!

Ding Ling’s Calm Wind Swordsmanship laid open, the Four Great Breathing Techniques activated for amplification, strolling amidst enemies, naturally free and easy, a slash an attack, all struck the enemy’s vital spots.
Whether it’s chopping, cleaving, slicing, or stabbing.
A single sword sometimes transformed into a breeze, sometimes into a ghost prison, sometimes grand and magnificent, sometimes freezing cold.
Ding Ling wielded the sword in style.
People walked through.
Like flowers through a wire.
In just a few blinks.
Yu Renyan’s group, all flipped over to the ground, each either gripping their neck, staring widely, or with fearful panic...
Their posture and looks varied.
But without exception.
They were all dead!
The pockmarked girl and hunched old man widened their eyes, staring dumbfounded at Ding Ling.
They never expected, this guy, who looked like a prince or crown prince, would be a top-notch expert not inferior to major sect leaders!
"Hiss!"
Lin Pingzhi gasped in awe and fear at Ding Ling, feeling at a loss, and involuntarily stepped back a few steps, distancing himself from Ding Ling.
Other darts masters saw it, and quickly surrounded Lin Pingzhi protectively.
Ding Ling didn’t mind, merely sheathing the sword!
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword returned to its place.
Carried on Ding Ling’s back, making his figure seem heavier and taller!
He stood there, walking slowly, like a towering mountain, a deep chasm!
Immeasurable, incalculable!
Previously, they didn’t feel this way.
But as Ding Ling showed his might.
Looking at Ding Ling now, he seemed more and more like a peerless Sword God!
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Lin Pingzhi.]
[Note: Lin Pingzhi, spoiled since childhood, unaware of the world’s dangers, not knowing where the true strength of the world’s experts lies.
Your presence made him realize he had lived inside a well, never seeing the real scenery on the path of Martial Dao!]
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Yue Lingshan.]
[Note: On Yue Buqun’s order, Yue Lingshan came here, never having suffered hardships.
Pure and cute, lively and active, she believed the world’s goodness outweighs the evil.
But your decisive killings, ruthless strikes without mercy, with one sword taking countless lives.
Stunned and terrified her!]
[Achievement Medal earned: Intimidating Yu Renyan.]

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill Full Level! Inner Power Value Increased (13/13)
paragraphs: [Note: As the son of the Qingcheng Sect Leader, Yu Renyan has had a smooth life, rarely encountering adversity, and is often flattered! Thus, he is arrogant, domineering, conceited, and reckless.
But your appearance.
Made him truly realize for the first time.
That the title of Young Sect Leader of the Qingcheng Sect is not useful at all!
That there really are extremely terrifying and frightening figures in this world!
He fears you. He wants to kill you more. Don’t doubt, if he escapes, he will certainly seek revenge for this hatred and humiliation!
Ding Ling’s eyebrow raised like a knife as he heard.
He walked to Yu Renyan’s front, looking down at him.
He saw him trembling and couldn’t help but reach out to grip the handle of the Heaven-Swaying Sword, ready to draw it.
Yu Renyan couldn’t help but tremble and said:
"No, you can’t draw it. If you do, I will surely bleed to death."
"If you don’t want me to draw it, that’s fine too."
Ding Ling looked at him coldly:
"Recite and practice your Qingcheng Sect’s cultivation technique out loud."
Dealing with people like Dong Huang and Yuan Yao,
Ding Ling is extremely straightforward.
He directly intimidates!
It’s unfailingly effective!
For people with a backbone like Zhang Fei and Xu Sheng, Ding Ling had no way to force them, but it was clear that Yu Renyan wasn’t one with backbone, so Ding Ling naturally hoped to gain something.
Qingcheng Sect.
It’s a famous sect in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World!
In the Jiuzhou Territory, there aren’t many such great sects, being ranked among them shows their extraordinary nature.
If he could obtain their heart technique and martial arts,
Ding Ling’s martial arts would certainly advance by leaps and bounds.
Only because his current Inner Power Value is still 0!
Learning inner power will surely bring a huge breakthrough!
The Breathing Technique and inner power are entirely different. The Breathing Technique focuses on Body Refining.
Inner power seems completely different from that.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t specially list an Inner Power Value!
Yu Renyan widened his eyes, staring at Ding Ling in disbelief, stammering as if trying to say something.
"What do you mean by ’I’?"
Ding Ling shook the scabbard of the Heaven-Swaying Sword, slap, slap!
It struck Yu Renyan’s left cheek!
In no time, his left cheek swelled up rapidly as if inflated.
Painful and itchy.
Plus, waves of pain from the calf pierced by the Giant Que Sword rushed into his brain.
He gasped in pain, his face turning pale.
Beside him, Yue Lingshan and a few others watched with extremely complex expressions.
Each of them looked at Ding Ling with nuanced eyes.
There was caution, vigilance, fear, and uncertainty.
Clearly, in an instant, they had categorized Ding Ling from a harmless sheep into a group of tigers and wolves!
Ding Ling didn’t care at all.
He wasn’t familiar with Yue Lingshan and the others after all, so why would he specifically care about their thoughts? What he wanted the most was the Qingcheng Sect’s technique.
"I, I can give it to you."

Yu Renyan gritted his teeth, seeing Ding Ling’s face full of killing intent and impatience, he felt a chill in his heart and a crack in his liver. The instinctual desire to survive madly took over, dismissing all ancestor teachings and father’s words to the great beyond:
"But the Qingcheng Sect’s secret technique cannot be heard by too many people."
Ding Ling understood.
He gave Yue Lingshan, Lin Pingzhi, and the others a look, signaling them to move further away.
Yue Lingshan and the others, like frightened rabbits, madly ran far away until they could no longer hear the conversation between Ding Ling and Yu Renyan, then they stopped.
Lin Pingzhi and Yue Lingshan exchanged glances, speechless for a moment.
But from the previous running movements,

Lin Pingzhi realized that Yue Lingshan and the others surprisingly had martial arts background, and felt stifled in his heart, about to voice his questioning. But recalling Ding Ling’s frightening demeanor, he held back, merely looking over with gleaming eyes.
He had heard people mention the Qingcheng Sect before, and never imagined such a great sect could actually be disregarded by someone.
For a moment, he couldn’t help but be filled with admiration!
At his juvenile, passionate age, fearing someone like Ding Ling first, and then admiring him is quite normal.
"Alright. You can speak now."
Ding Ling looked at Yu Renyan, saying indifferently.
Yu Renyan dared not delay, straightened up quickly, took a breath, and spoke rapidly:

"Our Qingcheng Sect’s Inner Power Heart Method is the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, with the technique divided into nine sections. Only by practicing to the ninth section can one reach the First-class Great Success Level.

I’ve only practiced to the third section. My skills are insufficient, which is quite normal, but it doesn’t mean the Qingcheng Sect is weak. My father, Yu Canghai, has already practiced the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill to the eighth section, extremely accomplished, and most people in the world respect and fear him..."
Slap, slap!
The sword scabbard moved, and there were two more slaps.

With a grunt, Yu Renyan bled from the mouth, looking at Ding Ling with a mixture of shock and anger, infinite resentment and killing intent swelling in his heart. No one had ever dared treat him like this!
But fearing Ding Ling would sense his murderous intent, he quickly lowered his head, not daring to look at Ding Ling.
"Enough with the nonsense."
Ding Ling said coldly:
"Directly recite the technique!"
How could he not perceive that Yu Renyan was trying to use Yu Canghai to intimidate and threaten him?
But what kind of person is Ding Ling?
The Supreme Emperor behind the scenes of the Three Kingdoms World, the Guardian God of Jiuzhou, the National Preceptor of the Great Wei Kingdom!
With a Divine Sword in hand, he slaughtered from north to south, from south to Si Li, and killed countless people outside, calling him a killing god is no exaggeration.
How could such a person possibly fear, possibly worry about mere intimidation?
"I’ll recite, I’ll recite it..."
Yu Renyan felt so oppressed and frustrated to the extreme.

Encountering someone as impenetrable as Ding Ling, he truly had no recourse, and could only go along with Ding Ling’s wishes, fearing to provoke Ding Ling and risk being tormented or even killed by him.
Thinking about death,
Yu Renyan shuddered, babbling rapidly and incessantly.
He didn’t want to die; he still had plenty of silver unspent, too many women unenjoyed.
How could he die?!
After one round,
Yu Renyan, somewhat uneasy, looked at Ding Ling and cautiously said:
"That’s all the Heart Method Mantras of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill. With my limited aptitude and strength, I cannot offer you further explanation. I hope you understand."
Ding Ling nodded noncommittally.
He slightly closed his eyes.
All the Heart Method Mantras of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill rolled through his Sea of Consciousness.
Soon after,
A book converged on the library shelf.
[Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In just the blink of an eye,
This Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill transformed into an instinct throughout Ding Ling’s body, immersing into the dantian and meridians.
Whoosh whoosh!
Between each of Ding Ling’s breath, rolling Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi surged in swiftly!

These qi immersed into Ding Ling’s dantian, rapidly condensing into energy, then, like raging pythons, giant dragons, or fierce lions, they madly shot through each of his Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Clearing thorns and brambles along the way, they forcefully pierced through clogged meridians and pathways!
Ding Ling’s physique became increasingly light!
The aura around him also grew steadier, more concentrated, and powerful.
He seemed to be undergoing a transformation.

chapters.title: Chapter 279: My Father Is Yu Canghai
paragraphs: Yu Renyan in front of Ding Ling looked at him with a face full of shock and terror, filled with disbelief, as if seeing a Celestial God or the Jade Emperor!
"This, this, how is this possible?!"
"This is Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!"

"I’ve been cultivating for many years and only reached the third section! My father spent his whole life cultivating, yet he only reached the eighth section! This person in front of me, this person..."
His face was blank, and his heart was full of horror, looking at Ding Ling like the moon in a well, feeling particularly unreal!
How could he not see?
Just now, Ding Ling’s aura changed dramatically, like Wanhai returning to the source, the divided Jiuzhou united once again!
The whole person instantly became grand, majestic, with a touch of aloofness and a sense of mediocrity.
This was clearly the external manifestation of the Great Perfection of Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!
Yu Renyan remembered clearly.
How could he mistake it?
But is this possible?!
Too ridiculous!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s breathing became increasingly profound and long. Streams of white gas emerged from his nostrils like ribbons.
This is the manifestation of Inner Power at Great Success.
Ding Ling’s eyes suddenly opened, beams of essence flashed out from his eyes, seemingly illuminating this heaven and earth.
Yu Renyan’s mouth twitched, because he was so shocked that at this moment, he almost forgot the pain.
"A very good cultivation technique."
Ding Ling carefully comprehended, thinking:
"It’s just that the increased 100 Inner Power Value seemed to be all used to open up blocked meridians. My dantian is still empty, without a trace of inner strength."
Ding Ling clenched his fist.
Although the inner strength was gone.
But he could clearly feel that he had become stronger.
He looked at the Character Panel.
[Inner Power Value: 0]
Indeed.
The Inner Power Value had crazily dropped from 100 points to 0 points.
Needless to say.
It was all used to open up meridians.
He could perceive that among the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, at least one or two were completely opened.
"Perhaps when all the meridians are opened, I can automatically condense inner strength when I cultivate Inner Power."
The feeling just now when the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi frantically surged towards him.
Left Ding Ling extremely shaken.
He could clearly perceive the stark contrast to the barren real world.
This place was like the Immortal Realm!
The Primordial Qi here was much denser than in the real world!
"It seems that even with an Inner Power Heart Method, the probability of cultivating inner strength in the real world is quite low."
Ding Ling was also surprised.
He did not expect that the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill was actually absorbing external Primordial Qi.
Didn’t it say that some inner powers are formed by self-cultivation and refining essence?
Ding Ling was thoughtful. He felt that to know more, perhaps he needed to obtain more Inner Power Skills.
But after the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill reached Full Level.
Ding Ling, as long as he calmed down and practiced well, could still quickly generate a kind of ’Returning to the Source Qi that unifies nine parts into one’!
This Returning to the Source Qi, although moderate.
But undeniably, in terms of harmony and health preservation ability, it’s extraordinary.

But Ding Ling couldn’t possibly spend time meditating and cultivating inner power. With this effort, it would be more effective to look at several Inner Power Heart Methods and instantly achieve full level.
Just look at Yu Renyan and Yu Canghai.
How many years have they been cultivating the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill?!
If Ding Ling learned like them, he would be using the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats as a mere ornament. He’s not that foolish!
"Continue the practice."
Ding Ling looked at Yu Renyan.
Yu Renyan’s body trembled, looking at Ding Ling with strange eyes, he mechanically, dully recited the mantra of ’Pine Wind Swordsmanship’.
After reciting it.
Ding Ling stepped to the side, picked up Yu Renyan’s sword, tossed it back to him, and signaled him to practice the sword moves of Pine Wind Swordsmanship.
Yu Renyan began to practice tremblingly.
The first time.
Due to fear and intense pain, he practiced inadequately and was asked to redo it again.
He practiced a full three times.
Only then did a book gather in Ding Ling’s library.
In an instant.
[Pine Wind Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
The various essences and esoteric truths of the Pine Wind Swordsmanship surged in his mind.
Within an instant, it became an instinct engraved into every part of Ding Ling’s body and viscera.
Ding Ling quickly sensed that he fully understood and mastered this Pine Wind Swordsmanship.
"A very excellent sword technique.
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
According to Yu Renyan.

This Pine Wind Swordsmanship is the Sect’s Swordsmanship of the Qingcheng Sect. Cultivating it to mastery, or a perfect state, is extremely difficult. In the entire Qingcheng Sect, only Yu Canghai reached this stage.
It’s truly because this sword technique is genuinely a high-tier, peak-level sword technique!
Stronger than many sword techniques in the Three Kingdoms World.
In no way inferior to Qing Frost Swordsmanship or Calm Wind Swordsmanship, these top-notch sword skills.
In certain aspects, it’s even superior.
Ding Ling made a sword with his fingers, practiced slightly, and sure enough, once the Pine Wind Swordsmanship was used, there seemed to be a vigorous force surging back and forth in the void!
This force, seeming to contain the strength of the pine, the speed of the wind! Extremely extraordinary!
Swoosh!
The stimulated void even seemed to emit strange sounds!
Yu Renyan was completely dumbfounded.
Just by reciting the mantra once and practicing the sword technique three times, Ding Ling actually practiced and mastered their Qingcheng Sect’s Sect’s Swordsmanship to the Perfection Stage!
Is this really a human?!
Thinking that he brought such a terrifyingly talented person to the sect, Yu Renyan’s body couldn’t help but tremble.
At the same time.
The killing intent towards Ding Ling in his heart grew more fervent.
Because he knew that Ding Ling was still young, his martial arts hadn’t reached Great Success, and if not eliminated now, it would be impossible once Ding Ling became even stronger in a few years!
"Is there more?"
Ding Ling looked at Yu Renyan.
Yu Renyan was a bit bewildered and, under Ding Ling’s penetrating gaze, shook his head fearfully:

"My father has another skill, Heart Shattering Palm. But he didn’t teach it to me. He said not to bite off more than you can chew. Once I’ve cultivated Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill and Pine Wind Swordsmanship to a certain stage, he’d teach me Heart Shattering Palm."
Ding Ling sighed.
Hearing this, Yu Renyan seemed to understand something and began screaming in fear:
"You promised me, you wouldn’t kill me!"
Feeling that wasn’t convincing enough, he started repeating something over and over: "You can’t kill me, my father is Yu Canghai! My father is Yu Canghai!"
Whoosh!

Ding Ling directly picked up a sword from the ground, held it tightly in his hand, and executed Pine Wind Swordsmanship. The sword instantly transformed, like a tenacious pine and a swift wind, thrusting forward, like wind and lightning, yet extremely fierce!
One thrust. Thud!
A crisp sound.
Yu Renyan’s forehead was pierced through.
He looked at Ding Ling with disbelief, his eyes filled with resentment, hatred, reluctance, fear, and a longing for life.

Ding Ling no longer looked at him, instead pulling out the Heaven-Swaying Sword, sheathing it, turning around, and walking to the Ferghana Horse. He rummaged through the bag, pulling out a piece of gold.
With no small change.
Ding Ling placed it directly on the table.

sentences.text: Yu Renyan in front of Ding Ling looked at him with a face full of shock and terror, filled with disbelief, as if seeing a Celestial God or the Jade Emperor!
"This, this, how is this possible?!"
"This is Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!"
"I’ve been cultivating for many years and only reached the third section!
My father spent his whole life cultivating, yet he only reached the eighth section!
This person in front of me, this person..."
His face was blank, and his heart was full of horror, looking at Ding Ling like the moon in a well, feeling particularly unreal!
How could he not see?
Just now, Ding Ling’s aura changed dramatically, like Wanhai returning to the source, the divided Jiuzhou united once again!
The whole person instantly became grand, majestic, with a touch of aloofness and a sense of mediocrity.
This was clearly the external manifestation of the Great Perfection of Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!
Yu Renyan remembered clearly.
How could he mistake it?
But is this possible?!
Too ridiculous!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s breathing became increasingly profound and long.
Streams of white gas emerged from his nostrils like ribbons.
This is the manifestation of Inner Power at Great Success.
Ding Ling’s eyes suddenly opened, beams of essence flashed out from his eyes, seemingly illuminating this heaven and earth.
Yu Renyan’s mouth twitched, because he was so shocked that at this moment, he almost forgot the pain.
"A very good cultivation technique."
Ding Ling carefully comprehended, thinking:
"It’s just that the increased 100 Inner Power Value seemed to be all used to open up blocked meridians.
My dantian is still empty, without a trace of inner strength."
Ding Ling clenched his fist.
Although the inner strength was gone.
But he could clearly feel that he had become stronger.
He looked at the Character Panel.
[Inner Power Value: 0]
Indeed.
The Inner Power Value had crazily dropped from 100 points to 0 points.
Needless to say.
It was all used to open up meridians.
He could perceive that among the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, at least one or two were completely opened.
"Perhaps when all the meridians are opened, I can automatically condense inner strength when I cultivate Inner Power."
The feeling just now when the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi frantically surged towards him.
Left Ding Ling extremely shaken.
He could clearly perceive the stark contrast to the barren real world.
This place was like the Immortal Realm!
The Primordial Qi here was much denser than in the real world!
"It seems that even with an Inner Power Heart Method, the probability of cultivating inner strength in the real world is quite low."
Ding Ling was also surprised.
He did not expect that the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill was actually absorbing external Primordial Qi.
Didn’t it say that some inner powers are formed by self-cultivation and refining essence?
Ding Ling was thoughtful.
He felt that to know more, perhaps he needed to obtain more Inner Power Skills.
But after the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill reached Full Level.
Ding Ling, as long as he calmed down and practiced well, could still quickly generate a kind of ’Returning to the Source Qi that unifies nine parts into one’!
This Returning to the Source Qi, although moderate.
But undeniably, in terms of harmony and health preservation ability, it’s extraordinary.
But Ding Ling couldn’t possibly spend time meditating and cultivating inner power.
With this effort, it would be more effective to look at several Inner Power Heart Methods and instantly achieve full level.
Just look at Yu Renyan and Yu Canghai.
How many years have they been cultivating the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill?!
If Ding Ling learned like them, he would be using the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheats as a mere ornament.
He’s not that foolish!
"Continue the practice."
Ding Ling looked at Yu Renyan.
Yu Renyan’s body trembled, looking at Ding Ling with strange eyes, he mechanically, dully recited the mantra of ’Pine Wind Swordsmanship’.
After reciting it.
Ding Ling stepped to the side, picked up Yu Renyan’s sword, tossed it back to him, and signaled him to practice the sword moves of Pine Wind Swordsmanship.
Yu Renyan began to practice tremblingly.
The first time.
Due to fear and intense pain, he practiced inadequately and was asked to redo it again.
He practiced a full three times.
Only then did a book gather in Ding Ling’s library.
In an instant.
[Pine Wind Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
The various essences and esoteric truths of the Pine Wind Swordsmanship surged in his mind.
Within an instant, it became an instinct engraved into every part of Ding Ling’s body and viscera.
Ding Ling quickly sensed that he fully understood and mastered this Pine Wind Swordsmanship.
"A very excellent sword technique.
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
According to Yu Renyan.
This Pine Wind Swordsmanship is the Sect’s Swordsmanship of the Qingcheng Sect.
Cultivating it to mastery, or a perfect state, is extremely difficult.
In the entire Qingcheng Sect, only Yu Canghai reached this stage.
It’s truly because this sword technique is genuinely a high-tier, peak-level sword technique!
Stronger than many sword techniques in the Three Kingdoms World.
In no way inferior to Qing Frost Swordsmanship or Calm Wind Swordsmanship, these top-notch sword skills.
In certain aspects, it’s even superior.
Ding Ling made a sword with his fingers, practiced slightly, and sure enough, once the Pine Wind Swordsmanship was used, there seemed to be a vigorous force surging back and forth in the void!
This force, seeming to contain the strength of the pine, the speed of the wind!
Extremely extraordinary!
Swoosh!
The stimulated void even seemed to emit strange sounds!
Yu Renyan was completely dumbfounded.
Just by reciting the mantra once and practicing the sword technique three times, Ding Ling actually practiced and mastered their Qingcheng Sect’s Sect’s Swordsmanship to the Perfection Stage!
Is this really a human?!
Thinking that he brought such a terrifyingly talented person to the sect, Yu Renyan’s body couldn’t help but tremble.
At the same time.
The killing intent towards Ding Ling in his heart grew more fervent.
Because he knew that Ding Ling was still young, his martial arts hadn’t reached Great Success, and if not eliminated now, it would be impossible once Ding Ling became even stronger in a few years!
"Is there more?"
Ding Ling looked at Yu Renyan.
Yu Renyan was a bit bewildered and, under Ding Ling’s penetrating gaze, shook his head fearfully:
"My father has another skill, Heart Shattering Palm.
But he didn’t teach it to me.
He said not to bite off more than you can chew.
Once I’ve cultivated Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill and Pine Wind Swordsmanship to a certain stage, he’d teach me Heart Shattering Palm."
Ding Ling sighed.
Hearing this, Yu Renyan seemed to understand something and began screaming in fear:
"You promised me, you wouldn’t kill me!"
Feeling that wasn’t convincing enough, he started repeating something over and over: "You can’t kill me, my father is Yu Canghai!
My father is Yu Canghai!"
Whoosh!
Ding Ling directly picked up a sword from the ground, held it tightly in his hand, and executed Pine Wind Swordsmanship.
The sword instantly transformed, like a tenacious pine and a swift wind, thrusting forward, like wind and lightning, yet extremely fierce!
One thrust.
Thud!
A crisp sound.
Yu Renyan’s forehead was pierced through.
He looked at Ding Ling with disbelief, his eyes filled with resentment, hatred, reluctance, fear, and a longing for life.
Ding Ling no longer looked at him, instead pulling out the Heaven-Swaying Sword, sheathing it, turning around, and walking to the Ferghana Horse.
He rummaged through the bag, pulling out a piece of gold.
With no small change.
Ding Ling placed it directly on the table.

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Second Senior Brother Laudeno (2/15)
paragraphs: Then, he turned and leaped onto the horseback.
A clear shout of ’Go!’.
Amid the neighing of the horse.
The Ferghana Horse carrying Ding Ling charged out of the area where the shop was located, rushing towards Fuzhou City.
The speed of the Ferghana Horse was swift.
As they gradually moved farther away, until they completely disappeared from view.
Only then did Yue Lingshan, Lin Pingzhi, and the others dare to relax, looking at each other speechlessly.
Lin Pingzhi, who had wanted to question Yue Lingshan.

At this moment, also felt lingering fear, seeing the miserable state of Yu Renyan and others, he broke out in a cold sweat, and now only wanted to hurry back to find his parents, leaving no mind to talk to Yue Lingshan.
He immediately ran hastily to his mount, mounted it, and rode away.
Several darts masters paid the bill.
And left as well.
Only Yue Lingshan and the old man were left in place.
"Second Senior Brother."
Yue Lingshan’s voice was still crisp and pleasant, but at this moment, her voice was somewhat trembling, evidently showing her nervousness and shock:
"Did you recognize what kind of Martial Arts that person was using just now?"
"First time seeing it."
The old man, Second Senior Brother, was actually Laudeno. Seeing everyone had left, he straightened his back, no longer hunching, stroked his beard and said:

"That person is truly terrifying. Noble, domineering, and sacred in aura! Like an emperor, similar to a Dragon Child. In the Jianghu where there are many heroes, a figure with such a disposition, if I had seen once, I would never forget. Because it’s too unique, like a light in the darkness, so glaring!"
Yue Lingshan nodded in agreement:
"My parents have managed the Huashan Sect for many years, a sect of prestige, yet they do not carry such noble and domineering energy!"
"The most important thing is still his Sword Technique and the two swords in his hands."
Laudeno’s eyes twinkled with sharp light:
"Don’t know if you saw clearly. Among those two swords, one was surprisingly the Giant Que Sword, one of the ancient legendary swords!"
"Giant Que Sword?!"
Yue Lingshan widened her eyes.
"Exactly."
Laudeno nodded:
"The Giant Que Sword has been lost for many years. I never expected to see it again, in the hands of such a mysterious person."
"What about the other sword?"
"The Heaven-Swaying Sword."
Laudeno pondered:
"Cao Mengde of the Three Kingdoms period had two swords: the Heaven-Swaying Sword and the Cyan Gang Sword. Perhaps this sword is indeed Cao Mengde’s sword, who knows."
"How is that possible?"
Yue Lingshan doubted:
"What era is it now? It’s been so long ago."
"Hehe.
Laudeno chuckled wryly:

"It might also be the Mountain Guardian Treasure Sword of Emei from the late previous dynasty. It’s hard to clearly say its origins. But it’s certain that a person owning these two swords is definitely someone important. It’s merely unclear if he’s from the court or from another country; otherwise, there’s no way the Central Plains Jiuzhou, over so many years, wouldn’t have any record of such a person!"
Yue Lingshan nodded, walked to the table, picked up the small piece of gold Ding Ling left behind:
"At least he isn’t a bad person. He knows how to respect me and even knows to pay!"
Thinking about how her homemade dishes weren’t tasty.
Ding Ling still ate them heartily.
Yue Lingshan blushed, her almond eyes gleaming, involuntarily glancing towards the direction Ding Ling went, her thoughts unclear.
"By the way, should we report this to my father?"
Yue Lingshan suddenly thought of something and said.
"Hmm."
Laudeno absent-mindedly nodded, casually uttering a few words.
At this time.
A divine being like Ding Ling arrived in Fuzhou.
Instinctively.
Laudeno felt Ding Ling came for the Exorcism Sword Manual.
Ding Ling indeed was aiming for the Exorcism Swordsmanship.
Regardless of whether to learn it.
At least he thought seeing it wouldn’t kill him.
Besides.
After automatically maxing out the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Ding Ling also understood.
Just starting to learn this Exorcism Swordsmanship to break through the closed meridians shouldn’t be a problem.
Afterwards, whether to continue?
Ding Ling thought that as a normal man, he wouldn’t consider self-castration.
As for those who would dare to castrate themselves.
Ding Ling could only express admiration!
It’s a feat beyond an ordinary person’s capability!
Ding Ling considered himself already decisive and ruthless, but the mere thought of self-castration was frightening from the heart, let alone actually doing it.
"Moreover, learning High Tier Martial Arts in this world indeed increases Attribute Points."
"Just not sure up to how many points?"
When able to cultivate the Medicine King Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling had guessed such a thing would happen.
And sure enough, Pine Wind Swordsmanship confirmed it.
"This world is truly of a higher level. The limit it can bear is also stronger. Just not sure where the upper limit is."
Ding Ling even pondered whether to make a trip to that historical world he alone could go to, to gather the High Tier Martial Arts there.
Then return to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer to level up and practice?
But he thought the game probably wouldn’t have such a loophole.
Going to the historical world.
He might instantly reach the Celestial Human Realm, rivaling the Land God.
How would he improve then?
The most crucial thing is, the items allowed for carrying upon Ascension are limited.
Bringing a Secret Manual upon ascension, only not to be allowed to carry it, what then?
Wouldn’t that be all for naught?
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling felt relieved, no longer dwelling on it.
But prepared to head to Fuzhou, Xiangyang Lane to the Lin Family’s old mansion, to first obtain that Exorcism Sword Manual.
"Now this world has only me as a player. If some time later another player ascends here, I might not even have the chance to take it!"
Ding Ling was very decisive.
Upon entering Fuzhou City.
He expended one or two pieces of gold.
Hiring a local old man.
To guide him to Xiangyang Lane.
Upon reaching Xiangyang Lane.
The old man proactively inquired, and finally found the Lin Family’s old mansion.
A mansion that looked rather opulent.
Although a bit old.
But it was clear, the prosperity here in the past.
Ding Ling thanked the old man.
The old man quietly left, not asking why Ding Ling came here.
To this.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but marvel again at the power of ’money.’
Money makes the world go round.
It’s evident.
He glanced at the old mansion, thought for a moment, and decided to be a ’thief’.

Then rode to an inn, entrusted the boss to take care of the Ferghana Horse, then returned to his room, waited until nightfall, then operated the Flying Swallow Technique, directly leaping out of the inn through the window.
Don’t know if it’s because he cleared the meridians, or because the Pine Wind Swordsmanship full level added agility.

Now the Four Great Breathing Techniques collectively amplified the Flying Swallow Technique, allowing Ding Ling to glide like a swallow, in leaps and bounds, like the wind and lightning, extremely fast.
Stronger than when he returned to reality sometime before.
Evidently he has truly become stronger.
Despite not having Celestial Might or Celestial Favor, without that terrifying god-like or demon-like state, he was still extremely strong now.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Exorcism Sword Manual Inner Power Heart Method Full Level (3/15)
paragraphs: Moreover, now he is the most authentic version of himself.
Dispelling the Celestial Might.
That’s true strength!
To indulge in false prosperity is wrong, as it’s merely external power, not true strength that one possesses.
Ding Ling sees this very clearly.
He no longer dwells on it.

Instead, he races to the old Lin family residence, looking around, with no one in sight, he operates the Ascending Skill, easily leaps, soaring several meters high, activating the Five Animals Qigong, spinning in mid-air like a bird, landing lightly like a tiger.
The entire process is silent.
Not a speck of dust is stirred.
Once Ding Ling enters the courtyard.
Avoiding an old man guarding the door.
He searches and seeks.

Finding a Buddhist temple, he cautiously pushes the door, the sound of ’creeaak’ rings out, Ding Ling’s brow twitches, looking towards the old man, seeing that he hasn’t noticed, realizing the old man must be too old, his hearing dull.
He breathes a sigh of relief.
Now the Lin family is at its peak, not yet begun to decline.
It’s understandable that someone would guard the old residence.
When Yu Canghai starts his killing spree, this old residence will become completely desolate, the people will leave and the tea will cool, just as expected.
Once inside the temple.
He opens the window.
By moonlight.
Glances around.
The old items placed neatly everywhere.
Wooden fish, meditation mats, etc., all arranged neatly, indicating that someone here still takes care of them.
Though some places have dust.
They are within acceptable limits.
Ding Ling’s eyes are like lightning, quickly locking onto a portrait of Dharma.
Seeing Dharma with one hand behind his back and one index finger pointing to the sky.
He smiles slightly.
Following the direction of the index finger.
There is a beam.
Being nighttime.
Everything is quite hazy.
Ding Ling, though highly skilled and with sharp eyes and ears, can’t see as clearly as in daylight.
He operates his Ascending Skill, pushes off the ground, and springs upward, grabbing the beam with one hand, while the other hand reaches up to explore.
Before long.
He indeed feels fine cloth.
His heart rejoices, he pulls gently and with the crisp sound of ’crackle’, a few tiles fall along with the cloth.
Ding Ling descends in mid-air, seizing the cloth bundle, spinning and landing lightly.
Crash!
The tiles subsequently smash onto the ground, producing a crashing sound.
Ding Ling is startled, hastily glancing toward the old man.
Seeing that he still hasn’t noticed, he breathes a sigh of relief.
He approaches the window.
By moonlight.
Spreads the cloth bundle in his hand.
The cloth bundle is a kasaya made of fine silk, somewhat aged but the text on it remains intact.
[To practice Divine Skill, wield the knife to self-castrate!]
The first line.
Makes Ding Ling’s expression involuntarily tighten.
Carefully reading two lines, confirming it’s genuine.
Ding Ling places the kasaya in his bosom, then swiftly shuts the window and door.
Using the Flying Swallow Technique, he departs gracefully.
This feeling of being a thief was too exhilarating.
In the future, unless necessary.
Such actions should be done less.
Ding Ling acquired the Lin family’s Exorcism Sword Manual, along with his recent thieving behavior, he couldn’t help but feel a slight shame.
Taking without asking.
Is theft!
Ding Ling deeply understands this.
If what he steals is from bad people, he can righteously state that he’s enacting justice, and thus feel at ease, continuing his deeds.
But stealing from good people leaves him slightly remorseful.
Lin Pingzhi’s family.
Regardless of Lin Zhennan and his wife.
Lin Pingzhi stands up for justice, showing a kind heart, he is a good person!
Ding Ling, with Full Level Observing People Skill, Full Level Psychology, Full Level Acting, can naturally discern if Lin Pingzhi’s previous actions were sincere or fake.
Clearly, Lin Pingzhi is a kind-hearted passionate young man.
"If necessary, save them a bit."
Ding Ling mused:
"After all, I’ve completely turned against the Qingcheng Sect! Besides, the matter of me killing Yu Renyan surely can’t remain covered up, it will inevitably come to light."
So many people saw it at the scene.
Can Ding Ling hope for them to keep it a secret?
Impossible!
Of course.
What’s most crucial and important is that Ding Ling is not afraid of the Qingcheng Sect.
If scared, he wouldn’t have interrogated Yu Renyan about the Qingcheng Sect’s Martial Arts Secret Technique.
If encountered.
He actually wants to experience Yu Canghai’s high skills.
Ding Ling thought this.
Unknowingly, he reached the side of the inn.
He scanned around, once more springing up, directly leaping meters high, returning to the room.
Closing the windows and door.
Lighting the oil lamp.
Ding Ling spreads open the kasaya.
Begins to meticulously examine.
He reads it once.
Briefly closes his eyes to recall.
The bookshelf in the library instantly condenses into a book.
[Exorcism Sword Manual Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In an instant!
Boom!
In the heavens and earth, it seems a muffled thunder passes, followed by a scorching and intense Primordial Qi rushing towards Ding Ling’s limbs and veins.
In but a moment, it engulfs Ding Ling.
Ding Ling as if placed in a furnace, experiences an unspeakable feeling of heat and impulse!
"This kind of Primordial Qi..."
Ding Ling is astounded.
This Primordial Qi is Supreme Yang, Firm and Strong, akin to the sun in mid-sky, the earth’s fiery poison!
Ding Ling’s current physical condition can be said to be extremely strong, even so, he feels like he’s about to collapse at any moment.
But soon.
As this Primordial Qi’s inner strength transforms into a fierce dragon charging at the blocked meridians.
Rumble!
This time, three meridians are opened.
Much more swiftly than the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!
"Even though both add +100 Inner Power Value, the inner power heart method of the Exorcism Sword Manual is more tyrannical and fierce."
"It’s like both are men of eight feet, one is timid, the other dares to risk his life. Naturally, the effect is drastically different."
Ding Ling silently breathes a sigh.
"Luckily my physical condition is strong enough. For an ordinary person, this surging Supreme Yang, Firm and Strong Qi would definitely lead to instant death!"
It’s like someone who can’t take supplements.
More like someone who can’t take strength.
If weak, and then carrying a hundred, or even a thousand pounds upstairs, the outcome is likely death.
That’s the feeling the Exorcism Sword Manual’s internal power heart method gave Ding Ling.
"No wonder people in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World have to self-castrate to practice the Exorcism Sword Manual."
Ding Ling finally understood the great secret within.
He thought it was mysterious.
Turns out it’s this matter.

"But I’m different. In the Three Kingdoms World, I laid a solid foundation. Whether it’s the External Refining Breathing Technique or Inner Refining Breathing Technique, they’re all body refining techniques! My physical condition is so high, the Inner Power experts of this world are hard to match!"
Ding Ling felt this insight growing deeper.
Because he has battled against Yu Renyan and others.
Realizing that Yu Renyan’s physical condition is far inferior to the third-rate and second-rate fierce generals of the Three Kingdoms World! Let alone first-rate fierce generals!
If not for their unique Inner Power Heart Method and excellent sword techniques.
Perhaps they would be far inferior to the war generals of the Three Kingdoms World!

sentences.text: Moreover, now he is the most authentic version of himself.
Dispelling the Celestial Might.
That’s true strength!
To indulge in false prosperity is wrong, as it’s merely external power, not true strength that one possesses.
Ding Ling sees this very clearly.
He no longer dwells on it.

Instead, he races to the old Lin family residence, looking around, with no one in sight, he operates the Ascending Skill, easily leaps, soaring several meters high, activating the Five Animals Qigong, spinning in mid-air like a bird, landing lightly like a tiger.
The entire process is silent.
Not a speck of dust is stirred.
Once Ding Ling enters the courtyard.
Avoiding an old man guarding the door.
He searches and seeks.

Finding a Buddhist temple, he cautiously pushes the door, the sound of ’creeaak’ rings out, Ding Ling’s brow twitches, looking towards the old man, seeing that he hasn’t noticed, realizing the old man must be too old, his hearing dull.
He breathes a sigh of relief.
Now the Lin family is at its peak, not yet begun to decline.
It’s understandable that someone would guard the old residence.
When Yu Canghai starts his killing spree, this old residence will become completely desolate, the people will leave and the tea will cool, just as expected.
Once inside the temple.
He opens the window.
By moonlight.
Glances around.
The old items placed neatly everywhere.
Wooden fish, meditation mats, etc., all arranged neatly, indicating that someone here still takes care of them.
Though some places have dust.
They are within acceptable limits.
Ding Ling’s eyes are like lightning, quickly locking onto a portrait of Dharma.
Seeing Dharma with one hand behind his back and one index finger pointing to the sky.
He smiles slightly.
Following the direction of the index finger.
There is a beam.
Being nighttime.
Everything is quite hazy.
Ding Ling, though highly skilled and with sharp eyes and ears, can’t see as clearly as in daylight.
He operates his Ascending Skill, pushes off the ground, and springs upward, grabbing the beam with one hand, while the other hand reaches up to explore.
Before long.
He indeed feels fine cloth.
His heart rejoices, he pulls gently and with the crisp sound of ’crackle’, a few tiles fall along with the cloth.
Ding Ling descends in mid-air, seizing the cloth bundle, spinning and landing lightly.
Crash!
The tiles subsequently smash onto the ground, producing a crashing sound.
Ding Ling is startled, hastily glancing toward the old man.
Seeing that he still hasn’t noticed, he breathes a sigh of relief.
He approaches the window.
By moonlight.
Spreads the cloth bundle in his hand.
The cloth bundle is a kasaya made of fine silk, somewhat aged but the text on it remains intact.
[To practice Divine Skill, wield the knife to self-castrate!]
The first line.
Makes Ding Ling’s expression involuntarily tighten.
Carefully reading two lines, confirming it’s genuine.
Ding Ling places the kasaya in his bosom, then swiftly shuts the window and door.
Using the Flying Swallow Technique, he departs gracefully.
This feeling of being a thief was too exhilarating.
In the future, unless necessary.
Such actions should be done less.
Ding Ling acquired the Lin family’s Exorcism Sword Manual, along with his recent thieving behavior, he couldn’t help but feel a slight shame.
Taking without asking.
Is theft!
Ding Ling deeply understands this.
If what he steals is from bad people, he can righteously state that he’s enacting justice, and thus feel at ease, continuing his deeds.
But stealing from good people leaves him slightly remorseful.
Lin Pingzhi’s family.
Regardless of Lin Zhennan and his wife.
Lin Pingzhi stands up for justice, showing a kind heart, he is a good person!
Ding Ling, with Full Level Observing People Skill, Full Level Psychology, Full Level Acting, can naturally discern if Lin Pingzhi’s previous actions were sincere or fake.
Clearly, Lin Pingzhi is a kind-hearted passionate young man.
"If necessary, save them a bit."
Ding Ling mused:
"After all, I’ve completely turned against the Qingcheng Sect!
Besides, the matter of me killing Yu Renyan surely can’t remain covered up, it will inevitably come to light."
So many people saw it at the scene.
Can Ding Ling hope for them to keep it a secret?
Impossible!
Of course.
What’s most crucial and important is that Ding Ling is not afraid of the Qingcheng Sect.
If scared, he wouldn’t have interrogated Yu Renyan about the Qingcheng Sect’s Martial Arts Secret Technique.
If encountered.
He actually wants to experience Yu Canghai’s high skills.
Ding Ling thought this.
Unknowingly, he reached the side of the inn.
He scanned around, once more springing up, directly leaping meters high, returning to the room.
Closing the windows and door.
Lighting the oil lamp.
Ding Ling spreads open the kasaya.
Begins to meticulously examine.
He reads it once.
Briefly closes his eyes to recall.
The bookshelf in the library instantly condenses into a book.
[Exorcism Sword Manual Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In an instant!
Boom!
In the heavens and earth, it seems a muffled thunder passes, followed by a scorching and intense Primordial Qi rushing towards Ding Ling’s limbs and veins.
In but a moment, it engulfs Ding Ling.
Ding Ling as if placed in a furnace, experiences an unspeakable feeling of heat and impulse!
"This kind of Primordial Qi..."
Ding Ling is astounded.
This Primordial Qi is Supreme Yang, Firm and Strong, akin to the sun in mid-sky, the earth’s fiery poison!
Ding Ling’s current physical condition can be said to be extremely strong, even so, he feels like he’s about to collapse at any moment.
But soon.
As this Primordial Qi’s inner strength transforms into a fierce dragon charging at the blocked meridians.
Rumble!
This time, three meridians are opened.
Much more swiftly than the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill!
"Even though both add +100 Inner Power Value, the inner power heart method of the Exorcism Sword Manual is more tyrannical and fierce."
"It’s like both are men of eight feet, one is timid, the other dares to risk his life.
Naturally, the effect is drastically different."
Ding Ling silently breathes a sigh.
"Luckily my physical condition is strong enough.
For an ordinary person, this surging Supreme Yang, Firm and Strong Qi would definitely lead to instant death!"
It’s like someone who can’t take supplements.
More like someone who can’t take strength.
If weak, and then carrying a hundred, or even a thousand pounds upstairs, the outcome is likely death.
That’s the feeling the Exorcism Sword Manual’s internal power heart method gave Ding Ling.
"No wonder people in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World have to self-castrate to practice the Exorcism Sword Manual."
Ding Ling finally understood the great secret within.
He thought it was mysterious.
Turns out it’s this matter.
"But I’m different.
In the Three Kingdoms World, I laid a solid foundation.
Whether it’s the External Refining Breathing Technique or Inner Refining Breathing Technique, they’re all body refining techniques!
My physical condition is so high, the Inner Power experts of this world are hard to match!"
Ding Ling felt this insight growing deeper.
Because he has battled against Yu Renyan and others.
Realizing that Yu Renyan’s physical condition is far inferior to the third-rate and second-rate fierce generals of the Three Kingdoms World!
Let alone first-rate fierce generals!
If not for their unique Inner Power Heart Method and excellent sword techniques.
Perhaps they would be far inferior to the war generals of the Three Kingdoms World!

chapters.title: Chapter 282: New Players Can Choose the Martial Hero Plane
paragraphs: "It is precisely because my body’s constitution is strong enough. That’s why I can withstand the erosion and coverage of this Supreme Yang and Firm inner strength."
Ding Ling thought to himself with luck.

"But even though my physical condition is extremely high now, I still feel I can’t bear this Supreme Yang and Firm inner strength. It seems I should not practice this Exorcism Sword Manual in the future."

Ding Ling thought about the 100 Inner Power Value that increased from the full level of the Exorcism Sword Manual Internal Power Heart Method, which was all used to open up meridians, and he couldn’t help but feel more fortunate.
His previous guess was correct.
After the full level of inner strength, the Inner Power Value will first be used to open up meridians.
If it weren’t so.
Even if he blocked the backlash of the Exorcism Sword Manual Internal Power Heart Method this time, it would probably lead to endless troubles.
"As expected, it’s indeed the first evil martial art of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World. No, perhaps the Sunflower Manual is the most evil?"
Ding Ling thought that the Exorcism Sword Manual was only a fragment of the Sunflower Manual.
Couldn’t help but feel a stir in his heart.
The Exorcism Sword Manual is already so remarkable.
The Supreme Yang and Firm Inner Strength far surpasses the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, wouldn’t the Sunflower Manual be defying the heavens?
Ding Ling silently warned himself:
"Without absolute certainty, I absolutely must not fight with top masters like Dongfang Bubai! To avoid capsizing in a ditch, that would be the end."
The higher Ding Ling’s cultivation.
The more he feels he cannot die.
After death.
Not to mention losing levels, losing items, etc.
The possibility of losing soul and other energies is something he cannot accept!
"Therefore, stability is the main thing."

Ding Ling feels that with the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level, if he can win, he will push horizontally; if he can’t, he will run away. After finding enough Divine Skills to become stronger, he will come out to push horizontally again!
What could be more stable than this?
In reality, to better survive quietly.
He has started to use the Eight Array Map.
Just a little regretful.
The Eight Array Map cannot unleash overwhelming power in the real world like the Three Kingdoms World.
This is understandable.

It’s like Ding Ling being an Earth Immortal in the Three Kingdoms World, because he is an Earth Immortal, so after learning the Eight Array Map, he can naturally leverage Celestial Might, borrow the power of the heavens to activate the Eight Array Map, making it possess ghostly powers.
But in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and the real world.
Without the support of the heavens in the Three Kingdoms World.
The Eight Array Map becomes quite ordinary.
Although it still has the effect of blocking and confusing enemies, it’s not so magical and terrifying. It has no killing power either.
Although Ding Ling feels a bit regretful, he is quite open about it.
After all, it’s an external force.
When he really reaches the Land Immortal Realm, the Eight Array Map can naturally be fully activated by him at will.
"While I have time today, let’s return to reality for a moment."
Would also need to enhance strength in the real world.
Along with eating, etc.
After achieving full level in the "Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship," Ding Ling logged off in the inn room and returned to reality.
After arriving at the Player Plaza.
The first thing he did was choose to use the Achievement Medal to exchange for strength.
Then he paid no attention to the strange gazes and screams of other players, directly returning to reality.
"Was that just Ding Ling?"
"It was indeed him!"
"Didn’t expect to see him so late. Heard he transcended and ascended?! Really envy him, don’t know when we can reach that step."
The players were all talking excitedly.
Ding Ling can now be said to be the number one player in the mythical game, an absolute pillar bearer! An unparalleled superstar!
The number of loyal fans he has far surpasses other players!
The screams heard earlier were from Ding Ling’s loyal fans.
No doubt.
Ding Ling now has the ability and charm to attract fans!
His ability is undisputed!
His charm is far superior to ordinary people, with his multiple transformations in appearance, the current Ding Ling is becoming more handsome, trending towards the perfect man.
Anyone familiar who sees him.
Can still recognize him.
Just because although Ding Ling has changed greatly, the outline of his features remains.
The former beautiful landlady Ouyang Lingling has sighed, regretted, and lamented more than once.
Missed out on a potential stock like Ding Ling!
It can be said to be a great loss and regret!
Such an opportunity will never come again.
hours after Ding Ling ascended to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
A change suddenly occurred in the Player Plaza.
Many players received notifications.

[In light of player Ding Ling having completed the Path of Glory, the Celestial Ladder has successfully connected the three major Martial Hero Planes: The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Other players may also freely choose whether to enter these three major Martial Hero Planes.]
Seeing this.
Many players became excited.
Compared to the Historical Plane World, where they can only practice Pile Skill every day!
Players are obviously more eager for the high-flying inner power and lightweight skills of the Martial World.
As for Ding Ling also knowing lightweight skills in the Three Kingdoms World!
Many players can only say, Ding Ling is an exception, he’s one of a kind, comparing with him?
They might as well go die.
If they want to compare, they should compare with other players around them!
Amidst their excitement and joy, they also secretly felt grateful to Ding Ling for being so strong, providing direct benefits to everyone!
If Ding Ling hadn’t broken the world barrier, opening the Celestial Ladder to the Martial Hero Plane, how long would they have had to wait to experience inner power?
They were about to choose to immediately go to the Martial Hero Plane.
Unexpectedly, they quickly saw a newly appeared prompt.

[Friendly reminder: Once you choose to enter the Martial Hero Plane. You will most likely start from scratch. All cultivation and abilities from the Three Kingdoms World will be converted into energy values for opening the Gate of Glory. If your cultivation is high enough, you may retain some, but those with low cultivation will absolutely retain nothing.]
The players were stunned seeing this.
The initial excitement vanished, replaced by confusion.
"What kind of door is the Gate of Glory?"
"To enter the Martial Hero Plane and still have to start from scratch. Did I practice for years in vain? I painstakingly trained to a third-class general!"
"Yeah. Which heroic soul dares to test the waters and give us a reference."
No one is willing to take the initiative to be the first to try.
It’s just that they have painstakingly cultivated so far, having endured so much hardship, none of them willingly wants to give it up.
However, they understood about the energy value aspect.
Everything is an exchange of energies.
Without enough cultivation, naturally, they cannot ascend the Celestial Ladder.
Trying to forcefully ascend the Celestial Ladder to enter the Martial Hero Plane will have losses, which is quite normal.
The players discussed this, and eventually, some rich individuals and big families stepped forward, bribing a few greedy people to scout the way with heavy rewards.
As for the players who just bought helmets to enter the mythical game, they were very excited.
Because they are newcomers.
So, they have altogether six choices.
Besides the Historical Plane World.
They can also choose to go to the Martial Hero Plane.
Many players immediately chose to go to the Martial Hero Plane.
All of a sudden.
The worlds of The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer...
