chapters.title: Chapter 283: Players Descend Into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (5/15)
paragraphs: Countless new players flooded into these three Martial Hero Plane Worlds.
There were also a few old players mingling among them.
They were sent here to scout the way.
Regarding this.
Ding Ling was naturally unaware.
But he knew one thing.
That is, the game could not provide him too big a loophole.
Being able to seize time difference and obtain the Exorcism Sword Manual ahead of time, he was already quite satisfied.
He was worried that other players would suddenly descend into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and throw this Jianghu into chaos!
This is why, after ascension, he immediately sought out this Exorcism Sword Manual.
To prevent it from being taken by other players.
It seems now.
He did the right thing.
Because the next afternoon.
After spending some gold and sending his letter to Lin Family’s ’Lin Zhennan’,
he packed up his things, ready to leave Fuzhou City, when unexpectedly he saw some people in the city whose attire and speech were distinctly different from other natives.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, this group even shouted:
"Whoa, look, it’s Ding Ling!"
"My God. It’s really him. Didn’t expect he’d come to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World. Wait a minute, he came to this Fuzhou City?! Could it be the Exorcism Sword Manual was taken by him?!"
Their voices were bluntly uncovered.
Ding Ling, with keen hearing and eyesight, naturally understood everything clearly.
The corners of his eyes twitched.
After this group of players completely mismatched with The Smiling, Proud Wanderer appeared,
Ding Ling foresaw that this Jianghu might turn chaotic.
"They appeared even earlier than I thought."
Ding Ling rode on horseback, pondering:
"I originally thought they would appear in large numbers a few days later. Now it seems the game had already patched such loopholes."
However, when Ding Ling thought that the Breathing Technique from the Three Kingdoms World was not much inferior to Inner Power, he couldn’t help but ponder:
"I wonder what cost the players in the Historical Plane World paid to ascend here?"
Last time he returned.
Came and went in a hurry.
Upon confirming that cultivating high tier Inner Power in reality was extremely difficult,
he decisively returned to the game world!

So-called high tier Inner Power, in Ding Ling’s view, is akin to Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, Exorcism Sword Manual that can draw the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi for one’s use as Inner Power Heart Method!
Yet in reality, the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi is exceedingly thin!
Even cultivating the Breathing Technique is incredibly difficult.
Let alone cultivating such high tier Inner Power!
It can only be said.
Reality has entered the so-called ’Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi Exhaustion Period’! Can only nurture small fish and shrimps, anything slightly larger can’t be satisfied with the supply needed.
And at this moment.
The Achievement Medal is needed to be used.
The Achievement Medal to exchange game strength can perfectly strengthen the self in reality.
Ding Ling speculates that the Achievement Medal might be a treasure that contains endless Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi.
What the specific facts are.
It is currently unknown because Ding Ling hasn’t qualified to know such a great secret!
’It seems next time I return to reality, I need a thorough investigation.’
Know yourself and your enemy, hundred battles without peril.
Players don’t need excessive guarding.
But still must be guarded.
Because there are indeed quite a few players jealous of Ding Ling, wishing him dead.
Ding Ling is a top hacker, often traversing various forums, boards, etc., knowing this door well.
Therefore.
He always tries to avoid prolonged contact with players.
Compared to players.
Ding Ling trusts Zhao Zilong, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao more!

"There’s no need to stay in Fuzhou City. I must seize the window period while players aren’t yet capable of going to Huashan Reflection Cliff, to quickly go to Huashan, and learn all those exquisite Sword Skills."
Pine Wind Swordsmanship is not weaker than Calm Wind Swordsmanship and others.
Imagining the Sword Skills of the Five Mountains Sword Sect that is famous throughout Jiuzhou, they’ll be remarkably strong.
Most importantly...
"Huashan has Feng Qingyang."
Ding Ling is eyeing the legendary Dugu Nine Swords.
"If Dugu Nine Swords is truly that unfathomable, then I must learn it!"
Ding Ling made up his mind.
Wanting to become the World’s Number One.
How can he not learn such supreme Sword Technique as Dugu Nine Swords?
Clop clop!
Ding Ling rode along.
Due to a multitude of travelers on the long street.
Ding Ling’s progress was slow.
He occasionally encountered groups of players, around eighteen years old, brimming with excitement and curiosity.
Ding Ling didn’t need to listen deliberately.
He could still overhear their ’grand talks.’

"My mom was afraid it would affect my studies, forbidding me from playing games, yet she herself played every day. It really frustrated me. After pleading and negotiating, she finally bought me a game helmet when I became an adult."

"Same with me. Said no games until adulthood. After I logged online for trial today, I finally realized why my parents are always immersed in this game, constantly shouting and training, talking about becoming Immortal and such."
"Hahaha, becoming Immortal. Really cracks me up."

"What’s there to joke about. Ding Ling from the Three Kingdoms World is strong enough to be comparable to Earth Immortals, which all players are well aware of. Hey, look, isn’t that Ding Ling?! Ah!!! It’s really Ding Ling, Ding Ling, idol, here, here, look here~~"
A少女 dressed in ancient attire hopped and waved at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gave an awkward smile and nodded at her, then promptly rode away.
He didn’t want to interact much with players.
Especially female players.
Knowing that he has many Queens in the Three Kingdoms World, if he interacts long with female players and develops feelings, he can imagine the jealousy would drown him.
Ding Ling is self-aware, never actively courting pretty and cute female players. Even if female players initiate, he tries to avoid deep contact.

Mainly because Ding Ling knows he’s not a heartless person, if feelings develop with someone fond of him, he’d be in a dilemma. After all, not interacting with Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao? That would truly put him in a hard spot.
Hence, he tries to prevent such things from happening.
Clop clop!
Ding Ling rode out of Fuzhou City.
Heading towards the Northern Lands.
For Lin Zhennan’s family, the letter was sent, highlighting Yu Canghai’s plots and ruthlessness, urging them to guard against, and collaborate with the authorities to escape calamity.
Aside from this.
Ding Ling specially sent a Sword Skill: Moon Shadow Swordsmanship!
This is a top-grade Supreme Skill from the Xiahou Clan of the Three Kingdoms World.
To ease the apology towards Lin Family.
He did everything he could.
What choice Lin Zhennan’s family makes, how the future unfolds?
Ding Ling can no longer predict, only because players have flooded into this world.

sentences.text: Countless new players flooded into these three Martial Hero Plane Worlds.
There were also a few old players mingling among them.
They were sent here to scout the way.
Regarding this.
Ding Ling was naturally unaware.
But he knew one thing.
That is, the game could not provide him too big a loophole.
Being able to seize time difference and obtain the Exorcism Sword Manual ahead of time, he was already quite satisfied.
He was worried that other players would suddenly descend into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and throw this Jianghu into chaos!
This is why, after ascension, he immediately sought out this Exorcism Sword Manual.
To prevent it from being taken by other players.
It seems now.
He did the right thing.
Because the next afternoon.
After spending some gold and sending his letter to Lin Family’s ’Lin Zhennan’,
he packed up his things, ready to leave Fuzhou City, when unexpectedly he saw some people in the city whose attire and speech were distinctly different from other natives.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, this group even shouted:
"Whoa, look, it’s Ding Ling!"
"My God.
It’s really him.
Didn’t expect he’d come to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
Wait a minute, he came to this Fuzhou City?!
Could it be the Exorcism Sword Manual was taken by him?!"
Their voices were bluntly uncovered.
Ding Ling, with keen hearing and eyesight, naturally understood everything clearly.
The corners of his eyes twitched.
After this group of players completely mismatched with The Smiling, Proud Wanderer appeared,
Ding Ling foresaw that this Jianghu might turn chaotic.
"They appeared even earlier than I thought."
Ding Ling rode on horseback, pondering:
"I originally thought they would appear in large numbers a few days later.
Now it seems the game had already patched such loopholes."
However, when Ding Ling thought that the Breathing Technique from the Three Kingdoms World was not much inferior to Inner Power, he couldn’t help but ponder:
"I wonder what cost the players in the Historical Plane World paid to ascend here?"
Last time he returned.
Came and went in a hurry.
Upon confirming that cultivating high tier Inner Power in reality was extremely difficult,
he decisively returned to the game world!

So-called high tier Inner Power, in Ding Ling’s view, is akin to Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, Exorcism Sword Manual that can draw the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi for one’s use as Inner Power Heart Method!
Yet in reality, the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi is exceedingly thin!
Even cultivating the Breathing Technique is incredibly difficult.
Let alone cultivating such high tier Inner Power!
It can only be said.
Reality has entered the so-called ’Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi Exhaustion Period’!
Can only nurture small fish and shrimps, anything slightly larger can’t be satisfied with the supply needed.
And at this moment.
The Achievement Medal is needed to be used.
The Achievement Medal to exchange game strength can perfectly strengthen the self in reality.
Ding Ling speculates that the Achievement Medal might be a treasure that contains endless Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi.
What the specific facts are.
It is currently unknown because Ding Ling hasn’t qualified to know such a great secret!
’It seems next time I return to reality, I need a thorough investigation.’
Know yourself and your enemy, hundred battles without peril.
Players don’t need excessive guarding.
But still must be guarded.
Because there are indeed quite a few players jealous of Ding Ling, wishing him dead.
Ding Ling is a top hacker, often traversing various forums, boards, etc., knowing this door well.
Therefore.
He always tries to avoid prolonged contact with players.
Compared to players.
Ding Ling trusts Zhao Zilong, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, Da and Xiao Qiao more!
"There’s no need to stay in Fuzhou City.
I must seize the window period while players aren’t yet capable of going to Huashan Reflection Cliff, to quickly go to Huashan, and learn all those exquisite Sword Skills."
Pine Wind Swordsmanship is not weaker than Calm Wind Swordsmanship and others.
Imagining the Sword Skills of the Five Mountains Sword Sect that is famous throughout Jiuzhou, they’ll be remarkably strong.
Most importantly...
"Huashan has Feng Qingyang."
Ding Ling is eyeing the legendary Dugu Nine Swords.
"If Dugu Nine Swords is truly that unfathomable, then I must learn it!"
Ding Ling made up his mind.
Wanting to become the World’s Number One.
How can he not learn such supreme Sword Technique as Dugu Nine Swords?
Clop clop!
Ding Ling rode along.
Due to a multitude of travelers on the long street.
Ding Ling’s progress was slow.
He occasionally encountered groups of players, around eighteen years old, brimming with excitement and curiosity.
Ding Ling didn’t need to listen deliberately.
He could still overhear their ’grand talks.’
"My mom was afraid it would affect my studies, forbidding me from playing games, yet she herself played every day.
It really frustrated me.
After pleading and negotiating, she finally bought me a game helmet when I became an adult."
"Same with me.
Said no games until adulthood.
After I logged online for trial today, I finally realized why my parents are always immersed in this game, constantly shouting and training, talking about becoming Immortal and such."
"Hahaha, becoming Immortal.
Really cracks me up."
"What’s there to joke about.
Ding Ling from the Three Kingdoms World is strong enough to be comparable to Earth Immortals, which all players are well aware of.
Hey, look, isn’t that Ding Ling?!
Ah!!!
It’s really Ding Ling, Ding Ling, idol, here, here, look here~~"
A少女 dressed in ancient attire hopped and waved at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gave an awkward smile and nodded at her, then promptly rode away.
He didn’t want to interact much with players.
Especially female players.
Knowing that he has many Queens in the Three Kingdoms World, if he interacts long with female players and develops feelings, he can imagine the jealousy would drown him.
Ding Ling is self-aware, never actively courting pretty and cute female players.
Even if female players initiate, he tries to avoid deep contact.
Mainly because Ding Ling knows he’s not a heartless person, if feelings develop with someone fond of him, he’d be in a dilemma.
After all, not interacting with Diao Chan, Da and Xiao Qiao?
That would truly put him in a hard spot.
Hence, he tries to prevent such things from happening.
Clop clop!
Ding Ling rode out of Fuzhou City.
Heading towards the Northern Lands.
For Lin Zhennan’s family, the letter was sent, highlighting Yu Canghai’s plots and ruthlessness, urging them to guard against, and collaborate with the authorities to escape calamity.
Aside from this.
Ding Ling specially sent a Sword Skill: Moon Shadow Swordsmanship!
This is a top-grade Supreme Skill from the Xiahou Clan of the Three Kingdoms World.
To ease the apology towards Lin Family.
He did everything he could.
What choice Lin Zhennan’s family makes, how the future unfolds?
Ding Ling can no longer predict, only because players have flooded into this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Cultivating Inner Strength (6/15)
paragraphs: With the influx of players, the Lin Zhennan family will definitely experience more ups and downs, but what exactly will they go through?
That remains unknown.
Ding Ling visited the Lin family today, initially thinking that if he encountered Yu Canghai’s group, he would step in to relieve his guilt.
But he did not wait for Yu Canghai.
Ding Ling can’t stay in Fuzhou forever.
For him.
Learning martial arts and becoming the world’s number one is the most important thing.
Seeing that he couldn’t wait for anyone.
Ding Ling naturally thought of other ways.
He couldn’t just rashly enter the Lin family and say to Lin Zhennan: "Disaster is looming over you!"
He would definitely be regarded as crazy.
Right now, the Lin family’s development is flourishing, like the rising sun, the bright pearl in the night! Extremely dazzling! Eminent!
Countless people admire and respect them.
Lin Zhennan and his wife are prominent figures in the locality, and ordinary people are disregarded by them.
If Ding Ling barged in and said something unpleasant, he would absolutely be swept out the door like a jinx.
Perhaps Lin Pingzhi would recognize him and out of fear and shock stop his father from throwing him out, but Ding Ling has no need to be an annoying person!
That’s just his character.
He does what he thinks needs to be done.
But he absolutely wouldn’t do something knowing it would annoy others and insist on doing it anyway.
He thinks Lin Pingzhi is currently a good person, and since he took the Exorcism Sword Manual from his house, he feels remorse.
With remorse.
He would take action.
He’s done what he should.
Now seeing players coming to Fuzhou, many players are discussing the disappearance of the ’Exorcism Sword Manual’.
Ding Ling knew.
If he didn’t take the Exorcism Sword Manual, other players would definitely take it.

Although there are players with conscience, who can guarantee that the one who takes the sword manual is definitely a conscientious player? When that happens, the Lin Pingzhi family will likely suffer even more.
Ding Ling didn’t worry about this matter further, and rode swiftly.
Because Huashan is to the northwest of Fuzhou.
So.
After leaving the city, Ding Ling traveled north for a while, then began heading northwest.
On this day.
He stopped in a small town to rest.
After returning to reality midway, and clarifying the players’ situation.
He felt quite amazed.
He pondered:
"It seems there’s no need to worry about too many accomplished cultivation players entering The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for now."
Accomplished cultivation players have learned it in the Historical Plane World.
They would never abandon their martial skills and join the Martial Hero Plane World.
After all, the Breathing Technique, to some extent, is not inferior to ordinary Inner Power, and is a powerful Body Refining Technique.
Some people might just be suited to practice this Breathing Technique.
If they switch to Inner Power and find it’s unsuitable, wouldn’t years of effort be in vain?
Who could be that carefree?
Of course.
Those with not very high cultivation, players who don’t fare well in the Historical Plane World, are highly likely to come to the Martial World.
"But these people will be cannon fodder when they come! No need to worry."
Compared to the already stable Great Wei Kingdom.
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World is treacherous, with constant killing, and players who rashly enter are highly likely to be killed.
After all, they are weak in the Historical Plane World, so why would they suddenly become experts in the Martial Hero Plane?
In the short term, Ding Ling doesn’t need to worry about what players might do.

"Because cultivating Inner Power is also calculated in years. Players’ aptitude won’t be much higher than the natives’. It’s imaginable that they would definitely experience a painful martial arts learning process similar to in the Historical Plane World."
"Rest here for a day, then continue the journey."
After resolving his confusion.
Ding Ling tried cultivating the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill in the bedroom of a small town inn.
Because his Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill is already at the Full Level.
And he’s opened a few Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
The speed of his cultivation could be described as progressing rapidly, with significant progress.
In the blink of an eye.

Surging Primordial Qi rushed into his body, flowing along the opened meridians, absorbed and refined by the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, ultimately transforming into extremely pure ’Qi’, stored in the Dantian.
Ding Ling knew.
This is Inner Strength.
His cultivation progress was extremely smooth.
Every time he cultivated a strand of Qi.
His body felt lighter by a fraction!
Feeling much stronger.
His heart filled with joy, he unwittingly immersed himself in the exhilarating process of continuously enhancing himself through Inner Power cultivation.
Thus, not knowing the passage of time.
When he came to.
He found his Inner Strength had achieved Minor Achievement.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
[Inner Power Value: 20]
Ding Ling pondered secretly:
"Is it because when I cultivated the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill to Full Level before, it increased my Inner Power Value by 100, so this time the cultivation is incredibly fast?"
He had a strong premonition.
When the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill reaches an Inner Power Value of 100, the cultivation speed would undoubtedly drop a hundredfold or more, with no chance of such astonishing efficiency.
As for the reason?

"It seems when reaching Full Level before, it broke through the meridians, and although most of the 100 Inner Power Value dissipated, a significant portion should have remained and lingered throughout the body’s meridians. Now when cultivating the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill again, these remaining Inner Power would naturally be absorbed, converted, and stored in the Dantian as Inner Strength."
Ding Ling pondering deeply:

"That must be it. Besides this, I can’t think of another possibility. I need to understand that my roots and talent are not high. Cultivating the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill this fast on personal aptitude? How could it be!"
Ding Ling had self-awareness.
It’s not due to personal talent.
Then it must be the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat causing it. Naturally associating it with the 100 Inner Power Value produced at Full Level!
Thinking about this.
Ding Ling was moved:
"Apparently, without operating the Inner Power Heart Method for the Exorcism Swordsmanship, I might be forced to castrate myself by one careless mistake!"
Thinking about it.
Ding Ling couldn’t help feeling a tingling scalp.
The Exorcism Swordsmanship, such a sinister sword technique.
Currently, with his physical condition wanting to master it freely is still somewhat difficult.
Perhaps after further progress, he can consider cultivating this supremely pure and powerful Cultivation Technique.
"Whew."
Ding Ling rose to his full height.

"I have to find ways to acquire more Cultivation Techniques because only this way can I quickly break through all the Eight Meridians. By then, all meridians open, absolutely not inferior to those true peerless talents! If I continue cultivating like this, further aided by the residual Inner Power in the meridians, the progress will definitely be rapid.
One day of cultivation may equal years of cultivation for others!"
Ding Ling slightly operated the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Just feeling a hot flow surging incessantly in his Dantian.
The hot flow followed the operation of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, continuously rushing toward the various major meridians that had been opened.
Ding Ling just felt warm all over, with a slightly tipsy feel, very comfortable and at ease.
At this moment.
He comprehended why so many geniuses and masters like to retreat and cultivate Inner Power.
Because this feeling is really so delightful.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Storage Pouch Successfully Opened (7/15)
paragraphs: "Is this what Inner Strength feels like? Indeed extraordinary!"
Ding Ling marveled silently.
From today on,
he was now someone with Inner Strength.
Crack, crack!
Suddenly, a strange sound came from the direction of his chest.
Ding Ling, puzzled, reached towards his chest and felt something, a Storage Bag.
He examined it carefully.
Ding Ling was astonished to find that the Storage Bag had miraculously opened.
Ding Ling couldn’t sense the size of the Storage Bag’s interior, but he could reach in to inspect and explore.
After a while,
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"The internal space of this Storage Bag is approximately 8 cubic meters. So spacious, it can hold a lot of things. But the strange thing is, how exactly did this Storage Bag open?!"
Ding Ling pondered, thought about it, and suddenly had a bright idea.
Unable to resist, he activated the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill and experimented again.
As expected.
This Storage Bag requires Inner Strength to activate, open, and close it.
To open it, one just needs to touch it with Inner Strength.
Closing it is the same.
Ding Ling was speechless.
He thought this Storage Bag was just like those described in novels, requiring something like Divine Sense to open it.
Now it seemed he had overthought it.
He was experiencing a highly realistic and likely real-world mythical Game World!
One cannot measure this world by the standards set in novels.
Because the two have a fundamental difference.
"But being able to open this Storage Bag conveniently will certainly be much more convenient."
Ding Ling was delighted.
He tentatively placed the Heaven-Swaying Sword into the Storage Bag, then closed it again, weighing the Storage Bag in his hand.
It was still as light as ever.
As if it had no weight at all.
"Amazing."
Ding Ling clicked his tongue in admiration.
"Even a mundane Storage Bag is so magical when it requires Inner Strength to open. Imagine how much stronger and more wondrous those of other grades will be in the future?"
Ding Ling was eagerly anticipating the day he could step onto the stage of the Immortal Gods.
Immortality, eternal youth and life, was what he most hoped to achieve.
No amount of worldly power or money could compare to immortality!
"The journey must be taken step by step. Complete the current task first."
Ding Ling opened the Storage Bag again, reached in to take out the Heaven-Swaying Sword, and strapped it to his back.
The sword needs to be used at any time.
Strapping it on his back is more prudent.
As for the Gold, it can go inside.
Ding Ling placed the remaining hundred some taels of Gold into the Storage Bag.
This Gold is conspicuous when carried around, but once inside the Storage Bag, it immediately looks perfectly normal.
Ding Ling was very pleased.
With a Storage Bag while wandering outside, it’s hard to go hungry.
"Later, I’ll replenish some food in this city and buy a bow and arrows, etc., as well."
Ding Ling thought:
"This saves me the trouble of having to hunt when I’m hungry while traveling in the wilderness. It’s too much hassle."
It’s fine if he can catch prey.
The problem is sometimes he can’t.
Without a bow and arrows on hand.
Sometimes, even when Ding Ling runs with all his might, he indeed cannot outrun a hare in the forest.
The hare, in its struggle to survive, has such agility and explosiveness that is utterly terrifying, as Ding Ling had witnessed more than once.
But with a bow and arrows, it’s entirely different, allowing for long-distance, direct hits.
This is precisely why he suddenly thought of buying a bow and arrows.

"If this were in the Three Kingdoms World, with the blessing of Celestial Might, trivial hares would die in any number. But in this world, without the blessing of Celestial Might, it’s much more solid! Although everything is identical to the real world, to run faster than a rabbit here is extremely difficult."
Ding Ling did not delve deeper into this subject.
It was because after his Ascension, he had thoroughly figured this aspect out.
Da-da!
Ding Ling went downstairs.
Having just settled the bill.
The shopkeeper, however, said somewhat awkwardly:
"Sir, you’ve stayed in my humble establishment for three days. This Silver may not be enough."
Silver naturally comes from exchanging Gold.
Paying with Gold is always expensive.
Ding Ling had not much Gold left now. He needed to use it sparingly; otherwise, he would be forced to handle basic needs in the wild. That was not something he wanted to see.
"Three days?!"
Ding Ling was taken aback.
He hadn’t expected that a single retreat, in the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
No wonder he felt a bit hungry.
But thinking about all the wonderful feelings during retreat, he was relieved.
If a day could produce an Inner Power Value of 20,
that would indeed be a bit exaggerated.
According to his observations,
The power exerted by a 100 Inner Power Value is absolutely no less than the full force of a Second-class Fierce General from the Three Kingdoms World!
If a day could achieve a level of 20, wouldn’t it be quick to reach the level of a Third-class Fierce General?
If he could practice for one day, he probably would equal what many practice their entire lives for.
Having figured it out, Ding Ling didn’t say much to the owner, but started settling the bill again.
After paying,
he rode off to some shops.
Among them, he purchased enough supplies, discretely storing them all into the Storage Bag.
Of course.
The purchased bow and arrows were hung on the side of the horse’s belly. Bows and arrows might be needed anytime, so there was no need to store them.
Clip-clop!
The Ferghana Horses were well taken care of by the shopkeeper these past few days.

Although many coveted his horse, even wanting to buy them, Ding Ling ignored them, brutally dealing with several hoodlums, teaching them a harsh lesson. After a few times, no one dared to make trouble again.
Because of this, the shopkeeper was extremely courteous to him.
At this moment, the Ferghana Horse galloped swiftly, kicking up a lot of dust.
In the sound of clip-clop.
The Ferghana Horse carried Ding Ling into an avenue flanked by lush greenery.
This was a main road.
And there were quite a few similar main roads indeed.
The beauty of the ancient environment was evident.
Having just entered the avenue for a little while.
Ding Ling sensed something was amiss.
Too quiet.
He abruptly tightened the reins.
Neighing!
The Ferghana Horse reared up, kicking its front hooves several times into the void before heavily stamping back down to earth.
Neighing!
The Ferghana Horse snorted, a look of bewilderment in its eyes.
Ding Ling glanced around.
He saw no one.
But soon enough.
He glanced sharply upwards only to see a fishing net falling over him.
The net was filled with thorns and iron spikes.
One could imagine, once trapped inside and unable to move, it would be a fate worse than death.
Ding Ling’s eyes filled with a trace of killing intent and anger.
He swiftly drew his sword.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword was unsheathed.
Pine Wind Swordsmanship!
Like the wind, like lightning, steady as pine, each thrust released a strong energy from the sword tip, whistling out with Ding Ling’s full-force swing at the net.
Crackling!
Boom!
The net was slashed to pieces by the Giant Que Sword, scattered everywhere.
"What a sharp sword!"
Someone exclaimed:
"Don’t spare his life, shoot him dead!"
Upon hearing this,
Ding Ling instantly realized someone had plotted against him.

Now it seemed he had overthought it.
He was experiencing a highly realistic and likely real-world mythical Game World!
One cannot measure this world by the standards set in novels.
Because the two have a fundamental difference.
"But being able to open this Storage Bag conveniently will certainly be much more convenient."
Ding Ling was delighted.
He tentatively placed the Heaven-Swaying Sword into the Storage Bag, then closed it again, weighing the Storage Bag in his hand.
It was still as light as ever.
As if it had no weight at all.
"Amazing."
Ding Ling clicked his tongue in admiration.
"Even a mundane Storage Bag is so magical when it requires Inner Strength to open.
Imagine how much stronger and more wondrous those of other grades will be in the future?"
Ding Ling was eagerly anticipating the day he could step onto the stage of the Immortal Gods.
Immortality, eternal youth and life, was what he most hoped to achieve.
No amount of worldly power or money could compare to immortality!
"The journey must be taken step by step.
Complete the current task first."
Ding Ling opened the Storage Bag again, reached in to take out the Heaven-Swaying Sword, and strapped it to his back.
The sword needs to be used at any time.
Strapping it on his back is more prudent.
As for the Gold, it can go inside.
Ding Ling placed the remaining hundred some taels of Gold into the Storage Bag.
This Gold is conspicuous when carried around, but once inside the Storage Bag, it immediately looks perfectly normal.
Ding Ling was very pleased.
With a Storage Bag while wandering outside, it’s hard to go hungry.
"Later, I’ll replenish some food in this city and buy a bow and arrows, etc., as well."
Ding Ling thought:
"This saves me the trouble of having to hunt when I’m hungry while traveling in the wilderness.
It’s too much hassle."
It’s fine if he can catch prey.
The problem is sometimes he can’t.
Without a bow and arrows on hand.
Sometimes, even when Ding Ling runs with all his might, he indeed cannot outrun a hare in the forest.
The hare, in its struggle to survive, has such agility and explosiveness that is utterly terrifying, as Ding Ling had witnessed more than once.
But with a bow and arrows, it’s entirely different, allowing for long-distance, direct hits.
This is precisely why he suddenly thought of buying a bow and arrows.
"If this were in the Three Kingdoms World, with the blessing of Celestial Might, trivial hares would die in any number.
But in this world, without the blessing of Celestial Might, it’s much more solid!
Although everything is identical to the real world, to run faster than a rabbit here is extremely difficult."
Ding Ling did not delve deeper into this subject.
It was because after his Ascension, he had thoroughly figured this aspect out.
Da-da!
Ding Ling went downstairs.
Having just settled the bill.
The shopkeeper, however, said somewhat awkwardly:
"Sir, you’ve stayed in my humble establishment for three days.
This Silver may not be enough."
Silver naturally comes from exchanging Gold.
Paying with Gold is always expensive.
Ding Ling had not much Gold left now.
He needed to use it sparingly; otherwise, he would be forced to handle basic needs in the wild.
That was not something he wanted to see.
"Three days?!"
Ding Ling was taken aback.
He hadn’t expected that a single retreat, in the blink of an eye, three days had passed.
No wonder he felt a bit hungry.
But thinking about all the wonderful feelings during retreat, he was relieved.
If a day could produce an Inner Power Value of 20,
that would indeed be a bit exaggerated.
According to his observations,
The power exerted by a 100 Inner Power Value is absolutely no less than the full force of a Second-class Fierce General from the Three Kingdoms World!
If a day could achieve a level of 20, wouldn’t it be quick to reach the level of a Third-class Fierce General?
If he could practice for one day, he probably would equal what many practice their entire lives for.
Having figured it out, Ding Ling didn’t say much to the owner, but started settling the bill again.
After paying,
he rode off to some shops.
Among them, he purchased enough supplies, discretely storing them all into the Storage Bag.
Of course.
The purchased bow and arrows were hung on the side of the horse’s belly.
Bows and arrows might be needed anytime, so there was no need to store them.
Clip-clop!
The Ferghana Horses were well taken care of by the shopkeeper these past few days.
Although many coveted his horse, even wanting to buy them, Ding Ling ignored them, brutally dealing with several hoodlums, teaching them a harsh lesson.
After a few times, no one dared to make trouble again.
Because of this, the shopkeeper was extremely courteous to him.
At this moment, the Ferghana Horse galloped swiftly, kicking up a lot of dust.
In the sound of clip-clop.
The Ferghana Horse carried Ding Ling into an avenue flanked by lush greenery.
This was a main road.
And there were quite a few similar main roads indeed.
The beauty of the ancient environment was evident.
Having just entered the avenue for a little while.
Ding Ling sensed something was amiss.
Too quiet.
He abruptly tightened the reins.
Neighing!
The Ferghana Horse reared up, kicking its front hooves several times into the void before heavily stamping back down to earth.
Neighing!
The Ferghana Horse snorted, a look of bewilderment in its eyes.
Ding Ling glanced around.
He saw no one.
But soon enough.
He glanced sharply upwards only to see a fishing net falling over him.
The net was filled with thorns and iron spikes.
One could imagine, once trapped inside and unable to move, it would be a fate worse than death.
Ding Ling’s eyes filled with a trace of killing intent and anger.
He swiftly drew his sword.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword was unsheathed.
Pine Wind Swordsmanship!
Like the wind, like lightning, steady as pine, each thrust released a strong energy from the sword tip, whistling out with Ding Ling’s full-force swing at the net.
Crackling!
Boom!
The net was slashed to pieces by the Giant Que Sword, scattered everywhere.
"What a sharp sword!"
Someone exclaimed:
"Don’t spare his life, shoot him dead!"
Upon hearing this,
Ding Ling instantly realized someone had plotted against him.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Qingcheng Four Talents (8/15)
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s eyes flashed like lightning, following the sound.
He saw five or six people standing atop the lush trees.
They were hiding behind the branches of the trees, scattered around in Ding Ling’s blind spot!
Clearly, the opponents had studied this and were alert!
This was why Ding Ling detected them immediately, but couldn’t pinpoint their exact location.
It was evident.
The group before him were seasoned criminals! Highly skilled and experienced in ambushing and killing their enemies.
Ding Ling was furious.
As crossbow arrows shot towards him, he leapt from the horseback, clang! From where he drew out another Heaven-Swaying Sword, swinging swords both ways.
Sword God Skill!
Pine Wind Swordsmanship!
Two world-class Sword Skills demonstrated their power simultaneously.
One sword spun continuously, blooming like flowers, sword blossoms bursting in the void, enchanting yet containing deadly murderous intent;
The other sword stabbed forward, vibrating with a constant hum, resembling an unwavering pine, and an omnipresent, ethereal wind, moving left, right, up, down, the latter imbued with explosive speed;
Two swords.
Two distinct Sword Techniques, as Ding Ling activated Ascending Skill, Flying Swallow Technique, jumping sagacious, unveiled unparalleled brilliance in the world.
Clang!
Clink clink clink!
All arrows were perfectly blocked and split open by sword strikes, some even pierced and separated by the sword edge.
Ding Ling soared several feet, relentlessly slicing the bursting arrows, within moments, landing atop a tree, locking eyes with a few archers.
Very close.
Ding Ling could clearly see the surprise, panic, and terror in their eyes.
With a cold smile, Ding Ling kicked the tree trunk, his whole body shot forth like a Flying Cloud Arrow, resembling a cannonball, flew face-to-face with one of the archers in a blink.
When the archer instinctively swung the bow towards Ding Ling, he casually sliced with a sword.
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Setting Sun Diagram flickered on the sword edge.
Perfectly evading the bow, striking directly at the opponent’s neck!
Spurt!
A head flew into the air.
A column of blood surged from the neck.
Ignoring the body, Ding Ling turned to the other archers.
At this moment, they all widened their eyes, staring at Ding Ling in shock, disbelief that Ding Ling could be so powerful and terrifying.

Ding Ling gave them a deathly look, again kicking the trunk, Five Animals Qigong activated, Flying Swallow Technique in motion, Ascending Skill showcased, his figure flew out, like a sparrow spinning in the air, both swords dancing, forming a Wind Wheel, perfectly blocking the torrent of arrows.
"Shoot!"
"Quick, shoot him dead!"
The leader, a straight-backed young man full of heroism, extraordinary demeanor, watched Ding Ling in terror, shouting hysterically:
"Don’t let him get close to me!"
Clang!
Clink clink clink!
Heaven-Swaying Sword, Giant Que Sword, slashed, chopped, hacked, stabbed, under Human Emperor Swordsmanship, sword light gleamed, golden light shone, unstoppable all the way.
A wave of arrow rain was useless against Ding Ling.
The archers, under the young man’s anger, revealed themselves, totaling over a dozen.
Each held a bow, with a quiver on their back.
A wave of arrow rain consisted of over a dozen arrows.
Each arrow released at full draw, shot swiftly, with blue-green arrowheads, seemingly laced with poison!
An average martial arts master, caught off guard, could risk dying regrettably!
But their opponent was Ding Ling.
A man honed in arrow rain!
A warrior undefeated in Three Kingdoms!
Mere dozen or so arrows, for him, made no difference than tickles.
Unreacted was fine, once reacted, Ding Ling swiftly counterattacked like thunderbolt, each counterkills an opponent.
Spurt!
He landed on a tree, Giant Que Sword swung, blocking the unexpected arrows, Heaven-Swaying Sword waved forward, amidst an archer’s startled scream, spurt!

A massive head fell off, Ding Ling kicked it casually, bang! Striking the leading young man’s forehead, the kick’s force coupled with Breathing Technique’s unique Vigorous Qi, weighing thousands, struck the young man, his forehead blasted, killed on the spot, flipped down the tree, rotated twice.
Bang!
Heavily fell on the ground, motionless.
"Hou Renying!"
Someone called out mournfully, glaring at Ding Ling like an enemy.
"Hou Renying?"
A familiar name.

Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, unfazed, ran like the wind, Ascending Skill, Flying Swallow Technique executed perfectly, sometimes up sometimes down, sometimes left sometimes right, in the forest, at times like apes climbing vines, extremely agile!
At times like a swallow streaking across the sky, graceful posture, swift speed!
With two swords, Ding Ling transformed into a Death God in the forest!
Wherever he passed.
A storm of blood!
Bang bang!
Spurt spurt!
Accompanied by sporadic screams, momentarily, the ground was covered with severed limbs, broken arms, heads!
Ding Ling jumped again, landed before another young man.
This person had elegant charm, graceful demeanor, exceptional talent.
But now he seemed terrified, his crotch soaked.
Gazing at Ding Ling like watching Death god, King Yama, filled with immense fear and panic.
[Achievement Medal: Intimidating Hou Renying!]
[Note: As one of Qingcheng Sect’s ’Qingcheng Four Talents’, his reputation is illustrious, echoing across Qingcheng Earth Realm, even in Jianghu, praised and glorified.
They took pride in this. Hou Renying even more conceited, thinking himself a youthful hero, looking down on ordinary people, and even disciples of renowned sects, confident in surpassing them.
This time.
Confidently approached to surround and kill you.
Unexpectedly encountered your effortless counterkills!
Hou Renying was shocked, disbelieving to the extreme. You shattered his pride and arrogance, sending him to meet King Yama amidst his hysteria.
He couldn’t believe, dying so wretchedly, brutally unexpectedly!
If there’s a next life. Seeing you, he will surely avoid you far away.]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidating Hong Renxiong]
[Note: Also one of Qingcheng Four Talents. He too had his pride. But you gave him the most terrifying nightmare of his life.
If possible. He would never want to face you again.]
Prompt sounded timely.
Ding Ling paused, soon regained his composure.
Initially wanting to interrogate the young man before him, now it seemed unnecessary, the previous was Hou Renying.
The one before now must be Hong Renxiong.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: The Reason! The Ruined Temple (9/15)
paragraphs: Ding Ling struck directly with a sword, snap, snap!
The back of the sword slapped against the young man’s cheek, making him stagger and almost lose his balance, stepping back a few steps before crashing to the ground.
"Hong Renxiong?"
Ding Ling looked down at him and asked indifferently.
"How, how, how did you know it was me?!"
The young man was a bit confused, more so in disbelief:
"Is it possible that my reputation has really spread across the entire Jiuzhou Territory, so even a master like you knows of me?!"
"Heh heh."
Ding Ling chuckled ambiguously and said:
"Why did you come to kill me?"
His voice was gentle, like a spring breeze in the ear.

Yet it was like cold water poured over his head, causing Hong Renxiong’s heart to plunge into an icy abyss. His feelings towards Ding Ling were a mix of hatred, fear, anger, jealousy, and envy... an extremely complex emotion.
He was so confused that he forgot to hide the expression on his face.
By the time he realized it.
It was already too late.
His heart felt ashen, he hung his head, saying nothing.
"If you don’t speak, I’ll have you flayed alive."

Ding Ling waved his long sword, under the effect of Dawn Swordsmanship, a scene of blooming flowers formed on the ground, crackling sounds filled the air as the wild grass got instantly shredded to pieces, looking like it had just been through a tornado, increasingly fragmented and chaotic.
Hong Renxiong’s pupils shrank as he fearfully glanced at Ding Ling and said:
"If, if, if I speak, can you spare my life?"
"I can let you die a bit quicker."
Ding Ling spoke frankly:
"Anyway, I already know that Qingcheng Sect sent the assassin after me. I’ll settle the score with Yu Canghai sooner or later, whether you speak or not doesn’t really matter anymore."
He raised his sword:
"I can flay you alive right now."
"No!"
Hong Renxiong screamed in terror:
"I’ll talk!"
As soon as he uttered these two words.
He broke out in a cold sweat.
As if he’d just been pulled out of the water.
His face turned ghastly pale as he said:

"It was the Darts Master from the Fuwei Escort Agency who said you killed Yu Renyan. And there are aliens who claimed you took the Exorcism Sword Manual. We were able to find you so easily because someone secretly provided the information."
"I see."
Ding Ling understood.
When players massively entered a world.
The local natives would naturally learn about some of the things concerning these aliens.
It was true back in the Three Kingdoms.
And it’s true in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World as well.

If it was just Ding Ling alone, perhaps it wouldn’t be like this. But the player group had already flooded into this world several days ago, and it seems the local natives have gradually adapted to the presence of these aliens.
"Where is Yu Canghai?"
"In a ruined temple ahead. It’s just over a dozen miles from here. If we’re unable to hold our ground, we can flee there, and the Sect Leader will aid us."
He glanced at Ding Ling in fear:
"What we didn’t expect is that you’d be so strong. It seems those aliens weren’t lying. It’s truly our arrogance and overconfidence."
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched slightly.
No doubt about it.
The alien who provided secret information either has a grudge with him, harbors deep resentment, or simply doesn’t like him!
In the Three Kingdoms World, there were many such people, and Ding Ling subdued the world by himself. Anyone who dared defy him would be obliterated directly!
Now that he’s here.
Does Ding Ling have the same power?
Perhaps the players are also testing him?
Ding Ling pondered to himself:
"If they figure out the essence of it, they might attack me in the real world."
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling became cautious.
He felt more and more that it was a wise decision not to deeply engage with the players.
Illusions and realities.
Real and fake.
Let them see it vaguely so they’re indecisive, which might delay a lot more time.
Of course, to be on the safe side.
Moving again.
And using the Eight Array Map and other disguises is also quite necessary.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling had Hong Renxiong recite the Kung Fu he knew.
It turned out he learned the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, Pine Wind Swordsmanship, and Basic Archery.
He knew all three.
So why keep Hong Renxiong around?
Amid his screams.
Clang!
The blade trembled, thud!
A head soared into the sky.
Ding Ling turned around and left without looking back.
A Ferghana Horse neighing!

The Ferghana Horse, as if it had a soul, galloped over, and Ding Ling flipped onto its back, tugged slightly on the reins, and charged towards the direction Hong Renxiong had pointed to, where the ruined temple lay.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
The horse was fast.
Ding Ling sat steadily on the horse’s back, sheathed his sword, and picked up a bow.
To treat people the way they treat him!
If the other side shoots arrows in ambush.
Then don’t blame him for using arrows to kill as well.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
After some time.
Among the sounds of hooves.

Ding Ling’s eyes were as sharp as lightning, and he spotted the hidden ruined temple in the lush Green Forest at first glance, because the temple was extremely conspicuous, built right beside a vast lake!
At this moment, someone seemed to be fetching water from the lake to cook.
Thin wisps of smoke could be seen rising from the temple.
Ding Ling sneered, dismounted, patted the heads of the two Ferghana Horses, signaling them to stay there and wait.

He then performed the Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill, leaping several meters high in a bound, landing on a branch of a large tree, similar to how a Tiger King crosses a mountain stream; activating the Five Animals Qigong, he continued moving nimbly, lightly landing on one tree after another, getting closer to the temple without being noticed.
At this moment.
Ding Ling was only about ten meters from the temple entrance.
Being so close.
Ding Ling’s gaze was like a torch, sharp and clear.
A dozen people were gathered at the temple entrance.
Inside the temple were three to five people tied up.
There was a middle-aged man and woman, elegantly dressed and with a noble air, leaning against the wall.
Next to them knelt a handsome young man, wasn’t it Lin Pingzhi?
Ding Ling was secretly surprised:
"I clearly saw the letter delivered directly into the hands of the Lin Family, so how did they end up like this?"
No doubt.
Either Lin Zhennan didn’t believe his words at all.
Or there was player interference involved, or Yu Canghai acted swiftly, not giving Lin Zhennan time to escape?
No matter the truth.
Ding Ling didn’t spare them another glance.
He had done everything he could and felt no shame in his heart.
If it doesn’t work out, in the future find an opportunity to return the Exorcism Sword Manual to Lin Pingzhi.
This is because he took it, if someone else took it, how likely would they return it?
Not only would Ding Ling return it, but before that, he had already given advice, and also sent them a Superior Swordsmanship!
If all this is still considered unscrupulous, then Ding Ling has nothing to say.
In his actions, he strives to stand tall and remain blameless, once he feels he has done his utmost, he won’t hesitate anymore.
And this is the case now.
He ignored the Lin family.
Instead, he looked at the dozen men at the door.
Among them, the leader was short and thin, yet showed extraordinary demeanour, exuding a majestic presence as he sat ’big and mighty’ on a rock, looking coldly at a beardless, fair-skinned man.

Does Ding Ling have the same power?
Perhaps the players are also testing him?
Ding Ling pondered to himself:
"If they figure out the essence of it, they might attack me in the real world."
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling became cautious.
He felt more and more that it was a wise decision not to deeply engage with the players.
Illusions and realities.
Real and fake.
Let them see it vaguely so they’re indecisive, which might delay a lot more time.
Of course, to be on the safe side.
Moving again.
And using the Eight Array Map and other disguises is also quite necessary.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling had Hong Renxiong recite the Kung Fu he knew.
It turned out he learned the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, Pine Wind Swordsmanship, and Basic Archery.
He knew all three.
So why keep Hong Renxiong around?
Amid his screams.
Clang!
The blade trembled, thud!
A head soared into the sky.
Ding Ling turned around and left without looking back.
A Ferghana Horse neighing!

The Ferghana Horse, as if it had a soul, galloped over, and Ding Ling flipped onto its back, tugged slightly on the reins, and charged towards the direction Hong Renxiong had pointed to, where the ruined temple lay.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
The horse was fast.
Ding Ling sat steadily on the horse’s back, sheathed his sword, and picked up a bow.
To treat people the way they treat him!
If the other side shoots arrows in ambush.
Then don’t blame him for using arrows to kill as well.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
After some time.
Among the sounds of hooves.

Ding Ling’s eyes were as sharp as lightning, and he spotted the hidden ruined temple in the lush Green Forest at first glance, because the temple was extremely conspicuous, built right beside a vast lake!
At this moment, someone seemed to be fetching water from the lake to cook.
Thin wisps of smoke could be seen rising from the temple.
Ding Ling sneered, dismounted, patted the heads of the two Ferghana Horses, signaling them to stay there and wait.

He then performed the Flying Swallow Technique and Ascending Skill, leaping several meters high in a bound, landing on a branch of a large tree, similar to how a Tiger King crosses a mountain stream; activating the Five Animals Qigong, he continued moving nimbly, lightly landing on one tree after another, getting closer to the temple without being noticed.
At this moment.
Ding Ling was only about ten meters from the temple entrance.
Being so close.
Ding Ling’s gaze was like a torch, sharp and clear.
A dozen people were gathered at the temple entrance.
Inside the temple were three to five people tied up.
There was a middle-aged man and woman, elegantly dressed and with a noble air, leaning against the wall.
Next to them knelt a handsome young man, wasn’t it Lin Pingzhi?
Ding Ling was secretly surprised:
"I clearly saw the letter delivered directly into the hands of the Lin Family, so how did they end up like this?"
No doubt.
Either Lin Zhennan didn’t believe his words at all.
Or there was player interference involved, or Yu Canghai acted swiftly, not giving Lin Zhennan time to escape?
No matter the truth.
Ding Ling didn’t spare them another glance.
He had done everything he could and felt no shame in his heart.
If it doesn’t work out, in the future find an opportunity to return the Exorcism Sword Manual to Lin Pingzhi.
This is because he took it, if someone else took it, how likely would they return it?
Not only would Ding Ling return it, but before that, he had already given advice, and also sent them a Superior Swordsmanship!
If all this is still considered unscrupulous, then Ding Ling has nothing to say.
In his actions, he strives to stand tall and remain blameless, once he feels he has done his utmost, he won’t hesitate anymore.
And this is the case now.
He ignored the Lin family.
Instead, he looked at the dozen men at the door.
Among them, the leader was short and thin, yet showed extraordinary demeanour, exuding a majestic presence as he sat ’big and mighty’ on a rock, looking coldly at a beardless, fair-skinned man.

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Ding Ling vs. Yu Canghai
paragraphs: This man, Ding Ling, at first just found him familiar, but couldn’t recall who he was at the moment.
When the short man shouted "Duanmu Qing," only then did Ding Ling suddenly realize.

In the Three Kingdoms World, Duanmu Qing plotted against Ding Ling, resulting in Ding Ling ordering Li Meng to personally lead troops to surround and kill him, reducing Duanmu Qing’s skill level to zero. He dared not log on anymore.
Unexpectedly, this guy actually came to the Martial World.
It’s understandable upon reflection.
In the Three Kingdoms World, this guy could no longer stay, with Li Meng always watching over him.
He naturally chose to endure bitterly and wait.

When all players could ascend to the Martial Hero Plane, he, having no skills or capabilities in the Three Kingdoms World, would naturally choose to abandon everything and start anew in the Martial World.
But as fate would have it.
Duanmu Qing, to his misfortune, ascended to the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. Upon learning that Ding Ling was in Fuzhou City, he began plotting against Ding Ling once again.
It shows how deep his hatred for Ding Ling is.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, thinking:
"I’ve killed quite a lot of players in the Three Kingdoms World. Thinking about it, I do have quite a few enemies. Looks like I’ll have to be more cautious in the future."
There are players deliberately targeting Ding Ling.
Ding Ling ordered people to block the players’ online and offline spots, refusing to stop until they were killed to level zero.
This can be said to be mortal enemies.
Those encountered in ordinary battlefield clashes, Ding Ling really doesn’t know how many he has killed, and he himself has no idea.
So, upon seeing Duanmu Qing at this moment, his thoughts became chaotic and at the same time, he secretly warned himself to always be on guard and cautious!
"Duanmu Qing, if you dare to lie to me even a little, I will make you understand what fate worse than death is."
The short man looked at Duanmu Qing with a cold, fierce gaze.
Duanmu Qing nodded and bowed obsequiously, saying:
"Yu Sect Leader speaks wisely. How dare I deceive you?"
After swearing to the sky, he solemnly said:
"From now on, I am Yu Sect Leader’s most loyal servant."
Yu Sect Leader stroked the three strands of long beard under his chin, smiling rather strangely, unclear what he was thinking at the moment.
Yu Sect Leader?
It should be Yu Canghai.

Ding Ling found the main target, hesitated no longer, and picked up three arrows, placing them on the big bow, pulling the bowstring to its full extent, with the Double Extreme Arrow Skill and Tornado Arrow Technique enhancing each other, not to mention strengthening with the Four Great Breathing Techniques, and also injecting the Inner Strength of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill into the arrows.
As soon as Inner Strength was injected, it caused a subtle transformation with the Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique.
The arrowhead constantly hummed, seeming ready to explode at any moment.
Ding Ling was secretly amazed, but at the instant the arrowhead hummed, he inwardly realized something was wrong, and immediately, without hesitation, released the string.
In an instant, the three sharp arrows shot forth like a fast ship at sea, a falling meteor, a streak across the sky, explosively shooting towards Yu Canghai.
These three sharp arrows were as fast as lightning, creating brilliant fiery trails as they rubbed against the void!
Sparks flying, lightning flashing!
With a whoosh, they arrived before Yu Canghai, one arrow aimed directly at his forehead, one at his chest, and one at his throat!
The three arrows were like harbingers of death.
Utterly terrifying.

At the instant the arrowhead hummed, Yu Canghai’s ears twitched, seemingly sensing something, and as the three arrows shot out, he seemed to be targeted by the Death God, breaking into a cold sweat uncontrollably, as he turned his head sharply, just in time to see the three arrows explosively shooting straight towards him.
"Ah!"
In a swift motion, Yu Canghai leaped three meters high, barely avoiding the three arrows.
He dodged.
But Duanmu Qing in front of him and the other disciples suffered.
With a few puffs!
Following the sound, one could see.

Duanmu Qing was pierced through the chest by an arrow. Perhaps the force of the arrow was too great, for he was carried over ten meters away, crashing into several people along the way before rolling to the ground, fate unknown.
The other disciples were pierced through the abdomen by the other two arrows, and those arrows still had enough force to knock down two more disciples before finally exhausting their energy.
This happened in an instant.
Many people had not yet reacted.
The scene turned from peaceful to bloody in an instant, some people stood stunned for a moment, then started screaming, while others began to turn and flee.
But Ding Ling did not give them any time to breathe.
After the three arrows,
he quickly picked up three more arrows, stringing the bow and shooting explosively at Yu Canghai in mid-air.
"See how you dodge this time!"
Whoosh, whoosh!

With the sound of the string snapping, the three arrows once again became divine arrows piercing the clouds! The arrowheads hummed continuously with the empowerment of Inner Strength and the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique, occasionally revealing the arrow’s shadow as it flickered in the void and then vanished, only to see Yu Canghai let out a loud roar, drawing his sword to block the three arrows!
Clang!
Clang! Clang! Clang!

Yu Canghai’s Pine Wind Swordsmanship had evidently reached a mastery level, with a sword like pine, like wind, both powerful and agile to the extreme, augmented with Inner Strength, the sharp sword, when thrust, was like the horns of an antelope, leaving no trace.
Clang!

Every clash with Ding Ling’s arrows transmitted an explosive force along the sword into his organs, and with each impact, he felt as if struck by lightning, his whole body uncomfortable. After three successive clashes, Yu Canghai was so stifled he wanted to vomit blood, his face turning crimson with alarm.
At this point, as he had just flipped over and landed, before he could stand firm, three more arrows explosively shot towards him!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Yu Canghai swiftly swung his sharp sword, his Pine Wind Swordsmanship performed to the zenith, immediately creating a sky filled with shadows of pine and the void of the wind!
Pine and wind merged into one.
Vigorous Sword Qi roiled and surged in the void, colliding with the divine arrows producing enormous sound.
Every sound rang like muffled thunder, shaking even the earth beneath, catching the eyes and shocking everyone.
The breath of Lin Pingzhi’s family was momentarily suffocated, their expressions serious, eyes full of expectation.
Whoosh!
Thud!
An arrow struck Yu Canghai’s foot, in an instant, piercing through his thigh, carrying him helplessly backward several steps before he barely managed to stabilize.
But Ding Ling didn’t give him time to react, relentlessly stringing the bow and shooting explosively at Yu Canghai. He was secretly shaken in his heart, thinking:
"This Yu Canghai is even more difficult to deal with than I imagined. It doesn’t make sense, if just Yu Canghai is so hard to manage, wouldn’t Dongfang Bubai be even more overwhelming?"
Even in a sneak attack to kill the enemy, it was so difficult.
If confronted directly.
It was highly likely Ding Ling wouldn’t be able to kill Yu Canghai, who might escape.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling’s killing intent surged to the extreme, how could he dare show mercy.
The speed at which he strung the bow and shot arrows grew faster and faster.
His endurance, speed was astonishing.
In the peak of killing intent, his explosive power was even more unparalleled, and after shooting a dozen arrows, the arrows shot subsequently were unexpectedly stronger instead of weaker.
As Yu Canghai was blocking an arrow with his sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Lin Zhennan and His Wife (11/15)
paragraphs: Ding Ling became aware.
His heart grew increasingly shocked.
Clang!
Bang bang bang!

Three consecutive clashes, each time Yu Canghai crossed weapons, he was pushed back several steps. By the time he finished clashing with the three arrows again, he had retreated to the lakeside. Here, Yu Canghai saw three more arrows coming at him from the void.

Previously, because he wasn’t steady on his feet to confront the arrows, an imprudent move led to an arrow piercing his thigh. Now, enduring excruciating pain, he saw that the person hiding in the dark was shooting arrows endlessly, densely packed, with no weaknesses to exploit. He immediately realized that this must be an unparalleled master.
How could he dare to linger any longer?
He immediately gathered his inner strength and shouted loudly:
"Which hero is this? Why must you try to kill me? Can we sit down and talk first to resolve any misunderstandings?"
The voice was powerful and resonant, full of iron-blooded force.
Enhanced by inner strength, it was like the pounding waves of a tumultuous sea hitting the beach, rumbling with such force that the void seemed to tear and groan!
But Ding Ling ignored him.
They had already torn faces.
There was no reason to hold back.
Whoosh whoosh!
The arrows flew faster than lightning, and in a finger snap, six arrows were fired in succession. Three arrows in front, three arrows behind!
Every arrow fired through the void, sparking a blinding shower of sparks.
The speed was astounding, the vigorous qi fierce!
Yu Canghai’s expression drastically changed; without hesitation, he leapt into the lake.
Splash!

Yu Canghai fell heavily onto the lake surface, sending water splashing up in bursts, whoosh whoosh! As arrows brushed past him, accompanied by a muffled grunt, blood flowers appeared on the lake’s surface as Yu Canghai got hit again.
Six arrows.
Five missed.
One hit the target.

Ding Ling didn’t know if Yu Canghai was dead or not. He leaped down from the tree, flew over ten meters with one stride, landing by the lakeside, and looked closely. He saw the water was filled with blood, fish occasionally jumping up, but Yu Canghai’s figure was nowhere to be seen.
"Hmph."
Ding Ling snorted coldly, bent his bow, and aimed at the fleeing Qingcheng Sect disciples.
Whoosh whoosh!
Even Yu Canghai couldn’t avoid Ding Ling’s arrows and had to face them head-on; how could these disciples evade them?
Only screams could be heard continuously.
One by one, the disciples who turned and ran far were shot and fell to the ground, motionless.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling emptied several quivers at his waist and then stopped.
[Achievement Medal: Intimidating Yu Canghai]
[Annotation: As a true first-class expert in this plane world, Yu Canghai’s strength can rival the super-elite fierce generals of the historical plane. In some areas, even surpassing them!
He roamed the land of Sichuan, impressively powerful, his name known across the Four Seas! Few dared provoke him!
He was confident that his lifelong learning was not inferior to past sages and predecessors, often using martial force to coerce and intimidate others.
Very few opponents could catch his attention.
Yet today, he was nearly shot dead by you; he harbors intense fear, resentment, and terror towards you!
Without a doubt, if you meet again, he will prepare thoroughly to confront you.]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidating Yhiuu Renhao]

[Annotation: As one of the Qingcheng Four Talents. Yhiuu Renhao had never experienced such a terrifying scene as today, unable even to flee before being shot dead on the spot. Even in death, he was utterly shocked, fearful, and horrified!]
[Achievement Medal: Intimidating Lin Zhennan and Wife]
[Annotation: They witnessed firsthand how you dealt with enemies in a flash of lightning, repelling Yu Canghai, and developed intense fear towards you.

In their eyes, Yu Canghai’s martial arts were too terrifying to be resisted by human strength. But you easily repelled him, astonishing them and making them fearful of falling into the hands of other villains.]
Another three achievement medals.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
He hadn’t realized that among the fleeing Qingcheng Sect disciples, there was another of the Qingcheng Four Talents.
Three of the Qingcheng Four Talents were now dead.
The middle tier of the Qingcheng Sect was cut off, making a lasting future unlikely.
He suddenly looked towards the inside of the ruined temple.
He happened to meet Lin Pingzhi’s gaze.
"Ah!"
Lin Pingzhi exclaimed in slight fear, hurriedly lowering his head, not daring to look at Ding Ling.
Meeting Ding Ling again.
In such a moment, such a scene.
In his heart, Ding Ling was already as grand and mighty as an unparalleled master.
After the battle before the ruined temple.
Ding Ling further became a godlike, majestic figure in his heart.

Just looking at Ding Ling made him instinctively tremble with fear, not to mention meeting Ding Ling’s gaze, which felt like he might be claimed by the Death God at any moment, making him genuinely fearful and trembling.
Ding Ling looked expressionlessly at the few in the ruined temple.
Lin Zhennan and his wife.
Lin Pingzhi.
And two others who were clearly Darts Masters.
Needless to say.
One of them must have leaked Ding Ling’s information.
Because from their eyes, Ding Ling saw unease, shock, guilt, and anxiety.
Ding Ling was skilled in psychology, observing people skill, and acting.
Naturally, he could discern who was the informant.
He glanced around and saw Duanmu Qing’s restless face.
"So now you’re at level 0, right?"
Ding Ling looked pensively at Duanmu Qing:
"I wonder what terrifying thing happens when a player’s level drops to 0?"
Instinctively.
Ding Ling felt that Duanmu Qing’s future was certainly worrisome.
However, regarding this.
Ding Ling was glad to see it.
He couldn’t wait for Duanmu Qing to die.
From the Three Kingdoms World to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, plotting incessantly without rest!
Truly one who doesn’t know to repent when the cart is placed before the horse!
Who knows where he found such courage and confidence!

Ding Ling saw that Duanmu Qing’s ankle had vanished; when his body completely disappeared later, it might be the time of his resurrection, but who knows if the next resurrection, he would still be him?
Ding Ling felt it necessary to research it.
But now was evidently not suitable.

Next time in the real world, he could use hacking techniques to track and lock Duanmu Qing’s IP, or track posts and figures related to him, to see what subtle changes might happen to Duanmu Qing, and thus deduce the truth and reasoning within.
Upon this thought.
Ding Ling stopped thinking further, entered the ruined temple, glanced at Lin Zhennan and his wife, drew his sword, and in their terrified cries, swish!
The sword light flashed.
The ropes binding them were severed.
"Huh?!"
Without experiencing any piercing, pain, or other sensations.
Lin Zhennan and his wife opened their eyes, realizing they were freed. They exchanged a glance and then, full of shame, bowed to Ding Ling in thanks:
"Thank you for saving us, I, Lin Zhennan, am indebted beyond words! If ever commanded, I shall spare no effort to accomplish it!"
Ding Ling paid them no heed.
Last time, he sent a message, sword technique.
This time, he saved them.
He felt utterly at peace. In the future, they would be strangers, and there was no need to be too involved.
