He hadn’t realized that among the fleeing Qingcheng Sect disciples, there was another of the Qingcheng Four Talents.
Three of the Qingcheng Four Talents were now dead.
The middle tier of the Qingcheng Sect was cut off, making a lasting future unlikely.
He suddenly looked towards the inside of the ruined temple.
He happened to meet Lin Pingzhi’s gaze.
"Ah!"
Lin Pingzhi exclaimed in slight fear, hurriedly lowering his head, not daring to look at Ding Ling.
Meeting Ding Ling again.
In such a moment, such a scene.
In his heart, Ding Ling was already as grand and mighty as an unparalleled master.
After the battle before the ruined temple.
Ding Ling further became a godlike, majestic figure in his heart.

Just looking at Ding Ling made him instinctively tremble with fear, not to mention meeting Ding Ling’s gaze, which felt like he might be claimed by the Death God at any moment, making him genuinely fearful and trembling.
Ding Ling looked expressionlessly at the few in the ruined temple.
Lin Zhennan and his wife.
Lin Pingzhi.
And two others who were clearly Darts Masters.
Needless to say.
One of them must have leaked Ding Ling’s information.
Because from their eyes, Ding Ling saw unease, shock, guilt, and anxiety.
Ding Ling was skilled in psychology, observing people skill, and acting.
Naturally, he could discern who was the informant.
He glanced around and saw Duanmu Qing’s restless face.
"So now you’re at level 0, right?"
Ding Ling looked pensively at Duanmu Qing:
"I wonder what terrifying thing happens when a player’s level drops to 0?"
Instinctively.
Ding Ling felt that Duanmu Qing’s future was certainly worrisome.
However, regarding this.
Ding Ling was glad to see it.
He couldn’t wait for Duanmu Qing to die.
From the Three Kingdoms World to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, plotting incessantly without rest!
Truly one who doesn’t know to repent when the cart is placed before the horse!
Who knows where he found such courage and confidence!

Ding Ling saw that Duanmu Qing’s ankle had vanished; when his body completely disappeared later, it might be the time of his resurrection, but who knows if the next resurrection, he would still be him?
Ding Ling felt it necessary to research it.
But now was evidently not suitable.

Next time in the real world, he could use hacking techniques to track and lock Duanmu Qing’s IP, or track posts and figures related to him, to see what subtle changes might happen to Duanmu Qing, and thus deduce the truth and reasoning within.
Upon this thought.
Ding Ling stopped thinking further, entered the ruined temple, glanced at Lin Zhennan and his wife, drew his sword, and in their terrified cries, swish!
The sword light flashed.
The ropes binding them were severed.
"Huh?!"
Without experiencing any piercing, pain, or other sensations.
Lin Zhennan and his wife opened their eyes, realizing they were freed.
They exchanged a glance and then, full of shame, bowed to Ding Ling in thanks:
"Thank you for saving us, I, Lin Zhennan, am indebted beyond words!
If ever commanded, I shall spare no effort to accomplish it!"
Ding Ling paid them no heed.
Last time, he sent a message, sword technique.
This time, he saved them.
He felt utterly at peace.
In the future, they would be strangers, and there was no need to be too involved.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Investment! Apprenticeship
paragraphs: Ding Ling is not the Holy Mother, but he’s also not someone without a bottom line.
Precisely because he has a bottom line and a conscience.
That’s why he can clearly distinguish between good and evil, right and wrong.
It’s also the reason he believes that stealing from bad people is justified, while taking from good people must be compensated for.
This is his code of conduct in life.
Rather than trying to curry favor with the Lin Family, he simply nodded indifferently at Lin Zhennan and his wife and turned to the Darts Master:
"Was it you who informed Yu Canghai, saying I killed Yu Renyan?"
The Darts Master looked at Ding Ling in terror, shrinking back, not daring to speak.
Ding Ling frowned, drew his sword, clang!
Slash!
Two heads flew up, accompanied by hot pillars of blood, thudding to the ground in front of Lin Pingzhi.
"Ah!"
Lin Pingzhi screamed in horror and fled behind Lin Zhennan and his wife.
"Benefactor, you, you..."
Lin Zhennan looked shocked.
Ding Ling glanced at him.

Under a mix of awe and respect, Lin Zhennan unconsciously took a step back, and when he realized it, he felt both shame and awkwardness, turning his head slightly as if he dared not meet Ding Ling’s gaze at this moment.
Ding Ling sighed inwardly and lifted his leg to leave.
He wasn’t necessarily going to kill the leakers.
But the leakers described his appearance so specifically, knowing Yu Canghai would definitely kill him—wasn’t it clear they didn’t care about others’ lives?
If the Darts Master had described him vaguely, Ding Ling wouldn’t have resorted to killing.
What a pity.
The other side wanted him dead.
So why should he spare their lives?
In this world, no matter who wants him, Ding Ling, dead, for any reason, Ding Ling will show no mercy.
He won’t make the mistake of hesitating due to soft-heartedness, only to be deceived or killed in return!
Tap tap!
Ding Ling had just stepped over the threshold of the ruined temple.
"Benefactor, please, please wait a moment."
Lin Zhennan’s slightly anxious voice called from behind.
Ding Ling didn’t stop.
"Benefactor."
Lin Zhennan seemed to muster his courage:
"Our family is very wealthy, and I can provide you with a large amount of Great Medicine for your cultivation."
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling paused his step.
Seeing his words were effective, Lin Zhennan breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly continued:
"Our Lin Family’s Fuwei Escort Agency has branches in many prosperous areas. Business is booming, and wealth flows in abundantly—it’s no joke.
As long as I throw enough silver around and use our escort agency’s established paths, we can purchase plenty of Great Medicine from some rural villagers or various shopkeepers across the land.
If these Great Medicines are used properly, I believe they will definitely be useful to you, Benefactor."
These words hit the nail on the head for Ding Ling.
After arriving in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, he had considered developing a power base to purchase Great Medicine, Martial Arts Secret Manuals, Academic Secret Manuals, and so on.
But to develop a powerful influence spanning Jiuzhou out of thin air in a short time?
How difficult is that?
Short-term, Ding Ling had no solution.
And after the battle with Yu Canghai,
he had a rough understanding of his own combat power.
"In the Three Kingdoms World, a Super-Elite Fierce General-level expert is comparable to a First-class Inner Power master in this The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World."

"And my four-dimensional attributes are much stronger than a Super-Elite Peak Fierce General. Plus, I have cultivated Inner Strength. So my combat power should be comparable to a First-class Supreme expert in this world!"
In that case.
Was Yu Canghai actually a First-class Supreme expert?
Ding Ling was surprised.
Reading novels and watching TV dramas, no matter how you look at it, this Yu the Dwarf doesn’t have the strength of a First-class Supreme.
But thinking about it, this is a world based on references from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer novels, movies, TV dramas, games, etc.
Ding Ling felt at ease.
You can’t just compare it outright with the TV series of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
This is not a TV drama.
Some subtle changes are only natural.
"Benefactor, Benefactor..."
Lin Zhennan’s voice sounded.
Ding Ling pulled himself out of his thoughts and turned to look at the Lin family of three.
Madam Lin, a lady of a well-bred house and virtuous, looked at him with awe.
Lin Pingzhi, like a startled rabbit, cowered behind Lin Zhennan and his wife, heads down, not daring to look ahead.
As for Lin Zhennan?
He was delighted to see Ding Ling turn around and quickly suppressed his inner fear and anxiety to earnestly say:

"Benefactor, as I, Lin Zhennan, wander the Jianghu, I take ’righteousness’ as my foundation, opening the way with ’prosperity’. Hence, I have made friends with heroes from all paths. Yet I never expected to encounter such a disastrous calamity."
He sighed, his expression slightly melancholic, pitiful, and dazed. After a moment, he steadied himself and said with some shame:

"After this incident, I have come to a complete understanding. Without absolute martial power to guard Fuwei Escort Agency, the stronger it is, the more it invites covetousness. In the end, all the hard work of a lifetime ends up being a wedding gown for others, and it’s difficult even to protect the lives of the whole family."
He looked at Ding Ling solemnly:
"I am willing to entrust Fuwei Escort Agency to you, Benefactor, to help you achieve greater martial prowess."
Ding Ling nodded, his expression slightly relaxed.
Seeing this, Lin Zhennan brightened up and immediately pulled his wife and son, Lin Pingzhi, to kneel on the ground:
"We, the Lin couple, have no other requests. We only ask that you, Benefactor, accept my son."
Lin Pingzhi looked at Lin Zhennan in shock and fear.
Obviously, he never expected his father would entrust him to a Great Demon God whom he feared and was terrified of!
"Why are you not kneeling and calling him Master?"
Lin Zhennan glared at Lin Pingzhi and reproached him.
Lin Pingzhi was dumbfounded on the spot; his father had never been so strict with him before.
"What are you standing there for?"
Lin Zhennan, hating iron for not becoming steel, was about to jump up and hit him.
His wife immediately pressed Lin Pingzhi’s head down to make him kowtow.
Ding Ling gestured:
"No need to kowtow. I don’t take disciples."
"Benefactor..."
Lin Zhennan was stunned for a moment, at a loss, repeating:
"I beg you, I have only this one son, and I have no other requests, just to learn something under your guidance..."
"Enough."
Ding Ling frowned.
Lin Zhennan immediately shut his mouth, not daring to speak again, but felt increasingly desolate, finding it hard to see any hope for the future.
Just one Yu Canghai had already disturbed the Lin Family into chaos, with the whole family barely escaping death.
What if someone stronger than Yu Canghai appeared in the future?
Thinking about it.
An oppressive cloud seemed to hang over Lin Zhennan’s heart, his face turning inexplicably mournful, his eyes extremely heavy.
Although Lin Pingzhi was terrified of Ding Ling, he was indeed clever, kind, and filial. Seeing his parents in such a state, he thought a little and understood.
He strongly suppressed his trembling and discomfort, crawled over on his knees to Ding Ling, and without hesitation, knocked his head three times, solidly:
"Master, above, please accept the bow of your pupil."
After kowtowing, he formally performed a great bow of respect to Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm
paragraphs: This happened suddenly to the extreme.
Ding Ling couldn’t even stop it in time. By the time he wanted to reach out to stop it, Lin Pingzhi had already finished kowtowing.
At this point, trying to stop it was meaningless.
Ding Ling just let it be.
At this moment, seeing him finished with the grand ceremony of bowing.
Ding Ling pondered for a moment, nodded, and said:
"Forget it, let Lin Pingzhi follow me."
Lin Zhennan was stunned, then overjoyed, quickly pulling his wife and child to bow in gratitude again.
It was truly like finding a village through the shaded willow trees after being stuck with nowhere to go!
Even more like the clouds dissipating to finally see the sun.
Lin Zhennan felt a warm current rising from his heart, a feeling of indescribable excitement and joy.
"Disciple meets Master."

Seeing his parents so excited, Lin Pingzhi noticed Ding Ling’s expression slightly eased. Although he still felt fear and awe towards Ding Ling, it was somewhat better, after all, now that the master-disciple relationship was established, as a master, it’s unlikely for him to kill his disciple, right?
Thinking like this.
Under the indication of his parents, Lin Pingzhi obediently moved behind Ding Ling, preparing to be a disciple who follows his master closely.
Ding Ling’s eye twitched twice, then let him be.
He looked at Lin Zhennan.
Lin Zhennan consciously began to introduce the property chain of the Fuwei Escort Agency.
And expressed the need to make a trip back to Fuzhou to stabilize people’s hearts and count the money and goods.
Ding Ling suspected that all the goods had been looted by the Qingcheng Sect.
Lin Zhennan said:

"The goods they looted are all placed at the Fuwei Escort Agency in Fuzhou, they didn’t have the chance to take them away. They were eager to kill you, our benefactor, so they couldn’t manage those goods."
Ding Ling understood.
For Yu Canghai.
The primary task was the Exorcism Sword Manual.
The secondary task was to seize the wealth of the Fuwei Escort Agency.
The player confidently vouched with his name that Ding Ling had taken the Exorcism Sword Manual, Yu Canghai, in doubt, will surely take action.
But did Lin Zhennan and his wife not know this?
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Yet he didn’t ask.
He had already learned this Exorcism Sword Manual and was considering finding a suitable opportunity to give it to Lin Pingzhi to handle.
Thinking like this, Ding Ling prepared to return to Fuzhou with Lin Zhennan and others, and then turn to the northwest.
According to Lin Zhennan.
In the lands of Mount Heng in the northwest.
They also had a branch of the Fuwei Escort Agency there.
A recent batch of Great Medicine was to be transported there, and it’s necessary to fetch it.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, recalling the issue of Liu Zhengfeng’s ’Golden Basin Hand Washing’ meeting in the Mount Heng Sect.
He stayed in Fuzhou for a day.
Then Ding Ling took Lin Pingzhi and Lin Zhennan’s letter of authority to the territory of the Mount Heng Sect.

The Fuwei Escort Agency in Fuzhou had Lin Zhennan in charge, and with Ding Ling appearing, and sweeping away the Qingcheng Sect disciples who were harming other escort masters in Fuzhou City with the speed of lightning, it invigorated the people’s hearts and stabilized the situation!
Lin Zhennan and his wife were extremely grateful for this.
Lin Pingzhi’s recognition of Ding Ling also rapidly increased.
He was originally someone who was outwardly gentle but inwardly resolute, extremely pure and filial.
But being a flower nurtured in the greenhouse, he appeared somewhat fragile.
Within these few days of ups and downs, frequently experiencing life and death, and coming into contact with bloody matters, it was a sufficiently huge and profound blow to him.
He slowly grew from his initial fear, unease, and anxiety.
Now, he no longer had intense fear towards Ding Ling, but was full of respect and admiration.
Basically, whatever Ding Ling said.
He would obediently do it without questioning or denial.
The speed of his growth was extremely exaggerated.
Ding Ling was quite pleased.
Very deserving of being a character from the later stages of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World who can hunt Yu Canghai and Mu Gaofeng down.
This is a true man who can go to great lengths to benefit himself!
In this regard, Ding Ling couldn’t help but admire him.
All the way toward Mount Heng.
Ding Ling taught Lin Pingzhi as they walked.
He found that Lin Pingzhi’s progress in cultivating Inner Power was rather slow, but when it came to the Breathing Technique, he progressed rapidly.
He was secretly puzzled and thought to himself:
"Could Lin Pingzhi be naturally suited to cultivating the Exorcism Sword Manual, and other Techniques are unsuitable?"
How exactly it was.
The result was unknown at the moment.
But since Lin Pingzhi was suited to the Breathing Technique, Ding Ling stopped teaching him the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill in favor of teaching him the Sword God Breathing Technique.
This is the pinnacle External Refining Breathing Technique in the Three Kingdoms World.

With someone like Ding Ling, who had reached the Transformation Realm in Breathing Technique, guiding Lin Pingzhi, his cultivation and comprehension naturally progressed at a phenomenal pace, with almost no obstacles in existence.
Lin Pingzhi also sensed this, becoming more and more excited, and was very diligent and proactive in doing miscellaneous work, not looking at all like a young master from a prestigious family.
One day.
Ding Ling inquired what other Kung Fu Lin Pingzhi knew.
Lin Pingzhi proactively talked about the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship, and at the end said:
"Compared to the Moon Shadow Swordsmanship taught by you Master, the Exorcism Swordsmanship is too ordinary."
After Lin Pingzhi’s family learned that the letter was sent by Ding Ling.
They became increasingly respectful and recognizing of Ding Ling.
This also led to the swift dissolution of Lin Pingzhi’s fear towards Ding Ling.
It turns out that Ding Ling was trying to save their family from the start, but they were too blind to recognize a distinguished person.
Naturally, Lin Zhennan’s family felt regret, embarrassment, and shame about this. While becoming more enthusiastic about Ding Ling, they also apologized several times.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded indifferently and said:
"Besides the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship, what other Martial Arts do you know?"
"I also know the ancestral Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm."
"Demonstrate it once. Recite the mantra as well."
"Yes, Master."
Lin Pingzhi solemnly replied.
Then he began to demonstrate it meticulously.
The mantra was recited step by step as well.
Regarding the degree of mastery over the Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm, Lin Pingzhi was evidently only at an entry-level, full of flaws as soon as Ding Ling glanced at it.
Such a palm technique.
Even an ordinary third-rate expert could easily break it!
But Ding Ling did not underestimate this palm technique, given it was mastered by Lin Yuantu from the Lin family - a formidable individual.
After Lin Pingzhi finished explaining once, he stood aside, looking at Ding Ling, asking if he needed to demonstrate again.
Ding Ling shook his head, closed his eyes slightly.
A moment of reflection.
The library then condensed a book.
In an instant.
[Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
In the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling comprehensively mastered this palm technique.
With the palm technique entering into mastery.
What surprised Ding Ling was that this Flipping Heaven Palm was actually a high-tier palm technique.
Need to know that the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship was a genuinely low-tier Sword Technique, offering no attribute growth to Ding Ling, only adding some foundation.
Yet the Flipping Heaven Palm could increase attributes.
This could definitely be seen as a top-tier palm technique.

The descendants of the Lin family did not hone this palm technique to perfection, instead devoting themselves to practicing the Exorcism Swordsmanship with which Lin Yuantu gained fame across the world!

Basically, whatever Ding Ling said.
He would obediently do it without questioning or denial.
The speed of his growth was extremely exaggerated.
Ding Ling was quite pleased.
Very deserving of being a character from the later stages of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World who can hunt Yu Canghai and Mu Gaofeng down.
This is a true man who can go to great lengths to benefit himself!
In this regard, Ding Ling couldn’t help but admire him.
All the way toward Mount Heng.
Ding Ling taught Lin Pingzhi as they walked.
He found that Lin Pingzhi’s progress in cultivating Inner Power was rather slow, but when it came to the Breathing Technique, he progressed rapidly.
He was secretly puzzled and thought to himself:
"Could Lin Pingzhi be naturally suited to cultivating the Exorcism Sword Manual, and other Techniques are unsuitable?"
How exactly it was.
The result was unknown at the moment.
But since Lin Pingzhi was suited to the Breathing Technique, Ding Ling stopped teaching him the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill in favor of teaching him the Sword God Breathing Technique.
This is the pinnacle External Refining Breathing Technique in the Three Kingdoms World.

With someone like Ding Ling, who had reached the Transformation Realm in Breathing Technique, guiding Lin Pingzhi, his cultivation and comprehension naturally progressed at a phenomenal pace, with almost no obstacles in existence.
Lin Pingzhi also sensed this, becoming more and more excited, and was very diligent and proactive in doing miscellaneous work, not looking at all like a young master from a prestigious family.
One day.
Ding Ling inquired what other Kung Fu Lin Pingzhi knew.
Lin Pingzhi proactively talked about the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship, and at the end said:
"Compared to the Moon Shadow Swordsmanship taught by you Master, the Exorcism Swordsmanship is too ordinary."
After Lin Pingzhi’s family learned that the letter was sent by Ding Ling.
They became increasingly respectful and recognizing of Ding Ling.
This also led to the swift dissolution of Lin Pingzhi’s fear towards Ding Ling.
It turns out that Ding Ling was trying to save their family from the start, but they were too blind to recognize a distinguished person.
Naturally, Lin Zhennan’s family felt regret, embarrassment, and shame about this.
While becoming more enthusiastic about Ding Ling, they also apologized several times.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded indifferently and said:
"Besides the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship, what other Martial Arts do you know?"
"I also know the ancestral Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm."
"Demonstrate it once.
Recite the mantra as well."
"Yes, Master."
Lin Pingzhi solemnly replied.
Then he began to demonstrate it meticulously.
The mantra was recited step by step as well.
Regarding the degree of mastery over the Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm, Lin Pingzhi was evidently only at an entry-level, full of flaws as soon as Ding Ling glanced at it.
Such a palm technique.
Even an ordinary third-rate expert could easily break it!
But Ding Ling did not underestimate this palm technique, given it was mastered by Lin Yuantu from the Lin family - a formidable individual.
After Lin Pingzhi finished explaining once, he stood aside, looking at Ding Ling, asking if he needed to demonstrate again.
Ding Ling shook his head, closed his eyes slightly.
A moment of reflection.
The library then condensed a book.
In an instant.
[Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
In the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling comprehensively mastered this palm technique.
With the palm technique entering into mastery.
What surprised Ding Ling was that this Flipping Heaven Palm was actually a high-tier palm technique.
Need to know that the Seventy-Two Paths of Exorcism Swordsmanship was a genuinely low-tier Sword Technique, offering no attribute growth to Ding Ling, only adding some foundation.
Yet the Flipping Heaven Palm could increase attributes.
This could definitely be seen as a top-tier palm technique.

The descendants of the Lin family did not hone this palm technique to perfection, instead devoting themselves to practicing the Exorcism Swordsmanship with which Lin Yuantu gained fame across the world!

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Arrival at Mount Heng! Escort Agency Branch (14/15)
paragraphs: It can be said that the balance was misplaced.

If the descendants of the Lin Family had trained in this palm technique daily from the start, they definitely wouldn’t have been slaughtered so miserably by Yu Canghai and his men. They would have had some power to resist.
Yet they crumbled like clay chickens and pottery dogs under the attack of the Qingcheng Sect’s members.
This shows that they were neglectful in their cultivation of the Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm!
Not only Lin Pingzhi was neglectful, but his father Lin Zhennan must have been the same.
Bang!
Ding Ling suddenly opened his eyes, flicked his wrist, and a flurry of palm shadows filled the air, densely packed, spreading throughout the void. As Ding Ling struck to one side, boom!
The many palm shadows merged into one, transforming into a mountain that descended upon the earth with a thunderous bang!
With a loud crash, it caused half of a hillside to collapse!
Lin Pingzhi was dumbstruck as he watched all this, his mouth agape, unable to close it for quite a while.

When Ding Ling withdrew his palm, mounted his horse, and signaled for him to continue on the journey, it was only then that Lin Pingzhi seemed to snap back to reality. He quickly leapt onto his mount and anxiously questioned:
"Master, master, was that the Heaven-Flipping Palm from my Lin Family just now?"
"That’s right."
"Master, did you know this Heaven-Flipping Palm before?"
"No."
"So you mean, Master, you just learned it just now?!"
Lin Pingzhi asked in shock and disbelief.
"That’s right."
Ding Ling appeared calm and unruffled:
"Is there something strange about that?"
At a loss for words, Lin Pingzhi felt his worldview shatter, questioning his life:
"Is the Heaven-Flipping Palm of my Lin Family that easy to learn?! Or is it that my talent and aptitude are so poor, I’ve never found the way into its mastery?!"
Thinking about the power of the Heaven-Flipping Palm just now.
He felt a burning desire yet also some frustration.
He had been training in the Heaven-Flipping Palm for years, yet he always found it difficult to progress.
He was self-aware enough to know that without guidance, even if he practiced for another ten years, his Heaven-Flipping Palm could never reach Ding Ling’s level of Transformation Realm.
And how long had Ding Ling been learning the Heaven-Flipping Palm?!
Comparing the two.
Lin Pingzhi instantly felt like a nobody!
The ’master image’ in his heart, already towering, was elevated even higher, reaching an immeasurable level of profundity and mystery!
"Master. Have you always been this quick in your martial arts training?"
Lin Pingzhi suppressed the turmoil in his heart and asked.
"That’s right."
This cannot be hidden.
After all, so many players know about it.
"So, it’s not that the Heaven-Flipping Palm is easy to learn, but that you’re incredibly skilled, Master?!"
Lin Pingzhi was shaken, awed, and impressed.
"Hehe.
Ding Ling chuckled softly, without saying much, just thinking: It’s not me that’s amazing; it’s the automatic full-level cheats that are amazing!
And so began the day.
Lin Pingzhi’s admiration for Ding Ling grew increasingly fervent.
At one point, he seemed to be careening down the path of a ’superfan’.
Because no matter in martial arts or other aspects, Ding Ling was proficient in everything, understood everything, and knew everything!
Lin Pingzhi was in awe, wanting to ask Ding Ling if there was anything he didn’t know. Too incredible.
Truly an All-Purpose King!
And after learning Ding Ling’s approximate age, he was even more ashamed to the point of wishing to vanish.
He felt like he’d wasted all those years of his life!
He knew his talent couldn’t compare to Ding Ling’s.
So he could only practice the Breathing Technique and Sword Technique diligently.
Hoping that hard work could make up for his inadequacies.
Traveling along the way.
Guidance along the way.
Lin Pingzhi progressed rapidly, and his understanding of the Breathing Technique became increasingly powerful.
At this point, if a herbal bath were used together with the practice.
His physical quality would undoubtedly improve rapidly.
In the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, where the general physical condition is poor, Ding Ling, with his Breathing Technique cultivated to a perfect level, was an anomaly!
Not only was his defense extremely high, but his immense strength and incredible endurance also made him tireless.
Staying awake for days and nights, he didn’t feel the slightest fatigue.
While Lin Pingzhi was amazed, he also became increasingly eager.

He felt that the longer he stayed with Ding Ling, the more he felt like an underachiever, and he didn’t want to become a useless burden. He hoped someday to face Yu Canghai and have the ability to defeat him! To avenge the deep hatred of Fuzhou!
On this day.
The two rode into the Mount Heng Territory, heading straight for the branch of the Fuwei Escort Agency.
The branch was in a small town.
Not far from the Mount Heng Sect.
It was said that the place of Liu Zhengfeng’s Golden Basin Hand Washing was right here.
Ding Ling had no intention of joining the excitement.
He directly entered the branch office and ordered them to bring out the Great Medicine.
With Lin Pingzhi, the Young Leader, and Lin Zhennan’s token, the people guarding this branch dared not speak much, obediently bringing out all the Great Medicines, herbs, and so on.
Immediately, Ding Ling prepared a medicinal bath for Lin Pingzhi.
Lin Pingzhi refused, saying:
"These are all for you to use, Master. I cannot use up these resources."
"Hehe."
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"Now, Great Medicine below a hundred-year vintage is basically useless to me. Feel free to use it."
This was indeed the truth.
In the Three Kingdoms world.
Even two-hundred-year-old Great Medicine was basically useless to Ding Ling, not to mention hundred-year-old ones.
Now, perhaps a hundred-year vintage might be useful to him.
Because Ding Ling had thought of cultivating Inner Power, which might require the aid of Great Medicine.
The Great Medicine in the Three Kingdoms world contained Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi.
The Great Medicine in this world must also contain Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi!
Absorbing and refining Great Medicine can directly turn Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi to one’s advantage to a certain extent.
Ding Ling cultivating Inner Power might also utilize this Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi, since his Inner Power is all at full level, the efficiency of refining and absorbing is extraordinary!
"This... "
Lin Pingzhi hesitated for a moment before nodding.
Ding Ling immediately had him go to practice the Breathing Technique.
He himself directly chewed on the Great Medicine.
He was consuming Great Medicine of approximately a two-hundred-year vintage.
Crunch, crunch, consuming one plant.
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
The four-dimensional attributes increased simultaneously and were extremely balanced!
The four Breathing Techniques operated simultaneously, refining, absorbing, and utilizing the potency of the medicine to his advantage.
The utilization rate and refining efficiency of the Great Medicine were pushed to the extreme.
He had just consumed the Great Medicine.
And it was immediately refined.
"Indeed, it’s useful."
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly, carefully sensing:
"Moreover, the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi contained within the two-hundred-year-old Great Medicine in this world far exceed that of the Three Kingdoms world."
You must know that in the Three Kingdoms world, consuming two-hundred-year Great Medicine was almost useless to Ding Ling!
But in this world, the four dimensions simultaneously increased once again.
He pondered secretly:
"In that case, the hundred-year vintage might also be useful to me?"
He picked up a hundred-year-old plant and consumed it.
As soon as he finished consuming it, it was immediately refined.
The sensation of heat was extremely rapid.
Yet it quickly dissipated, and no information prompts appeared, until Ding Ling consumed four consecutive hundred-year-old Great Medicines.
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
The prompt appeared once more.
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
"Even hundred-year-old Great Medicine is useful to me, but I wonder what the upper limit of this world is. To what extent can my four-dimensional attributes be improved?"

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Power Surge! Gushe Divine Lady (15/15)
paragraphs: Ding Ling was filled with anticipation.
He tried consuming the Great Medicine, aged several decades, but the efficacy was extremely thin. To achieve any effect, he might have to consume an unknown number of these, truly a waste.
It would be better to give it to Lin Pingzhi.
Therefore, Ding Ling only consumed those Great Medicines that were over a century old.
He consumed more than eighty of the hundred-year-old ones.
Attribute Points increase:
[Strength +1.5]
[Agility +1.5]
[Constitution +1.5]
[Defense +1.5]
The more he consumed.
The weaker the efficacy became.
After consuming over eighty of the hundred-year-old ones.
Ding Ling could feel that even hundred-year-old ones had only a negligible effect on him now.
However, the increase of 1.5 points simultaneously in the four-dimensional attributes was a pleasant surprise for Ding Ling.
He laughed heartily in his heart, thinking:

"Lin Zhennan’s gift is certainly timely! It seems my earlier decision to accept Lin Pingzhi and cooperate with the Fuwei Escort Agency was extremely wise. Otherwise, relying on my own efforts alone, who knows how long it would take to gather so much Great Medicine."
After finishing the hundred-year-old Great Medicine.
Ding Ling moved on to the two-hundred-year-old ones.
A total of 30 stalks.
Again, the more he consumed, the weaker the efficacy became.
But even so.
The increase in the four-dimensional attributes was far superior to that of the hundred-year-old great medicines.
After finishing them.
Ding Ling checked the increase in his four-dimensional attributes:
[Strength +2.4]
[Agility +2.4]
[Constitution +2.4]
[Defense +2.4]
"Very good."
Ding Ling clenched his fist, feeling a terrifying power swirling unpredictably in his fist, as if it might burst forth like a dam releasing a flood at any moment.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
Strength: [Aptitude 2 (ordinary human is 1 point), Intelligence 3, Strength 35.3, Agility 35.4, Constitution 35.3, Defense 35.1, Charisma 11. Inner Power Value: 20]
Previously, attributes like strength were all 31.
Then improvements in Pine Wind Swordsmanship, Heaven-Flipping Palm, and others added some growth.
And now, with the assistance of so much Great Medicine.
Directly causing a massive surge in Strength, Agility, Constitution, and Defense attribute points!
Reaching a terrifying over 35 points!
To such an extent.
Ding Ling’s strength had exceeded 3,500 pounds, each move seemed to contain the power to support the sky.
"In the Three Kingdoms World, 31 points was the maximum limit, unable to go further. But this world directly reaches 35 points!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"If I were to go to the Three Kingdoms World now, with this overwhelming strength, and the added blessing of Celestial Might, could I easily defeat Zuo Ci?"
Even Ding Ling wasn’t entirely sure.
After all, Zuo Ci also had the blessing of Celestial Might and the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor, which is too mystical and miraculous!
"If I had learned the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor..."
Ding Ling shook his head, not dwelling on it.

Zuo Ci was unlikely to hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor to him, and Nanhua Old Immortal was nowhere to be found. Ding Ling reckoned either he flew to a mysterious world or he died of old age.
But Ding Ling is virtually immortal in the Three Kingdoms World, how could the legendary Nanhua Old Immortal be dead? So, most likely Nanhua Old Immortal has flown to immortality.
Just don’t know which world he flew off to?
Ding Ling steadied himself, suppressing the complicated thoughts, and walked out of the inner storage of herbs, directly heading to find Lin Pingzhi.
The business of the Fuwei Escort Agency, with its store of Great Medicine, all have a hundred to two hundred years of age.
It’s said there are a few over two hundred years old but appear to be still on the way, needing some time to reach here.
Ding Ling chose to wait.
Of course, he also hoped to acquire such Great Medicine elsewhere.
But where could it be obtained?
Imperial Palace?
To break in directly?
Or take another path?

Ding Ling shook his head, not considering it much, the waters of the Imperial Palace run deep, who knows if there are eunuchs inside proficient in martial arts and have practiced the Sunflower Manual!
If there are eunuchs who practiced similar techniques, Ding Ling might not make it out.
Ding Ling instructed Lin Pingzhi in his cultivation smoothly.
On the same day.
After Lin Pingzhi finished a section of his training.
Under the arrangement of the sub-branch manager, Ding Ling and Lin Pingzhi prepared to have dinner.
Suddenly, a clear voice came from the side:
"Who is Ding Ling?"
The voice was sonorous and powerful, extremely iron-blooded and overbearing, imbued with the meaning of military might.
Just by hearing the voice.
One could tell the visitor was no ordinary person.
Ding Ling felt a chill in his heart, looking toward the sound, only to see in the courtyard to the left front, someone standing at the top of a peach tree.
This person had a graceful figure, wearing magnificent clothes made of red silk, wholly splendid, like a fairy rose descending to the mortal world.
Her face was covered by a veil.
Specific features were not visible.
But her elegantly curved eyebrows and a pair of almond eyes were visible outside, in a sidelong glance, she exuded grace and elegance, commanding attention and admiration!
Ding Ling saw such a woman for the first time.
Different from Diao Chan’s heroic air.
Her aura was grand, overbearing, and stunningly worldly!
Much like an Empress overlooking the mortal world, a female immortal looking down upon the mundane.
"Who are you?!"
Lin Pingzhi was also stunned, having never seen such a captivating woman, but he was not overly enchanted, quickly regaining his composure, he demanded:
"This is a private residence, how dare you intrude?"
"Seems you’re Ding Ling."
The woman, by just listening to Lin Pingzhi’s voice, seemed to discern who Ding Ling was, with her almond eyes turned, she looked at Ding Ling and smiled:
"I roam the world and heard that the Void Shatterer Ding Ling came to our world. Curious, I came to see, now it seems, you’re nothing extraordinary."
"My master has profound knowledge, with skills as vast as the heavens. Your lack of understanding and your ignorance of the specifics, while prattling nonsense here! Don’t you feel foolish?"
Lin Pingzhi shouted, vigorously defending Ding Ling.
Meanwhile, he was secretly shocked: His master had arrived in this world by shattering the void?!
He marveled: No wonder his master learned everything so quickly! So he had been a terrestrial immortal before!
While relieved, he felt more admiration and worship toward Ding Ling!
And sincere happiness!
Such a divine being is Lin Pingzhi’s master!!
What an honor, what luck!
"Heh."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly:
"To have a friend visit from afar, isn’t that delightful? Friend, if you’re not averse to it, come down and join us for a meal."
"Alright!"
That woman didn’t seem to understand reserve.
She actually responded and leaped down from the top of the peach tree, like a Fairy descending to the mortal world, walking on air, lightly landing in front of Ding Ling and his group.
From the top of the peach tree to in front of Ding Ling and others, her speed was as swift as wind, yet her form was exceptionally elegant and beautiful!
Landing without a sound.
Appearing to tread midair with lotus blossoms beneath each step.
Walking on air, yet not disrupting her elegance!
Ding Ling watched with a silent shock, this was a peerless expert!
In the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, a woman with such lightweight skill would definitely not be an unremarkable individual.
Who exactly is she?!
Upon close inspection of this woman.
She possessed eyes like limpid autumn waters, with a divine and ethereal appearance, seeming like the Gushe Divine Lady who stepped out from time and space into this courtyard.

[Defense +2.4]
"Very good."
Ding Ling clenched his fist, feeling a terrifying power swirling unpredictably in his fist, as if it might burst forth like a dam releasing a flood at any moment.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
Strength: [Aptitude 2 (ordinary human is 1 point), Intelligence 3, Strength 35.3, Agility 35.4, Constitution 35.3, Defense 35.1, Charisma 11.
Inner Power Value: 20]
Previously, attributes like strength were all 31.
Then improvements in Pine Wind Swordsmanship, Heaven-Flipping Palm, and others added some growth.
And now, with the assistance of so much Great Medicine.
Directly causing a massive surge in Strength, Agility, Constitution, and Defense attribute points!
Reaching a terrifying over 35 points!
To such an extent.
Ding Ling’s strength had exceeded 3,500 pounds, each move seemed to contain the power to support the sky.
"In the Three Kingdoms World, 31 points was the maximum limit, unable to go further.
But this world directly reaches 35 points!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"If I were to go to the Three Kingdoms World now, with this overwhelming strength, and the added blessing of Celestial Might, could I easily defeat Zuo Ci?"
Even Ding Ling wasn’t entirely sure.
After all, Zuo Ci also had the blessing of Celestial Might and the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor, which is too mystical and miraculous!
"If I had learned the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor..."
Ding Ling shook his head, not dwelling on it.
Zuo Ci was unlikely to hand over the Heavenly Book of Escape Armor to him, and Nanhua Old Immortal was nowhere to be found.
Ding Ling reckoned either he flew to a mysterious world or he died of old age.
But Ding Ling is virtually immortal in the Three Kingdoms World, how could the legendary Nanhua Old Immortal be dead?
So, most likely Nanhua Old Immortal has flown to immortality.
Just don’t know which world he flew off to?
Ding Ling steadied himself, suppressing the complicated thoughts, and walked out of the inner storage of herbs, directly heading to find Lin Pingzhi.
The business of the Fuwei Escort Agency, with its store of Great Medicine, all have a hundred to two hundred years of age.
It’s said there are a few over two hundred years old but appear to be still on the way, needing some time to reach here.
Ding Ling chose to wait.
Of course, he also hoped to acquire such Great Medicine elsewhere.
But where could it be obtained?
Imperial Palace?
To break in directly?
Or take another path?

Ding Ling shook his head, not considering it much, the waters of the Imperial Palace run deep, who knows if there are eunuchs inside proficient in martial arts and have practiced the Sunflower Manual!
If there are eunuchs who practiced similar techniques, Ding Ling might not make it out.
Ding Ling instructed Lin Pingzhi in his cultivation smoothly.
On the same day.
After Lin Pingzhi finished a section of his training.
Under the arrangement of the sub-branch manager, Ding Ling and Lin Pingzhi prepared to have dinner.
Suddenly, a clear voice came from the side:
"Who is Ding Ling?"
The voice was sonorous and powerful, extremely iron-blooded and overbearing, imbued with the meaning of military might.
Just by hearing the voice.
One could tell the visitor was no ordinary person.
Ding Ling felt a chill in his heart, looking toward the sound, only to see in the courtyard to the left front, someone standing at the top of a peach tree.
This person had a graceful figure, wearing magnificent clothes made of red silk, wholly splendid, like a fairy rose descending to the mortal world.
Her face was covered by a veil.
Specific features were not visible.
But her elegantly curved eyebrows and a pair of almond eyes were visible outside, in a sidelong glance, she exuded grace and elegance, commanding attention and admiration!
Ding Ling saw such a woman for the first time.
Different from Diao Chan’s heroic air.
Her aura was grand, overbearing, and stunningly worldly!
Much like an Empress overlooking the mortal world, a female immortal looking down upon the mundane.
"Who are you?!"
Lin Pingzhi was also stunned, having never seen such a captivating woman, but he was not overly enchanted, quickly regaining his composure, he demanded:
"This is a private residence, how dare you intrude?"
"Seems you’re Ding Ling."
The woman, by just listening to Lin Pingzhi’s voice, seemed to discern who Ding Ling was, with her almond eyes turned, she looked at Ding Ling and smiled:
"I roam the world and heard that the Void Shatterer Ding Ling came to our world.
Curious, I came to see, now it seems, you’re nothing extraordinary."
"My master has profound knowledge, with skills as vast as the heavens.
Your lack of understanding and your ignorance of the specifics, while prattling nonsense here!
Don’t you feel foolish?"
Lin Pingzhi shouted, vigorously defending Ding Ling.
Meanwhile, he was secretly shocked: His master had arrived in this world by shattering the void?!
He marveled: No wonder his master learned everything so quickly!
So he had been a terrestrial immortal before!
While relieved, he felt more admiration and worship toward Ding Ling!
And sincere happiness!
Such a divine being is Lin Pingzhi’s master!!
What an honor, what luck!
"Heh."
Ding Ling chuckled lightly:
"To have a friend visit from afar, isn’t that delightful?
Friend, if you’re not averse to it, come down and join us for a meal."
"Alright!"
That woman didn’t seem to understand reserve.
She actually responded and leaped down from the top of the peach tree, like a Fairy descending to the mortal world, walking on air, lightly landing in front of Ding Ling and his group.
From the top of the peach tree to in front of Ding Ling and others, her speed was as swift as wind, yet her form was exceptionally elegant and beautiful!
Landing without a sound.
Appearing to tread midair with lotus blossoms beneath each step.
Walking on air, yet not disrupting her elegance!
Ding Ling watched with a silent shock, this was a peerless expert!
In the world of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, a woman with such lightweight skill would definitely not be an unremarkable individual.
Who exactly is she?!
Upon close inspection of this woman.
She possessed eyes like limpid autumn waters, with a divine and ethereal appearance, seeming like the Gushe Divine Lady who stepped out from time and space into this courtyard.

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Is She Dongfang Bubai? (1/11)
paragraphs: The arrival of the woman.
Made the courtyard glow, brightening considerably.
Lin Pingzhi was once again stunned. When he caught sight of the woman’s half-smiling eyes, his face flushed with embarrassment, and he hastily turned his head away.
Ding Ling, however, after a moment of amazement, remained calm and indifferent.

His acting skills were at full level, and at this moment, he subtly conveyed an air of supreme grandmaster, his gaze as calm as an ancient well when looking at the woman, no different from looking at any ordinary woman.
The woman seemed to be observed in such a manner for the first time and couldn’t help being taken aback; this time, she appeared much more solemn, sizing up Ding Ling and exclaiming:
"In all the world, you’re the first person to disregard my allure!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"I wouldn’t say disregard, seeing you for the first time also brightened my eyes; you indeed are different from ordinary women."
"Is that so?"
The woman said ambiguously, folding her arms and looking at Ding Ling.
She was over seven feet tall, her stature not inferior to a heroic man, and with her graceful figure, from a distance she appeared to be tall and elegant, standing out prominently.
At this moment, she was looking into Ding Ling’s eyes.
Ding Ling’s eyes were deep and calm, like an unfathomable abyss staring at a mortal.
Her gaze was grand and majestic, like a stormy wave surging.
However, after a few moments of eye contact with Ding Ling, she seemed a bit overwhelmed, retreating two steps, her gaze slightly unnatural.
As if to disguise her awkwardness, she laughed aloud:
"As expected of the Void Shatterer, it seems I underestimated you before. Come."
She gestured:
"How about we exchange a few moves?"
"Can I refuse?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
"Of course."
The woman laughed and said:

"But it’s best not to. I traveled a thousand miles, rushing to this Mount Heng Territory, just to compete with you, to witness the pinnacle of Martial Dao, if you refuse. Wouldn’t that make my trip in vain?"
"We didn’t invite you here."
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but retort.
"Indeed."
The woman was momentarily stunned and laughed:
"I came presumptuously. How about this."
She took out a secret manual from her bosom:
"This is the Wudang Sect’s Tai Chi Scripture. It’s a secret manual personally written by Taoist Zhang Sanfeng in his later years! It’s priceless."
She looked at Ding Ling, her eyes charming, as if speaking:
"As long as you can defeat me, Ding Ling, I will give you this Tai Chi Scripture.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was moved.
If it really is the Tai Chi Scripture. It truly is a supreme treasure.
It’s just...
How could the Tai Chi Scripture be in this woman’s hands?
Moreover, this is a transmission secret technique of the Wudang Sect.
Ding Ling recalled a story from the novel "The Smiling, Proud Wanderer," and couldn’t help but look deeply at the woman.
If he’s not mistaken.
The woman before him is likely Dongfang Bubai!
Besides the Wudang Sect, it seems only the Sun and Moon Divine Sect has the Tai Chi Scripture!
At least that’s the case in this world.
And the Wudang Sect wouldn’t gamble with such an inherited treasure.
There is only one possibility, the woman before him is from the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
And who in the Sun and Moon Divine Sect could casually use such a valuable treasure as a wager?
It’s easy to guess this with a bit of thought.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling’s heart tensed, becoming solemn.
He never expected.
To meet Dongfang Bubai so much earlier!
He originally planned to practice enough martial arts before competing with Dongfang Bubai, but unexpectedly, this person was so curious and traveled a thousand miles to see him, the Void Shatterer!
’No doubt, it’s due to players exaggerating tremendously.’
Ding Ling thought:

’Only players would boast to great extents. Besides, some players are my devoted fans, and they’ve personally witnessed my exploits in the Three Kingdoms World. If Dongfang Bubai inquired, they might indeed describe everything in vivid, exaggerated details.
Initially, Dongfang Bubai might not believe it.
But if three people say so.
If three hundred or three thousand people all say so.
She would definitely be skeptical, leading her to take action!
If not for this, how could I possibly encounter her here!’
Ding Ling was clear-minded.
After understanding the reasoning, he no longer hesitated and readily agreed:
"Alright! I can spar with you. I just don’t know what wager I need to make?"
"You don’t need to make any."
The woman laughed and said:
"I came looking for you. If you were looking for me, I might have required something from you. That would seem fair, don’t you think?"
Ding Ling was speechless.
The woman before him, her eyes and brows radiated femininity; although her appearance was hidden, her voice, eyes, and figure were unparalleled, surpassing all ordinary women.
Such a beauty!
No matter how you look at it, she doesn’t seem like a man who self-castrated to practice the Sunflower Manual!
The more Ding Ling observed the woman before him, the more he felt she was charming and exceedingly beautiful.
When he realized his thoughts.
Ding Ling broke out in a cold sweat, thinking to himself:
"Is the Sunflower Manual really so insidious? It almost captivated someone like me!"
Falling for a self-castrated man.
It’s absolutely unacceptable for Ding Ling!
Coming to his senses.
He immediately dismissed all distracting thoughts, flipped his wrist, and launched the Heaven-Flipping Palm:
"Let’s compete in palm techniques, please instruct me."
"Alright."
The woman responded loudly:
"My name is Bai Wushuang. A wanderer of the Jianghu! Today, I will personally witness the Void Shatterer’s skills. Watch your palm!"
As she finished speaking.
She struck a palm toward Ding Ling.
This palm strike seemed unremarkable at first, but upon closer inspection, the palm shadows were endless, and amidst her flying hands, white lotuses appeared to have been formed.
The white lotuses turned into raging waves, pressing toward Ding Ling’s chest following the palm shadows.
Ding Ling, unwilling to be outdone, similarly countered with a palm strike, aiming for her palm.
This strike encapsulated the essence of the Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm!
Along with the amplification from four breathing techniques, the power, physique, and agility displayed their might together.
This made the Heaven-Flipping Palm not only amazingly fast but also extremely aggressive, like thunder and lightning, each palm strike into the void made even the void seem to shudder.
As countless palm shadows descended, they seemed to transform into a massive mountain, pressing down on the lotus palm shadows produced by Bai Wushuang.
Boom!
Rumble!
The two engaged in a fast-paced battle.
Neither gaining the upper hand in speed, both reaching the utmost limit.
To others watching.
They could only see shadows moving rapidly across the void, and by the time they looked again, their hands were already striking heavily together.
Each and every clash.
Resounded with explosive sounds in the void!

Lin Pingzhi, being weak in martial arts, felt his eardrums about to be pierced by the explosive sound, and with a horrified expression, he retreated more than ten steps before deliberately turning away to watch from a distance.
Only watching from afar did it feel somewhat better.

chapters.title: Chapter 295: The Promise! Rematch in Six Months (2/11)
paragraphs: In his heart, Lin Pingzhi admired secretly, but also grew increasingly curious about Bai Wushuang’s identity.
To casually bring out the Wudang Sect’s Tai Chi Scripture.
And to possess such astonishing skills, truly unfathomable and hard to grasp!
During the time he traveled the Jianghu with Ding Ling.
Through Ding Ling’s teachings.
Lin Pingzhi was no longer a frog at the bottom of the well; it was because he had seen the views atop peaks that he was so shaken, growing more amazed by Bai Wushuang.
Of course, he always held Ding Ling in great esteem, and at this moment, his admiration and reverence reached its peak.
It was because Lin Pingzhi realized he had underestimated Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was far stronger than he had imagined.
That fierce, vigorous palm wind, was it really the Heaven-Flipping Palm of his Lin Family?!
If he had mastered such a Heaven-Flipping Palm, how could he have been bullied by someone like Yu Canghai?!
Thinking of this.
He felt both bitter and ashamed. The Heaven-Flipping Palm passed down through the Lin Family, Ding Ling learned to mastery just by watching once, and he?
The difference was simply incomparable!
Especially seeing Ding Ling, using the Heaven-Flipping Palm, reaching a level of consummate skill, Lin Pingzhi felt greatly rewarded, but couldn’t help watching with bright eyes.
Not just him.
Some escorts and servants in the residence heard the commotion and flocked over to watch, when they understood the situation, they were all shocked and changed colors.
When they realized there was someone like Ding Ling present,
the master of the young leader of their Escort Agency, everyone was surprised, yet overjoyed.
With such a master watching over Fuwei Escort Agency, who would dare to offend?!
Boom boom boom!

The final time Ding Ling and Bai Wushuang’s palms collided, Ding Ling stepped back a few paces, and Bai Wushuang also gracefully retreated like a butterfly. She looked at Ding Ling and said with a smile:
"Your strength is extraordinary. Your palm techniques are varied, either vigorous, fierce, strange, or gentle. And each has been cultivated to the realm of transformation.
In this regard, I am far inferior to you."

When Ding Ling competed with her, he used all his moves, employing the Chain Palm, Eight Trigrams Palm, Iron Sand Palm, Lion Palm, and Python Palm in succession, not to mention operating the Four Great Breathing Techniques at full speed to amplify his palm power. In addition, the meager inner power fused with the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, creating a bizarre explosion-like change in the palm force.
Every time such a palm force struck, Bai Wushuang’s hand would tremble slightly.
Yet even so.
It seemed that both sides were only evenly matched.
Truly difficult to determine superiority.
Ding Ling observed Bai Wushuang calmly.
Was she really Dongfang Bubai? Bai Wushuang did not admit it, and Ding Ling found it hard to conclude.
Since Bai Wushuang said she was Bai Wushuang.
Ding Ling decided to call her that for now:
"Miss Bai’s palm technique is like floating clouds, vigorous like iron, also very remarkable. Admirable."
"Haha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed heartily, so much so that the peach tree leaves nearby trembled wildly:
"Ding Ling, your palm power is mighty, your body hard like leather, extremely fast, and with strong endurance. In terms of physical qualities, you indeed overpower everyone.
But it seems your inner power is very low."
She became somewhat curious:
"In your Lower Realm, do you cultivate Breathing Techniques? Or Body Refining Techniques?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling was very candid:
"If I had a few months to cultivate inner power. I would definitely surpass you in inner strength. Next time we compete, the result would be entirely different."
Ding Ling earnestly wanted the Tai Chi Scripture.
But he could not defeat Bai Wushuang.
He could only use a Provocation Technique.
Bai Wushuang was taken aback, then laughed and said:

"Good, good, good! Then I’ll give you a few months. As long as you can defeat me as agreed, I will still present you with the Tai Chi Scripture. Today I’ve also witnessed the abilities of a Void Shatterer, so I won’t linger here any longer. We will meet again if fate allows."
As her voice fell.
Bai Wushuang suddenly leaped high, stepping on the void, condensing lotus blossoms, and flew more than ten meters away, lightly landing on the tip of a tree, seemingly about to ’fly away.’
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but shout loudly:
"Bai Wushuang. You haven’t said how my master should find you then!"
"Six months later. Huashan Peak!"
The voice drifted from afar.
When the last word ’peak’ was heard.
Bai Wushuang’s figure had already faded into the depths of the void, her trace vanished.
"Such strong body technique, such fast speed!"
Lin Pingzhi was startled:
"Almost indistinguishable from an immortal!"
Saying this.
Lin Pingzhi’s gaze towards Ding Ling grew more respectful.
To compete in palm power to a draw with such an individual. How remarkable is that?!
Moreover, listening to Bai Wushuang’s tone.
His own master was at an impasse solely due to lacking inner power.
If the inner power were slightly stronger...
Just thinking about it.
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but feel his blood boil.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling also felt a sense of urgency.
Six months’ time.
Huashan Peak.
Could it be that Bai Wushuang was planning some kind of Huashan Sword Discussion?
Indeed.
It seems many experts in the Martial World have such quirks!

Especially the experts of the Celestial Dragon, Eagle Shooter, Divine Eagle, etc., with the worlds of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer and Divine Eagle being directly inherited, having this ’quirk’ is quite normal.
Ding Ling no longer had doubts, he was pondering how to learn the Dugu Nine Swords, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and other techniques.
Reading through The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
The Five Mountains Sword Sect engaged in internecine conflict, the Sun and Moon Divine Sect ended up half-crippled, and Wudang had no outstanding successors. Only Shaolin stood firm and radiant!
To say there was no manipulation?
Ding Ling didn’t believe it.
How could there be such coincidences?
It must be known the Qi Sect and Sword Sect struggle at Huashan started over a Sunflower Manual, and the origin of the Sunflower Manual was in Shaolin Temple!
At that time, it was when the Huashan Sect was flourishing and overshadowing Jiuzhou, Shaolin Temple could barely compete.
And after the Sword Qi struggle, the Huashan Sect declined completely.
Shaolin Temple returned to being the Mount Tai and Beidou of Martial Arts.
Many times in this world you can infer the process through the result and the beginning.
The beginning is the Sunflower Manual leading to various great battles;
The result is Shaolin Temple benefiting.
During the process, did Shaolin Temple fan the flames? No one can say for sure.

But Ding Ling felt that in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, Shaolin Temple certainly didn’t shy away from doing such things. To steal the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and other supreme skills from Shaolin, Ding Ling felt very justified.
In Ding Ling’s view, as long as it wasn’t something belonging to a pure, filial person like Lin Pingzhi, what he could take without hesitation didn’t need excessive courtesy.
Being overly courteous would seem too contrived and hypocritical.
Being a person requires freedom, grandeur, and decisiveness.
Earlier indecision due to Lin Pingzhi’s situation was purely from having interacted with Lin Pingzhi, along with the influence of original works, TV series, etc., leading to that judgment.
After battling Bai Wushuang.
Ding Ling had a feeling of enlightenment.
Being a person should be about indulging in desires and enmities, why be timid, assuming a frail demeanor?

The final time Ding Ling and Bai Wushuang’s palms collided, Ding Ling stepped back a few paces, and Bai Wushuang also gracefully retreated like a butterfly.
She looked at Ding Ling and said with a smile:
"Your strength is extraordinary.
Your palm techniques are varied, either vigorous, fierce, strange, or gentle.
And each has been cultivated to the realm of transformation.
In this regard, I am far inferior to you."

When Ding Ling competed with her, he used all his moves, employing the Chain Palm, Eight Trigrams Palm, Iron Sand Palm, Lion Palm, and Python Palm in succession, not to mention operating the Four Great Breathing Techniques at full speed to amplify his palm power.
In addition, the meager inner power fused with the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, creating a bizarre explosion-like change in the palm force.
Every time such a palm force struck, Bai Wushuang’s hand would tremble slightly.
Yet even so.
It seemed that both sides were only evenly matched.
Truly difficult to determine superiority.
Ding Ling observed Bai Wushuang calmly.
Was she really Dongfang Bubai?
Bai Wushuang did not admit it, and Ding Ling found it hard to conclude.
Since Bai Wushuang said she was Bai Wushuang.
Ding Ling decided to call her that for now:
"Miss Bai’s palm technique is like floating clouds, vigorous like iron, also very remarkable.
Admirable."
"Haha..."
Bai Wushuang laughed heartily, so much so that the peach tree leaves nearby trembled wildly:
"Ding Ling, your palm power is mighty, your body hard like leather, extremely fast, and with strong endurance.
In terms of physical qualities, you indeed overpower everyone.
But it seems your inner power is very low."
She became somewhat curious:
"In your Lower Realm, do you cultivate Breathing Techniques?
Or Body Refining Techniques?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling was very candid:
"If I had a few months to cultivate inner power.
I would definitely surpass you in inner strength.
Next time we compete, the result would be entirely different."
Ding Ling earnestly wanted the Tai Chi Scripture.
But he could not defeat Bai Wushuang.
He could only use a Provocation Technique.
Bai Wushuang was taken aback, then laughed and said:
"Good, good, good!
Then I’ll give you a few months.
As long as you can defeat me as agreed, I will still present you with the Tai Chi Scripture.
Today I’ve also witnessed the abilities of a Void Shatterer, so I won’t linger here any longer.
We will meet again if fate allows."
As her voice fell.
Bai Wushuang suddenly leaped high, stepping on the void, condensing lotus blossoms, and flew more than ten meters away, lightly landing on the tip of a tree, seemingly about to ’fly away.’
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but shout loudly:
"Bai Wushuang.
You haven’t said how my master should find you then!"
"Six months later.
Huashan Peak!"
The voice drifted from afar.
When the last word ’peak’ was heard.
Bai Wushuang’s figure had already faded into the depths of the void, her trace vanished.
"Such strong body technique, such fast speed!"
Lin Pingzhi was startled:
"Almost indistinguishable from an immortal!"
Saying this.
Lin Pingzhi’s gaze towards Ding Ling grew more respectful.
To compete in palm power to a draw with such an individual.
How remarkable is that?!
Moreover, listening to Bai Wushuang’s tone.
His own master was at an impasse solely due to lacking inner power.
If the inner power were slightly stronger...
Just thinking about it.
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t help but feel his blood boil.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling also felt a sense of urgency.
Six months’ time.
Huashan Peak.
Could it be that Bai Wushuang was planning some kind of Huashan Sword Discussion?
Indeed.
It seems many experts in the Martial World have such quirks!

Especially the experts of the Celestial Dragon, Eagle Shooter, Divine Eagle, etc., with the worlds of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer and Divine Eagle being directly inherited, having this ’quirk’ is quite normal.
Ding Ling no longer had doubts, he was pondering how to learn the Dugu Nine Swords, Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic, and other techniques.
Reading through The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
The Five Mountains Sword Sect engaged in internecine conflict, the Sun and Moon Divine Sect ended up half-crippled, and Wudang had no outstanding successors.
Only Shaolin stood firm and radiant!
To say there was no manipulation?
Ding Ling didn’t believe it.
How could there be such coincidences?
It must be known the Qi Sect and Sword Sect struggle at Huashan started over a Sunflower Manual, and the origin of the Sunflower Manual was in Shaolin Temple!
At that time, it was when the Huashan Sect was flourishing and overshadowing Jiuzhou, Shaolin Temple could barely compete.
And after the Sword Qi struggle, the Huashan Sect declined completely.
Shaolin Temple returned to being the Mount Tai and Beidou of Martial Arts.
Many times in this world you can infer the process through the result and the beginning.
The beginning is the Sunflower Manual leading to various great battles;
The result is Shaolin Temple benefiting.
During the process, did Shaolin Temple fan the flames?
No one can say for sure.
But Ding Ling felt that in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, Shaolin Temple certainly didn’t shy away from doing such things.
To steal the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic and other supreme skills from Shaolin, Ding Ling felt very justified.
In Ding Ling’s view, as long as it wasn’t something belonging to a pure, filial person like Lin Pingzhi, what he could take without hesitation didn’t need excessive courtesy.
Being overly courteous would seem too contrived and hypocritical.
Being a person requires freedom, grandeur, and decisiveness.
Earlier indecision due to Lin Pingzhi’s situation was purely from having interacted with Lin Pingzhi, along with the influence of original works, TV series, etc., leading to that judgment.
After battling Bai Wushuang.
Ding Ling had a feeling of enlightenment.
Being a person should be about indulging in desires and enmities, why be timid, assuming a frail demeanor?

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Enlightened Mindset! At the Inn (3/11)
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s mental cultivation has improved.
He sees the future path more clearly now.
Step by step.
Every time Ding Ling takes a step, he undergoes subtle transformations.
It seems in the early days of the Three Kingdoms World, he was somewhat inexperienced, almost losing composure when meeting Zhen Jiang.
Later, as his strength grew and status elevated.
His mindset naturally evolved rapidly, becoming more steady and mature.
Towards women, he no longer had that immature mentality, becoming more casual, accepting, calm, and indifferent.
And just after the battle with Bai Wushuang.
It made Ding Ling realize what makes a hero, what constitutes ease and grandeur!
As a man.
If he couldn’t even surpass a woman.
No.
The opponent might not even be a woman!
If he couldn’t surpass such a person, could he even call himself a man?
Ding Ling seems to have felt the Ren and Du Meridians open.
His breath slightly fluctuated, growing more bold and fierce, but soon, it gathered within him, calm and without a ripple.
Lin Pingzhi sensed something, glancing at Ding Ling with some doubt, then wisely followed Ding Ling forward.
Early the next morning.

The Squad Leader of the Fuwei Escort Agency’s branch came to find Ding Ling and Lin Pingzhi, mentioning the matter of the Great Medicine, and emphasized that another batch of Great Medicine had arrived. However, the branch’s explicit accounts didn’t have enough funds, requiring approval from someone with authority like Lin Zhennan or Lin Pingzhi to use the reserve account.
Ding Ling was delighted.
He didn’t expect the Fuwei Escort Agency to be so efficient.
He had originally thought he might have to stay a few more days, but now he didn’t have to, which was naturally better.
Lin Pingzhi immediately approved.
The Squad Leader took the orders and left.
But half an hour later.
The Squad Leader hurried back, kneeling in front of Lin Pingzhi, tremblingly saying:
"Young Leader. Our Great Medicine has been stolen!"
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
Now, even Bai Wushuang, who is likely Dongfang Bubai, knows that Ding Ling is a Void Shatterer.
It’s unlikely that other well-known figures wouldn’t know.
Since they know, they should also know he is at the Fuwei Escort Agency. So daring to snatch the Fuwei Escort Agency’s goods like this.
Is this provocation?
Or disregard?
Or perhaps just pure ignorance?
"Who?!"
Lin Pingzhi slapped the table in shock and anger:
"Simply bold as brass!"
The entire family in Fuzhou City was almost wiped out by the Qingcheng Sect.
Lin Pingzhi is very sensitive to such matters, and upon hearing this, his heart inevitably surged with anger.
"I don’t know. But after that person stole our medicine, they calmly went to an inn. I had someone guard there. That person shouldn’t have left yet."
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling stood up:
"Let’s go and see."
This is a batch of Great Medicine.
Not just one or two stalks.
So much Great Medicine even requires using the Fuwei Escort Agency’s reserve account, indicating the significant quantity.
Ding Ling’s capabilities had surged enormously after consuming Great Medicine.
Now, he’s also quite eager for Great Medicine.
Someone dared to pluck the tiger’s whiskers at this moment, naturally, he wouldn’t tolerate it.
"Yes."
The Squad Leader rejoiced.
He had witnessed Ding Ling’s abilities firsthand and believed with Ding Ling taking the action, victory would surely be achieved.
Clip, clop!
The group rode out of the mansion.
Before long.
They arrived at an inn.
Ding Ling leaped lightly off the horse, landing silently, eliciting a wave of cheers nearby.
Ding Ling looked towards the sound and saw another group of players incompatible with the natives; seeing Ding Ling looking at them, they waved excitedly, shouting:
"Ding Ling, idol. Can I become your apprentice?"
Ding Ling twitched at the corner of his eye, awkwardly laughed twice, and didn’t respond to them, lifting his leg to enter the inn.
In response.
The players weren’t disappointed.
After all, rumors had it that someone offered a billion to be Ding Ling’s apprentice, and he refused. Could they successfully trick him without an offer?
Things must be looked at optimistically; what if one day Ding Ling suddenly had a lapse in judgment and accepted?
People should dream big!
Creak, creak!
Ding Ling stepped on the wooden stairs of the inn, producing creaking sounds.
"It’s him."
Just stepping onto the second floor, before fully standing, the Squad Leader pointed to a robust, defiant-eyed man, who was drinking heavily.
That man was sitting aggressively on a stool, across from him sat a young, beautiful nun, with an innocent face.
This nun’s beauty was rich as spring blossoms, graceful like the autumn moon, akin to a Bodhisattva sitting in a nunnery, emanating a sacred, inviolable aura.
Her beauty, upon anyone seeing it, would instantly dispel all desires!
This was a nun beautiful enough to make any man feel compassion and protective intent!
The nun seemed to have heard the Squad Leader’s voice, glanced over, directly meeting Ding Ling’s gaze, seemingly seeing Ding Ling’s purely appreciative gaze without any disrespect.
The nun blushed slightly, embarrassed, and turned her head away.
"So it’s you!"
The man saw the Squad Leader bringing two people over and began scrutinizing them closely, noticing one was a young, graceful youth with splendid looks and weak demeanor;
The other was tall and upright, with handsome features and deep aura.
He couldn’t help but burst into laughter:
"What? Just because I took some of your herbs, you think you need to bring people to corner me, Tian Boguang?!"
"Ten Thousand Miles Solo, Tian Boguang?!"
The Squad Leader was startled, involuntarily stepped back, but soon regained composure. He now had a backer, and stood up straight, moving forward two steps, slightly behind Ding Ling:
"Even if you’re Tian Boguang, so what. A person should be reasonable. You took my Fuwei Escort Agency’s medicine, you must return it."
"Knowing it’s me and still having the courage to ask for the medicine."
Tian Boguang slammed the wine bowl heavily on the table, startling the nun across who shivered slightly.
Tian Boguang smiled slightly seeing this:
"Little beauty, no need to worry. Once I’m healed, I’ll strip you naked and have some fun."
The nun’s face paled, lips tightened, seemingly wanting to say something but, seeing Ding Ling approaching, she closed her mouth.
Ding Ling stood not far in front of Tian Boguang, expressionlessly extending his hand, and said:
"Return the items."
"I’ve already ordered the Great Medicine to be boiled. You are late."
Tian Boguang looked at Ding Ling with a strange expression:

"Young man, don’t be unwise. Among those who collided with me, no less than hundreds made it out safely. I spared a life today, didn’t harm him, yet he foolishly brings you two rookies to corner me. Hahaha..."
He laughed heartily, looking down on Ding Ling, standing tall, his voice suddenly becoming low and commanding:
"Is it because you think I am easy to talk to, or that your Martial Arts are superior to mine?"
