chapters.title: Chapter 297: Ding Ling vs. Tian Boguang
paragraphs: "I think my martial arts are definitely better than yours."
Ding Ling suddenly struck with his palm, slapping towards Tian Boguang.
"Hahaha..."
Tian Boguang laughed heartily, his voice resounding in all directions:
"Alright, alright, let me see what tricks you have!"
Before the sound had fallen.
Tian Boguang’s eyes flickered with a fierce gleam, his hand moved like lightning, suddenly grabbing the saber hilt, clang!
The blade unsheathed, turning into a ribbon, and cut heavily towards Ding Ling’s palm!
This strike was as swift as light, the attack like a waterfall crashing down.
If even slightly unguarded, it would hit.
Ding Ling’s hand would definitely be ruined.
The nun seemed to discern the situation, unable to refrain from exclaiming ’Careful!’
Lin Pingzhi looked on, feeling a chill in his heart, somewhat worried.
Nearby spectators, travelers on both sides of the upper floors, guests couldn’t help but turn their eyes to watch.
Bang bang!
Ding Ling’s palm flew swift as forest leaves, with each strike falling, it seemed as if a great mountain pressed down to the ground, yet this Palm Force was extremely clever and swift!
He could often attack Tian Boguang from incredible angles.
The two exchanged no less than ten moves in a blink of an eye!
Each move collided with shadow and blade, issuing a loud bang.
After ten moves.
Ding Ling stood firm as a mountain.
Tian Boguang was shaken till his hand went numb, unable to resist leaping back a few steps, looking at Ding Ling with a solemn expression:
"Who are you? What was that palm technique you just used? Why is it so fierce?!"
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled, drawing the Giant Que Sword from his back, the sword tip pointed directly at Tian Boguang:
"If you want to know who I am, once I defeat you, I will tell you!"
Ding Ling is no longer who he used to be.
After a series of power improvements.

He now far surpasses his clash with Yu Canghai, and after some encounters with Bai Wushuang, his confidence has soared. Although he admits he cannot sweep across the world, there aren’t many who can stop him.
Now with Tian Boguang, this filthy thief, before him, how could Ding Ling hold back?
Without waiting for Tian Boguang to reply.
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Qing Frost Swordsmanship!
Moon Shadow Swordsmanship!
Pine Wind Swordsmanship!
All kinds of extraordinary and magical sword techniques were effortlessly mastered by Ding Ling, with each move and stroke being extraordinary.
Yet when the Floral Sword Map flickered through the void, upon closer look, it was as if a crescent moon fell to the earth.

Tian Boguang was greatly shocked, instinctively wanted to flee, but couldn’t bear to leave the nun at the inn and the Great Medicine being prepared in the kitchen. More crucially, Ding Ling’s sword tip pointed directly at his vital spot; if he fled blindly, he’d likely be stabbed fatally and die on the spot.
Thinking of this.

Tian Boguang yelled, channeling all his inner strength, infusing into his blade, deploying the Gale Blade Technique, each strike swift as lightning, accompanied by endless gales, chopping heavily towards Ding Ling’s head.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
A saber and a sword soon clashed together!
Both weapons moved so fast their blades were barely visible, even those skilled found it dizzying, while less adept spectators found continued viewing unsettling and nauseating.
Clang clang clang!
The clash of weapons filled the inn with resounding clinks!
From the high second floor, a scholarly middle-aged man accompanied by a jade-like beautiful young girl intently observed this battle.
As he watched.

He saw a sword floating like an immortal, sometimes casting a hellish shadow across the world, sometimes like a hidden fire of rampant blaze, secretly perturbed, for he discerned Ding Ling’s sword technique seemed to contain the battlefield prowess of spear skill, and each was mastered to the level of mastery.
’Remarkable.’
He internally praised.
The young girl beside him didn’t understand.
She only saw sword shadows and flashes of the blade through the sky; within moments, Tian Boguang had already lost several fingers, his swift blade dropping to the ground.
Unable to resist standing up in delight, she cheered loudly.
The girl knew no taste of sorrow, only knowing Tian Boguang’s notorious name as the filthy thief, and with someone eliminating him, how could she resist clapping and cheering?
All the onlookers turned pale, for the first time truly scrutinizing this young Ding Ling.
Yet Ding Ling paid no heed to the travelers and guests around, instead twisting the sword point, resting on Tian Boguang’s neck, indifferently demanding:
"Where is the Great Medicine?"
Tian Boguang’s face turned ash-gray, looking at Ding Ling in shocked terror.
Just because his swift blade couldn’t keep up with Ding Ling’s swift sword, totally overwhelmed!
In this world, there actually exists someone faster than his blade!
Moreover, still so much younger than him.
His heart was momentarily filled with discouragement, frustration, and despair, even forgetting the pain of severed fingers.
Once hearing Ding Ling’s voice.
He seemed to snap back to senses, inadvertently breathing in pain sharply.
Staring at his severed fingers, his face turned pale and bitterly smiled:
"The Great Medicine is one-third simmering in the kitchen. The remaining two-thirds is hidden in my bundle. That bundle is..."
He didn’t conceal it, speaking frankly.
Ding Ling signaled the Squad Leader to check.

The Squad Leader paused, then turned urgently. At this moment, he revered Ding Ling’s words like a Holy Decree, never imagining the renowned Ten Thousand Miles Solo, Tian Boguang, could be so easily defeated by Ding Ling! So formidable!
Not long after.
The Squad Leader hurried back, now carrying a bundle.
Inside hidden with numerous Great Medicine.
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief. With the Great Medicine safe, he could bring it back to use.
"Wh-whose honorable name?"
Tian Boguang held back the pain and asked.
"Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!"
Tian Boguang seemed confused:
"Such a familiar name."
It seemed he had certainly heard of some stories about Ding Ling from some players, although his focus was on the nun, momentarily forgetting was normal.
He just said:
"Now that the Great Medicine is returned and I am injured, can we consider this settled?"
"You’re fooling yourself."
Ding Ling swiftly drew his sword.
Clang!
A slash right through Tian Boguang’s crotch!
Upon further look.
Blood was already pouring from below Tian Boguang.
He seemed to realize something, unable to resist crying in anguish.
"Hiss!"
The spectators, particularly the men, instinctively clutched below, breath sharply drawn as if sharing the pain.
"Doesn’t it seem excessive to push so hard, Sir?"
A loud voice suddenly called from the doorway.
The nun’s body trembled, following the sound, seeing a slick, unrestrained figure, exclaiming:
"Brother Linghu!"
"Yilin."
Brother Linghu holding a sharp sword, smiled gently at the nun:
"I’m glad you’re alright."
Yilin blushed slightly, bowing her head.
But soon.
She seemed to recall something, involuntarily glancing at Ding Ling.
This suddenly appeared handsome man.

Tian Boguang yelled, channeling all his inner strength, infusing into his blade, deploying the Gale Blade Technique, each strike swift as lightning, accompanied by endless gales, chopping heavily towards Ding Ling’s head.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
A saber and a sword soon clashed together!
Both weapons moved so fast their blades were barely visible, even those skilled found it dizzying, while less adept spectators found continued viewing unsettling and nauseating.
Clang clang clang!
The clash of weapons filled the inn with resounding clinks!
From the high second floor, a scholarly middle-aged man accompanied by a jade-like beautiful young girl intently observed this battle.
As he watched.

He saw a sword floating like an immortal, sometimes casting a hellish shadow across the world, sometimes like a hidden fire of rampant blaze, secretly perturbed, for he discerned Ding Ling’s sword technique seemed to contain the battlefield prowess of spear skill, and each was mastered to the level of mastery.
’Remarkable.’
He internally praised.
The young girl beside him didn’t understand.
She only saw sword shadows and flashes of the blade through the sky; within moments, Tian Boguang had already lost several fingers, his swift blade dropping to the ground.
Unable to resist standing up in delight, she cheered loudly.
The girl knew no taste of sorrow, only knowing Tian Boguang’s notorious name as the filthy thief, and with someone eliminating him, how could she resist clapping and cheering?
All the onlookers turned pale, for the first time truly scrutinizing this young Ding Ling.
Yet Ding Ling paid no heed to the travelers and guests around, instead twisting the sword point, resting on Tian Boguang’s neck, indifferently demanding:
"Where is the Great Medicine?"
Tian Boguang’s face turned ash-gray, looking at Ding Ling in shocked terror.
Just because his swift blade couldn’t keep up with Ding Ling’s swift sword, totally overwhelmed!
In this world, there actually exists someone faster than his blade!
Moreover, still so much younger than him.
His heart was momentarily filled with discouragement, frustration, and despair, even forgetting the pain of severed fingers.
Once hearing Ding Ling’s voice.
He seemed to snap back to senses, inadvertently breathing in pain sharply.
Staring at his severed fingers, his face turned pale and bitterly smiled:
"The Great Medicine is one-third simmering in the kitchen.
The remaining two-thirds is hidden in my bundle.
That bundle is..."
He didn’t conceal it, speaking frankly.
Ding Ling signaled the Squad Leader to check.
The Squad Leader paused, then turned urgently.
At this moment, he revered Ding Ling’s words like a Holy Decree, never imagining the renowned Ten Thousand Miles Solo, Tian Boguang, could be so easily defeated by Ding Ling!
So formidable!
Not long after.
The Squad Leader hurried back, now carrying a bundle.
Inside hidden with numerous Great Medicine.
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
With the Great Medicine safe, he could bring it back to use.
"Wh-whose honorable name?"
Tian Boguang held back the pain and asked.
"Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?!"
Tian Boguang seemed confused:
"Such a familiar name."
It seemed he had certainly heard of some stories about Ding Ling from some players, although his focus was on the nun, momentarily forgetting was normal.
He just said:
"Now that the Great Medicine is returned and I am injured, can we consider this settled?"
"You’re fooling yourself."
Ding Ling swiftly drew his sword.
Clang!
A slash right through Tian Boguang’s crotch!
Upon further look.
Blood was already pouring from below Tian Boguang.
He seemed to realize something, unable to resist crying in anguish.
"Hiss!"
The spectators, particularly the men, instinctively clutched below, breath sharply drawn as if sharing the pain.
"Doesn’t it seem excessive to push so hard, Sir?"
A loud voice suddenly called from the doorway.
The nun’s body trembled, following the sound, seeing a slick, unrestrained figure, exclaiming:
"Brother Linghu!"
"Yilin."
Brother Linghu holding a sharp sword, smiled gently at the nun:
"I’m glad you’re alright."
Yilin blushed slightly, bowing her head.
But soon.
She seemed to recall something, involuntarily glancing at Ding Ling.
This suddenly appeared handsome man.

chapters.title: Chapter 298: Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill Full Level (5/11)
paragraphs: Extraordinary demeanor, noble temperament mixed with some overbearing aura, sharpness, and sanctity!
He seemed like a Sword God or a Medical Saint descended to the mortal world.
Yilin just looked on and instinctively developed a liking for Ding Ling.
When Ding Ling stepped forward to confront Tian Boguang, this liking elevated to a rather high degree.
She was very aware of how terrifying Tian Boguang was.
Knowing it was Tian Boguang face-to-face and still daring to act, that courage alone was commendable!
Yilin felt anxious at the time, wanting to persuade Ding Ling not to fight Tian Boguang to avoid suffering.
But she couldn’t manage to speak before Ding Ling was already engaged with Tian Boguang.
She could only remind Ding Ling to be ’careful’.
However, what happened next surprised her greatly.
Ding Ling suppressed Tian Boguang throughout the fight, and in just a moment, Tian Boguang suffered greatly, even having his fingers sliced off.
This astounding ability left Yilin dazzled.
While she was in a daze, she heard a familiar voice, and upon looking closely, it turned out to be the Brother Linghu she had been longing for.
But at this moment Brother Linghu seemed to have a conflict with Ding Ling; she instinctively stood up to urge peace, but Ding Ling ignored Brother Linghu.
This made Yilin heave a sigh of relief.
Clatter!

The Giant Que Sword in Ding Ling’s hand shook, and during the clattering, Tian Boguang’s upper body clothing was chopped to tatters. Ding Ling saw a booklet fall out from his bosom, his eyes gleamed, and before Tian Boguang could reach for it, the tip of the sword flicked.
The booklet flew up.
Ding Ling reached out and grabbed it right into his hand.
"Return, return my secret manual."
Tian Boguang looked at Ding Ling with eyes filled with anger and murderous intent, his face flushed red from the agony or the uncontrollable fury:
"You, you are despicable and shameless!"
"Ha."
Ding Ling let out a light scoff, too lazy to argue with Tian Boguang, and immediately started quickly flipping through the secret manual.
He swiftly scanned the text.
Soon, half of the booklet was read.
A book materialized in the library.
In an instant.
[Gale Blade Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Another high-tier Sword Technique!
In an instant, Ding Ling mastered the Swordsmanship to the stage of mastery, at a high level.
Various incredible fast Sword Techniques surged and rolled over in the Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling didn’t ponder long and continued to flip through the secret manual.
He flipped through the pages swiftly.
Soon he finished reading the other half of the booklet.
A book condensed again in the library.
[Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.1]
An absolutely rare high-tier Lightweight Skill!
Once reaching full level and mastery.
Ding Ling felt the meridians in the bones of his legs expand and stretch, his agility became much higher, and his speed and reflexes seemed to reach a new level.
Ding Ling sensed that if he used the Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill now, he would indeed be as fast as a gale, as fierce as a storm!
This Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill was a highly advanced lightweight body technique for long-distance sprinting, exceedingly rare.
After skimming through the entire booklet.
Ding Ling completely understood why Tian Boguang was reputed for his solo travels, why his blade technique was superb, and his lightness skill was so advanced that few could rival or capture him.
Both were high-tier premium Techniques.
Tian Boguang seemed to have mastered them to a very high degree, earning fame across Jiuzhou was naturally expected.
However, this booklet did not contain records of Tian Boguang’s Inner Power Heart Method or other Techniques.
Ding Ling felt a tinge of regret.
But he didn’t ponder more and just tossed the booklet back to Tian Boguang, staring at him and said:
"I’m returning your booklet. Now tell me your Inner Power Heart Method. If you do so, I may spare your life."
’Haha.’
Tian Boguang let out a miserable laugh:
"I, Laozi, have roamed the world; didn’t expect to fall into the hands of a nobody today. That’s fine, you even stripped me of my rights as a man. Now you want my Inner Power Heart Method? Bah!"
He disdainfully spat in Ding Ling’s direction.
Ding Ling sighed.
The Giant Que Sword in his hand trembled, and then he slashed it towards Tian Boguang’s neck.
Given that he was a sworn enemy, and the fact that Ding Ling despised filthy thieves like him the most, how could he let him go after capturing him?
Since the Inner Power Heart Method couldn’t be obtained, Ding Ling wouldn’t press further, he intended to kill Tian Boguang to eliminate future threats.
Clang!

A sword stabbed in from the side, precisely blocking Ding Ling’s sword edge, Ding Ling raised his eyebrows and glanced sideways, seeing Brother Linghu, whom Yilin had mentioned, looking at him with intense anger:
"Spare when possible; you’ve already injured him critically, the punishment is heavy enough, why must you kill him?"
"And who might you be?"
Ding Ling sneered.
He had a guess in mind.
Sure enough.
"Linghu Chong!"
"Disciple of Huashan Sect, Linghu Chong?"
"Indeed."
Linghu Chong said in a loud voice:
"I am acquainted with this Tian Boguang, I hope you can do me a small favor."
"Brother Linghu, don’t plead with him."
Tian Boguang, clutching his neck, looked at Ding Ling with vicious eyes:
"Today, Laozi admits defeat! But if you ever suffer a mishap in the future, I will never forgive you."
"Heh."
Ding Ling let out a light sneer:
"One is from a reputable sect, the other an infamous filthy thief. I don’t care how you two are entangled. But Tian Boguang’s nature is vile!
The number of women he has violated and humiliated is unknown!
Did you ever consider what would become of the women he violated?
In such an era, they would rather die than live, or directly commit suicide in no small number.
The resulting broken families, ruined lives, who is to blame? Who can take responsibility?! Ha..."
He looked coldly at Linghu Chong:
"Can you, Hero Linghu Chong, take responsibility?"
"This..."
Linghu Chong was speechless, his face changed color.
Tian Boguang’s face also turned unpleasant, he opened his mouth, still wanting to argue.
But claps rang from above:
"Well said, well said. Hero Ding Ling, quickly kill this filthy thief. Rid the world of a major scourge."
It was a clear-eyed, red-lipped, white-toothed pretty girl.
The scholarly man beside the pretty girl also seemed to agree with Ding Ling’s words, nodding slightly in approval towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling nodded kindly at the two, then turned his gaze, abruptly shook his sword again, and stabbed towards Tian Boguang once more.
Linghu Chong instinctively blocked it.
Clang!
Another clash of swords.
This time Ding Ling used seventy percent strength, with many Breathing Techniques augmenting simultaneously.
How could Linghu Chong withstand it?

His palm shook, the tiger’s mouth cracked open on the spot, causing him to grunt, and the sword in his hand was knocked out, flying away and spinning in the air, piercing into a plank nearby with a puff.
Linghu Chong’s face changed drastically, just about to speak again.
Swoosh!
The sharp tip of the sword sliced across Tian Boguang’s neck.
Accompanied by a soaring column of blood, a large head rolled and tumbled to Linghu Chong’s feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: Linghu Chong! Yilin
paragraphs: Linghu Chong slightly lowered his head and could see the face of Tian Boguang, who died with his eyes open.
His body trembled slightly, as he looked angrily at Ding Ling:
"You!!"
"What’s with you?"

A beautiful girl with bright eyes and a good-natured look jumped down from a high place, cheerfully walked to Ding Ling’s side, first showing a brilliant smile to Ding Ling, then suddenly turned her head to Linghu Chong, and said coldly:

"It’s a disgrace that you’re a disciple of a renowned sect! Can’t distinguish between right and wrong, and actually consider Tian Boguang a friend, an old acquaintance. So what? Did you both visit a brothel to drink flower wine together?
Or did you bully some maiden together?!"
"I, I did not!"
Linghu Chong’s face turned red, pointing at the beautiful girl:
"You, you’re slandering me!"
"Why should I slander you?"
The beautiful girl snorted disdainfully, then pointed her finger towards the crowd.
"Many heroes and warriors here saw you help Tian Boguang repeatedly! And they all heard Tian Boguang call you Brother Linghu!
You’ve become brothers with the infamous filthy thief!
What more do you have to say!"
She made a face at Linghu Chong:
"Your master must be ashamed. He actually raised a fool like you who can’t tell right from wrong!"
"You!"
Linghu Chong was so furious that he was about to explode on the spot.
On the other side, a refined man called out:
"Feifei, that’s enough. Let’s go."
"Alright."
The beautiful girl no longer paid attention to Linghu Chong, just waved to Ding Ling with a smile:
"Hero Ding Ling, I’ll come to see you in the future for fun."
Ding Ling smiled and nodded.
The beautiful girl was delighted:
"Then I’ll take it as you agreeing. By then, don’t shut the door on me."
"Let’s go."
The refined man had already walked up close, glancing at the beautiful girl.
The beautiful girl let out an ’oh’ and followed obediently behind the refined man, keeping back glancing at Ding Ling, clearly having a great liking for him.
[Achievement Medal Earned: Intimidating Tian Boguang]
[Annotation: Tian Boguang roamed the Jianghu without any scruples. Even renowned sect leaders he disregarded.
Because of his nature, he toyed with countless women.
He considered his Lightweight Skill unrivaled, and Saber Technique the fastest, thinking as long as he was careful, no accident would happen.
But unexpectedly, he was completely defeated in this Yanhui Pavilion. He never thought that such a master like you would be hidden in an escort agency he casually robbed!
If given a chance to redo, he would never rob the escort agency’s goods!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Intimidating Linghu Chong.]
[Annotation: Linghu Chong is carefree, acting as he pleases. After many battles with Tian Boguang, they became friends due to mutual admiration. For a friend, he would fight against injustice.
Initially thought you could give the Huashan Sect some face, but you showed no mercy. With one strike, you shocked him, making him realize the gap between you two was as wide as a Celestial Abyss.
His heart was filled with shock.
He never imagined there could be such a young and skillful master like you in the world!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have won Qu Feiyan’s recognition.]
[Annotation: Qu Feiyan is smart, lively, and clear in her likes and dislikes. Your initiative, decisiveness, martial bravery, speech, and sword skill have greatly intrigued and attracted her.]
Another three achievement medals.
Entering The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, having already obtained over ten achievement medals.
Ding Ling exhaled a breath.
With a flick of the sword tip, Tian Boguang’s Secret Manual was tossed towards Lin Pingzhi’s direction, who clumsily caught it.
As for his master’s martial arts, Lin Pingzhi was full of admiration.
Tian Boguang, such a capable person, was easily killed by his master, and the Huashan disciple Linghu Chong, who tried to stop his master, couldn’t even hold against one move.
Filled with infinite admiration, he secretly vowed to practice diligently, to avoid repeating the disaster in Fuzhou City! He did not want to experience such misfortune again!
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced at Yilin, seeing her eyes solely focused on Linghu Chong, said no more, just walked past her with Lin Pingzhi and others down the stairs, and left directly.
"Cough, cough."
Linghu Chong coughed twice.

The brief clash with Ding Ling made him feel as if he was facing a Divine Mountain, in just one exchange of blows, not only did his tiger’s mouth get torn, but his inner organs seemed to have suffered an injury. Having been provoked several times by Qu Feiyan afterward, he finally couldn’t hold back, coughing up blood.
Yilin, startled, turned slightly pale, stepped forward with a concerned look at Linghu Chong:
"Brother Linghu, are you okay?"
"I, I’m fine."

Linghu Chong looked at Ding Ling’s departing figure, not daring to step forward to stop, then glanced at Tian Boguang’s corpse, his heart filled with boundless desolation, couldn’t help but look at Yilin, and asked:
"Did I do wrong? Shouldn’t I have aided Tian Boguang?"
"This..."
Yilin hesitated for a moment, then clasped her hands together, solemnly saying:

"I am a Buddhist sect disciple, never taking life. But the Buddhist sect also speaks of cause and effect, retribution. Tian Boguang did countless evils, ending up like this is his own fault, Brother Linghu, why cling to it?
"Even you don’t approve of me?!"
Linghu Chong’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"Brother Linghu."
Yilin blushed slightly:
"Of course, I’m on your side. But what Hero Ding Ling said makes sense. Tian Boguang oppressed too many women, killed too many people.
He deserved to go to hell and face Buddha’s judgement."
"Heh heh."
Linghu Chong gave a bitter smile, abandoning his sword, stumbled, ready to leave.
Yilin hurried forward to support him.
Linghu Chong rejected:
"You are from the Buddhist sect. I am a wanderer of Jianghu. The Buddhist sect values cause and effect, we better not get too involved."
With that, he broke free from Yilin’s hand, went down the stairs, and walked into the distance.
Yet he was so struck that he began to doubt life, momentarily even neglecting to collect Tian Boguang’s corpse.
"Brother Linghu, Brother Linghu..."
Yilin called several times, seeing Linghu Chong ignoring her, her eyes reddened.
Recalling how she had focused entirely on Linghu Chong earlier, she hadn’t even had the chance to thank Ding Ling for his help.
She could not help feeling embarrassed and ashamed.
She stood there, her heart surging with emotions, momentarily dazed.
The matter of Ding Ling killing Tian Boguang.
It caused a great commotion locally!
Many people began to inquire about who Ding Ling was, someone who could easily kill a first-class expert like Tian Boguang!
Due to curiosity, martial artists came in an endless stream to visit the Fuwei Escort Agency branch.
Ding Ling did not see guests.
Lin Pingzhi personally received them.
Watching these martial heroes praise his master with admiration.
Lin Pingzhi could not help but feel a deep sense of honor!
His heart shone with pride!
In the next couple of days.

Your initiative, decisiveness, martial bravery, speech, and sword skill have greatly intrigued and attracted her.]
Another three achievement medals.
Entering The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, having already obtained over ten achievement medals.
Ding Ling exhaled a breath.
With a flick of the sword tip, Tian Boguang’s Secret Manual was tossed towards Lin Pingzhi’s direction, who clumsily caught it.
As for his master’s martial arts, Lin Pingzhi was full of admiration.
Tian Boguang, such a capable person, was easily killed by his master, and the Huashan disciple Linghu Chong, who tried to stop his master, couldn’t even hold against one move.
Filled with infinite admiration, he secretly vowed to practice diligently, to avoid repeating the disaster in Fuzhou City!
He did not want to experience such misfortune again!
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced at Yilin, seeing her eyes solely focused on Linghu Chong, said no more, just walked past her with Lin Pingzhi and others down the stairs, and left directly.
"Cough, cough."
Linghu Chong coughed twice.

The brief clash with Ding Ling made him feel as if he was facing a Divine Mountain, in just one exchange of blows, not only did his tiger’s mouth get torn, but his inner organs seemed to have suffered an injury.
Having been provoked several times by Qu Feiyan afterward, he finally couldn’t hold back, coughing up blood.
Yilin, startled, turned slightly pale, stepped forward with a concerned look at Linghu Chong:
"Brother Linghu, are you okay?"
"I, I’m fine."

Linghu Chong looked at Ding Ling’s departing figure, not daring to step forward to stop, then glanced at Tian Boguang’s corpse, his heart filled with boundless desolation, couldn’t help but look at Yilin, and asked:
"Did I do wrong?
Shouldn’t I have aided Tian Boguang?"
"This..."
Yilin hesitated for a moment, then clasped her hands together, solemnly saying:
"I am a Buddhist sect disciple, never taking life.
But the Buddhist sect also speaks of cause and effect, retribution.
Tian Boguang did countless evils, ending up like this is his own fault, Brother Linghu, why cling to it?
"Even you don’t approve of me?!"
Linghu Chong’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"Brother Linghu."
Yilin blushed slightly:
"Of course, I’m on your side.
But what Hero Ding Ling said makes sense.
Tian Boguang oppressed too many women, killed too many people.
He deserved to go to hell and face Buddha’s judgement."
"Heh heh."
Linghu Chong gave a bitter smile, abandoning his sword, stumbled, ready to leave.
Yilin hurried forward to support him.
Linghu Chong rejected:
"You are from the Buddhist sect.
I am a wanderer of Jianghu.
The Buddhist sect values cause and effect, we better not get too involved."
With that, he broke free from Yilin’s hand, went down the stairs, and walked into the distance.
Yet he was so struck that he began to doubt life, momentarily even neglecting to collect Tian Boguang’s corpse.
"Brother Linghu, Brother Linghu..."
Yilin called several times, seeing Linghu Chong ignoring her, her eyes reddened.
Recalling how she had focused entirely on Linghu Chong earlier, she hadn’t even had the chance to thank Ding Ling for his help.
She could not help feeling embarrassed and ashamed.
She stood there, her heart surging with emotions, momentarily dazed.
The matter of Ding Ling killing Tian Boguang.
It caused a great commotion locally!
Many people began to inquire about who Ding Ling was, someone who could easily kill a first-class expert like Tian Boguang!
Due to curiosity, martial artists came in an endless stream to visit the Fuwei Escort Agency branch.
Ding Ling did not see guests.
Lin Pingzhi personally received them.
Watching these martial heroes praise his master with admiration.
Lin Pingzhi could not help but feel a deep sense of honor!
His heart shone with pride!
In the next couple of days.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Power Rises Again! Elder Fei of the Great Songyang Hand
paragraphs: Lin Pingzhi was in high spirits.
His steps were brisk as if walking with the wind.
When had he ever encountered so many heroes of the martial arts world?
Overwhelmed by the accolades from these martial arts heroes, he momentarily lost his bearings.
Just as a robust man of eight feet, with a broad chest and shoulders, carrying three treasure swords, approached him, a chill went through his heart, and he hurriedly said:
"I did not know that Elder Fei of the Great Songyang Hand was coming; forgive me for not welcoming you from afar!"
"It’s I who came uninvited. How could you possibly be at fault?"
Elder Fei of the Great Songyang Hand looked at Lin Pingzhi with a smile, glanced around, and said:
"Why don’t I see Ding Ling?"
"My master is in seclusion for training."
"Already so strong and still practicing martial arts every day, it truly is commendable."
Elder Fei of the Great Songyang Hand praised him, then shifted the topic, saying:
"Please pass on a message to Ding Ling, telling him that Fei Bin, the fourth junior brother of the Mount Songh Sect’s sect leader, has come to pay his respects. I hope to have an audience."
"This..."
Lin Pingzhi hesitated.
Fei Bin’s expression darkened:
"What is it? I personally came to visit. Are you going to refuse?"
A powerful and imposing aura emanated from him, transforming into a surging wave, pressing down on Lin Pingzhi.
Lin Pingzhi’s breath caught, and he couldn’t help but step back two steps.

With that, he snapped out of his euphoric daze, truly realizing for the first time that the respect and approval others had for him, and the flattering words they spoke, were all because of his master Ding Ling.
He was, after all, just a small character.
If he offended a master, others could easily manipulate him!
Thinking of this.
A chill ran through Lin Pingzhi’s heart, and he said solemnly:
"I wouldn’t dare."
"If you don’t dare, why are you still standing here in a daze?"
Fei Bin looked coldly at Lin Pingzhi.
Lin Pingzhi, feeling aggrieved, bowed to Fei Bin before turning to look for Ding Ling.
There was a certain deep-seated dissatisfaction in his heart along the way.
He had treated Fei Bin quite courteously.
Yet, Fei Bin completely disregarded him, only ever mentioning his master.
However, reminded of his own meager martial power, he felt powerless, for in the world of Jianghu, it is a survival of the fittest, where the strong are revered.
Being weak, he deserved to be looked down upon!
Having been with Ding Ling for some time now, Lin Pingzhi’s perspective had somewhat broadened, yet the recent ups and downs had left him somewhat impatient and restless.
When he finally reached Ding Ling’s quarters, he still couldn’t calm down.
Knock knock!
He took a deep breath and then knocked on the door.
"Come in."
The familiar voice rang out.

Hearing this, Lin Pingzhi felt as if he were bathing in a spring breeze; the Great Demon God in his eyes had now become his most admired person and the greatest pillar of support for Fuwei Escort Agency. Without Ding Ling, Fuwei Escort Agency certainly wouldn’t have been peaceful; it would have likely been destroyed long ago.
Thinking of this, Lin Pingzhi’s gratitude towards Ding Ling grew stronger. Upon entering, he immediately performed the disciple’s salute, showing utmost reverence to Ding Ling.
What kind of person was Ding Ling?
He immediately saw that Lin Pingzhi had something on his mind, and casually asked a few questions.
How could Lin Pingzhi dare to hide anything? He recounted everything truthfully, without any embellishment.
Even so.
Ding Ling’s eyebrows slightly raised, and he sneered:
"The Mount Songh Sect’s reach is too far."
"Master."
Lin Pingzhi said cautiously:
"I heard that the Mount Songh Sect’s influence is exceedingly grand, virtually the most powerful among the Five Mountains Sword Sect!
In recent years, they have stirred up a great momentum in Jianghu, subduing countless Black Dao figures!
Our Fuwei Escort Agency is isolated and weak; should we provoke them, we won’t have any good outcome."
Seemingly fearing Ding Ling’s misunderstanding, he quickly added:

"Of course, no matter what Master does, Fuwei Escort Agency will always stand by Master’s side; even if Master wants us to go through hell and high water, we would go without the slightest hesitation!"
He spoke seriously and earnestly.
It was clear to see.
He wasn’t lying.

In truth, this is what Lin Pingzhi always believed in his heart: without Ding Ling, Fuwei Escort Agency would have long been destroyed, their entire family exterminated. Surviving until now was all due to Ding Ling’s beneficence. How could they possibly oppose Ding Ling?
"I am content with your loyalty."
Ding Ling patted Lin Pingzhi’s shoulder, saying:
"You can go out first. Let that Fei Bin wait for an hour or two. If he’s unwilling to wait, tell him to come back at the same time tomorrow."
"Yes, Master."
Lin Pingzhi retreated respectfully.
Before long.
The sound of footsteps gradually grew distant.
It seemed that Lin Pingzhi was going to inform Fei Bin.
Ding Ling didn’t concern himself further with these matters.
Instead, he turned to the side to continue consuming the Great Medicine.
Before Lin Pingzhi came, he had already consumed a total of 39 two-hundred-year-old Great Medicines.
The increase in four-dimensional attributes:
[Strength +1.4]
[Agility +1.4]
[Constitution +1.4]
[Defense +1.4]
The more he chewed and consumed, the weaker the medicinal effects became towards the end.
No need to say.
It must have developed resistance.
In this regard.
Ding Ling was no stranger to such occurrences, having experienced them in the Three Kingdoms World, and was not surprised.
"Previously, eating a total of 30 of the 200-year Great Medicines increased the four dimensions by 2.4."
Now, eating 39.
Yet only reached 1.4.
Ding Ling pondered that if he continued to consume more, the increase might come to a halt.
Thus, he decided not to continue eating, but instead planned to use these Great Medicines to cultivate Inner Power.

After all, the Spiritual Mechanism and Primordial Qi contained within the Great Medicines were extremely abundant, and using the Inner Power Heart Method to absorb and refine these sources into Inner Power would be much faster than absorbing and refining from the external world.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
Strength: [Bone structure 2 (ordinary people are 1 point), Wisdom 3, Strength 36.9, Agility 37.3, Constitution 36.9, Defense 36.5, Charm 11. Inner Power Value: 20]
The ingestion of the Great Medicine, along with the growth brought by the Gale Blade Technique and so on, led to the strengths listed above.
"The 100-year Great Medicine is almost useless to me now; there’s no need to consume it anymore. I can use it to concoct medicine for cultivating Inner Power."
Ding Ling skipped over the 100-year Great Medicines.
Directly picked up the 300-year Great Medicine.
There were only 2 of the 300-year type.
Ding Ling crunched through a few mouthfuls, finishing them.
The increase in four-dimensional attributes:
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
Previously, the increase in four-dimensional attributes from consuming one 200-year was 0.1.
Now, consuming one 300-year also results in a 0.1 increase.
It is clear that with the enhancement of strength, resistance also increases.
In future, the assistance from the Great Medicine to him will become weaker and weaker.
But Ding Ling didn’t mind this.
As long as he is strong enough, he will always find a way to acquire better Great Medicines!
His current strength once again increased to:
[Strength 37.1, Agility 37.5, Constitution 37.1, Defense 36.7]
Reaching this level.
By using the Heaven-Flipping Palm under the amplification of the Four Great Breathing Techniques simultaneously, Ding Ling’s power was immense, enough to easily topple a First-class Supreme expert!
Upon reaching the First-class Realm, each point of improvement becomes hard to come by.
Ding Ling’s continuous advancement was as easy and simple as drinking water or eating food.
Moreover, his Breathing Technique is at the Perfect Level.
The cumulative amplification effect brought by the Four Great Breathing Techniques is also extremely terrifying, further enhanced by using a High Tier Palm Technique.
